evidence.readmeExcerpt: # image-scout **Give your agent eyes.** Find a real photograph on the public web, download it, and prove it is a real image before the rest of your workflow touches it. [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4b6bfb)](#install) [![No API key](https://img.shields.io/badge/API%20key-not%20required-brightgreen)](#) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-22%2B-339933)](package.json) `image-scout` is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that bundles one agent skill and one zero-dependency Node.js CLI. It answers the question agents are bad at: *is this URL actually a photo, and can I trust it?* ```console $ image-scout search --query "red telephone box" --limit 3 SEARCH wikimedia: "red telephone box" -> 3 result(s) 1. File:Red telephone box, St Paul's Cathedral, London, England, GB, IMG 5182 edit.jpg [JPEG 3608x5509] license: CC0 - Christoph Braun page: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Red_telephone_box,_St_Paul%27s_Cathedral,… image: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/56/Red_telephone_box%2C_St_Paul… $ image-scout download --from search --image-url "https://upload.wikimedia.org/…/Red_Telephone_Box_Defibrillator.jpg" \ --out output/reference/red-telephone-box-01.jpg --license "CC BY-SA 4.0 - Sebastiandoe5" VERIFY_OK: JPEG 5184x3888 10160640 bytes SAVED: output/reference/red-telephone-box-01.jpg META: output/reference/red-telephone-box-01.jpg.json ``` ## What it does | Command | What it guarantees | |---|---| | `search` | Queries the Wikimedia Commons or Openverse API; returns title, pixel size, licence, author, file page and direct image URL | | `list` | Fetches a page and extracts ``, `srcset` and `og:image` candidates, with the full-size URL when it can derive it | | `download` | Downloads one URL, **refuses URLs that are not on the declared page**, then checks magic bytes, dimensions and file size before writing | | `verify` | Re-checks any file on disk with the same three checks | No daemon, no cache directory, no config file, no API key, no npm dependencies. ## Install ### DeepSeek Harness (the plugin) ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-image-scout@2.0.2 ``` The registry copy is immutable and ships its own `integrity` metadata, so it installs cleanly under the `nodeLinker: hoisted` setting DSH profiles use — the failure mode that bare remote tarball URLs hit does not apply here. `2.0.2` was published on 2026-11-07 and is `latest`: the registry tarball is 28,461 B (sha256 `d2af2746…`) and byte-identical to the [v2.0.2 release asset](https://github.com/2039108952x-lab/image-scout/releases/tag/v2.0.2). Check it yourself with `npm view dsh-image-scout@2.0.2 dist.integrity`; the release procedure is documented in [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md). Prefer a git checkout? The pinned-tag form works too: ```bash # Pin a release tag so reinstalls stay reproducible. dsh plugin --profile web add github:2039108952x-lab/image-scout#v2.0.2 ``` Restart the profile (or wait for the skill watcher). The bundle registers a skill-filesystem provider pointing at its own `skills/` directory, so **`image-scout` is available immediately** — no copy into `~/.dsh/skills`, no config edit. Check it loaded: ```bash dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep image-scout ``` Remove it again with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-image-scout`. Two environment problems show up on Windows and are worth knowing before you blame the plugin: | Symptom | Cause | Fix | |---|---|---| | `ERR_PNPM_MISSING_TARBALL_INTEGRITY` | DSH profiles set `nodeLinker: hoisted`; pnpm 11.7 writes no `integrity` for a **bare remote tarball URL** and then rejects its own lockfile entry. Only the `add https://…/x.tgz` install form hits this — npm specs, `github:` and local files are unaffected. | Use the npm or `github:` form above, or install a local `.tgz` (see below). | | `fetch failed` / `ECONNREFUSED` | GitHub needs the proxy | Export it in **lower case** — pnpm and `git ls-remote` read `https_proxy` / `http_proxy`, not the upper-case spelling: `$env:https_proxy='http://127.0.0.1:7897'; $env:http_proxy=$env:https_proxy` | Local-file fallback (verified on a clean profile): download `dsh-image-scout-2.0.2.tgz` from the [release](https://github.com/2039108952x-lab/image-scout/releases/tag/v2.0.2) and run `dsh plugin --profile web add C:\path\to\dsh-image-scout-2.0.2.tgz`. **Upgrading from a tarball install?** The v2.0.0 release asset was overwritten twice (26,733 B → 26,759 B) and has been withdrawn — the tag stays, the asset is gone. An old lockfile that pinned it records an `integrity` for bytes that no longer exist, so it keeps working only while pnpm's store holds a copy and fails with an integrity mismatch as soon as the store is cleared or the machine changes. Reinstall with the npm or `github:` command above. ### Any other agent The CLI is the interface; the skill file is the instructions. Both live in [`skills/image-scout/`](skills/image-scout/): ```bash git clone https://github.com/2039108952x-lab/image-scout.git node image-scout/skills/image-scout/scripts/image-scout.mjs search --query "mountain lake" --limit 5 ``` - **Claude Code / Codex / Cursor**: point your skill directory at `skills/image-scout/`, or copy it into `~/.claude/skills/`. - **Clients with `web_fetch` + `import_web_image` but no shell** (Reasonix): the original tool-native instructions are preserved in [`legacy/reasonix/`](legacy/reasonix/SKILL.md). > `image-scout` is a community plugin. It is not an official DeepSeek product and is not > affiliated with Wikimedia or Openverse. ## Quick start ```console $ image-scout search --query "cat portrait" --source openverse --limit 3 SEARCH openverse: "cat portrait" -> 3 result(s) 1. Cat portrait [image 1024x819] license: BY-SA 2.0 - solarisgirl page: https://www.flickr.com/photos/7252160@N04/33533092025 image: https://live.staticflickr.com/3679/33533092025_a4d3c17e1f_b.jpg ``` Pick a result, download it, keep the sidecar: ```console $ image-scout download --from search \ --image-url "https://live.staticflickr.com/3679/33533092025_a4d3c17e1f_b.jpg" \ --out output/reference/cat-01.jpg --license "BY-SA 2.0 - solarisgirl" VERIFY_OK: JPEG 1024x819 118343 bytes SAVED: output/reference/cat-01.jpg ``` If you found the image on a page instead, hand the page in and let the CLI re-check it: ```console $ image-scout list --page-url "https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?search=cat&title=Special:MediaSearch&type=image" --limit 5 CANDIDATES: 5 (from https://commons.wikimedia.org/…) 1. https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/…/250px-Cat.jpg full: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/…/Cat.jpg alt: Cat sitting on a wall $ image-scout download --page-url "https://commons.wikimedia.org/…" \ --image-url "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/…/Cat.jpg" --out output/reference/cat-02.jpg ``` ## Why not just fetch the URL? Because "downloaded" is not the same as "got an image". A consent wall, a 429 page, a hotlink-protection redirect and a 250 px thumbnail all return HTTP 200. `download` therefore checks, in order: 1. **Provenance** — the URL must appear on the page you named (query strings and Wikimedia thumb sizes are normalised, so the full-size URL of a listed thumb is accepted). 2. **Magic bytes** — JPEG, PNG, GIF or WEBP signature; an HTML error page never passes. 3. **Dimensions** — parsed from the header (`SOF` for JPEG, `IHDR` for PNG, the frame header for GIF/WEBP) without decoding the pixels. 4. **Size floor** — rejects tracking pixels and placeholders below `--min-bytes` (2 KB default). 5. **Atomic write** — temp file + rename, so an interrupted download cannot leave a truncated image that later looks valid. Anything else exits non-zero and writes nothing. ## Sources and licences | Source | How | Notes | |---|---|---| | **Wikimedia Commons** | `--source wikimedia` (default) | Highest resolution, licence + author in the API response, mostly CC | | **Openverse** | `--source openverse` | Aggregates Flickr and others; check for `NC` (no commercial) and `ND` (no derivatives) | | **Any page** | `list` + `download --page-url` | Works on gallery and article pages; often only a thumbnail is embedded | Every download writes `.json` with the source URL, licence (when passed with `--license`), dimensions and timestamp. Keep it — that is your attribution record. The image keeps its own licence; MIT here covers the code and the skill text only. ## Layout ```text image-scout/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle → cordis.patch.yml ├── cordis.patch.yml # registers the bundled skills/ directory ├── lib/index.js # package entry + skill-root resolver ├── skills/image-scout/ │ ├── SKILL.md # what the agent reads │ └── scripts/image-scout.mjs # the CLI (only node: builtins) ├── test/ # node:test, no network required ├── legacy/reasonix/ # the v1 tool-native skill, kept for web_fetch clients ├── release.json └── CHANGELOG.md ``` ## Requirements - Node.js 22.19+ or 24+ (the CLI uses `parseArgs`, `fetch`-free `http`-level proxy support and native ESM). - Outbound HTTPS to `commons.wikimedia.org`, `upload.wikimedia.org` and (optionally) `api.openverse.org`. Behind a proxy, set `HTTPS_PROXY` or pass `--proxy`. - No dependencies. `npm install` installs nothing, because there is nothing to install. ## Troubleshooting | Symptom | Fix | |---|---| | `cannot reach … ECONNRESET` / timeout | Set `HTTPS_PROXY`, or pass `--proxy http://host:port` | | `HTTP 429` (Openverse) | Wait a minute, lower `--limit`, or use Wikimedia | | `REJECT: image_url is not present on …` | Copy the exact URL from the file page, or pass `--allow-unlisted` when you know the source | | `magic bytes are not JPEG/PNG/GIF/WEBP` | The server returned HTML (consent wall, error page); fetch with a browser and use `--html-file`, or pick another result | | `refusing private or loopback host` | SSRF guard; use a public URL, or `--allow-private-hosts` for trusted LAN sources | | Dimensions print `?x?` | Unusual header; the file is still valid, confirm visually | Run `image-scout --help` for the full flag list; every command accepts `--json`. ## 中文说明 [`README.zh.md`](README.zh.md) — 同样的内容，中文版，面向不想读英文的使用者。 ## Contributing Issues and PRs are welcome. The most useful report is a **failure case**: which page, which error, what you expected. The test suite runs offline (`npm test`); add a fixture when you fix an HTML-parsing bug. ## License MIT © 2026. Images keep the licence their source states.

# DS Usage

独立的 DeepSeek Harness 用量插件：Token 账本、按厂商的走势图、热力日历，统计这台 DSH 上每一次模型调用。

数据全量从 Session 日志重建，账本存在自己的 `$DSH_HOME/ds-usage` 下，不依赖任何其他插件。

## 它做什么

- **逐调用记账**：扫每个 Session 的日志（历史调用也计入），日志之外的调用（压缩、标题、识图等）在流经时实时计量。
- **用量窗口**：侧边栏底部的「用量」按钮打开——Token 总量、缓存命中率、输出、调用次数，按厂商堆叠的走势图，厂商排行，近一年活跃度热力图。
- **按厂商计**：排行榜一行一个厂商（DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、GPT、Claude…），不管走的是哪个渠道、哪一档模型。同一个模型换了中转站或改了写法（`deepseek-flash` 与 `deepseek-v4.1-flash`、`claude-haiku-5.5` 与 `claude-haiku-5-5`）仍算一行。
- **钻取**：点任意厂商看它的单独页面，里面列出该厂商自己各个模型的用量；时间范围支持预设（24 小时～12 个月）和日历自定义。
- **中文界面**：默认中文，也可跟随 DSH 的语言设置。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/ds-usage-0.2.5.tgz
```

或手动装进 profile（`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`）：

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add /path/to/ds-usage-0.2.5.tgz
```

`package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明让 dsh 启动时自动挂载 host 插件；浏览器侧通过 `dsh.client` 清单发现 `client.js`。装好后重启 DeepSeek Harness。

## 语言

窗口默认中文。想跟随 DSH 的语言设置，在浏览器控制台执行：

```js
localStorage.setItem('ds-usage.language', 'auto')   // 跟随应用
localStorage.setItem('ds-usage.language', 'en')     // 强制英文
localStorage.setItem('ds-usage.language', 'zh')     // 强制中文（默认）
```

## 从源码构建

```bash
npm install          # 只需要 esbuild
npm test             # 账本与数据层的测试
npm run build        # 生成 client.js（构建产物已提交，装 tarball 无需构建）
```

## 结构

```
src/host/index.js    插件壳：rt（state/load/warn/catalog）+ POST /api/usage 路由
src/host/usage.js    用量账本：扫描 Session 日志、实时计量、SQLite、厂商归并
src/client/          浏览器侧：UsagePage、对话框、i18n、样式、API
client.js            构建产物（esbuild bundle）
cordis.patch.yml     挂载声明
```

## 数据

账本在 `$DSH_HOME/ds-usage/usage.sqlite`（SQLite，WAL 模式）。删掉它下次启动会全量重扫 Session 日志重建。

## 许可

Apache-2.0。用量账本与页面源自 [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot)（Apache-2.0）的 Usage 功能，提取后改造为独立插件。

Its POST /api/usage handler accepts supplied records without an explicit owner admission check in the inspected handler; host-wide admission remains unverified. No lifecycle hook. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# @vfvrpq/dsh-file-explorer

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@vfvrpq/dsh-file-explorer?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vfvrpq/dsh-file-explorer)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@vfvrpq/dsh-file-explorer?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)

给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个 VSCode 风格的「文件夹 + 文件预览器」：左侧栏多一个图标入口，点开是主区域的文件树、打开的 tab 与文本 / Markdown / 图片预览。

![面板](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-file-explorer/main/docs/panel.png)

> npm 上的 `dsh-file-explorer` 是另一个作者的同名插件，本包使用 `@vfvrpq/` scope 区分，两者不冲突、可共存。

## 界面

| 文件树 + 代码预览 | Markdown 渲染 |
|---|---|
| ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-file-explorer/main/docs/panel.png) | ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-file-explorer/main/docs/markdown.png) |

| 图片预览 | 文件名搜索 |
|---|---|
| ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-file-explorer/main/docs/image.png) | ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-file-explorer/main/docs/search.png) |

| 点文件直接进右侧栏文档预览 |
|---|
| ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-file-explorer/main/docs/right-panel.png) |

## 它做什么

- **左侧栏入口**：注册在 `sidebar.panellist` 槽位，id 与主面板 key 同为 `file-explorer`，点图标即切到面板。
- **文件树**：懒加载（展开才列目录）、文件夹优先排序、按后缀着色的类型徽标、隐藏文件开关、目录树宽度可拖。
- **打开文件**：单击文件就在**面板内**预览——左边树、右边一张独立的预览卡片（tab、面包屑、行号/图片/渲染后的 Markdown，状态栏显示字节、行数、是否截断），不跳走。展开过的文件夹会按根记住，刷新后树还在原处。
- **交给右侧栏（可选）**：面包屑旁的「在右侧打开」把当前文件送进会话的右侧文档预览（内置渲染器：代码/PDF/Office…）。注意右侧栏属于会话，所以这个动作会让会话回来、面板让位；想每次点文件都这样做，把 `openInRightPanel` 设为 `true`。
- **用默认程序打开**：面包屑旁与**右侧文档工具栏**各有一个按钮，`POST` 到认证路由 `?op=open`，把当前文件交给系统默认程序（Windows `start` / macOS `open` / Linux `xdg-open`）。可执行后缀（exe/bat/cmd/ps1…）默认拒绝，`GET` 一律 405，避免预取或误点直接跑程序。
- **多 tab**：tab 关闭、活动文件高亮、面包屑、状态栏（字节 / 行数 / 是否截断）。
- **预览**：
  - 文本：等宽字体 + 行号 + 自动换行开关，单文件默认最多 1 MiB、最多渲染 4000 行；
  - Markdown：标题 / 列表 / 引用 / 代码块 / 链接 / 图片，相对图片走原始字节路由，可一键切回源码；
  - 图片：png / jpg / gif / webp / avif / bmp / ico / svg；
  - 其它二进制：只显示类型与大小，不加载内容。
- **搜索**：按文件名在当前根目录内递归搜索（受目录数、命中数、时间三重预算约束）。

## 安装

DSH 0.2 预览版，插件是标准 bundle（包内带 `dsh.bundle.patch`）：

```bash
# 装进某个 profile（会同时写 dependencies 与 dsh.profile.bundles）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @vfvrpq/dsh-file-explorer@0.1.0
```

或者手写进 profile 的 `package.json`：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": { "@vfvrpq/dsh-file-explorer": "0.1.0" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ ..., "@vfvrpq/dsh-file-explorer" ] } }
}
```

也可以只在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里挂一行（**两种方式不要同时用**，`insert` 不按 id 去重，会挂载两次）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: file-explorer
      name: "@vfvrpq/dsh-file-explorer"
      config:
        enabled: true
```

宿主半随 Host 启动加载，客户端半由页面加载；装好后重启一次 DSH（或让 Loader 重载），侧栏就会出现「文件浏览」图标。

> 不要用 `link:` / 目录 junction 安装：`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 由宿主在 profile 的 `node_modules` 里解析，软链会被 Node 还原成源码真实路径，从那里向上找不到宿主包，插件会以 `failed to import` 静默不激活。用 npm 安装或 `file:` tar 包（真实拷贝）。

## 配置

配置层在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config` 下，字段与默认值：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 关掉后路由不再响应，但侧栏入口仍在 |
| `routePath` | `/api/file-explorer` | 认证路由，必须以 `/api/` 开头才能吃到连接层的鉴权围栏 |
| `extraRoots` | `[]` | 额外可浏览的绝对目录（除了工作区、默认目录、进程目录、主目录） |
| `includeHome` | `true` | 是否把用户主目录作为根 |
| `ignored` | `[]` | 列表与搜索里隐藏的条目名，例如 `node_modules` |
| `maxTextBytes` | `1048576` | 文本预览上限（超出截断并标注） |
| `maxRawBytes` | `33554432` | 原始字节路由上限（图片预览） |
| `defaultShowHidden` | `false` | 文件树初始是否显示点文件 |
| `openInRightPanel` | `false` | 设为 `true` 时，点文件改为送进右侧栏文档预览（右侧栏属会话，面板会让位）；默认留在面板内预览 |
| `allowOpenWithDefaultApp` | `true` | 是否显示「用默认程序打开」按钮；关掉后 `?op=open` 直接 403 |
| `blockedOpenExtensions` | `exe,com,bat,cmd,msi,scr,pif,vbs,vbe,ps1,reg,sh,command,app,desktop` | 启动器拒绝交给系统处理的后缀（这些交给 shell 会变成"执行"）；设空数组表示不拦 |

## 权限模型

这个插件只读，并且**不接受任意路径**：

1. 可浏览的根 = 已注册工作区 + 默认工作目录 + 进程目录 + 主目录 + `extraRoots`，去重后只保留真实存在的目录；
2. 每次请求的 `path` 都会用 `ctx.fs.resolve` 解析成稳定 target，再用 `ctx.fs.contains(root, target)` 证明它落在某个根内，否则 403；
3. 路由挂在 `/api/` 下，继承连接层的 Host/Origin 校验与会话 cookie 鉴权；
4. 原始字节路由只对图片类型内联（带 `nosniff` + `CSP sandbox`），其它一律按附件下发，避免同源 HTML/SVG 被执行；
5. `?op=open` 只接受 `POST`（`GET` 一律 405），只接受普通文件且拒绝可执行后缀，启动命令由平台决定（`start "" <path>` / `open` / `xdg-open`），不拼接 shell 字符串。

## 目录结构

```
lib/index.js    接线：name / inject / Config / apply，注册路由 + 下发客户端配置
lib/config.js   默认值与归一化（可脱离宿主单测）
lib/schema.js   schemastery 配置（设置页用）
lib/roots.js    根目录候选、解析、去重、路径围栏
lib/files.js    列目录、读预览、递归搜索（全部走 ctx.fs）
lib/route.js    /api/file-explorer?op=roots|list|read|search|raw|open（open 仅 POST）
lib/client.js   浏览器半：侧栏图标 + 主面板（无构建，手写 ModuleLoader bundle）
test/           宿主单测 + 客户端 bundle 的结构断言
docs/           验证截图
dev/            临时 profile 端到端验证脚本
```

依赖方向严格单向：`index → route → files/roots → config`，客户端只经 HTTP 路由取数据。

## 开发与验证

```powershell
# 宿主与客户端结构单测（20 项，不需要 DSH 运行时）
node --test test\host.test.mjs test\client.test.mjs

# 端到端：建临时 profile → 装包 → 起无头 Web → Playwright 断言 17 项 → 拆掉
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File dev\verify-local.ps1

# 验证的是 registry 装下来的产物而不是源码目录（第一次就靠这条抓到 patch 里残留旧包名）
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File dev\verify-local.ps1 -PackageDir "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\@vfvrpq\dsh-file-explorer"
```

端到端脚本会验证：侧栏图标存在、面板挂载、树懒加载、`roots` 接口、文本预览内容与行号、Markdown 渲染与源码切换、Markdown 相对图片真的解码（读 `naturalWidth`）、图片预览解码、状态栏跟随活动文件、搜索命中、刷新后仍可用。截图落在 `dev/`，可复制到 `docs/`。

## 已知限制

- 只读：不提供保存、重命名、删除，避免和会话的写权限、审批策略打架。
- 无语法高亮：只做行号与类型着色，不做 tokenizer。
- 单文件渲染上限 4000 行；文本读取上限 1 MiB（都可配）。
- 搜索是文件名子串匹配，不是内容检索；单次最多开 400 个目录、4 秒预算。
- 二进制文件不给下载按钮（原始路由只服务图片内联）。

## License

MIT

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # Sqode English | [中文](README.zh.md) Sqode (`dsh`) is an open-source agent harness developed by [DeepSeek AI](https://deepseek.com). It is built on an **everything-is-a-plugin** architecture and powered by [Cordis](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis), whose design is described in [_A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability_](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.25512). # @agentsight/dsh-plugin AgentSight observability plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). ## Install From the monorepo checkout (local path): ```bash cd src/agentsight/dsh-plugin pnpm install && pnpm run build dsh plugin --profile web add . ``` Or via `--patch` for a quick trial (no profile modification): ```bash dsh --profile web --patch ./src/agentsight/dsh-plugin/cordis.patch.yml ``` ## Capabilities | Tool | Description | |------|-------------| | `agentsight_status` | Report plugin status and version | ## Development ```bash pnpm install pnpm run build ``` ## License Apache-2.0
**A**gentic **N**exus **O**perating **L**ayer & **I**nterface **S**ystem **A**rchitecture **A system software stack for AI Agents.** [中文版](README_zh.md) · [Website](https://agentic-os.sh/) · [Get Started](#get-started) · [User Guide](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/) · [Contribute](CONTRIBUTING.md) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Linux%20%7C%20macOS-lightgrey.svg)](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/getting-started/installation/) [![AARM Aligned](https://img.shields.io/badge/AARM-Aligned-blue.svg)](https://aarm.dev/builders/agentseccore-anolisa) [![OWASP Agentic Top 10: 7 Full, 3 Partial](https://img.shields.io/badge/OWASP_Agentic_Top_10-7_Full,_3_Partial-blue)](docs/user-guide/en/agent-sec-core/owasp-agentic-top10.md)
**ANOLISA is a multi-component system software stack for AI Agent workloads.** Built on existing operating system kernels and infrastructure, it provides context management, Skills delivery, workspace recovery, security, and observability for Agent applications, frameworks and platforms. **Users** can carry out tasks in a native terminal that preserves a familiar Shell experience, and enable system-level optimizations for their Agents' runtime environments. **Developers** can extend the stack through [AW's open architecture](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/developer-guide/aw/providers/) by integrating their own system software optimized for Agent workloads into ANOLISA. > **ANOLISA vs. Agentic OS:** Agentic OS describes a class of operating systems > designed for AI Agent workloads. Our community takes a neutral and open > approach to exploring this direction; ANOLISA is the core system software > stack in the Agentic OS architecture we design. ## 1. Get started ANOLISA offers three ways to get started: use a **preinstalled image** to experience the full capabilities of an Agentic OS; install the system software stack on an existing OS to **extend it into an Agentic OS**; or connect an existing Agent application, framework, or harness to **enable configurable system-level optimizations**. ### 1.1 Start from an image In a ready-to-use preinstalled system environment, you can use familiar Shell workflows in cosh and call system tools and Skills through natural language. After installing and configuring the relevant components, you can also use Agent Semantic Layer capabilities such as context compression, workspace snapshots and recovery, security, and observability. Container base images provide a starting point for building your own Agent runtime environment. The [Images and cloud services](docs/user-guide/en/getting-started/images.md) catalog lists available images, their preinstalled software, download or pull addresses, and cloud service entry points. Vendors and community contributors can add image or cloud service entries and usage instructions to the catalog. Developers of Agent platforms and Agent runtime infrastructure can preinstall ANOLISA packages in Agent, sandbox, or business images. See the [base image catalog](docs/user-guide/en/getting-started/images.md#container-base-images) and [package installation guide](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/getting-started/installation/). ### 1.2 Convert an existing OS into an Agentic OS If you already run a supported Linux system, you can install ANOLISA's system software stack to add runtime capabilities for Agent workloads. You can install cosh, OS Skills, and the Agent Semantic Layer components you need, use cosh as the terminal entry point, and configure model access and the relevant services. First read the [installation guide](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/getting-started/installation/) to check platform requirements, then install the packages and configure the services. Follow the [cosh first-use guide](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/cosh-ng/) to begin using the terminal. ### 1.3 Enable ANOLISA for an existing Agent If you want to keep using an existing Agent application, framework, or harness, you can enable ANOLISA's headless system capabilities in its runtime environment through adapters and plugins. You can continue using the Agent's interface, model account, and workflow. For the currently available workflow, see [installation and adapter integration](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/getting-started/installation/). ## 2. Why ANOLISA? **ANOLISA is a system software stack that enhances Agent applications, frameworks, and harnesses without replacing them.** When Agents plan tasks and call tools, they also need their runtime environments to provide context management, Skill discovery, action constraints, and execution records. ANOLISA improves an Agent's working environment in the following ways: - **Keep context for useful information.** Tool output compression shortens lengthy results. Persistent memory lets Agents retrieve and reuse information across sessions, reducing repeated reads. - **Find system Skills for the task.** Agents can consult OS instructions and discover and read the Skills they need for a task. - **Constrain actions and recover workspace changes.** Security policies and underlying isolation mechanisms constrain Agent actions. Workspace snapshots let users inspect file changes and roll them back when needed. - **Understand how a task ran.** You can inspect an Agent's model and tool calls, trajectories, and Token usage to investigate task failures and analyze runtime costs. We welcome **OS vendors and distribution communities** to adopt and help develop ANOLISA, integrating it into existing distributions or incorporating it into their Agentic OS architecture from the outset. **Enterprise Agent governance platform developers** and **sandbox service providers** can also preinstall ANOLISA in their runtime environments to provide context management, security, and observability for the Agent workloads they host. ## 3. Examples

Observability: Observe an Agent run
Inspect model and tool calls, execution trajectories, and Token usage.
Reproduction guide
Context compression: See tool output compression
Try Tokenless and inspect tool output compression and changes in Token usage.
Reproduction guide
Security: Detect Skill file changes
Use Qoder to check Skill file changes and inspect rescan results.
Reproduction guide
## 4. Components ANOLISA's components are organized into the User Entrypoint Layer, AW Unified Stack Layer, and Agent Semantic Layer. See the [glossary](#glossary) for each layer's role. ### 4.1 User Entrypoint Layer | Component | What it adds | |---|---| | [cosh (cosh-ng)](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/cosh-ng/) | An AI-native terminal that preserves a familiar Shell experience, letting users call tools and Skills through natural language to complete tasks. | | [OS Skills](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/os-skills/) | An OS handbook for AI Agents, covering system administration, monitoring, security, DevOps automation, and more. | ### 4.2 AW Unified Stack Layer | Component | What it adds | |---|---| | [AW](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/aw/) | A unified architecture connecting Agent frameworks with extensible AI-native system software. | ### 4.3 Agent Semantic Layer | Component | What it adds | |---|---| | [Tokenless](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/tokenless/) | Reduce AI Agent Token usage through tool output compression, tool schema simplification, command rewriting, and other techniques. | | [Agent Memory](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/agent-memory/) | Store persistent memories that Agents can retrieve and reuse in later sessions. | | [SkillFS](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/skillfs/) | Organize Skills into stable filesystem views for Agents to discover and read on demand. | | [Workspace Checkpoint (ws-ckpt)](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/ws-ckpt/) | Create Agent workspace snapshots so users can compare file differences and roll back changes when needed. | | [Agent Security Core](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/agent-sec-core/) | OS-level security kernel for AI Agents. | | [AgentSight](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/agentsight/) | Observe Agent execution through trajectories, LLM calls, and Token usage. | [ANOLISA CLI](distribution/anolisa/README.md) manages component installation and lifecycle. [ktuner](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/ktuner/) inspects Linux kernel parameters, provides tuning recommendations, and can apply or roll back kernel parameter changes. See [Installation](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/getting-started/installation/) for each component's supported platforms. ## 5. Open architecture Within ANOLISA's AW Unified Stack Layer, AW connects Agents to the system software that supports them. Developers can build adapters for Agents that AW does not yet support, or create system software optimized for Agent workloads and expose its capabilities to ANOLISA through the Provider protocol. The existing Agent application or framework continues to manage its models, interface, and permissions. AW currently integrates command safety checks and tool-content optimization, and can correlate AgentSight execution records through optional configuration. The existing operating system, kernel, and sandbox provide the underlying resources and isolation mechanisms. ANOLISA is designed for environments including AI PCs and cloud desktops, Agent applications and frameworks, Agent platforms, and Agent runtime infrastructure. ### 5.1 Configuration and execution example This example enables safety checks and context optimization in one configuration. Before running it, follow [AW installation](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/aw/installation/) to install the Linux Preview version of `aw-all-in-one` and set `AW_PREFIX` and `PATH`. Then start sec-core using the [security backend setup](https://agentic-os.sh/docs/user-guide/aw/security/). CI packages require a Linux x86_64 system with glibc 2.39 or later. You also need Qoder CLI 1.1.64 or later, installed and signed in. Run the following commands as the user who normally runs Qoder to create a new `anolisa.yaml` and start the Agent. The socket path below connects to the local trial backend in the security guide. If you are connecting to another existing security backend, set `AW_SEC_SOCKET` to that service's actual socket path. ```bash export AW_HOME="$HOME/aw" export AW_SEC_SOCKET=/run/aw-preview-sec/daemon.sock install -d -m 700 "$AW_HOME" "$AW_HOME/workspace" aw config init --prefix "$AW_PREFIX" \ --config "$AW_HOME/anolisa.yaml" --state-dir "$AW_HOME/anolisa-state" \ --qoder "$(command -v qodercli)" \ --provider sec-core+tokenless --socket "$AW_SEC_SOCKET" aw validate --config "$AW_HOME/anolisa.yaml" cd "$AW_HOME/workspace" aw run --config "$AW_HOME/anolisa.yaml" --agent qoder ``` For tool calls covered by the configuration, sec-core performs safety checks before the tool executes. After a tool succeeds, Tokenless attempts to compress supported text results. # DSH MonkeyAI Sessions

Read and continue your MonkeyAI conversations inside DeepSeek Harness.

Browse the sessions on your MonkeyAI devices, open one to read its full conversation history, and send new instructions to carry on the work you started in the MonkeyAI client — no copy-pasting context, no restarting the task. Replies stream back live, and you can stop a running turn or switch models without leaving DSH.

Authorization uses the MonkeyAI OAuth authorization-code flow with PKCE; DSH stores the resulting grant in its credential store.

## Development

The plugin targets DSH `v0.2.2-rc.1` and Node.js `>=24.9.0`.

```sh
npm test
npm run build
```

`npm test` builds the Client bundle before running tests. The build generates `client.js` and `lib/client-runtime.cjs`; both artifacts are distributed with the package.
Tests load the generated Client bundle, validate unary and duplex stream descriptors, check the `main` and `sidebar.panellist` registrations, verify stream and Remote cleanup on unload, and test PKCE state/challenge construction.
Host-service and Host-stream tests use credential-store, fetch, and WebSocket fakes to cover authorization exchange, device/session scoping, connection tickets, history and live frames, prompt delivery, connection loss, permission revocation, and read-only rejection.

The Host registers invocation descriptors through `ctx.typert`. The Client mounts the package's Remote contribution with `$mount()`. Shared Remote metadata uses the protocol package's `remote-info` entry, which has no Cordis runtime import.
The Client bundle inlines a spec-compatible copy of that factory (`src/shared/remote-info-lite.mjs`): DSH materializes only the modules listed in `dsh.client.inject`, and the protocol package's subpath entries are not seed words there.

## Authorization

The panel uses DSH's light theme for a consistent, simple look. The layout is state-driven: an unconnected panel shows a single connect card (server origin plus one primary button, with the paste-callback mode collapsed), a connected panel shows a compact toolbar (account, device, one Refresh action that loads devices and sessions together, disconnect) above the session cards, and an open session focuses the conversation with a compact header (back button, title, model switcher), an approval card with plain option buttons instead of raw JSON, and an Enter-to-send composer. Secondary actions (adding a device by machine ID, creating a new session) stay collapsed in details sections.
The device list reads the account-wide endpoint directory (`GET /api/v1/endpoints`, no runtime-API header) so every registered device appears, marking `online` from the boolean field and skipping revoked entries. Selecting a device loads its sessions automatically. Headless runtime devices that register through the separate device-code grant may not appear in that directory; for those, add a device manually by machine ID ("Device missing?..." section in the panel) - the entry is kept in browser storage and merged into the device selector.

Two authorization modes are available in the panel:

- **Automatic callback (loopback)**: the Host listens on `127.0.0.1` with a random port and the MonkeyAI server redirects to `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/oauth/callback` (officially allowed for the `monkeyai-desktop` client). On desktop the grant completes with no copy-paste; on phones the OS shows a failed connection page whose address bar keeps the full callback URL to paste as a fallback.
- **Paste callback (scheme)**: the original `monkeyai-desktop://oauth/callback` redirect for environments where loopback is rejected.

Both modes request `device:connect`, `session:read`, and `session:control` through the registered `monkeyai-desktop` public client. OAuth state and the PKCE verifier stay in the DSH Host process; the Host answers the loopback callback itself and the panel polls `authorizationStatus`.

## Sessions

Full conversation history is loaded over the runtime's HTTP read channel (`POST {http_base}/read/session` with `_monkeyai/session/messages`, paginated by cursor) instead of the bounded ACP `session/load` replay, so long sessions show every turn including the latest replies. While a turn is running the composer shows a stop button that sends `session/cancel`; the model switcher uses `_monkeyai/session/model/set` on the live session connection. Assistant messages render lightweight markdown (code blocks, inline code, bold, headings, lists).

## Installation

From npm, once published:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-monkeyai-sessions
```

From the plugin market index: enable **Custom plugin indexes** under Plugins → Experimental plugins, open **Discover**, and add this index source:

```
https://artenx.github.io/dsh-monkeyai-sessions/index.json
```

From a checkout:

```sh
npm install
npm run build
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-monkeyai-sessions-0.1.0.tgz
```

Verified against a real DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` web profile and a live MonkeyAI runtime: authorization, full history loading, prompt delivery, model switching, and turn cancellation all work end to end.

## Publishing

The package declares a DSH bundle (`dsh.bundle.patch`), a web Client (`dsh.client`), and `engines.dsh`. Host-provided modules resolve through the running DSH installation, so the only peer dependency is `@deepseek-ai/cordis`.

```sh
# Build the Client bundle and the market index
npm run build
npm run build:market

# Publish the package (requires an npm account with publish rights)
npm publish --access public
```

`scripts/build-market-index.mjs` reads published versions and their publish times from the npm registry, falling back to the current `package.json` version before the first release. The resulting `market/index.json` follows plugin market index format 1 and is deployed to GitHub Pages by `.github/workflows/market-index.yml`. Set `MARKET_INDEX_URL` to override the printed index address.

## License

MIT

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-desktop-hand

[![tests](https://github.com/AsterionZephyr/dsh-desktop-hand/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/AsterionZephyr/dsh-desktop-hand/actions/workflows/tests.yml)

Windows desktop control for a DSH agent, as eleven agent-callable tools.

> A plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).
> **Windows only.**
>
> 当前版本 **1.1.0**（2026-10-22）：在 v1.0 的抓图 / 点击 / 输入 / 聚焦四件原语之上，
> 加了 UIA 语义层、滚动、剪贴板、等待、启动应用。接口已冻结，规格见
> [`docs/DESIGN-v1.1-ui-layer.zh-CN.md`](docs/DESIGN-v1.1-ui-layer.zh-CN.md)。

---

## 特性

**抓被遮挡的窗口。** 这是本插件最重要的一条。`desktop_capture` 指定窗口时走
`PrintWindow`，抓到的是**窗口自己的内容**——即使它被别的窗口完全盖住。
抓全屏走 `CopyFromScreen`，只能抓到遮挡者。

同一时刻、同一个目标窗口，被一个最大化窗口完全盖住，两种抓法对比
（`lib/occlusion-test.ps1` 自动构造这个场景并给出客观判据）：

| 抓法 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 全屏 | **屏幕上实际可见的整屏**，即只有遮挡者，目标窗口完全不可见 |
| 指定窗口 | **目标窗口自己的尺寸与内容**，标题栏和正文清晰可见，与遮挡前的抓取一致 |

关键判据不是尺寸大小（窗口本来就可以比屏幕大），而是：
**指定窗口抓到的图既等于目标窗口自身的 rect，又不等于全屏图**——这正是
`PrintWindow` 与 `CopyFromScreen` 的分水岭。

**截图直接返回给模型。** `desktop_capture` 的结果里带图片本体，
不需要再调一次 `read_image`。

**输入绕过输入法。** `desktop_type` 走 `SendInput + KEYEVENTF_UNICODE` 直投字符。
中文、`%.15f` 这类格式符都能原样送达——用 `VkKeyScan` 走的键盘布局通路会被中文
输入法改写。

**坐标是物理像素。** 引擎每层都声明 DPI 感知，截图里的像素坐标可直接用于点击。
若截图宽与物理屏宽不一致，结果里会给出 `coordScale` 供换算。

**点击会回报落点。** `desktop_click` 校验光标最终位置并与目标比对，
落点不对会明确告诉你，而不是静默失败。

**读界面不靠像素（v1.1）。** `desktop_ui_tree` 读窗口的 UI Automation 树，逐个控件给出
`role / name / automationId / value / 屏幕边界`，可输出结构化 `nodes[]` 或纯文本 `flat`。
理论上连`ApplicationFrameWindow` 空白壳也能读（壳的像素拷不出来，控件树还在），**但前提是该应用真的暴露了 UIA 内容树** —— 这条限制很硬，见下方已知边界第一条。
`desktop_click` 可直接给 `target`（控件名）+ 可选 `role`，不必先量坐标。

**等条件，不等固定时长（v1.1）。** `desktop_wait` 等窗口出现/消失，或等某个窗口的
UIA 树里出现指定控件，替代 `Start-Sleep`。超时会带上已等待毫秒与最后一次观察到的状态。

**长文本走剪贴板（v1.1）。** `desktop_clipboard` 读写剪贴板；`keepPrevious` 会让 set
结果带上原内容 `previous`。路径、多行文本用 `set` + `desktop_type(key="ctrl+v")` 搬运。

**十一个工具（v1.1.0）：**

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `desktop_diagnose` | 体检：此刻合成输入可不可信（DPI / 屏幕 / 前台窗口 / 输入法 / 远程软件 / 光标落点稳定性） |
| `desktop_list_windows` | 列窗口：句柄、PID、进程、标题、位置尺寸、是否 UWP / 宿主壳、是否最小化 |
| `desktop_capture` | 截屏：全屏 / 指定窗口（标题或句柄）/ 区域裁切，**图片直接返回** |
| `desktop_ui_tree` | 读窗口的 UIA 树：逐个控件给 `role/name/value/边界`；结构化或纯文本（`flat`）；只对暴露 UIA 的应用有效 |
| `desktop_focus` | 把窗口拉到前台，并**报告是否真的成功** |
| `desktop_click` | 按坐标点击 / 双击 / 右键 / 拖动，带落点校验；**或按控件名点**（`target` + 可选 `role`） |
| `desktop_scroll` | 滚轮：`delta`（默认 3，正=下/右），`horizontal: true` 横向 |
| `desktop_type` | 输入文本（Unicode 直投）或发送白名单按键 |
| `desktop_clipboard` | 剪贴板 `get` / `set`；`keepPrevious` 时 set 结果带原内容 `previous` |
| `desktop_wait` | 等窗口出现/消失（`until: window/gone`）或等控件出现（`until: text`），替代固定 sleep |
| `desktop_open_app` | 搜开始菜单/桌面快捷方式启动应用（`app`）；**Store/MSIX 应用**（记事本、计算器）走 `Get-StartApps` 拿 AppID 调起；返回 pid 与窗口标题 |

**已知边界（不是 bug）：**

- **Store/MSIX 应用启动后拿不到 pid，标题也可能对不上。** Win11 的记事本/计算器没有
  `.lnk`，`desktop_open_app` 改查 `Get-StartApps` 的 AppID，交给 `shell:AppsFolder\<AppID>`
  让 shell 调起（`Start-Process` 直接调会报"找不到文件"）。副作用：`pid` 恒为 0，
  而且**窗口标题是本地化不一致的**（中文系统上记事本窗口叫 `无标题 - Notepad`），
  所以引擎用"启动前后窗口句柄差集"认领新窗口，返回 `matchedBy: "new-window"`。
  看不到 `titles` 不代表没启动成功，先用 `desktop_list_windows` 复核。
- **UWP 不是"一定抓不到"，取决于具体应用**（2026-10-22 实测两个样本）：
  - 「计算器」：**宿主壳句柄就能抓到完整内容**（`uwpWarning` 却是 true —— 底色占比 963‰，
    因为面板本身大面积同一底色）；`ui_tree` 读到 34 个按钮，`click(target="关闭 计算器")` 一次成功。
  - 「设置」：宿主壳抓到纯背景（986‰ / 18 色），必须改用 `frameHost=false` 的
    `Windows.UI.Core.CoreWindow` 句柄才拿到真内容；而它的 `ui_tree` **两个句柄都读不到**
    （frame 3 个节点 / CoreWindow 0 个）—— 这种应用只能按坐标点。
  顺序：抓壳空白 → 换另一个句柄重抓；要操作 → 先试 `ui_tree`，读不到再退回坐标。
  `uwpWarning` 只是"底色占比高"的提示，**不是判据**，一律以图为准。
- **最小化的窗口**尺寸退化，抓到的内容无意义（返回 `minimized: true`）。
- **远程会话正在操作鼠标时，合成点击不可靠**：坐标会被实时覆盖，调参无用。
  用 `desktop_diagnose` 确认，等远端空闲即可。**不要杀远程控制进程**，那会断连。
- 黑像素比例仅供参考，**不是成功判据**（实测 UWP 宿主黑像素仅 2.9%，图像却是空白框架）。

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:AsterionZephyr/dsh-desktop-hand
```

或手工安装——把仓库 clone 到任意位置，然后在 profile 的 `package.json`
（`%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness\profiles\web\package.json`）里加上**三处**：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-desktop-hand": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-desktop-hand"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [ /* ...原有条目..., */ "dsh-desktop-hand" ]
    }
  },
  "pnpm": {
    "overrides": {
      "dsh-desktop-hand": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-desktop-hand"
    }
  }
}
```

然后在 profile 目录里 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH（bundle 列表在启动时读取）。

**环境要求：** Windows 10/11、PowerShell 5.1（系统自带）、Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`。

**三处缺一不可**：只有 `overrides` 而没有 `dependencies` + `bundles` 是无效状态，不会加载。

> ⚠️ **bundle 通道和 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 手工挂载行，只能用一个。**
> 两者都写会双重挂载，工具注册时报 "already registered"，可能导致 DSH 起不来。

> ⚠️ **DSH 升级会重写 profile，把本地插件条目删掉。** 升级后请复查上面三处是否齐全。
> 细节与排查见 [`docs/COMPATIBILITY.md`](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)。

**配置项**（在 profile 里作为插件的 `config` 传入，一般不用改）：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enginePath` | 包内 `lib/desktop-hand.ps1` | 引擎脚本路径 |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | 单次调用超时（首次要编译 `Add-Type`，约 1.2 s） |
| `outputDir` | 系统临时目录 | 截图默认落盘目录 |

---

## 使用

agent 装上后会自动获得这十一个工具。两条主路径，外加长文本走剪贴板：

**A. 有画面：看图量坐标。**

```
desktop_list_windows            → 找到目标，拿句柄
desktop_capture(handle=...)     → 看图，量出要点哪里
desktop_focus(handle=...)       → 或 desktop_click 点窗口体拿焦点
desktop_type(text="...")        → 输入
desktop_capture(handle=...)     → 再看图确认结果
```

**B. 空白壳 / 不想量坐标：读 UIA 树，按控件名点。**

```
desktop_list_windows                     → 找到目标，拿句柄
desktop_capture(handle=...)              → 空白壳？不要据此判断界面状态
desktop_ui_tree(handle=..., flat=true)   → 读控件树；要结构/边界就用 nodes[]
desktop_click(handle=..., target="保存")  → 按控件名点，可加 role="button"
desktop_wait(until="text", target="已保存", handle=...)  → 等结果，不要 sleep
desktop_capture(handle=...)              → 只有需要视觉确认时才再抓图
```

**C. 长文本 / 路径 / 多行：走剪贴板。**

```
desktop_clipboard(mode="set", text="C:\path with spaces\file.txt", keepPrevious=true)
desktop_type(key="ctrl+v")                    → 目标窗口必须在前台
desktop_clipboard(mode="set", text="<上一步返回的 previous>")   → 需要还原就写回
```

### 六条使用要点

**1. 要看窗口内容就用 `window`/`handle`，不要抓全屏**——除非你确实要看屏幕上真实
可见的东西。指定窗口走 `PrintWindow`，被遮挡也能抓到目标自己的内容。

**2. 看图和点图用同一张图。** `desktop_capture` 结果的 `width` 若与物理屏宽不一致，
把该 `width` 作为 `shotWidth` 传给 `desktop_click`。一致时图中像素坐标 1:1 可用。

**3. 不要用黑像素比例判断抓取成功，必须看图。** 底色占比高时工具会给 `uwpWarning` ——
那可能真是空白壳，也可能只是界面大面积同色（计算器就误报过）。要操作就先试 `desktop_ui_tree`，
它读不到才说明该应用没暴露 UIA。
**4. 点不准或输入丢失时，先跑 `desktop_diagnose`，不要调坐标。** 它会连采两次
光标落点：稳定=可用；持续漂移=有别的输入源在覆盖（通常是远程会话）。这是环境
问题，改代码没用。

**5. 知道控件名就用 `target`，不要自己混两套坐标。** `desktop_ui_tree` 节点里的
`x/y/centerX/centerY` 是 UIA 的**屏幕边界**（物理像素），`desktop_click` 的 `x/y`
是**截图像素**（截图与物理屏不一致时按 `shotWidth` 换算）。两者语义不同；有名字就按名字点。

**6. 等界面用 `desktop_wait`，搬长文本用 `desktop_clipboard`。** 固定 sleep 要么
不够、要么白等；逐字符注入长文本慢，还可能被目标程序的自定义输入逻辑打断。

### 命令行直接调引擎

引擎也可脱离 DSH 单独使用，输出单行 JSON：

```powershell
$e = ".\lib\desktop-hand.ps1"
& $e -Action info                                    # 体检：DPI/屏幕/前台/输入法/远程软件
& $e -Action list-windows                            # 列窗口，拿句柄
& $e -Action capture -Window "Notepad" -OutPath a.png # 后台抓窗口（被遮挡也行）
& $e -Action capture -Handle 1234567 -OutPath b.png   # 按句柄抓
& $e -Action capture -FullScreen -Region "0,0,800,600"  # 全屏后裁切
& $e -Action click -X 640 -Y 360 -ShotWidth 1280      # 点击（坐标取自截图）
& $e -Action click -X 100 -Y 100 -ToX 400 -ToY 400    # 拖动（给 ToX/ToY）
& $e -Action type -Text "disp(1+1)" -Enter            # 输入（绕过输入法）
& $e -Action key -Key ctrl+s                          # 发按键
& $e -Action focus -Window "MATLAB"                   # 拉到前台
& $e -Action probe -X 400 -Y 400                      # 检测有无输入源在覆盖光标
& $e -Action ui-tree -Handle 1234567 -Flat            # 读 UIA 树（纯文本，limit 8000 字符）
& $e -Action ui-tree -Window "Notepad" -Depth 4 -MaxNodes 400 -AllNodes
& $e -Action click -Handle 1234567 -Target "Save" -Role button   # 按控件名点
& $e -Action scroll -X 640 -Y 360 -ShotWidth 1280 -Delta 3       # 纵向向下 3 格
& $e -Action scroll -X 640 -Y 360 -ShotWidth 1280 -Delta 3 -Horizontal  # 横向
& $e -Action clipboard -Mode set -Text "C:\path\file.txt" -KeepPrevious
& $e -Action clipboard -Mode get                     # 读回剪贴板
& $e -Action wait -Until text -Window "Notepad" -Target "保存" -WaitMs 10000 -PollMs 250
& $e -Action wait -Until gone -Window "Setup" -WaitMs 30000
& $e -Action open-app -Target "计算器"                # 启动并等窗口
& $e -Action open-app -Target "Notepad" -NoWait      # 只启动，不等窗口
```

v1.1 新增参数（全部可选）：`-Target`（click 的控件名 / wait 的标题或文本 / open-app 的
应用名）、`-Role`、`-Depth`（默认 3）、`-MaxNodes`（默认 200）、`-Flat`、`-AllNodes`、
`-Delta`（默认 3，正=下/右）、`-Horizontal`、`-Mode`（get|set）、`-KeepPrevious`、
`-WaitMs`（默认 10000）、`-PollMs`（默认 250）、`-NoWait`。

坐标系是**截图里的像素**。`-ShotWidth` 传你所用截图的真实宽度；截图与物理屏 1:1 时
可省略。`capture` 的结果里会给出 `coordScale` 与 `originX/originY` 供换算。

可用动作（14 个）：`info` `list-windows` `capture` `click` `move` `probe` `type` `key`
`focus` `ui-tree` `scroll` `clipboard` `wait` `open-app`。
拖动是 `click` 的参数（同时给 `-ToX`/`-ToY` 即为拖动），不是独立动作；
按控件名点同样是 `click` 的参数（给 `-Target`/`-Role`，此时不必给 `-X`/`-Y`）。

### 自检

```powershell
.\lib\link-deps.ps1               # 为脱离 DSH 的自检链接 peer 依赖
.\lib\selftest.ps1                # 37 项 — 引擎
node .\lib\selftest.mjs           # 146 项 — 工具层（11 个工具）
node .\lib\selftest-harness.mjs   # 18 项 — harness 子进程契约
node .\lib\verify-serialization-contract.mjs   # 25 项 — 宿主序列化契约
.\lib\occlusion-test.ps1          #  8 项 — 遮挡抓取（需肉眼看图）
.\lib\selftest-v11.ps1            # v1.1 语义层（ui-tree/click-target/scroll/clipboard/wait/open-app）
                                  #   需真实交互桌面，未纳入 CI；项数待跑过再记
.\lib\link-deps.ps1 -Clean
```

**以上项数是 v1.1.0 的记录**（37+146+18+25+8 = 234 项；引擎 37 与工具层 146 取自
GitHub `windows-latest` 实测，harness 18、序列化契约 25、遮挡 8 沿用 v1.0.x 记录）。
v1.1 语义层（`selftest-v11.ps1`）的项数等真机跑过再补。

> **要在普通终端里跑，别在 DSH 代理会话的沙箱里跑。** PS 5.1 的 `Add-Type` 靠 `csc.exe`
> 编译，受限沙箱下报 `A required privilege is not held by the client`，引擎于是「无输出」、
> 各套件全红（2026-11-08 实测）；同一限制下 node 套件会 `spawn EPERM`。这不是代码缺陷。
> 另：每份 `.ps1` 都必须是 **UTF-8 带 BOM**——5.1 会把无 BOM 的 UTF-8 当 ANSI 读，
> 中文变乱码甚至解析失败（`occlusion-test.ps1` 就踩过，已补 BOM）。

依赖真实桌面的检查（窗口枚举、键鼠闭环、遮挡抓取）在环境不满足时**跳过而非失败**——
环境无法构造场景不等于代码有缺陷。`fail` 是唯一代表代码坏了的信号。

`verify-serialization-contract.mjs` 与其它四套不同：它读的是**宿主的源码**，
用来钉住我们依赖的上游行为（`snapshotJsonValue` 接受/拒绝哪些值、
`applyFinalContent` 是否 `await` 钩子、`undefined` 属性在 `in` 与 `JSON.stringify`
眼里不一致）。它在找不到桌面版 DSH 时**跳过**，因为 npm 上的 `dsh-tools`
与桌面安装的版本不同；找不到时打印一行 `SKIP` 并 exit 0。

CI 覆盖不到"插件能否在运行中的 DSH 里加载"，那需要装 DSH 并重启；
`docs/COMPATIBILITY.md` 第 5 节有手工检查清单。

---

## 架构

两层，中间用单行 JSON 通信。

```
┌─ DSH agent ────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  11 tools: diagnose / list_windows / capture / focus,  │
│  click / ui_tree / scroll / clipboard / wait,          │
│  open_app / type        ← 11 个 defineTool             │
└───────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────┘
                        │  ctx.subprocess.spawn
                        │  argv + JSON on stdout
┌───────────────────────▼────────────────────────────────┐
│  lib/desktop-hand.ps1   PowerShell 引擎                │
│  P/Invoke → user32 / gdi32 / shcore / dwmapi / imm32   │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### `lib/index.js` — 工具层（Node, ESM）

- 用 `defineTool` 注册 11 个工具。参数是 dsh-tools 的**扁平 JSON-Schema 属性表**
  （不是 schemastery，后者只用于插件自己的 `Config`）。
- v1.1 新增的 5 个工具各自包 `try/catch` 注册：插件在 profile 里是 `required: true`，
  单个工具注册失败只能 warning，不能拖垮 DSH 启动。
- 经 `ctx.subprocess.spawn` 起引擎。**不用裸 `node:child_process`**：DSH 沙箱会
  拒绝 Node 以管道 stdio 起子进程（裸 `spawn` 报 `EPERM`）。裸 `spawn` 仅作脱离
  DSH 时的退路。
- 截图通过 `finalizeContent` 钩子把 PNG 交给附件服务，追加成 `image` 内容块。
  不能塞进返回值——`output.schema` 是 `additionalProperties: false`，多余键会校验失败。
- 引擎返回 `ok:false` 时抛带提示的异常，让模型能自我纠正（比如"标题匹配到多个窗口，
  请用 handle"）。

### `lib/desktop-hand.ps1` — 引擎（PowerShell）

单个脚本，`-Action` 分发，恒向 stdout 输出单行 JSON。设计上有五条硬约束，
每条都是实测踩出来的，改动前请先读文件头的注释：

**1. 抓窗口用 `PrintWindow` + `PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT(2)`。**
flag 必须是 `2`：`flag=0` 对 UWP 是 100% 黑，`flag=2` 降到 71.7%，即 0 更糟。

**2. 文本注入用 `SendInput + KEYEVENTF_UNICODE`。**
不能用 `VkKeyScan` + `keybd_event`——那条路经过键盘布局/输入法层，会被改写
（实测想要 `third batch`，目标程序收到的是「第三批」）。

**3. 坐标按物理像素，且 DPI 感知要显式声明。**
2560×1440 + 150% 缩放时，不声明 DPI 感知会让 `SetCursorPos(42,1046)` 落到物理
(56,1395)，而 `GetCursorPos` 又除回去报 (1280,720)——表现是"点的位置和说的不一样"。

**4. 输出必须是显式 UTF-8。**
PowerShell 5.1 在 stdout 被重定向时按**控制台 ANSI 代码页**（本机 GBK/936）编码，
而 Node 按 UTF-8 解码，于是所有非 ASCII 错误信息变乱码。引擎第一件事就是设
`[Console]::OutputEncoding = UTF8`。**删掉这行不会报错，只会静默毁掉所有中文提示。**

**5. `apply()` 绝不能抛异常。**
插件在 profile 里是 `required: true`，`apply()` 抛错会让**整个 DSH 启动失败**并进
安全模式，进而重写 profile 把插件删掉。所以系统提示段落这类锦上添花的东西整段包在
`try/catch` 里，失败只 warning。详见 [`docs/COMPATIBILITY.md`](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)。

### 文件

```
dsh-desktop-hand/
├── package.json                  dsh.bundle.patch 是能被加载的关键字段
├── cordis.patch.yml              bundle 挂载声明
├── README.md
├── docs/
│   ├── COMPATIBILITY.md          DSH 版本兼容、启动失败事故、三个序列化陷阱
│   ├── INCIDENT-2026-10-03-...  图片块序列化故障的原始排查报告（中文）
│   ├── DESIGN-v1.1-ui-layer.zh-CN.md  v1.1 接口规格（已冻结，改接口先改它）
│   ├── evidence/                故障报告与空白壳对照的实拍图
│   └── ENGINEERING-NOTES.zh-CN.md  详细工程笔记（中文，含每个 bug 的定位过程）
├── skills/desktop-hand/          给 agent 的用法 skill
└── lib/
    ├── index.js                  11 个 defineTool + 图片返回
    ├── desktop-hand.ps1          PowerShell 引擎
    ├── selftest.ps1              引擎自检
    ├── selftest.mjs              工具层自检
    ├── selftest-harness.mjs      子进程 seam 契约自检

    ├── occlusion-test.ps1        遮挡抓取验证

    └── link-deps.ps1             为脱离 DSH 的自检建/清依赖链接
```

# @automagik/acp-dsh

Agents other than DSH's own, as DeepSeek Harness models, over the
[Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com) (ACP). The design is
[RFC 0003](../../docs/rfcs/0003-model-routes-and-acp.md).

- **Agents as DSH models.** Each agent is a provider route (`acp-<agent>`) whose models are the
  agent's own (Claude Code's Opus, Sonnet, Haiku…; Codex's GPT models), each with the reasoning
  efforts the agent offers for it. A chat or a Bot picks one like any model. DSH keeps the
  Session, its history and the sidebar.
- **The agent's own models and efforts.** They are read from the agent over ACP: its session
  config options of category `model` and `thought_level`. A probe starts the adapter, opens a
  session it never prompts (no turn, no tokens), reads the models, then picks each one to read
  its efforts, since an agent rebuilds that list per model. The result is kept in
  `$AUTOMAGIK_HOME/acp/catalog/<route>.json`, so the next start lists it at once while a new probe
  runs; a new adapter release probes again. Before any probe has answered, a short list stands
  in (Claude Code: `default`, `opus`, `sonnet`, `haiku` at low, medium or high effort; Codex:
  `default`). The model `default` is always listed: it is whatever the agent's own settings
  choose. An effort's default is the person's own setting for that model.
- **The Session's model and effort, before each prompt.** The agent's session is put on the
  Session's model, then its effort (the model first: the efforts are that model's). No effort
  leaves the agent's own. A model or effort the agent does not offer fails the turn, naming what
  it offers.
- **DSH tool cards and approvals.** With `dshTools` off (the default), the agent runs its own
  tools. Each tool call it makes ends the model step with a call to `acp_tool`, a tool registered
  in that agent's scope only. DSH writes the `tool/call` and `tool/result` rows and draws the
  card (a terminal for a command, a diff for an edit, the generic card otherwise). When the agent
  asks permission for the call, `acp_tool` asks DSH's approval service
  (`approval/asked`, `approval/decided`) and gives the agent DSH's answer.
- **DSH's own tools over the bridge (`dshTools`).** On, the agent gets the Session's preset tool
  set (standard, or cordis in creator mode) over one stdio MCP server per ACP session, named
  `dsh` and spawned by the adapter with that session's arguments. The bridge has no port; it
  reaches this plugin over a loopback back-channel with a per-session credential
  (`DSH_BRIDGE_CREDENTIAL`), which binds a request to its Session and is revoked with the
  bridge. Every DSH tool call is approved in DSH under the Session's level before it runs,
  whatever the agent's own allow rules or hooks say, and the bridge writes the `tool/call` and
  `tool/result` rows the chat shows. `acp-claude` runs with its built-in tools off
  (`_meta.disableBuiltInTools`); a structured call that is not an MCP name is recorded as
  `plugin:acp-dsh/toolset-drift` and its turn is cancelled — the detector runs at every session
  start, and it detects and cancels because the update arrives after the call began.
  `acp-codex` stays a two-tool-set session (its adapter has no such switch) and, until a
  structured name is proven in its tool calls, draws no ACP card for an MCP call. The person's
  own MCP servers load beside the bridge with their own tools and sign-ins. A tool-list change
  (a preset or level change) is announced on `acp-claude` and arrives through `session/fork`
  plus `session/close` on `acp-codex`; a bridge that never lists its tools fails the turn
  (`acp_bridge_missing`) before the prompt. **Auto:** DSH's Auto preset is full access's sandbox
  with asks answered by auto-review. A bridge call adds one marked, tool-only assistant block
  for the reviewer, removes it from the surface once the call settles, and never replays it to
  another provider; the reviewer sees the bridge tool, its redacted arguments and its schema
  before the body runs. A denial is `AUTO_REVIEW_DENIED`, a failed reviewer refuses with
  `AUTO_REVIEW_FAILED`, a review past its deadline is `AUTO_REVIEW_TIMEOUT`, and the call never
  runs. The reviewer goes to the same non-agent side model as a Session title. Manual asks (one
  dialog), Full access does not. A Session that moves between providers carries its transcript
  redacted at each crossing — the replay out to an agent, and the transcript handed back to a
  native provider — and each crossing writes a provider-boundary row the chat shows. The
  reasoning effort the Session ran on crosses with it, both ways, when the target model offers
  that level (matched by id, else by name), replacing the target default DSH records on a model
  change; an effort DSH itself defaulted is not carried. A target with no reasoning levels,
  without that one, or whose levels cannot be read writes a notice row saying so and runs on its
  own. A switch back before the agent has answered drops the agent's chosen level; the native
  target's own default applies.
- **Only the chat reaches the agent.** DSH's side requests on an ACP route never become
  prompts. At the `llm/stream` waterfall a Session title (`purpose: session-title`) goes to a
  model that answers on its own, without the agent's effort. That is DSH's default model
  (`agentDefaultModel`) when it is not an agent; else `sideModel` below, DeepSeek Flash by
  default. Auto review (`purpose: auto-review`) takes the same route, with its messages redacted
  first. Every other side request on an ACP route, a compaction summary included, is refused
  (`UNSUPPORTED`): it would carry the agent's whole chat to another provider, and the agent
  manages its own context. Sessions on any other route are left alone.
- **Host only.** No browser half, so the plugin cannot stop the web UI from loading. With no
  agent CLI installed it registers no route. The welcome draws its setup from the `acpAgents`
  service below.
- **The Session's level, as the agent's own mode.** Before each prompt the agent's ACP session
  mode follows the Session: Manual is Claude Code's `default` mode, whatever default mode its
  own settings name; Codex runs in the sandbox that matches DSH's. Auto is Claude Code's `auto`
  and Codex's `agent`. Full access lets every call through, as it does DSH's own tools. An agent
  that does not offer the strict mode fails the turn instead of running in its own default.
- **Claude Code keeps the person's own settings.** It loads their Claude Code settings (user,
  project and local) and asks DSH only for what those leave as "ask". A call their allow rules,
  saved "always allow" rules or PreToolUse/PermissionRequest hooks approve runs with no DSH
  dialog. This is the owner's decision (RFC 0003, Decided).

## Agents

| Route | Agent | Runs | Adapter (newest release) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `acp-claude` | Claude Code | the person's `claude` (`CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE`) | `@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp` |
| `acp-codex` | Codex | the person's `codex` (`CODEX_PATH`) | `@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp` |
| `acp-fake` | `dev/fake-agent.mjs`, set as `fakeAgent` | Node | none; tests only |

An agent is offered only when its CLI is on PATH or where its installer puts it (`~/.local/bin`,
`/opt/homebrew/bin`, …). The settings `claude: false` or `codex: false` take one away. They are
live settings: switching one (from the welcome's Connect AI, its Settings page *Claude Code and
Codex*, or the plugin's own settings form) offers or withdraws the agent at once, with no
restart, and a connector that lands puts its model in the picker the same way
(`llm/adapters-updated`).

`dshTools` (default off, live) is the bridge, its DSH approval, the drift detector and live
switching above. Off is the behaviour without it: each agent keeps its own tools and its own
approvals. Turning it off is the rollback; a running Session keeps the transcript it has.

`sideModel` (`{ provider, model }`, default `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash`, live) is the
model that writes a Session's title on an agent's chat when DSH's default model is an agent
too. DSH's default is the model the person last picked, so on a team that chats with an agent it
usually is one. An agent route set here is ignored.

## The `acpAgents` service

A settings page reads the agents through this host service; the plugin stays host only.

| Method | Does |
|---|---|
| `status()` | Each agent: `{ id, key, name, on, cli: { found, installUrl }, connector: { state, version?, error?, updating? }, signedIn?, model: { provider, id, name, listed }, restartNeeded }`. `state` is `off`, `no-cli`, `installing`, `failed` (with the last install error) or `ready`. Spawns nothing. |
| `refresh()` | Looks for the CLIs again (one installed after DSH started is offered now), then asks each CLI whether it is signed in (`claude auth status --json`, of which only `loggedIn` is read; `codex login status`, by its exit code). No agent turn. |
| `retry(id)` | Starts the connector's install again, and answers at once. |
| `bridge()` | `{ on, probesPass }`: whether `dshTools` is on, and whether a real probe on this machine passes — the per-session bridge gets a fresh credential, answers MCP `initialize` and `tools/list`, and lists at least one tool. A success is cached per installed adapter version; a failure is retried after ten minutes or the next app start. A missing adapter or a failed probe says no. The Bot team reads it before its one-time move of Claude Bots onto `acp-claude`, so no Bot moves onto a route whose bridge cannot work. |

The switches are not the service's: a page writes them in the `acp-dsh` settings entry
through DSH's settings service (the welcome does, `src/host/acp.js` there).

The adapters are not pinned (RFC 0003, amended): the CLIs update themselves, and an adapter that
lags its CLI breaks first. They install in the background at DSH's start and once a day after,
with the desktop app's own pnpm (`AUTOMAGIK_PNPM`, never the person's) or else npm, into
`$AUTOMAGIK_HOME/acp/adapters/<package>/<version>`. An install goes to a fresh folder renamed into
place when complete, without install scripts or optional dependencies (the CLIs the adapters
bundle); an install that pulls in a bundled CLI's platform package anyway is refused. The
previous version stays for a Session still on it. Nothing is downloaded when a Session starts.
An install still running when DSH quits is killed with everything it started and its folder
removed; one a killed DSH left behind is removed at the next start.
Until the first install lands, the agent lists no model; a Session already on it says the
adapter is being installed, with the last install error.

## Check it

```sh
bun install && bun run harness
bun run test          # the adapter against the fake agent over real stdio
bun run lint
node dev/dsh-check.mjs   # one dsh headless turn on acp-fake (fake-small, high effort) in a temporary DSH home
node dev/dsh-check.mjs --agent claude   # the same on your own Claude Code (a few tokens)
node dev/dsh-check.mjs --agent codex    # the same on your own Codex (a few tokens)
```

`dev/dsh-check.mjs` installs the plugin the way DSH installs any plugin and reads the Session
log: the agent's text, a `tool/call` of `acp_tool` with its `tool/result`, and the
`approval/asked` and `approval/decided` pair for that call.

## Contracts

The plugin id `@automagik/acp-dsh`, the row id and storage prefix `acp-dsh`, the provider ids
`acp-<agent>` (never `claude-code*`, which the Bot team reads as the Claude Code plugin) and the
tool name `acp_tool` are public: Sessions keep them.

# Automagik

Automagik's plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), and the Automagik desktop app that runs them.

| Folder | Package | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| [`apps/bots-dsh`](apps/bots-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/bots-dsh` | The Bot team: long-lived Bots, group chats, memory, settings, scheduled tasks, the Bot browser. Omni's and Genie's plugins build on it. |
| [`apps/welcome-dsh`](apps/welcome-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/welcome-dsh` | The welcome: the octopus, the team step, and Connect AI through DSH's own sign-ins. |
| [`apps/acp-dsh`](apps/acp-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/acp-dsh` | Agents other than DSH's own, over ACP (Agent Client Protocol), as DSH models: the agent's tool calls show as DSH tool cards and ask through DSH's approval dialog (RFC 0003). |
| [`apps/locale-pt-br-dsh`](apps/locale-pt-br-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/locale-pt-br-dsh` | Português: the Bot team's Brazilian Portuguese under DSH's own Portuguese entry. Adds no language of its own, so Settings › General › Language keeps one Portuguese row; a pt-BR choice saved by an older pack moves to DSH's pt. |
| [`apps/desktop`](apps/desktop/README.md) | (the app) | The Automagik desktop app: DSH of its own with the Bot team, the welcome and Omni's channels and canvases. `omni desktop` opens it with Omni preloaded, `genie desktop` with Genie. |

Omni's own plugins (its channels and canvases) live with Omni, in [automagik-dev/omni](https://github.com/automagik-dev/omni) (`apps/omni-channels-dsh`, `apps/omni-canvas-dsh`), and carry Omni's version.

## Install

- **The desktop app**: download it from [Releases](https://github.com/automagik-dev/automagik/releases/latest), or run `omni desktop`. See [apps/desktop](apps/desktop/README.md).
- **Into your own DSH**: add the Automagik market to DSH's plugin market and install from there:

  ```
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automagik-dev/dsh-marketplace/main/index.json
  ```

  Every Omni also serves a market at `https://<your-omni>/api/market/index.json` with the release of these plugins it was tested with.

Nothing here is published to npm. The plugins install as git sources pinned to a release commit, or from the tarballs each release carries (`plugins.json` lists their integrity).

Omni's own plugins (its channels and canvases) live with Omni, in [automagik-dev/omni](https://github.com/automagik-dev/omni) (`apps/omni-channels-dsh`, `apps/omni-canvas-dsh`), and carry Omni's version.

## Install

- **The desktop app**: download it from [Releases](https://github.com/automagik-dev/automagik/releases/latest), or run `omni desktop`. See [apps/desktop](apps/desktop/README.md).
- **Into your own DSH**: add the Automagik market to DSH's plugin market and install from there:

  ```
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automagik-dev/dsh-marketplace/main/index.json
  ```

  Every Omni also serves a market at `https://<your-omni>/api/market/index.json` with the release of these plugins it was tested with.

Nothing here is published to npm. The plugins install as git sources pinned to a release commit, or from the tarballs each release carries (`plugins.json` lists their integrity).

## History

`@automagik/bots-dsh` and `@automagik/welcome-dsh` were `@automagik/omni-dsh` and `@automagik/omni-ai-dsh` in automagik-dev/omni (`apps/omni-ui-dsh`, `apps/omni-ai-dsh`), and the desktop app was automagik-dev/omni-desktop. They moved here with their history. What did not change with the names: plugin ids (`omni-ui`, `omni-ai`), routes and browser-storage prefixes. From 3.12 the team's home is Automagik's own (`~/.automagik/bots`, or `~/.automagik/desktop/bots` in the app), and the app's identity is Automagik's (`ai.namastex.automagik`): an app from 3.11.x or before is installed afresh, not updated.

- The Bot team's client bundle also answers to its former name, so channels and canvas plugins built before the rename keep working on it.
- In your own DSH: install `@automagik/bots-dsh` from the market. With both installed, the newer one runs (they share the plugin id); remove `@automagik/omni-dsh` when you like. A settings row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` that names `@automagik/omni-dsh` needs its `name:` changed to `@automagik/bots-dsh` to keep applying.

## Versions and releases

One version for the whole repository, `3.N` (semver `3.N.0`, N one above the last release: `scripts/version.ts`), above the 2.x builds omni-desktop released. Every merge into dev is a release: `release.yml` tags `v<version>`, publishes the plugin tarballs and `plugins.json`, builds the desktop app into the same release (`desktop-build.yml`), lists the release in [`marketplace/automagik.json`](marketplace/automagik.json), and moves `main` to it. `follow-omni.yml` moves the desktop app to each newer Omni release and cuts a release with it.

| Branch | What |
|---|---|
| `dev` | Integration: pull requests land here; releases are cut from it |
| `main` | The latest release, moved by `release.yml` only |

## Develop

Bun for the repository's own tooling; the plugins run on Node, as DSH does (`node --test`, esbuild), with Bun installing them; the desktop app uses npm for Electron.

```sh
bun install && bun run check                    # versions, release tooling, market index
cd apps/bots-dsh && bun install && bun run harness && bun run test
cd apps/welcome-dsh && bun install && bun run harness && bun run test
cd apps/desktop && npm ci && npm test
node scripts/boot-check.mjs                     # boot the plugins with Omni's in headless Chromium
```
