# Unfold events (`@automagik/unfold-events-dsh`)

What Unfold's agent is doing, inside the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) of Unfold's own instance. It adds two right-sidebar tabs:

- **Unfold events**: every event the agent sends, newest first, each named in plain words from the event catalog (`catalog/events.v3.json`). A kind the catalog doesn't name yet is shown as it came and flagged, never hidden.
- **Unfold**: the presence, one creature that says what the agent is doing right now (idle, pending, replying, speaking, asleep or unknown), with a production queue of what is running. Every pose cites its source; a missing or stale source shows as unknown, never as a guess.

It only watches. It attaches to the agent as a read-only **observer**, so the agent refuses anything it would send, and it drops the link if it is granted any other role.

## Where the agent is

Nothing here names an address or a port. In Unfold's instance the app publishes the agent's address in a file (one line, a literal loopback address with a port) only while its own chat holds the agent, and removes the file before it lets go. Unfold's launcher passes that file's path as `UNFOLD_AGENTD_OBSERVER`; the launcher's preload reads the variable once, deletes it from the environment before any plugin loads, and hands the path to in-process plugins as `globalThis[Symbol.for('unfold.channel')].observerFile`. This plugin reads the path from there only, never from the environment.

The file is read again at every connect. While it is absent the plugin waits, with backoff, and dials nothing; a file that holds anything but a literal loopback address with a port is refused in one line. Outside an Unfold instance there is no channel, and the tabs say so.

What the source can't show is stated in each snapshot (`source`): the agent never broadcasts the host's own input to observers, and a reconnect resumes live without filling the gap.

## Routes

Behind DSH's `/api` channel (`connection.fetch`: its Host/Origin fence and browser auth):

| Route | What it serves |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/unfold-events` | the window: `{rev, rows, aggregates, status, link, source, dropped, unknown}` |
| `GET /api/unfold-events/stream` | that snapshot, then every change, as server-sent events |
| `GET /api/unfold-presence` | the presence: `{rev, view}` |
| `GET /api/unfold-presence/stream` | that view, then each changed view, and a heartbeat |

The voice controls on the presence tab read and request through the Unfold session plugin's routes (`api/unfold-session/call`, `api/unfold-session/mute`); without that plugin voice stays unknown. The microphone indicator reads the host's status through its `unfoldSession` service.

## Settings

| Setting | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `limit` | 2000 | rows kept in the window |
| `agentd.enabled` | true | attach through the observer file; there is no address to set |
| `presence.host` | true | read the host's status for the microphone indicator |
| `presence.heartbeatMs` | 10000 | presence stream heartbeat |
| `stream.*` | 1 MiB, 10000, 5000 ms | per-client bounds of the server-sent events hub |

## Development

```sh
bun install && bun run harness
bun run test
bun run lint
node scripts/build-client.mjs   # after a change in src/client; commit client.js
```

Tested with DSH 0.2.1-rc.4.

`src/sse.js` is a copy of [`@automagik/unfold-sse-dsh`](../unfold-sse-dsh/README.md), held byte for byte by `test/sse-copy.test.js`. `src/client/redact.js` and the patterns in `src/window.js` are the credential masking the Unfold plugins share; a test holds the copies to one answer.

## Licence

MIT (see LICENSE).

# Automagik

Automagik's plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), and the Automagik desktop app that runs them.

| Folder | Package | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| [`apps/bots-dsh`](apps/bots-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/bots-dsh` | The Bot team: long-lived Bots, group chats, memory, settings, scheduled tasks, the Bot browser. Omni's and Genie's plugins build on it. |
| [`apps/welcome-dsh`](apps/welcome-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/welcome-dsh` | The welcome: the octopus, the team step, and Connect AI through DSH's own sign-ins. |
| [`apps/acp-dsh`](apps/acp-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/acp-dsh` | Agents other than DSH's own, over ACP (Agent Client Protocol), as DSH models: the agent's tool calls show as DSH tool cards and ask through DSH's approval dialog (RFC 0003). |
| [`apps/locale-pt-br-dsh`](apps/locale-pt-br-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/locale-pt-br-dsh` | Português: the Bot team's Brazilian Portuguese under DSH's own Portuguese entry. Adds no language of its own, so Settings › General › Language keeps one Portuguese row; a pt-BR choice saved by an older pack moves to DSH's pt. |
| [`apps/desktop`](apps/desktop/README.md) | (the app) | The Automagik desktop app: DSH of its own with the Bot team, the welcome and Omni's channels and canvases. `omni desktop` opens it with Omni preloaded, `genie desktop` with Genie. |

Omni's own plugins (its channels and canvases) live with Omni, in [automagik-dev/omni](https://github.com/automagik-dev/omni) (`apps/omni-channels-dsh`, `apps/omni-canvas-dsh`), and carry Omni's version.

## Install

- **The desktop app**: download it from [Releases](https://github.com/automagik-dev/automagik/releases/latest), or run `omni desktop`. See [apps/desktop](apps/desktop/README.md).
- **Into your own DSH**: add the Automagik market to DSH's plugin market and install from there:

  ```
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automagik-dev/dsh-marketplace/main/index.json
  ```

  Every Omni also serves a market at `https://<your-omni>/api/market/index.json` with the release of these plugins it was tested with.

Nothing here is published to npm. The plugins install as git sources pinned to a release commit, or from the tarballs each release carries (`plugins.json` lists their integrity).

## History

`@automagik/bots-dsh` and `@automagik/welcome-dsh` were `@automagik/omni-dsh` and `@automagik/omni-ai-dsh` in automagik-dev/omni (`apps/omni-ui-dsh`, `apps/omni-ai-dsh`), and the desktop app was automagik-dev/omni-desktop. They moved here with their history. What did not change with the names: plugin ids (`omni-ui`, `omni-ai`), routes and browser-storage prefixes. From 3.12 the team's home is Automagik's own (`~/.automagik/bots`, or `~/.automagik/desktop/bots` in the app), and the app's identity is Automagik's (`ai.namastex.automagik`): an app from 3.11.x or before is installed afresh, not updated.

- The Bot team's client bundle also answers to its former name, so channels and canvas plugins built before the rename keep working on it.
- In your own DSH: install `@automagik/bots-dsh` from the market. With both installed, the newer one runs (they share the plugin id); remove `@automagik/omni-dsh` when you like. A settings row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` that names `@automagik/omni-dsh` needs its `name:` changed to `@automagik/bots-dsh` to keep applying.

## Versions and releases

One version for the whole repository, `3.N` (semver `3.N.0`, N one above the last release: `scripts/version.ts`), above the 2.x builds omni-desktop released. Every merge into dev is a release: `release.yml` tags `v<version>`, publishes the plugin tarballs and `plugins.json`, builds the desktop app into the same release (`desktop-build.yml`), lists the release in [`marketplace/automagik.json`](marketplace/automagik.json), and moves `main` to it. `follow-omni.yml` moves the desktop app to each newer Omni release and cuts a release with it.

| Branch | What |
|---|---|
| `dev` | Integration: pull requests land here; releases are cut from it |
| `main` | The latest release, moved by `release.yml` only |

## Develop

Bun for the repository's own tooling; the plugins run on Node, as DSH does (`node --test`, esbuild), with Bun installing them; the desktop app uses npm for Electron.

```sh
bun install && bun run check                    # versions, release tooling, market index
cd apps/bots-dsh && bun install && bun run harness && bun run test
cd apps/welcome-dsh && bun install && bun run harness && bun run test
cd apps/desktop && npm ci && npm test
node scripts/boot-check.mjs                     # boot the plugins with Omni's in headless Chromium
```

## License

# Unfold Mind (`@automagik/unfold-mind-dsh`)

The Mind stream for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH): every event Unfold's agent and host emit, as far as its sources carry them, becomes one plain sentence, grouped into episodes through explicit ids only. Each row opens an audit record (ids, cause chain, source, integrity, catalog definition, redacted envelope), and gap markers show wherever the evidence is incomplete. It shows and never commands: the only write is a suggestion, appended to a local log that goes nowhere. Tested with DSH 0.2.1-rc.4.

## Sources

All read-only. Mind opens no connection of its own.

| Source | Where it comes from |
|---|---|
| Agent events | The `unfoldEvents` service of `@automagik/unfold-events-dsh`: its event window and link state, the one observer attachment to agentd. |
| Host journal | `journals.host`, or, with `journals.hostFromInstance`, the path in `UNFOLD_HOST_JOURNAL`. Off by default. |
| Agent journal | `journals.agentd`: the instance's agentd journal, for file offsets and history from before Mind loaded. Off by default. |

### The host journal binding

`UNFOLD_HOST_JOURNAL` is part of the Unfold channel contract: the Unfold app will set it on its instance child to `<data>/app/<label>/host.jsonl`, under the app's own dir, and the launcher preload reads and deletes it and hands it to plugins as `hostJournal` in its registry (`globalThis[Symbol.for('unfold.channel')]`). The name is reserved and unset until the app writes that journal, so the host lane stays off until then (unless `journals.host` names a file). Mind takes the value once, at its first load: from the registry's `hostJournal` key when the registry exists (and only that key), from the environment only when there is no registry. It deletes the variable either way, so tools DSH spawns later never inherit it. A later load keeps that first value.

The value is parsed, never opened by the binding: a path that is not exactly `<data>/app/<label>/host.jsonl` (an absolute path, a label of 1-64 letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`) is refused, and so is any path with a `..` segment; the host journal stays off with the reason in the snapshot's `sources`. Mind never falls back to another log.

Every journal is read only where it really is: a file that is a symbolic link is refused, and for the bound host journal so is a link at `<data>/app` or `<data>/app/<label>`. The source then reads `refused`, with the reason.

## Routes

On DSH's `connection.fetch` only (its Host/Origin fence and browser auth):

| Route | What it serves |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/unfold-mind` | The snapshot: rows, episodes, link, sources. |
| `GET /api/unfold-mind/stream` | Server-sent events: the snapshot, then `row`, `row-updated`, `episode`, `merged`, `evicted`, `link`, heartbeats. |
| `GET /api/unfold-mind/event?id=<id>` | The audit record of one row. |
| `GET`, `POST /api/unfold-mind/suggestions` | The suggestion log; `POST` appends one `{key, actor, scope: {episode, event, title}, text}`. |

Every payload is redacted at the boundary. Suggestions are stored in `suggestions.jsonl` in the plugin's data dir (`dataDir`, default `<DSH_HOME>/unfold-mind`).

## Browser half

`client.js` adds the Mind tab to DSH's right sidebar. It is built from `src/client` with esbuild and committed:

```sh
bun run build                          # writes client.js
node scripts/build-client.mjs --check  # fails when client.js is stale
```

## What it carries

- `src/sse.js` is `@automagik/unfold-sse-dsh`'s `index.js`, byte for byte; `test/sse-copy.test.js` holds the copy to it.
- `catalog/events.v3.json` is the event catalog `@automagik/unfold-events-dsh` carries.
- `test/support/` holds that package's event window and catalog reader, so the tests run Mind on exactly what it emits.

## Tests

```sh
bun run harness   # the DSH packages the tests and the linter run against, in dev/harness
bun run test
bun run lint
```

## Licence

MIT (see LICENSE).

# Automagik

Automagik's plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), and the Automagik desktop app that runs them.

| Folder | Package | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| [`apps/bots-dsh`](apps/bots-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/bots-dsh` | The Bot team: long-lived Bots, group chats, memory, settings, scheduled tasks, the Bot browser. Omni's and Genie's plugins build on it. |
| [`apps/welcome-dsh`](apps/welcome-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/welcome-dsh` | The welcome: the octopus, the team step, and Connect AI through DSH's own sign-ins. |
| [`apps/acp-dsh`](apps/acp-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/acp-dsh` | Agents other than DSH's own, over ACP (Agent Client Protocol), as DSH models: the agent's tool calls show as DSH tool cards and ask through DSH's approval dialog (RFC 0003). |
| [`apps/locale-pt-br-dsh`](apps/locale-pt-br-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/locale-pt-br-dsh` | Português: the Bot team's Brazilian Portuguese under DSH's own Portuguese entry. Adds no language of its own, so Settings › General › Language keeps one Portuguese row; a pt-BR choice saved by an older pack moves to DSH's pt. |
| [`apps/desktop`](apps/desktop/README.md) | (the app) | The Automagik desktop app: DSH of its own with the Bot team, the welcome and Omni's channels and canvases. `omni desktop` opens it with Omni preloaded, `genie desktop` with Genie. |

Omni's own plugins (its channels and canvases) live with Omni, in [automagik-dev/omni](https://github.com/automagik-dev/omni) (`apps/omni-channels-dsh`, `apps/omni-canvas-dsh`), and carry Omni's version.

## Install

- **The desktop app**: download it from [Releases](https://github.com/automagik-dev/automagik/releases/latest), or run `omni desktop`. See [apps/desktop](apps/desktop/README.md).
- **Into your own DSH**: add the Automagik market to DSH's plugin market and install from there:

  ```
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automagik-dev/dsh-marketplace/main/index.json
  ```

  Every Omni also serves a market at `https://<your-omni>/api/market/index.json` with the release of these plugins it was tested with.

Nothing here is published to npm. The plugins install as git sources pinned to a release commit, or from the tarballs each release carries (`plugins.json` lists their integrity).

## History

`@automagik/bots-dsh` and `@automagik/welcome-dsh` were `@automagik/omni-dsh` and `@automagik/omni-ai-dsh` in automagik-dev/omni (`apps/omni-ui-dsh`, `apps/omni-ai-dsh`), and the desktop app was automagik-dev/omni-desktop. They moved here with their history. What did not change with the names: plugin ids (`omni-ui`, `omni-ai`), routes and browser-storage prefixes. From 3.12 the team's home is Automagik's own (`~/.automagik/bots`, or `~/.automagik/desktop/bots` in the app), and the app's identity is Automagik's (`ai.namastex.automagik`): an app from 3.11.x or before is installed afresh, not updated.

- The Bot team's client bundle also answers to its former name, so channels and canvas plugins built before the rename keep working on it.
- In your own DSH: install `@automagik/bots-dsh` from the market. With both installed, the newer one runs (they share the plugin id); remove `@automagik/omni-dsh` when you like. A settings row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` that names `@automagik/omni-dsh` needs its `name:` changed to `@automagik/bots-dsh` to keep applying.

## Versions and releases

One version for the whole repository, `3.N` (semver `3.N.0`, N one above the last release: `scripts/version.ts`), above the 2.x builds omni-desktop released. Every merge into dev is a release: `release.yml` tags `v<version>`, publishes the plugin tarballs and `plugins.json`, builds the desktop app into the same release (`desktop-build.yml`), lists the release in [`marketplace/automagik.json`](marketplace/automagik.json), and moves `main` to it. `follow-omni.yml` moves the desktop app to each newer Omni release and cuts a release with it.

| Branch | What |
|---|---|
| `dev` | Integration: pull requests land here; releases are cut from it |
| `main` | The latest release, moved by `release.yml` only |

## Develop

Bun for the repository's own tooling; the plugins run on Node, as DSH does (`node --test`, esbuild), with Bun installing them; the desktop app uses npm for Electron.

```sh
bun install && bun run check                    # versions, release tooling, market index
cd apps/bots-dsh && bun install && bun run harness && bun run test
cd apps/welcome-dsh && bun install && bun run harness && bun run test
cd apps/desktop && npm ci && npm test
node scripts/boot-check.mjs                     # boot the plugins with Omni's in headless Chromium
```

## License

Apache-2.0. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) and [NOTICE](NOTICE).

# Unfold session (`@automagik/unfold-session-dsh`)

Unfold's rolling session as one root Session of the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) of Unfold's own instance. DSH is a view and a composer here, never a second brain:

- **Typed turns.** When you send a message in the `unfold-root` Session's composer, the plugin holds DSH's turn, sends your text once to Unfold's control endpoint, and Unfold's app sends it to the agent on the Unfold Session as a typed command. The reply streams back from the agent as a chat bubble. DSH's loop then ends the turn without a model step: no model call, no provider.
- **Spoken turns** are shown, never sent: a reply the agent's voice provider opened is followed by its own ids and drawn as a user bubble (the words heard for it) and a reply bubble.
- **Live listening**: a "listening…" bubble above the composer from the moment speech starts until its words land in a chat bubble.
- **Unfold status**: a right-sidebar tab with the link to the agent and the latest measured candidate.

The takeover is enabled only when `AUTOMAGIK_HOST=unfold` or `AUTOMAGIK_PRELOAD=unfold`, matching the Bot team and welcome. In that instance every other root Session is refused: DSH runs no root loop anywhere. On ordinary hosts this plugin leaves Sessions, agent hooks and the browser UI untouched; its stable configuration endpoint reports `enabled: false`.

## What is sent, and how

Only your own composer message is ever sent. Nothing an event says (a transcript, a reply, a note, a turn another composer sent) reaches the endpoint, and no DSH route of this plugin leads to it.

The endpoint is a Unix socket in the instance's own 0700 socket dir, with a bearer token made at each start. Unfold's launcher passes both as `UNFOLD_CONTROL_SOCKET` and `UNFOLD_CONTROL_TOKEN_FILE`; the launcher's preload reads them once, deletes them from the environment and unlinks the token file before any plugin loads, and hands the socket path and the token to in-process plugins as `globalThis[Symbol.for('unfold.channel')]`. This plugin reads them from there only. It opens no TCP connection for control, names no port, and never reads the token file. A tool or agent DSH spawns sees neither variable.

The endpoint has three verbs. `POST /submit {session, text}` sends a typed turn:

| Answer | What the chat shows |
|---|---|
| 200 `{accepted: true, turn_id}` | the reply, as it streams; its bubble names `turn_id`, the command id agentd admitted |
| 400 `command` | a message that starts with `/` is an owner command, which only Unfold's own keyboard sends; the plugin refuses it before it connects |
| 401, 403, 400 `body`, 503, a refused peer, no endpoint | not sent, and why |
| the connection failed after the message was written | outcome unknown: it may have been sent |

A message is sent at most once: no answer is ever retried, and a message the composer delivers again is never sent again. There is no verb to cancel a reply, so the stop button ends the turn here and says the outcome in Unfold is unknown unless the agent confirms it. After an observer gap a reply keeps the text it saw and is marked possibly incomplete; there is no recorded result to take its whole text from.

`GET /answer-with` and `POST /answer-with {choice?, effort?, ack?}` are what Unfold answers with, the same setting as Unfold's own settings: the Unfold Bot's model menu in DSH (drawn by the Bot team, registered by `@automagik/unfold-bot-dsh`) lists only the options the app returns, with where each message goes, the one picked, the one answering now and, for an option with levels, the app's levels. A pick answers `{rev, after_reply}`; while the app waits for the reply in progress the menu says it switches after this reply. 400 `body`, 409 `not_offered` and 409 `needs_ack` (an option the person has to confirm first) come back as the pick's refusal. The plugin reads the facts at start, when the agent link attaches again (a model change restarts the agent), when the menu opens, after a pick and when a typed turn ends; it never polls. The service carries it as `answerWith`.

Without a channel (a DSH that Unfold's launcher did not start), or before the agent names its Unfold Session, nothing is sent and the chat says so.

## Where the agent is

agentd's address is never configured. The app publishes it in the observer file only while its own chat holds the agent; the plugin reads that file at every connect, attaches as a read-only **observer**, and drops the link on any other grant. While the file is absent it waits, with backoff, and dials nothing. An address that is not a literal loopback address with a port is never dialled.

## Routes

Behind DSH's `/api` channel (`connection.fetch`: its Host/Origin fence and browser auth):

| Route | What it serves |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/unfold-session/status` | the link, the counters and the latest measured candidate |
| `GET /api/unfold-session/live` | the listening view, then each change, as server-sent events |
| `GET /api/unfold-session/call` | `{unavailable}`: in Unfold's instance calls belong to Unfold's own app |
| `POST /api/unfold-session/call`, `POST /api/unfold-session/mute` | 503: the endpoint has no call or mute verb |

The service `unfoldSession` (`bridge`, `turns`, `live`, `status()`) is what the Unfold events and settings plugins read. In Unfold's instance the host's own status is not readable through the control endpoint, so `status().owner` is always `{unavailable: <reason>}`, and those plugins show the call, the microphone and the voice as unknown.

`src/call-view.js` is a copy of the call view in [`@automagik/unfold-events-dsh`](../unfold-events-dsh/README.md), held byte for byte by `test/sse-copy.test.js`.

## Settings

| Setting | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `sessionId` | `unfold-root` | the one DSH root Session that shows Unfold |
| `title` | `Unfold` | its workspace title |
| `workspaceDir` | `<DSH_HOME>/unfold-workspace` | its workspace directory |
| `blockOtherSessions` | true | refuse turns in every other root Session |
| `route` | `/api/unfold-session` | the routes' base |

## Development

```sh
bun install && bun run harness
bun run test
bun run lint
node scripts/build-client.mjs   # after a change in src/client; commit client.js
```

The tests run against a fake control endpoint (`test/fake-control.js`) on a Unix socket under `/tmp/ufd-<uid>/`, removed by its path, and against fake agentd observers on kernel-picked ports; every other TCP connect is refused before it is made.

`src/sse.js` is a copy of [`@automagik/unfold-sse-dsh`](../unfold-sse-dsh/README.md), held byte for byte by `test/sse-copy.test.js`.

# Automagik

Automagik's plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), and the Automagik desktop app that runs them.

| Folder | Package | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| [`apps/bots-dsh`](apps/bots-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/bots-dsh` | The Bot team: long-lived Bots, group chats, memory, settings, scheduled tasks, the Bot browser. Omni's and Genie's plugins build on it. |
| [`apps/welcome-dsh`](apps/welcome-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/welcome-dsh` | The welcome: the octopus, the team step, and Connect AI through DSH's own sign-ins. |
| [`apps/acp-dsh`](apps/acp-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/acp-dsh` | Agents other than DSH's own, over ACP (Agent Client Protocol), as DSH models: the agent's tool calls show as DSH tool cards and ask through DSH's approval dialog (RFC 0003). |
| [`apps/locale-pt-br-dsh`](apps/locale-pt-br-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/locale-pt-br-dsh` | Português: the Bot team's Brazilian Portuguese under DSH's own Portuguese entry. Adds no language of its own, so Settings › General › Language keeps one Portuguese row; a pt-BR choice saved by an older pack moves to DSH's pt. |
| [`apps/desktop`](apps/desktop/README.md) | (the app) | The Automagik desktop app: DSH of its own with the Bot team, the welcome and Omni's channels and canvases. `omni desktop` opens it with Omni preloaded, `genie desktop` with Genie. |

Omni's own plugins (its channels and canvases) live with Omni, in [automagik-dev/omni](https://github.com/automagik-dev/omni) (`apps/omni-channels-dsh`, `apps/omni-canvas-dsh`), and carry Omni's version.

## Install

- **The desktop app**: download it from [Releases](https://github.com/automagik-dev/automagik/releases/latest), or run `omni desktop`. See [apps/desktop](apps/desktop/README.md).
- **Into your own DSH**: add the Automagik market to DSH's plugin market and install from there:

  ```
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automagik-dev/dsh-marketplace/main/index.json
  ```

  Every Omni also serves a market at `https://<your-omni>/api/market/index.json` with the release of these plugins it was tested with.

Nothing here is published to npm. The plugins install as git sources pinned to a release commit, or from the tarballs each release carries (`plugins.json` lists their integrity).

## History

`@automagik/bots-dsh` and `@automagik/welcome-dsh` were `@automagik/omni-dsh` and `@automagik/omni-ai-dsh` in automagik-dev/omni (`apps/omni-ui-dsh`, `apps/omni-ai-dsh`), and the desktop app was automagik-dev/omni-desktop. They moved here with their history. What did not change with the names: plugin ids (`omni-ui`, `omni-ai`), routes and browser-storage prefixes. From 3.12 the team's home is Automagik's own (`~/.automagik/bots`, or `~/.automagik/desktop/bots` in the app), and the app's identity is Automagik's (`ai.namastex.automagik`): an app from 3.11.x or before is installed afresh, not updated.

- The Bot team's client bundle also answers to its former name, so channels and canvas plugins built before the rename keep working on it.
- In your own DSH: install `@automagik/bots-dsh` from the market. With both installed, the newer one runs (they share the plugin id); remove `@automagik/omni-dsh` when you like. A settings row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` that names `@automagik/omni-dsh` needs its `name:` changed to `@automagik/bots-dsh` to keep applying.

## Versions and releases

One version for the whole repository, `3.N` (semver `3.N.0`, N one above the last release: `scripts/version.ts`), above the 2.x builds omni-desktop released. Every merge into dev is a release: `release.yml` tags `v<version>`, publishes the plugin tarballs and `plugins.json`, builds the desktop app into the same release (`desktop-build.yml`), lists the release in [`marketplace/automagik.json`](marketplace/automagik.json), and moves `main` to it. `follow-omni.yml` moves the desktop app to each newer Omni release and cuts a release with it.

| Branch | What |
|---|---|
| `dev` | Integration: pull requests land here; releases are cut from it |
| `main` | The latest release, moved by `release.yml` only |

## Develop

Bun for the repository's own tooling; the plugins run on Node, as DSH does (`node --test`, esbuild), with Bun installing them; the desktop app uses npm for Electron.

```sh
bun install && bun run check                    # versions, release tooling, market index
cd apps/bots-dsh && bun install && bun run harness && bun run test
cd apps/welcome-dsh && bun install && bun run harness && bun run test
cd apps/desktop && npm ci && npm test
node scripts/boot-check.mjs                     # boot the plugins with Omni's in headless Chromium
```

# Unfold settings (`@automagik/unfold-settings-dsh`)

"Unfold settings" for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), read-only: how Unfold is set up right now. Backend and model, the prompt and config revision, voice and device state and the model context, each with its source and how fresh it is. It has no write route and opens no connection of its own. Tested with DSH 0.2.1-rc.4.

## Where the values come from

It reads three services other plugins provide; a missing one makes its values unknown, never a default:

| Service | Plugin | What is read |
|---|---|---|
| `unfoldSession` | `@automagik/unfold-session-dsh` | `status().owner`, the host owner's status. Where the session plugin offers no `status()` (Unfold's own control endpoint carries only the person's submit), every host value is unknown and says why. An owner it reports unavailable is read once, and again only when unfold-session reloads. |
| `unfoldEvents` | `@automagik/unfold-events-dsh` | The observer's event window: the Hello, the `gemini ready` log line and `context_restore`. No second observer attaches to the agent. |
| `omniTeam` | the Bot team | `config.memoryReview` only. |

The effective prompt is never on a wire. The panel reads the policy text from the agent's `gemini.rs` (a constant tagged `[<name>-voice-policy <id>]`) and shows it only when a replica of the agent's setup message over that text and the ready line's knobs reproduces the line's `setup_id`; the context bounds come from the agent's `context.rs`. Both paths come from config; with none, the prompt is never shown and the bounds are unknown.

## Freshness

Every value is `live`, `stale`, `unknown` or `source` (a constant read from the agent's source). Host values expire at their lease; event-derived values need the stream's confirmation (views and heartbeats); a value seen before an observer gap is history until it is seen again. The browser expires what it shows on its own clock, so a silent or lost stream never keeps a value looking live. GET and the stream share one snapshot identity (the serving instance and a rising revision), so a late Refresh never undoes a newer view. Everything served passes through `redact`.

## Config

| Key | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `route` | `/api/unfold-settings` | The routes' base: `GET <route>` (one host read, then the view) and `GET <route>/stream` (the view, then each change, with heartbeats). |
| `leaseMs` | `15000` | A host status read older than this is stale. |
| `hostReadTimeoutMs` | `5000` | A host read that takes longer fails. |
| `heartbeatMs` | `5000` | Stream heartbeat while a settings stream is open; the browser treats three missed beats as a lost stream. |
| `sources.gemini` | none | Path to the agent's `gemini.rs` (the policy text). |
| `sources.context` | none | Path to the agent's `context.rs` (the fold bounds). |
| `transport` | `connection` | `connection`: DSH's `/api` channel (its Host/Origin fence and browser auth). `webServer`: a bare route, for hosts without Connection. |

The service is `unfoldSettings`. The browser half is a main panel with a sidebar entry (`unfold.settings`) and the same panel as a right-sidebar tab, for surfaces that hide the left panel list.

## Tests

```sh
bun run test
bun run lint   # oxlint from dev/harness (bun run harness), or DSH_HARNESS
node scripts/build-client.mjs --check
```

`src/sse.js` is `@automagik/unfold-sse-dsh`'s `index.js`, carried byte for byte; a test holds it to that file's hash. The test fixtures stand in for the agent's source files and a host status; they hold no real values.

## Licence

MIT (see LICENSE).

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Unfold's trajectory for DeepSeek Harness (`@automagik/unfold-trajectory-dsh`)

Unfold's real-time trajectory: what Unfold heard, thought, said and did, as one ledger with a
timing overview and an inspector. It is a fork of DeepSeek's trajectory UI
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-trajectory` 0.2.1-rc.3, MIT) that keeps upstream's toolbar, overview,
ledger and inspector and reads Unfold's Mind stream instead of a DSH session's events. Tested
with DSH 0.2.1-rc.4, whose trajectory UI ships the same bundle bytes as rc.3.

- **Where it shows.** In Unfold's configured Session (`unfold-root` by default): as its own conversation view,
  "Unfold", next to Chat and DeepSeek's Trajectory, and as a "Trajectory" tab in the right
  sidebar. With the Bot team installed, the Bot's header gets a Trajectory button that opens the
  tab. Any other session shows a short note that the view is Unfold's.
- **Where its data comes from.** The configured session and Mind route are discovered through the read-only
  `api/unfold-session/config` and `api/unfold-mind/config` endpoints on the DSH page. One
  `EventSource` reads that Mind route's `/stream`, which `@automagik/unfold-mind-dsh` serves. The plugin opens no other connection, names no
  host or port and reads no environment. It only reads.
- **What it claims.** Only what the Mind rows show: a reply is cancelled only when its own host
  process says so, a duration is shown only when both ends were measured on one clock, and
  anything else is "not measured", with the reason.
- **DeepSeek's Trajectory stays.** This is a separate plugin with its own loader id, dictionary,
  storage names and CSS classes, so both can load in one page.

## Develop

```sh
bun install              # esbuild, for the client build
node scripts/build-client.mjs          # writes client.js; commit it
node scripts/build-client.mjs --check  # exits 1 when client.js is stale
bun run test
bun run harness && bun run lint
```

`upstream/` holds DeepSeek's `LICENSE`, `package.json` and `lib/client.js` exactly as published
(`upstream/SHA256SUMS` lists every file of the package). The build applies the patch set in
`scripts/build-client.mjs`, each one counted, and `NOTICE.md` lists every change.

## License

MIT (`LICENSE`, DeepSeek's). `NOTICE.md` has the upstream notice and the Lucide, Feather and
jsdiff notices that the built `client.js` repeats.

# Automagik

Automagik's plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), and the Automagik desktop app that runs them.

| Folder | Package | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| [`apps/bots-dsh`](apps/bots-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/bots-dsh` | The Bot team: long-lived Bots, group chats, memory, settings, scheduled tasks, the Bot browser. Omni's and Genie's plugins build on it. |
| [`apps/welcome-dsh`](apps/welcome-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/welcome-dsh` | The welcome: the octopus, the team step, and Connect AI through DSH's own sign-ins. |
| [`apps/acp-dsh`](apps/acp-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/acp-dsh` | Agents other than DSH's own, over ACP (Agent Client Protocol), as DSH models: the agent's tool calls show as DSH tool cards and ask through DSH's approval dialog (RFC 0003). |
| [`apps/locale-pt-br-dsh`](apps/locale-pt-br-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/locale-pt-br-dsh` | Português: the Bot team's Brazilian Portuguese under DSH's own Portuguese entry. Adds no language of its own, so Settings › General › Language keeps one Portuguese row; a pt-BR choice saved by an older pack moves to DSH's pt. |
| [`apps/desktop`](apps/desktop/README.md) | (the app) | The Automagik desktop app: DSH of its own with the Bot team, the welcome and Omni's channels and canvases. `omni desktop` opens it with Omni preloaded, `genie desktop` with Genie. |

Omni's own plugins (its channels and canvases) live with Omni, in [automagik-dev/omni](https://github.com/automagik-dev/omni) (`apps/omni-channels-dsh`, `apps/omni-canvas-dsh`), and carry Omni's version.

## Install

- **The desktop app**: download it from [Releases](https://github.com/automagik-dev/automagik/releases/latest), or run `omni desktop`. See [apps/desktop](apps/desktop/README.md).
- **Into your own DSH**: add the Automagik market to DSH's plugin market and install from there:

  ```
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automagik-dev/dsh-marketplace/main/index.json
  ```

  Every Omni also serves a market at `https://<your-omni>/api/market/index.json` with the release of these plugins it was tested with.

Nothing here is published to npm. The plugins install as git sources pinned to a release commit, or from the tarballs each release carries (`plugins.json` lists their integrity).

## History

`@automagik/bots-dsh` and `@automagik/welcome-dsh` were `@automagik/omni-dsh` and `@automagik/omni-ai-dsh` in automagik-dev/omni (`apps/omni-ui-dsh`, `apps/omni-ai-dsh`), and the desktop app was automagik-dev/omni-desktop. They moved here with their history. What did not change with the names: plugin ids (`omni-ui`, `omni-ai`), routes and browser-storage prefixes. From 3.12 the team's home is Automagik's own (`~/.automagik/bots`, or `~/.automagik/desktop/bots` in the app), and the app's identity is Automagik's (`ai.namastex.automagik`): an app from 3.11.x or before is installed afresh, not updated.

- The Bot team's client bundle also answers to its former name, so channels and canvas plugins built before the rename keep working on it.
- In your own DSH: install `@automagik/bots-dsh` from the market. With both installed, the newer one runs (they share the plugin id); remove `@automagik/omni-dsh` when you like. A settings row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` that names `@automagik/omni-dsh` needs its `name:` changed to `@automagik/bots-dsh` to keep applying.

## Versions and releases

One version for the whole repository, `3.N` (semver `3.N.0`, N one above the last release: `scripts/version.ts`), above the 2.x builds omni-desktop released. Every merge into dev is a release: `release.yml` tags `v<version>`, publishes the plugin tarballs and `plugins.json`, builds the desktop app into the same release (`desktop-build.yml`), lists the release in [`marketplace/automagik.json`](marketplace/automagik.json), and moves `main` to it. `follow-omni.yml` moves the desktop app to each newer Omni release and cuts a release with it.

| Branch | What |
|---|---|
| `dev` | Integration: pull requests land here; releases are cut from it |
| `main` | The latest release, moved by `release.yml` only |

## Develop

Bun for the repository's own tooling; the plugins run on Node, as DSH does (`node --test`, esbuild), with Bun installing them; the desktop app uses npm for Electron.

```sh
bun install && bun run check                    # versions, release tooling, market index
cd apps/bots-dsh && bun install && bun run harness && bun run test
cd apps/welcome-dsh && bun install && bun run harness && bun run test
cd apps/desktop && npm ci && npm test
node scripts/boot-check.mjs                     # boot the plugins with Omni's in headless Chromium
```

## License

Apache-2.0. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) and [NOTICE](NOTICE).

# voice-mode · DSH 语音聊天模式插件

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）加一个**语音聊天模式**：说话自动触发录音、自动转写、自动提交；助手回复用 Edge TTS 或系统语音念出来（支持口播稿协议）。复用 DSH 内置语音栈做识别，只额外加一层很薄的 Host 路由（Edge TTS 与模型控制工具）。

> 状态：可用（v0.7.10）。Windows 10 + DSH Desktop 实测：说话→本地转写→自动提交→Edge TTS 播报闭环；设置页卡片化 + 右侧预览；模型可用 `voice_mode` 工具主动开麦/说话。

## English summary

`voice-mode` is a client-side plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds a voice-chat mode:

- always-on VAD listening (`getUserMedia` + AudioContext), automatic recording and transcription through DSH's authenticated `speechToText` remote;
- automatic submission into the current session (`beginSubmission` + `prompt`, `queue` by default; long-press to `steer`);
- spoken replies through **Edge TTS** (thin Host route + MP3 playback) or the system `speechSynthesis`, with per-turn coalescing, sentence splitting, prefetch and immediate stop;
- a `voice_mode` model tool (enable / disable / speak / status) that lets the agent open the microphone or read text in automated flows;
- explicit `[voice-note]` blocks: the agent may emit several per reply and each is spoken in order;
- session-scoped state, hard-off paths (toggle / `Esc` / hidden / session switch / refresh), `navigator.locks` arbitration across windows, ~20 tunable settings.

It replaces the built-in `ui-voice-input` row (see the maintenance header in `cordis.patch.yml`), reuses DSH's built-in experimental voice stack for local transcription (models are downloaded per user by DSH, never shipped or shared by this plugin), and adds a thin Host route for Edge TTS plus the `voice_mode` tool. License: MIT.

---

## 特点（为什么选它）

- **零自建识别服务**：转写直接用 DSH 内置语音栈（本地 SenseVoice + `speechToText`），不需要 API key、不用部署 ASR 服务——代价是必须启用 DSH 的实验语音 bundle；
- **口播稿优先**：模型用 `[voice-note]: <…>` 显式给出“该念的段落”，一轮可多段、按出现顺序朗读；没有口播稿才回退念正文前 3 句；
- **双引擎播报**：Edge TTS（8 个中文音色，默认晓伊 +10%）与系统语音一键切换；请求失败自动回退，断网也有声；
- **模型可控制**：`voice_mode` 工具让模型主动开麦（enable）、关麦（disable）、说话（speak）、查状态（status），适合自动化流程与“边跑边报进度”；
- **状态归属清晰**：会话级开关、切会话自动恢复、后台/失焦可配置、硬关闭路径明确（`Esc` / hidden / 切会话 / 刷新）；播报中失焦默认不掐断；
- **轻量**：无运行时 npm 依赖、不额外分发模型（模型由 DSH 语音 bundle 管理）；Host 侧只有一条 `/api` Fetch 路由 + 一个工具；
- **可维护**：设置页卡片 + 右侧实时试听、依赖自检、诊断日志；覆盖内置行处带维护注释，升级 DSH 时有据可查。

## 与其他语音插件的关系

同类不少（`dsh-voice-mode` 功能最全、`dsh-voice` 偏朗读、`dsh-voice-chat` / `dsh-voice-talk` 偏对话式）。本插件的取舍是**不重复造 ASR/TTS 服务，只把 DSH 内置语音栈接到最顺的交互上**（常驻监听、自动提交、口播稿、模型工具）；对应地，它要求内置实验语音 bundle 可用，也不提供唤醒词、流式字幕、音色克隆这些专项能力。

## 功能

- **常驻监听**：VAD（RMS 门限 + 最短语音时长）自动开始/结束录音，不需要点按钮；
- **自动提交**：转写文本走会话的 `beginSubmission` + `prompt`，默认 `queue`；长按开关 500ms 可把下一次说话标记为 `steer`（插话）；
- **语音播报（TTS）**：用系统 `speechSynthesis` 念助手最终回复，默认只念**口播稿**，没有口播稿时回退「前 3 句」；
- **多段口播**：一条回复可在不同阶段放多段 `[voice-note]`，按出现顺序逐段念；
- **打断判定**：播报中被声音触发打断时先记下剩余内容再停播；转写结果为空/纯语气词就恢复播报，只有有效发言才真正打断并提交（v0.6.6）；
- **会话级状态**：切走会话停麦、切回自动恢复（2 秒提示）；刷新/重载回 `OFF`；
- **硬关闭**：短按开关 / `Esc` / 切标签 / 刷新；空闲与失焦退出可配（0 = 不自动退出）；**切换会话只停麦，不打断正在播的回复**（v0.7.1）；
- **设置页**：20 项参数、诊断日志、「播放测试」；
- **多窗口仲裁**：`navigator.locks` 按会话加锁，另一个窗口占用时置灰并说明。

## 一键理解状态机

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> OFF
    OFF --> ARMING: 点开关
    ARMING --> LISTENING: 权限✓ 且模型 ready
    ARMING --> BLOCKED: 权限拒 / 未准备 / 无 AudioContext / 锁被占
    BLOCKED --> ARMING: 重试
    LISTENING --> CAPTURING: RMS>门限 且持续≥300ms
    CAPTURING --> TRANSCRIBING: 静音≥silenceMs 或 ≥maxSeconds
    TRANSCRIBING --> SUBMITTING: 转写成功且通过文本闸
    TRANSCRIBING --> LISTENING: 空结果 / 过短 / 失败(计数)
    SUBMITTING --> LISTENING: 提交完成
    LISTENING --> OFF: 开关 / Esc / hidden / 切会话 / 空闲超时
    CAPTURING --> OFF: 开关 / Esc / hidden
    LISTENING --> BLOCKED: 连续失败 N 次
```

叠加位（不是停留态）：`speaking`（播报中 → 抑制触发）、`pending`（该会话有回合在跑 → 提交仍走 queue）。

## 播报引擎（v0.2.0）

播报有两种引擎，设置页「语音回复 → 播报引擎」切换：

| 引擎 | 说明 | 依赖 |
|---|---|---|
| `edge`（默认） | Edge TTS 神经语音，8 个中文音色；默认 `zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural` + `+10%` 语速（已试听定稿） | 联网 + DSH 自带 Python 里的 `edge-tts` |
| `system` | 本机 `speechSynthesis`（离线、音色旧） | 无 |

安装 `edge-tts`（一次性）：

```powershell
$py = 'C:\Users\Lenovo\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe'
& $py -m pip install edge-tts -q -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple
& $py -m edge_tts --list-voices   # 能跑通即正常
```

链路：客户端按句 `POST /api/voice-mode.tts` → Host 子进程 `python -m edge_tts` → `audio/mpeg` → 客户端 `Audio(blob)` 播放。带 50 条内存 LRU、20 次/分钟限流、10s 单句超时、预取下一句。

失败回退：断网 / 超时 / 404 / 503 时自动切回系统语音（设置项可关），诊断记一条 `edge tts failed: …`。

顶栏有两个独立入口：**麦克风开关**（输入）与 **「朗读/静音」键**（只控制助手回复自动朗读，立即生效并持久化；工具 `speak` 不受它影响）。播报中点顶栏或 `Esc` 仍只停当前这一句。

> 非官方接口：Edge TTS 是微软 Edge 朗读用的端点，可能变更或失效；`speechSynthesis` 回退是安全带。仅供本机个人使用。

维护提示：升级 `edge-tts` 或换机器后，先跑 `--list-voices`；若失效，Host 返回 503 并在诊断里提示「需安装 edge-tts」。

## 模型控制（v0.3.0）

Host 半身注册了一个模型工具 `voice_mode`，并给客户端开了一个命令队列，模型可以在自动化流程里：

| action | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `enable` | 在**当前打开的会话**里打开麦克风（进入 LISTENING） |
| `disable` | 关闭语音模式（停麦、停播、放锁） |
| `speak` | 让客户端用当前 TTS 引擎念一段文本（≤500 字，不要求语音模式开着） |
| `status` | 返回窗口最近一次回报的状态（state / speaking / sessionId / detail） |

机制：工具把命令放进 Host 内存队列；浏览器插件每 **1.5s** 轮询 `GET /api/voice-mode.control` 取走并执行，随后 `POST` 回报状态。因此工具返回的是“已入队”，不是同步结果；`status` 反映最近一次轮询。

注意：

- `enable` 需要窗口里有一个打开的会话（header 已挂载）；没有会话会被忽略并在诊断里记一条；
- 这会允许模型**主动开麦**——只在你要求（或自动化流程明确需要）时使用；
- 命令队列上限 10 条，超过丢最旧的。

## 参数（设置页可改，存本机 localStorage）

| 参数 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 触发阈值（RMS） | 0.01 | 高于它才认为在说话 |
| 最短说话时长 | 300ms | 短于此不触发，防键盘声 |
| 前置缓冲 pre-roll | 300ms | 触发前保留的音频，防止吃掉第一个字 |
| 静音收尾 | 1500ms | 静音超过它就收尾送识别 |
| 提交冷却 | 500ms | 提交后短暂忽略触发，防自激 |
| 单段上限 | 60s | 一段最长录音 |
| 最短字数 | 2 | 文本闸：短于此丢弃 |
| 连续失败上限 | 3 | 到数停麦并置灰 |
| 空闲自动退出 | 10 分钟 | 0 = 不自动退出 |
| 失焦自动退出 | 0 | 0 = 不因失焦退出 |
| 后台继续监听 | 关 | 开启后最小化/切标签也继续采集 |
| 长按插话阈值 | 500ms | 按住超过它，下一次说话走 steer |
| 语音消息标记 | `[语音] ` | 加在语音提交的消息前面，可清空 |
| 语音回复（TTS） | 开 | 是否念助手回复 |
| 播报引擎 | edge | Edge（在线）/ 系统语音（本机） |
| Edge 音色 | `zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural` | 8 个中文音色（晓晓/晓伊/云健/云希/云夏/云扬/晓北/晓妮） |
| Edge 语速 | +10% | -50% ~ +50%（已试听定稿） |
| Edge 音量 / 音高 | +0% / +0Hz | -50% ~ +50% |
| 预取下一句 | 开 | 当前句播放时提前合成下一句 |
| 失败回退系统语音 | 开 | 断网/超时/接口错误时兜底 |
| 失焦/隐藏时继续播报 | 开 | 失焦或被遮挡时**先停麦**，让当前播报自然结束；`Esc`/关开关仍立即停 |
| 单句超时 | 10000ms | 3000–30000ms |
| 播报范围 | 前 3 句 | 前 3 句 / 仅末段 / 全文 / 仅短回复 / 不播 |
| 播报字数上限 | 220 | 超过截断 |
| 跳过开场白 | 开 | 「好的/稍等」这类短句不念 |
| 单句上限 | 120 | 超长句按逗号再切 |
| 语速 | 3.0 | 0.5–5.0 |
| 句间停顿 | 150ms | 相邻句子之间的空白 |
| 音调 / 音量 | 1.0 / 1.0 | `speechSynthesis` 参数 |
| 音色 | 系统默认 | 下拉列出系统语音 |
| 播报时忽略麦克风触发 | 开 | 播报期间只听不录 |
| 允许说话打断播报 | 开 | 播报中说话会停播并录音；若转写为空/纯语气词（噪声、咳嗽）则**恢复继续念**，不会丢内容 |

## 口播稿协议（`[voice-note]`）

语音输入时（用户消息以 `[语音] ` 开头），助手可在回复的不同阶段插入多段口播稿：

```
[voice-note]: <一到三句口语化的话：结论 / 下一步 / 需要注意什么。>
```

- 尖括号是 **Markdown 链接引用定义** 的合法目标，渲染时会被吃掉、聊天里不可见；
- 插件按出现顺序逐段朗读；完全没有口播稿时回退到「念正文前 3 句」；
- 建议把约定写进工作区 `AGENTS.md`，让不同会话的 agent 都遵守。

## 安装

> 本插件是**替换内置语音行**的 proof-of-concept：它覆盖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-client-ui-voice-input` 对应的 Loader 行。

前置：

1. DSH Desktop（或 Web）profile 已启用内置语音包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`（提供 Host 侧 `speechToText`、SenseVoice provider、Remote，以及模型）；
2. 首次使用前在「插件」页完成语音模型的「下载并准备」。

安装（创造模式对话，或手动）：

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<本目录绝对路径>
```

插件的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会把内置 `ui-voice-input` 行 `disabled: true`，并插入 `ui-voice-mode` 行指向本包。**不要同时启用两支麦克风**（见文件顶部维护注释）。

卸载：

```
plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=dsh-voice-chat-mode
```

## 依赖自包含（v0.7.0）

- `vendor/python/` 内置 edge-tts 7.3.1 及其依赖（Win + CPython 3.12 轮子，约 3.7 MB）；Host 合成时把它加进 `PYTHONPATH`，**优先用自带依赖**，不碰系统 site-packages。
- 自带包缺失或与当前 Python 版本不匹配时，Host 会**自动执行一次** `pip install edge-tts --target vendor/python`（无需用户手动装）。
- 播报回退到系统语音时，界面左下角会**显式弹提示**（20 秒或手动关闭），不再静默降级；设置页依赖状态会标注「插件自带 / 系统已安装」。
- `npm run check:client` 校验生成物 `client.js` 与 `client-body.js` + 当前 DSH bundle 同步；GitHub Actions `.github/workflows/verify.yml` 在推送/PR 时跑播放器与工具测试（不依赖网络）。

## AI 怎么知道这个插件（v0.5.0）

插件装进 DSH 后，任何 agent 不需要读 README 也能按约定工作，靠三个模型可见面：

1. **系统提示词节** `plugin:voice-chat-mode`（order 3200）：说明 `[语音] ` 开头的用户消息是口述转写、回复可以用 `[voice-note]: <…>` 块控制朗读、不要给打字消息加口播稿；
2. **动态状态上下文** `plugin:voice-chat-mode`（order 215）：每一步注入一行 `state=LISTENING, speaking=no` 之类的当前状态（来自浏览器每 1.5s 回报）；
3. **`voice_mode` 工具**：enable / disable / speak / status；调用会等到窗口真正应用（≤2.5s）再返回 `applied`，不再是"已入队"。

反面：设置页、顶栏按钮、诊断日志都是**人看的 UI**，模型看不到；模型能依赖的只有上面三项。工作区的 `AGENTS.md` 口播规则仍然有用，但已不是必需——提示词节会兜底。

补一句给维护者：提示词节与状态上下文在 Host 半身 `index.js` 注册（`ctx.systemPrompt.section/context`），改文案时保持"行为描述、不写实现细节"，也不要和工具描述重复。

## 给其他用户安装（分发）

本插件不是"下载即用"的独立应用：它依赖 DSH 自带的东西，必须先满足。

1. **DSH**：`>=0.2.0`（实测 0.2.1-rc.5，Windows 10 + Desktop）。
2. **内置语音输入 bundle**（提供本地 SenseVoice 转写与模型）：
   - 在「插件」页启用**实验性语音输入**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`）；
   - 首次使用前在插件详情里「下载并准备」模型（SenseVoice int8 约 228 MB + Silero VAD 1.7 MB，下载到用户自己的 `~/.dsh/speech-to-text/sensevoice/models`）。
3. **Edge TTS（仅 `edge` 引擎需要，可选）**：用 DSH 自带 Python 安装一次——

   ```powershell
   $py = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe"
   & $py -m pip install edge-tts -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple
   & $py -m pip show edge-tts   # 能打印版本即可
   ```

   路径随 DSH 版本可能不同；在 DSH 安装目录/运行时里找 `python.exe` 即可。
4. **安装插件**：插件页「添加插件」填包名 `dsh-voice-chat-mode`；或 CLI：
   `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice-chat-mode`。本地开发用 `plugin_manager install_bundle` 指向目录绝对路径。
5. 刷新页面 / 重启 DSH。

> 找不到 `edge-tts` 时插件不会崩：Host 返回 503，客户端自动回退系统语音；设置页「依赖状态」会显示未安装与安装命令。

## 依赖与隐私

| 依赖 | 由谁提供 | 大小/成本 | 是否必须 |
|---|---|---|---|
| DSH >=0.2.0 | 用户安装 | — | 必须 |
| SenseVoice + Silero VAD 模型 | DSH 内置语音 bundle 下载 | ~230 MB | 必须（转写） |
| Edge TTS（Python 包 + 微软在线端点） | 用户 pip 安装；联网 | 免费 | 可选（默认引擎） |
| 系统语音 speechSynthesis | 操作系统 | 0 | 回退 |

**隐私边界：**

- **识别在本机**：录音只在浏览器与 Host 回环接口之间传输，SenseVoice 在 Host CPU 上推理，不上传云端；音频不写进会话事件/附件。
- **Edge TTS 会把"要念的句子文本"发送到微软 Edge 朗读端点**（HTTPS）；不发送音频、不发送会话历史。这是选用 Edge 引擎的代价；系统引擎完全离线。
- Host 路由注册在 `/api` 认证栅栏内，只接受已认证的本机浏览器连接；默认部署只监听回环地址，不对外提供多用户服务。
- 无遥测；诊断只保存在浏览器 localStorage。
- **模型不随插件分发，也不共享**：每个用户各自从 DSH/微软下载源获取，互不可见。

## 发布流程（维护者）

DSH 的标准分发通道是 **npm 包 + `dsh` 清单**（本仓库 `package.json` 已是可发布形态：`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`，无运行时 npm 依赖）：

1. 改版本 → `npm publish`（需要 npm 账号；scoped 包用 `--access public`）；
2. 用户安装：
   - 插件页「添加插件」输入包名（即 README 里 `dsh plugin add` 后那段）；
   - 或 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice-chat-mode`；
3. 可选：加入**插件市场**——按格式 1 写一份 JSON 索引（name/version/target/registry/元数据），用户在「插件页 → 发现 → 添加索引源」填 URL 即可浏览安装，无需官方审核；

   本仓库已带一份格式 1 索引：`plugin-market-index.json`，可直接添加
   `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BeepFlyer/dsh-voice-chat-mode/main/plugin-market-index.json`。
   当前版本以 **git commit 固定**（仓库根即包目录）；发布 npm 后把 `source` 换成 `{ "type": "npm" }` 即可。
4. 验证：安装后 `plugin_manager list_plugins` 看行状态、顶栏出现两个按钮、设置页出现「语音聊天模式」。

GitHub 只作为源码与 issue 仓库，DSH 安装器不读 release（Git 地址可作为安装源，但 npm 是标准通道）。

## 兼容性

- 实测：DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 / Windows 10 19045 / Desktop profile；Windows 11 应同样可用。
- Web profile（浏览器）：需要 loopback + 麦克风权限；Edge 路由与工具同样可用。
- 依赖 DSH 的 `connection.fetch`、`tools`、`settings.section`、`conversation.session.header.utilities` 等稳定接口；大版本升级时按 `cordis.patch.yml` 维护注释核对。
- 覆盖内置行：与内置 `ui-voice-input` 行**互斥**，不要同时启用两个麦克风插件。

## 架构

```
voice-mode/
├── package.json          # bundle 清单 + dsh.client 声明
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 覆盖内置 ui-voice-input 行（含维护注释）
├── index.js              # Host 标记（apply 为空）
├── client-body.js        # 可读源码：状态机引擎 + UI（真实入口）
├── client.js             # 生成物：loader 工厂 + 内联 speech Remote + client-body
├── scripts/build-client.mjs  # 从 app.asar 抓取 Remote 生成物并重建 client.js
├── locale/               # 插件展示元数据
└── icon.svg
```

- **client 模块**：`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory(require) })`，React 取自页面模块表；
- **Remote**：内联 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-api-speech-to-text` 的生成定义，经 `ctx.remote.$mount()` 挂载，调用 `catalog / prepare / transcribe`；
- **采集**：`getUserMedia`（AEC + NS）→ `ScriptProcessorNode` 直取 PCM → 环形缓冲 pre-roll → 16k mono PCM16 WAV → base64；
- **提交**：`ctx.sessions.retain()` → `binding.session.beginSubmission/prompt`；`cancel()` 用于硬关闭；
- **TTS**：`speechSynthesis` + 句队列；播报期间 `speaking` 抑制触发，结束后冷却恢复。

## 开发

```bash
node scripts/build-client.mjs      # 重建 client.js（从 app.asar 读 Remote 生成物）
node --check client.js             # 语法检查
```

调试：

- 设置页底部 **诊断**：最近 24 条引擎事件（状态切换 / 触发 / 转写 / 提交 / TTS / 看门狗）；
- 设置页 **播放测试**：用系统语音念一句，先排除扬声器/系统语音问题；
- 改 `client.js` 后客户端会热重载，**模式内存态会清空**，需要重新点开。

## 已知限制

- TTS 用系统 `speechSynthesis`：音色/自然度取决于操作系统（Windows 10 只有较老的 SAPI 语音）；
- 不支持流式合成（按句播放）、不支持语气/情绪识别（Host `Transcript` 没有 emotion 字段）；
- 需要内置语音包提供 Host 侧识别服务；模型未准备时进入 `BLOCKED`；
- 后台监听受浏览器音频节流影响（有看门狗自愈与诊断）；
- 仅 Windows 实测；理论支持 Web 版（loopback + 麦克风权限）。

## 路线图

- 在线音色：Host 侧薄代理接入 Edge TTS（免费）/ Azure Speech（官方、需信用卡）；客户端播放器换成音频流；
- 中英混读：按句自动切换中文/英文音色；
- barge-in：说话即打断播报（已有开关与代码路径）；
- 语气/情感：需要 fork provider 或扩展 `Transcript` 字段，成本较高。

# Tobs [中文](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/README.md) ｜ **English** [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@botharness/tobs?style=flat-square&color=3d5afe&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@botharness/tobs) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-71964a?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/built_for-DeepSeek_Harness-b8702f?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **Tobs: the open-source Grok Bot alternative. A crew of bots, each with its own identity, persona and memory, working together.** [Website](https://tobs.app/en/) · [Video](#video) · [Install](#install) · [Features](#features) · [Releases](#releases) · [vs. DS Bot](#deepseek-bot-projects) · [Community](#community) · [Docs](https://tobs.app/en/docs/overview/)
## Video Tobs in three minutes: a crew of bots with their own identity, persona and memory, working together in a small town. Recorded under the former DeepSeekBot name. Click the poster to play.

Tobs is BotHarness’s MIT-licensed, open-source Grok Bot alternative, running as a plugin in [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Create Bots for research, writing or coding and work with them like colleagues: chat one to one, bring them into a group, hand them tasks. They remember you, do things on schedule, and answer you under their own identity in Slack, Discord, Lark / Feishu, QQ and WeChat. Bots use the model providers and quota you set up in DSH, and the machine running DSH has to stay online for Bots to keep working in the background. Tobs is a different project from the similarly named DS Bot (npm `ds-bot`); see [how they differ](#deepseek-bot-projects). ## Install Tobs was formerly named **DeepSeekBot**. The `deepseekbot` npm package and command remain supported for existing users; new installations use `@botharness/tobs`, with the `tobs` command. Follow the [installation guide](https://tobs.app/en/docs/installation/) for the current verified installation command; install and enable it in DeepSeek Harness, and **Bot mode** appears in the sidebar. No DSH yet? [Get the desktop app](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/). For command-line install, version notes and troubleshooting, see the [installation guide](https://tobs.app/en/docs/installation/). ## What you can do with it | You want | How Tobs helps | | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **A small AI team of your own** | Create a researcher, a designer, an engineer. Each Bot has a name, a persona and a pixel avatar, and stays the same Bot across conversations. | | **Bots that remember you** | Bots keep your preferences and project context and pick up where they left off. You can read and correct their memory, and sync it to other computers. | | **Several Bots on one job** | Bring Bots into a group chat and @ whoever you need. Hand a bigger task to one Bot to work on separately; it reports back and asks when it needs your call. | | **Bots in the chat apps you use** | Connect Bots to Slack, Discord, Lark / Feishu, QQ and WeChat. @ them in a group or message them directly, and they reply in place under their own identity; in WeChat DMs they can also send and receive files. | | **Things done on time** | Say “send me a log summary every morning at 9” and the Bot sets up the schedule itself, or set one to run every few minutes, hours or days. | | **Help on your computer and browser** | Once you allow it, a Bot can open web pages, click, type and take screenshots, or work on a shared desktop. You watch it live and can pause it any time. | | **Ready-made Bots in one click** | Browse and install Bots other people share in the [Bot Marketplace](https://tobs.app/en/market), share your own, or send a Bot to a friend as a zip. | | **Know what each update brings** | After an update, Bot mode shows what is new; check for and install updates from Settings in one click. | ### Pixel avatars Every Bot gets a pixel avatar made from its name, and while it works the avatar morphs into the tool it is using. Want to make one? Type a name in the [Avatar Studio](https://tobs.app/en/avatar) on our website and download it in high resolution. ## Screenshots

Bot DMs and memory evolution: Mira finds the visitor numbers in her memory; every commit and branch of that memory is on the right.
Group chats: @ three Bots and each replies; Nova reads the first two before answering.

Schedules: one sentence and the Bot sets up the task.
Bot Marketplace: find Bots by topic or keyword and install one as a new colleague (sample data).

Home and Tob: put panels side by side; ask Tob and it reports on all your Bots.
Appearance: themes, colors, a wallpaper library and see-through panels, saved on this device only.
_Screenshots from an isolated local DSH; the conversations are a fictional observatory-exhibition example._ ## Memory you can see Each Bot's memory is a plain Git repository. In the sidebar you can read what it remembers and see which lines changed and when, and edit anything that is wrong. Push it to GitHub to use the same Bot on several computers. See the [memory evolution guide](https://tobs.app/en/docs/channel-sidebar/memory-evolution/). ## Release highlights Full history on the [website changelog](https://tobs.app/en/changelog/). | Version | What's new | | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | **[1.6.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.6.1)** (2026-11-02) | **Bot Network**: Bots on computers in the same Tailscale network, under the same Connect account, or on a LAN both sides approve can find and message each other; long conversations and chat switching are much smoother, and Bot avatars are now static images; the composer's model button opens model settings directly; bundled cloudflared security update. Upgrading migrates local data, so 1.6.0 cannot open it afterwards. | | **[1.6.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.6.0)** (2026-10-29) | A **Simple layout mode** for Bot mode; the **Bot Marketplace** gains uploads, daily picks and a review by Tob before install; see an Assignment's work by Orchestrator round; QQ private messages and Bot-to-Bot mentions in Lark and Discord; many desktop and mobile fixes. | | **[1.5.2](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.5.2)** (2026-10-25) | **Native desktop zoom is enabled by default**, without extra setup; fixes improve Windows/macOS Computer component reuse and setup errors. | | **[1.5.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.5.1)** (2026-10-25) | **Tobs ships as `@botharness/tobs`**, keeping the supported `deepseekbot` entry; Bots use one delivery path for Channels and external chats; **background task results** can wake an idle Bot and report back; fixes restore installed CLI startup and the return-to-latest-message button. | | **[1.5.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.5.0)** (2026-10-22) | **Tobs Connect** pairs a phone through your account without Tailscale; **Storage** clears old media and messages; the Bot Marketplace becomes a panel; plugins update from Bot settings; Bot mode is fast again on long conversations; the VRM companion installs on its own. | | **[1.4.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.4.1)** (2026-10-20) | A five-step intro from Tob the first time you enter Bot mode; Bot mode gets its own **themes, see-through panels and a wallpaper library**; `/compact` and Idle Compaction keep long conversations fast; quick search jumps to any setting; Memory previews images and Markdown; the mobile Beta adds notification switches. | | **[1.4.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.4.0)** (2026-10-19) | **Tob** on Home manages Bots, models and groups through chat; the desktop becomes a drag-and-drop **panel workspace** that remembers each Channel's layout; a reviewer model can handle approvals; pair a phone; the CLI covers almost everything the UI does. Supports DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 through 0.2.x. | | **[1.3.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.3.1)** (2026-10-14) | Installing `deepseekbot` from the Plugins page takes one step again, with no build approval; needs DSH 0.2.0-rc.2. The `deepseekbot` CLI can configure a Host, drive a Bot's Browser and Computer, and manage IM apps; the Browser panel updates live. | | **[1.3.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.3.0)** (2026-10-14) | One design system across Bot mode, with Channel settings in a dialog; the Orchestrator tidies its own inbox and tasks; Bots use your secrets for CLI tools and **MCP** servers with your approval, and set up MCP from one sentence; **export** multi-selected messages; Bot colors, more pixel species and hand-drawn parts; restore memory to any version. Needs DSH 0.2.0 or later. | | **[1.2.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.2.1)** (2026-10-12) | Fixes installs failing on some DSH versions; group avatars show a grid of member avatars; audio and file attachments play and download in place. | | **[1.2.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/v1.2.0/CHANGELOG.md#120---2026-10-08)** (2026-10-08) | Pixel **Window Companions** you can pin on your desktop; bind one app to message Bots in Lark, Slack, Discord and WeChat; **import and export** Bots as zip files; Bot profiles with a banner and bio. | | **1.1.0** (2026-10-06) | **Schedules**; every conversation carries the Bot's persona and core memory; **one-click update** in Settings; WeChat voice-to-text and images. | | **1.0.1** (2026-10-05) | First stable release: PersonaBots with their own identity, Git memory, group chats, delegated tasks, pixel avatars, IM connections and the first **Bot Marketplace**. | ## Tobs and DS Bot (ds-bot): two projects, different focus The names are close, but these are two independent open-source projects. Both run on DeepSeek Harness (DSH), and neither is an official DeepSeek product. - **Tobs**, this repository, by BotHarness, makes each Bot a long-lived colleague that **works beyond the DSH window**: Git memory you can review, the Bot's own Lark / Slack / Discord / WeChat identity, schedules, delegated Assignments and a Bot Marketplace. - **DS Bot**, [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot) (npm `ds-bot`, also written DeepSeek Bot in its README), **turns DSH itself into a bot chat app**: a main Bot, Chief, sets up your team through conversation, a group admin answers first to keep token use down, and a Usage page shows tokens by time, Bot and model. | | Tobs | DS Bot (ds-bot) | | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Repository | [BotHarness/DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) | [Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot) | | Package | npm [`@botharness/tobs`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@botharness/tobs) | npm [`ds-bot`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ds-bot) | | License | MIT | Apache-2.0 | | Memory | One Git working tree per Bot: files, commits and diffs; push to GitHub to share it across machines | Markdown memory reviewed after each turn; personal and team levels | | Several Bots | @ whoever you need in a Group; Assignments delegate separate tasks with their own reports | A main Bot manages the team; a group admin answers by default and calls in other Bots | | Beyond DSH | Bots join Lark / Feishu, Slack, Discord and WeChat under their own identity | GitHub connector | | Also | Schedules, Bot Marketplace, Bot import and export, pixel avatars | Schedules, Usage page | **Which one?** If you want Bots to work in your IM under their own identity, or to review and sync memory with Git, try Tobs. If you want a main Bot to walk you through building a team inside DSH and keep an eye on token use, try DS Bot. Both are open source, so read both codebases: [Tobs](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot) · [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot). For a longer comparison, see [the article on our website](https://tobs.app/en/blog/deepseekbot-vs-ds-bot/). ## FAQ ### Which DeepSeek Bot project is this? This is **Tobs by BotHarness**: npm package [`@botharness/tobs`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@botharness/tobs), website [tobs.app](https://tobs.app/en/). DS Bot uses `ds-bot` and is a separate project, not a short name or an older version of this one. See [how the two differ](#deepseek-bot-projects). ### Does Tobs require DeepSeek models? No. It uses the providers configured in DSH; availability depends on API support, model settings and credentials. Memory and chat history stay on your host, while calls to a remote model send relevant context to the provider you chose. ## For developers To run from source or contribute, you need Node ≥22 and pnpm. ```bash git clone https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot.git BotHarness cd BotHarness pnpm install && pnpm build node scripts/dev-instance.mjs --home /tmp/botharness-demo --port 31967 ``` More in the [local instance guide](docs/client-bridge.md) · [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [architecture](docs/architecture/botharness-architecture.md) · [decisions](docs/adr/) · [agent guidelines](AGENTS.md) · [Release Ledger](CHANGELOG.md) · [DSH docs](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/). For real IM tests, the [shared QA App wizard](docs/agents/im-test-apps.md) configures independent Lark, Slack and Discord QA1/QA2/QA3 slots. For example, run `node scripts/dev-im-test-apps.mjs setup discord` to enter the Token privately; confirm the current exclusive window before each receiver start. ## Community Questions, ideas and the Bots you build are all welcome. | Come say hello | Build something together | | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | [](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) | [Join the Tobs server](https://discord.gg/aEB2Ayhu7B) to ask questions and share your crew. | | | Search for group **1125565676** in QQ. | | [](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions) | [Questions, ideas and things you have made](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions) · [Welcome thread](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions/1397). | | [](CONTRIBUTING.md) | [Contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [First contribution](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/discussions/1398). Docs, tests and answers all help; use [Issues](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/issues/new/choose) for confirmed bugs and implementation tasks. | | | We are on Product Hunt. Take a look and share Tobs with a friend. | ## Repository status **Last 30 days:** c

# Tobs **中文** ｜ [English](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/README.en.md) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@botharness/tobs?style=flat-square&color=3d5afe&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@botharness/tobs) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-71964a?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/built_for-DeepSeek_Harness-b8702f?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **Tobs（托布）：开源的 GrokBot 平替。一组有各自身份、人格和记忆的 bots，一起做事。** [官网](https://tobs.app) · [宣传片](#video) · [安装](#install) · [能力](#features) · [版本亮点](#releases) · [与 DS Bot 的区别](#deepseek-bot-projects) · [社区](#community) · [文档](https://tobs.app/docs/overview/)
## 宣传片 3 分钟看懂 Tobs：一组有身份、人格和记忆的 bots，在小镇里一起做事。视频录制时仍使用旧名 DeepSeekBot；点击封面即可播放。

Tobs（托布）是 BotHarness 开发的 MIT 开源 GrokBot 平替，作为插件运行在 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)里。你可以创建几个分别负责研究、写作或写代码的 Bot，像和同事一样私聊、拉群、派活；它们记得你，会按时做事，还能在 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信里以自己的身份回你消息。 模型用你在 DSH 里配置的服务商和额度；Bot 需要在后台持续工作时，运行 DSH 的电脑要保持在线。它和名字很像的 DS Bot（npm `ds-bot`）是两个独立项目，区别见[下文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ## 安装 Tobs（托布）原名 **DeepSeekBot**。已有用户仍可使用 `deepseekbot` npm 包和命令；新用户请安装 `@botharness/tobs`，使用 `tobs` 命令。 按[安装指南](https://tobs.app/docs/installation/)复制当前已验证的安装命令，在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端安装并启用，侧栏就会出现「Bot 模式」。还没装 DSH？先[下载桌面端](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)。 命令行安装、版本说明和常见问题见[官网安装指南](https://tobs.app/docs/installation/)。 ## 能用它做什么 | 你想要 | Tobs 怎么帮你 | | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **一支自己的 AI 小团队** | 创建研究员、设计师、工程师等 Bot，每个都有名字、人格和像素头像，换个对话也还是同一个它。 | | **让 Bot 记住你** | Bot 会记下你的偏好和项目背景，下次直接接着干；记忆随时能翻看、纠正，也能同步到别的电脑。 | | **多个 Bot 一起干活** | 把 Bot 拉进群聊，需要谁就 @ 谁；大一点的任务可以交给 Bot 单独去做，做完交回报告，需要你拍板时会提醒你。 | | **在常用的聊天软件里找它** | 把 Bot 接入 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信，在群里 @ 它或私聊，它就在原处用自己的身份回复；微信私聊里还能收发文件。 | | **定时做事** | 说一句「每天早上 9 点给我发日志摘要」，Bot 就自己建好定时任务；也可以手动设置每隔几分钟、几小时或每天执行。 | | **帮你操作电脑和浏览器** | 授权后，Bot 可以打开网页、点击、输入、截图，或操作一台共享桌面；你能实时看着它做，随时暂停。 | | **一键装别人做好的 Bot** | 在 [Bot 市场](https://tobs.app/market)浏览、安装别人分享的 Bot，也能把自己的 Bot 分享出去，或打包成 zip 发给朋友。 | | **知道每次更新了什么** | 升级后会告诉你这一版新增了什么；在设置里就能检查并一键更新。 | ### 像素头像 每个 Bot 都有一张由名字生成的像素头像，工作时还会变成它正在用的工具。想自己捏一个？到[官网头像工坊](https://tobs.app/avatar)输入名字试试，还能下载高清头像。 ## 截图

Bot 私聊与记忆演化：Mira 从记忆里找出访客统计；右侧能看到它记忆的每次提交和分支。
群聊协作：@ 三个 Bot，它们各自回复，Nova 读完前两位再接话。

定时任务：一句话让 Bot 自己建任务。
Bot 市场：按话题和关键词找 Bot，点「安装」就多一位同事（图中为示例数据）。

首页与托布：面板可以并排摆放；问托布一句，它就汇报所有 Bot 的状态。
界面设置：主题、配色、壁纸库和半透明面板，只保存在这台设备上。
_截图来自隔离的本地 DSH，对话是虚构的天文台展览示例。_ ## 看得见的记忆 每个 Bot 的记忆就是一个普通的 Git 仓库。你可以在侧栏翻看它记了什么、哪天改了哪几行，觉得不对就直接改；推到 GitHub，就能在几台电脑之间共用同一个 Bot。详见[记忆演化指南](https://tobs.app/docs/channel-sidebar/memory-evolution/)。 ## 版本亮点 完整记录见[官网更新日志](https://tobs.app/changelog/)。 | 版本 | 新内容 | | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **[1.6.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.6.1)**（2026-11-02） | **Bot 网络**：同一 Tailscale 网络、同一 Connect 账号，或经双方批准的局域网电脑之间，Bot 可以互相发现并私聊；长对话和切换聊天明显更流畅，Bot 头像改为静态图片；输入框的模型按钮直接打开模型设置；随附 cloudflared 安全更新。升级会迁移本地数据，不能直接退回 1.6.0。 | | **[1.6.0](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.6.0)**（2026-10-29） | Bot 模式新增**简洁布局**；**Bot 市场**支持上传、每日精选，安装前由托布审核；按 Orchestrator 轮次查看 Assignment 的工作；QQ 私聊，以及飞书和 Discord 中 Bot 互相 @；修复大量桌面端和移动端问题。 | | **[1.5.2](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.5.2)**（2026-10-25） | **原生桌面缩放默认启用**，无需额外设置；修复 Windows/macOS 的 Computer 组件复用与安装错误提示。 | | **[1.5.1](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/releases/tag/v1.5.1)**（2026-10-25） | **Tobs 新安装包** `@botharness/tobs` 正式发布，保留 Connect**：手机不装 Tailscale、登录账号一点就能配对；**存储空间**可清理旧媒体和旧消息；Bot 市场变成面板；插件在 Bot 设置里一键更新；长对话里的 Bot 模式重新流畅；VRM 伴侣可单独安装。 | | # @botharness/vrm-companion A VRM companion Panel for [DeepSeekBot](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot): the Bot's character sits at a desk in a lo-fi study room in the style of Chill with You. It types while the Bot works, looks up while it thinks, turns to you and speaks the Bot's committed replies in a speech bubble, and between tasks sips coffee, rests its chin or checks its phone. Day, night and weather follow your local clock, and **Change character…** loads your own `.vrm` file (VRoid/VRM 0.x or VRM 1.0) without uploading it. ## Requirements - DeepSeek Harness (DSH) `>=0.2.0-0` (including later prereleases; runtime qualification is separate). - DeepSeekBot newer than 1.4.1, installed in the same Profile. The Panel uses DeepSeekBot's `botPresentation` and `dockPanels` services, which 1.4.1 and earlier do not provide, and the DSH Client `locale` service for its Chinese and English text; the Panel does not load without them. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile add @botharness/vrm-companion@0.2.0 ``` Restart the Host. In Bot mode, select a Bot DM, open Messages and choose **VRM Companion** (**VRM 伴侣** in Chinese) in the Messages header. The pin icon creates a fixed instance for that Bot. See the [Panel guide](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/docs/panel-plugin.md) for controls and behavior. ## License The source code is MIT; see [LICENSE](LICENSE). The bundled assets keep their own terms: - The default character, VRoid Project's AvatarSample_A, may be used, modified and redistributed without credit under its VRoid Hub conditions; it is not under the MIT license. See [assets/README.md](assets/README.md). - The room models are KayKit Furniture Bits by Kay Lousberg, CC0; see [assets/kaykit/README.md](assets/kaykit/README.md). - The lilToon shader port is MIT; see [assets/THREE-LILTOON-LICENSE.txt](assets/THREE-LILTOON-LICENSE.txt) and its third-party notices. ## Release `@botharness/vrm-companion` is versioned independently of DeepSeekBot and published by `.github/workflows/vrm-companion-release.yml`. 1. Bump `version` in `packages/vrm-companion/package.json` (a prerelease such as `0.2.0-rc.1` goes to the `next` dist-tag, anything else to `latest`) and merge it to `main`. 2. Tag that commit on `main` and push the tag: ```sh git tag vrm-companion-v0.2.0 && git push origin vrm-companion-v0.2.0 ``` 3. The workflow checks that the tag is on `main` and matches the package version, runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm build` and the VRM tests, then waits for approval in the `npm-release` environment. 4. After approval it runs `npm publish --provenance --access public` in `packages/vrm-companion`. It authenticates with npm trusted publishing when a Trusted Publisher for this workflow is configured on npmjs.com for `@botharness/vrm-companion`, and otherwise with the `NPM_TOKEN` secret.
# Tobs **中文** ｜ [English](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/README.en.md) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@botharness/tobs?style=flat-square&color=3d5afe&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@botharness/tobs) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-71964a?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/built_for-DeepSeek_Harness-b8702f?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **Tobs（托布）：开源的 GrokBot 平替。一组有各自身份、人格和记忆的 bots，一起做事。** [官网](https://tobs.app) · [宣传片](#video) · [安装](#install) · [能力](#features) · [版本亮点](#releases) · [与 DS Bot 的区别](#deepseek-bot-projects) · [社区](#community) · [文档](https://tobs.app/docs/overview/)
## 宣传片 3 分钟看懂 Tobs：一组有身份、人格和记忆的 bots，在小镇里一起做事。视频录制时仍使用旧名 DeepSeekBot；点击封面即可播放。

Tobs（托布）是 BotHarness 开发的 MIT 开源 GrokBot 平替，作为插件运行在 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)里。你可以创建几个分别负责研究、写作或写代码的 Bot，像和同事一样私聊、拉群、派活；它们记得你，会按时做事，还能在 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信里以自己的身份回你消息。 模型用你在 DSH 里配置的服务商和额度；Bot 需要在后台持续工作时，运行 DSH 的电脑要保持在线。它和名字很像的 DS Bot（npm `ds-bot`）是两个独立项目，区别见[下文](#deepseek-bot-projects)。 ## 安装 Tobs（托布）原名 **DeepSeekBot**。已有用户仍可使用 `deepseekbot` npm 包和命令；新用户请安装 `@botharness/tobs`，使用 `tobs` 命令。 按[安装指南](https://tobs.app/docs/installation/)复制当前已验证的安装命令，在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端安装并启用，侧栏就会出现「Bot 模式」。还没装 DSH？先[下载桌面端](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)。 命令行安装、版本说明和常见问题见[官网安装指南](https://tobs.app/docs/installation/)。 ## 能用它做什么 | 你想要 | Tobs 怎么帮你 | | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **一支自己的 AI 小团队** | 创建研究员、设计师、工程师等 Bot，每个都有名字、人格和像素头像，换个对话也还是同一个它。 | | **让 Bot 记住你** | Bot 会记下你的偏好和项目背景，下次直接接着干；记忆随时能翻看、纠正，也能同步到别的电脑。 | | **多个 Bot 一起干活** | 把 Bot 拉进群聊，需要谁就 @ 谁；大一点的任务可以交给 Bot 单独去做，做完交回报告，需要你拍板时会提醒你。 | | **在常用的聊天软件里找它** | 把 Bot 接入 Slack、Discord、飞书 / Lark、QQ 和微信，在群里 @ 它或私聊，它就在原处用自己的身份回复；微信私聊里还能收发文件。 | | **定时做事** | 说一句「每天早上 9 点给我发日志摘要」，Bot 就自己建好定时任务；也可以手动设置每隔几分钟、几小时或每天执行。 | | **帮你操作电脑和浏览器** | 授权后，Bot 可以打开网页、点击、输入、截图，或操作一台共享桌面；你能实时看着它做，随时暂停。 | | **一键装别人做好的 Bot** | 在 [Bot 市场](https://tobs.app/market)浏览、安装别人分享的 Bot，也能把自己的 Bot 分享出去，或打包成 zip 发给朋友。 | | **知道每次更新了什么** | 升级后会告诉你这一版新增了什么；在设置里就能检查并一键更新。 | ### 像素头像 每个 Bot 都有一张由名字生成的像素头像，工作时还会变成它正在用的工具。想自己捏一个？到[官网头像工坊](https://tobs.app/avatar)输入名字试试，还能下载高清头像。 ## 截图

Bot 私聊与记忆演化：Mira 从记忆里找出访客统计；右侧能看到它记忆的每次提交和分支。
群聊协作：@ 三个 Bot，它们各自回复，Nova 读完前两位再接话。

定时任务：一句话让 Bot 自己建任务。
Bot 市场：按话题和关键词找 Bot，点「安装」就多一位同事（图中为示例数据）。

首页与托布：面板可以并排摆放；问托布一句，它就汇报所有 Bot 的状态。
界面设置：主题、配色、壁纸库和半透明面板，只保存在这台设备上。
_截图来自隔离的本地 DSH，对话是虚构的天文台展览示例。_ ## 看得见的记忆 每个 Bot 的记忆就是一个普通的 Git 仓库。你可以在侧栏翻看它记了什么、哪天改了哪几行，觉得不对就直接改；推到 GitHub，就能在几台电脑之间共用同一个 Bot。详见[记忆演化指南](https://tobs.app/docs/channel-sidebar/memory-evolution/)。 ## 版本亮点 完整记录见[官网更新日志](https://tobs.app/changelog/)。 | 版本 | 新内容 | | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
