# StudyHub search extension

A companion bundle for [StudyHub](https://github.com/EricWang1358/dsh-web-studyhub). It lets StudyHub search large textbooks by topic: StudyHub's Settings and its "Large textbooks" card install it with one click, and build the index with one more.

It contains one small DSH plugin that mounts DSH's MCP client for [mcp-local-rag](https://github.com/shinpr/mcp-local-rag) (MIT, pinned in `package.json`). The server is started with the Node that DSH itself runs on and finds its files next to this package, so nothing in DSH's configuration is edited by hand, and no system Node, Python or Docker is needed. Index and model cache live under `<DSH home>/study/retrieval`.

The first index build downloads the embedding model (about 90 MB, per the server's documentation). The default model favours English; keyword matching still helps Chinese text. To download from another address, set `hfEndpoint` (an https URL) in `<DSH home>/study/retrieval.json`, which StudyHub's Settings also offers under Advanced; the server's documentation describes this as `HF_ENDPOINT`.

Before the server starts, the extension checks its index. An index the server could not open (for example one whose newest files a crash left empty) is moved aside to `chunks.lance.broken-<time>` (kept, never deleted), `<DSH home>/study/retrieval/reset.json` records when and why, and the server starts on an empty index; StudyHub then asks for the index to be built again. The check opens the table with the server's own LanceDB in a separate process, and only when its newest version changed since the last check passed.

License: MIT.

# StudyHub

English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Turn your lecture slides into questions that each link back to their page; finish a round and see yourself getting it.

Free and open source, your materials stay on your computer; pick your own model and pay for what you use.

StudyHub is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/), an AI agent app. DSH runs as a desktop app or as a web page served from your own computer, and StudyHub opens inside it.

[Try the demo](https://daily-flashcard-demo.ziangw1358.chatgpt.site) · [Install guide](docs/install.md) · [Release 4.4.4](https://github.com/EricWang1358/dsh-web-studyhub/releases/tag/v4.4.4) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

The demo runs in your browser with sample questions and prepared AI replies. It needs no install and no key, and your progress there stays in that browser.

## At a glance

- **Made for:** students who learn from slides, PDFs, notes and recorded lectures, in English or Chinese.
- **Cost:** StudyHub is free and open source (MIT). Browsing sources, answering questions and review scheduling are free, with no model calls. Generating questions and AI help are billed by your model provider. StudyHub shows the estimated tokens before a generation run and the actual tokens after it, and **Statistics** totals the last 7 or 30 days.
- **Network and cost:** supported regions, free allowances and pricing depend on each provider’s current terms. If installing from the GitHub address fails, see the notes under [Quick start](#quick-start).
- **Computers:** the install links below cover Windows x64 and macOS on Apple silicon. For other systems, check current DSH support or use the web version with Node.js 22.19 or later.
- **Requires:** DSH 0.2 (0.2.0-rc.2 or later, below 0.3).
- **Your data:** the library is a folder on your computer. [Data and privacy](#data-and-privacy) lists what is sent where.

## What you can do

- **Make questions from your own sources.** Pick pages or chapters and generate flashcards, single- or multiple-choice, open-response or fill-in-the-blank questions. Every question cites its passage, and you review the draft before you publish it.
- **Move between questions and sources.** A citation opens the passage it came from. In a source, paragraph and table markers lead to the questions and explanations linked to them.
- **Practise and review.** Start today's study from the **Study library**, follow a **Learning flow** (a short lesson, then practice), click **Help me understand** on any question, and let FSRS-6 schedule your reviews.
- **Add exam focus highlights, even from screenshots.** Drop chat screenshots, whiteboard photos or scope notes into **Add exam focus…** (works with both vision and text-only models such as DeepSeek): focus topics schedule at shorter intervals, go first in daily rounds and study plans, and generate deeper application and advanced questions. Once topics are saved, the home shows how many are mastered, not yet and without questions, with a link to practise the ones you can't do yet; **Course settings** lists each topic with its questions.
- **Find weak points.** Use **Mistakes & weak points**, **Statistics** and **Mock exam**, which offers a multiple-choice paper, a case paper or an oral interview.
- **Finish with a daily recap.** After answering 10 distinct questions in one course on the same day, generate one recap across its chapters. Retries count once. Choose a friendly or professional tone and opt into automatic generation in Settings. Recaps use the source reader; saving one as a source and publishing on CSDN are separate actions.
- **Turn recordings into text.** Import a lecture recording, or transcribe a **Live class** as it happens, and get a Chinese–English transcript you can generate questions from.
- **Read and organise.** The reader keeps its toolbar short (**Contents**, **Make questions**, **Mistakes**, **Mind map**); search, **Translate…**, display settings and **Study tools** are in **More**, and **Practise these pages** is the arrow beside **Make questions**. Courses, **Study notes**, **Tasks** and a **Knowledge outline** keep a term's work together.
- **Works well with** the open-source [Archify](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify) (MIT licence, by tt-a1i; no partnership with StudyHub): your assistant can draw a knowledge outline as an interactive diagram with it, and StudyHub keeps and shows the file. See [Works well with other tools](docs/companions.md).

## Quick start

| You want to | You need | Cost |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Take the sample course and tour, browse sources, practise existing questions | StudyHub only | Free, no model calls |
| Generate questions, explanations and **Help me understand** | A model provider key in DSH **Settings › Models** | Billed by your provider, for example the [DeepSeek API](https://platform.deepseek.com/) |
| Turn recordings into text | A transcription key in StudyHub **Settings › Audio transcription** | SiliconFlow SenseVoice supports recording transcription. Gemini and Groq availability and allowances depend on the provider |

1. **Install DSH** (skip this if you have it). Use the official [Windows x64 installer](https://download.deepseek.com/desktop/dsh-latest-windows-x64.exe) or [macOS Apple silicon installer](https://download.deepseek.com/desktop/dsh-latest-macos-arm64.dmg). On any other computer, install Node.js 22.19 or later and run `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`.
2. **Install StudyHub.** In DSH, open **Plugins**, click **Add plugin**, paste this address and click **Enable**:

   ```text
   https://github.com/EricWang1358/dsh-web-studyhub/releases/download/v4.4.4/ericwang1358-dsh-daily-flashcard-4.4.4.tgz
   ```

   Check that the package is `@ericwang1358/dsh-daily-flashcard`, version **4.4.4**. The [release page](https://github.com/EricWang1358/dsh-web-studyhub/releases) is the newest channel: npm's `latest` tag can lag behind it, so install the `.tgz` from the release page. StudyHub then opens by itself. Later, open it from **StudyHub** in DSH's left sidebar (the session tab and the right sidebar also work); you do not need to send a chat message first.
3. **Take the tour (optional, a minute or two).** On the welcome page, click **Load the sample and start the tour**. The 7-step tour follows the first-run line's order (where the model is set up, add a source, make questions, check the draft, practise), pointing at the real controls, and ends on the line's step 2. A full tour of every page, Jobs included, is offered at its end. The sample makes no model calls and can be removed with one click.
4. **Add a model.** Paste a key in DSH **Settings › Models** and choose a model in your session. Until then, StudyHub says so wherever a step needs a model, with a **Go to settings** link, instead of letting the step fail later; **Settings › Library & model** shows **Model connected** or **Model not connected** and the steps.
5. **Start with your own material.** Click **Add source** and drop several PDFs, slides or notes at once. Then use **Generate from sources**, review the draft, publish it and practise.

Notes on installing:

- **Already use DSH?** Install only the plugin. Keep your current desktop app or web server, profile, model settings and workspace.
- **GitHub address does not work?** Download the `.tgz` from the [release page](https://github.com/EricWang1358/dsh-web-studyhub/releases/tag/v4.4.4) in your browser and give **Add plugin** its absolute path. The file must be on the computer or server that runs DSH.
- **Which file on the release page?** Only the complete package, `ericwang1358-dsh-daily-flashcard-<version>.tgz`, and you normally do not need to download it: step 2 pastes its address. The other files are the six separate components, the search extension (StudyHub installs it when you click **Install the search extension**), the checksum list and two setup guides.
- More options, including the command line: [installation and model setup guide](docs/install.md). Setup guides you can open in a browser: [English](https://github.com/EricWang1358/dsh-web-studyhub/releases/download/v4.4.4/StudyHub-4.4.4-Setup.html) · [Chinese](https://github.com/EricWang1358/dsh-web-studyhub/releases/download/v4.4.4/StudyHub-4.4.4-Setup.zh-CN.html). DSH itself comes only from the official sources in step 1.

## Use StudyHub

### Add sources

Click **Add source**, choose the course, then drop several files at once or paste text. Recordings go in the **Audio / recording** tab of the same window.

| Format | Limit | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PDF | 8 MB, 200 pages | Kept as one document that you expand to pages. For bigger books, see below |
| Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx, and the old .ppt) | 40 MB | Only text is read. Pictures, charts and SmartArt are skipped, and so are Word text boxes, headers and footers. A presentation keeps one page per slide, with its speaker notes. In an old .ppt, bullet indent levels are not kept |
| Markdown, HTML, TXT | 8 MB | |
| JSON deck | 2 MB | Questions you already have, or ones written elsewhere ([format](docs/json-import.md)) |
| Subtitles (.srt, .vtt) | 8 MB | Needs the audio component |
| Audio (MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, FLAC, OPUS, WEBM, AIFF) | 512 MB, 8 hours | See [Transcribe recordings](#transcribe-recordings) |

Old .doc files (and .wps, .key, .pages) are not read. Save them as .docx or PDF first. Password-protected files are not read either.

**Large textbooks** (over 8 MB or 200 pages):

- Click **Convert with MinerU** in the import window. StudyHub converts PDFs up to 800 MB and imports the result as one paged book that you can choose by chapter.
- MinerU runs on this computer. Click **One-click install** in **Settings › PDF conversion** (or right in the import window): StudyHub puts the program, Python and the models into one folder, not on the system drive by default, with no admin rights and nothing to install beforehand. The PDF stays on your computer and no token is needed. The cloud route was removed in 3.5.5 ([details](docs/mineru-conversion.md)).
- To practise across a whole book, use the search extension or the **Step-by-step path** on **Create deck**.

See [large textbooks](docs/large-documents.md) and [MinerU conversion](docs/mineru-conversion.md).

For another route, open the [external Marker guide](docs/marker-external.md) from Add material, download a script to run yourself, then choose its paginated Markdown output. Install Marker and its models separately; code and model licences apply separately.

### Generate a deck

1. Open **Create deck**. On the **Generate from sources** tab, choose sources by document (or by chapter for a big book), then the question type, count and difficulty. Not sure what to focus on? **Suggest a focus** proposes topics from your source titles and headings, without sending the full text.
2. Click **Generate & check deck**. The job runs in the background; you can keep studying.
3. Review the draft and its citations, then publish it. Publishing checks every question again; questions with a problem stay in the draft. Drafts stay separate from published questions.

To add to an existing deck, choose that deck: approved questions are added, and the old questions and their review progress stay. To bring in questions you already have, use the **Import JSON deck** tab.

<details>
<summary>How generation checks questions</summary>

- Each batch gets one independent review. Questions that pass are kept, and any shortfall is reported. Version 2.5.8 introduced one citation repair; the current workflow verifies knowledge points and answers first, corrects those preparation stages when needed, then writes and independently reviews questions. A question flagged only for wording is re-worded once and re-reviewed alone; there is no open-ended repair loop.
- When you add to an existing deck, reviewed questions are saved even if the generation budget runs out, with no second publish step.
- Citations and question structure are checked in code. The content itself can still be wrong, so read the draft. More in [question quality checks](docs/assessment-quality.md).
- Source text is given to the model as evidence, never as instructions to follow.
- Courses label sources and decks; folders only group decks for display. Every action uses only the courses, sources and decks you selected.

</details>

Save a default question type, count, content language, difficulty and focus in **Settings › Question defaults**; each new request can override them. Questions per batch, parallel batches and the time budget are there too, initially 5, 4 and 20 minutes. Started tasks and continued drafts keep their original choices. See [Generation pace](docs/generation-agents-sidebar.md#what-a-generation-task-does).

### Practise and review

Today's learning plan connects tasks to the library home. Ask AI for a plan based on real due reviews, weak areas, available materials, unfinished learning flows and accepted tasks. Give feedback to revise it, or accept. Each action has a reason and estimated duration; suggestions become board tasks only after acceptance, with direct start and resume controls.

Today's time budget is separate from your saved weekday/weekend pace; zero minutes supports a rest day. Unfinished actions are allocated within the budget, and completed actions still count toward today's workload. Record actual time after completion. After at least five comparable completed-day records, the median estimates your usual pace; explicitly saved preferences always take priority.

Practice progress counts actual answers, flows use completed steps, and you explicitly mark a reading block complete. Opening content or skipping questions does not count, and completing an action does not establish mastery. AI sees compact titles, progress and exam dates, not full materials. Invalid or unavailable AI results are clearly labelled as local suggestions. Plans are saved by library and date, alongside ordinary board tasks.

- Answer, then read the explanation. **Help me understand** asks a tutor about the current question.
- Rate flashcards and open answers from 0 to 5; FSRS-6 picks the next review date from your rating and the days that really passed since the last review. Each rating button shows the gap it would give. Answering and scheduling make no model calls.
- **Mistakes & weak points** groups wrong answers by deck (or by topic), filters them by deck, status and keyword, and can **Generate variants**. **Mock exam** and **Statistics** show what still needs work.

<details>
<summary>How Help me understand keeps context</summary>

When DSH supports local subagents, repeated **Help me understand** on the same question keeps the same tutor and its conversation, and follow-ups sent together are answered in order. Moving to another question, editing the question or switching model starts a new tutor. A tutor is released after 2 idle minutes or 8 rounds; a new one receives the last 3 answered exchanges. Earlier answers stay saved with the question.

</details>

### Read your sources

- Sources keep their original file and earlier versions, and open full screen.
- **Original page** shows the PDF page behind a citation, **More › Translate…** adds a translation, and **Practise these pages** (the arrow beside **Make questions**, shortcut P) quizzes you on the pages you are reading.
- Select a passage to ask about it, or to generate candidate questions that you review and add to an existing deck.
- A source imported as text only can get its original back with **Add the original file**, with no reimport.
- When a source changes and a linked position is no longer certain, StudyHub asks you to relocate it instead of guessing.
- Explanations, notes, **Tasks** and the **Inbox** link back to the question or source they are about. The reader and question links help you return to the current question.
- Press `?` to see every keyboard shortcut.

## Choose a model

Generation, explanations and learning help use the model selected in your DSH session. To use a different model for StudyHub, open **Settings › Library & model** and change **Generation model** from **Follow current session**. DSH stores the model credentials.

- **Everyday use:** the [official DeepSeek API](https://platform.deepseek.com/).
- **Heavy use:** a Coding Plan, but only if it gives you an API key and allows DSH and your actual study use. Before you buy, check its supported tools, endpoint, models, concurrency and quota rules.
- **Subscriptions are not keys:** Claude Pro/Max and ChatGPT/Codex subscriptions do not provide a general API key for DSH. Separately billed Anthropic or OpenAI APIs can be added as third-party providers.

Setup steps: [configure a model provider](docs/install.md#configure-a-model-provider). For how many tokens each feature uses, see [token usage and estimates](docs/token-usage.md).

## Transcribe recordings

1. Open **Settings › Audio transcription** and add a key. SiliconFlow SenseVoice supports recording transcription. Gemini (Google AI Studio) and Groq are also supported.
2. Open **Audio transcription**, click **Add audio** and then **Start import**. Nothing is uploaded until a provider is set up.
3. The transcript is saved as a source. Generate questions from it like any other source.

Only transcription uses these keys. Proofreading and translation use your DSH model by default, so their tokens are billed by your model provider and appear under **Model usage** in **Statistics**. **Live class** transcribes in real time and supports only Gemini.

<details>
<summary>More about audio</summary>

- With several keys, StudyHub tries Gemini free, then SiliconFlow, Groq and Gemini paid. A single import can be set to use paid keys only.
- M4A recordings over 1 hour can be split losslessly with one click.
- Recordings are processed one at a time; within a recording, 2–3 proofreading and translation windows run in parallel. Finished windows are checkpointed, and a retry reuses them.
- The **Proofreading & translation** panel sets the reasoning level for each step: Low, Medium, High or Model default. Higher levels take longer and do not guarantee better accuracy. A level the model does not support falls back to its default. Only high-confidence corrections that pass the source-location check rewrite the text; the rest are left as suggestions for you to check.
- The **Usage console** on the audio page records this plugin's requests to the transcription providers (failures and retries included), tokens and audio minutes. It shows free and paid keys separately, with a 7-day trend, and keeps 31 days. Groq's remaining daily quota comes from its responses; for Gemini, you can enter the daily limit shown in AI Studio to get an estimate. Requests from other apps, live-class streams and DSH model tokens are not counted there.
- Keys are stored in `study/audio.json` in your DSH home (by default `~/.dsh/study/audio.json`), outside the library. The interface shows only whether a key is set and its last 4 characters. Keys never enter library exports or chats. The environment variables `GEMINI_FREE_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_PAID_API_KEY`, `GROQ_API_KEY` and `SILICONFLOW_API_KEY` fill in a key that is not saved.

</details>

See [audio import](docs/audio-import.md) and [live class](docs/live-class.md).

## Use StudyHub from the DSH chat

- **Study mode preset.** For a new session, pick the agent preset **学习模式 · StudyHub** (Study mode; the label is in Chinese in both languages). The assistant then takes "materials", "my notes" or "this lecture" to mean your StudyHub library and asks when a request is ambiguous. It has the same tools as DSH's standard preset, so it can also run commands and edit files to convert material (for example split a question book by chapter) before importing it: it writes the results under `studyhub-work/` in the workspace, never deletes or overwrites your originals, and asks before installing anything.
- **Ask about your library** in the main chat: see [query sources and decks from the main chat](docs/main-session-queries.md).
- **Save a question you could not answer.** Type `/study-spar <your question>` in a DSH chat. StudyHub files it in your question bank as a flashcard. Add `--mq` for single choice or `--multi` for multiple choice; start with `--pre` to file it as a prerequisite of the question you are working on.
- **Follow background tasks** in DSH's sidebar: see [background tasks and the sidebar](docs/generation-agents-sidebar.md).

## Update StudyHub

DSH plugins do not update themselves, and restarting DSH alone keeps the old version.

- **2.1.2 and later:** StudyHub asks GitHub for a new release at most every 6 hours. When there is one, a **Version x.y.z available** chip appears in its sidebar, where x.y.z is the new version. Click it, then **Upgrade to x.y.z** and **Upgrade now**. StudyHub downloads the package, checks it against the release's `SHA256SUMS-x.y.z.txt` and hands it to DSH's plugin manager. If background tasks are running, **Stop tasks and upgrade** stops them and keeps their finished parts. The check sends no study data; switch it off in **Settings › About & updates**.
- **Older versions, or a DSH that cannot install from inside the app:** finish or cancel background tasks, open **Plugins**, uninstall StudyHub, then use **Add plugin** with the new release's package address.

Then restart DSH. Quit the desktop app fully (including the tray icon) and reopen it, or restart the web service with its original profile and reload the page. A browser refresh alone does not load new plugin code. Your library and settings are kept.

## Data and privacy

**Stays on your computer**

- The library: sources and their original files, decks, answers and review schedules, saved in shards. By default it is in the DSH session's workspace folder; choose another folder in **Settings › Library & model**.
- Transcription keys, in `study/` in your DSH home (by default `~/.dsh/study/`). They never enter the library, exports or backups. DSH keeps the model keys. (A MinerU token saved by a version before 3.5.5 stays in `study/mineru.json`; nothing reads it any more, and you can delete it.)
- The usage frequency record, if you turn it on in **Settings › Usage frequency record**. It is off by default, and StudyHub never sends it anywhere ([details](docs/usage-frequency.md)).

**Leaves your computer only when you use the feature**

- Generating questions or asking for help sends the selected source text to your model provider through DSH. **Suggest a focus** sends only titles and headings.
- Recordings go to your transcription provider. PDF conversion with MinerU runs on this computer; installing it downloads the program and its models (from mainland mirrors or the official sources) and uploads nothing.
- The update check asks GitHub for the latest version and sends no study data.

**Backups and older libraries**

- In **Settings › Import, schedule and backup**, **Backup & restore** exports one JSON file with your sources, decks, review progress and answers. Original files that were copied into the library are included; originals attached by reference are only listed.
- A restore first saves the current library under `backups/`. It is refused while a generation job is running.
- An older library is migrated on its first write, and its original file is backed up. Libraries missing newer optional fields stay usable, and data from a plugin that is not installed is kept.
- To import a library from the older `study-lib-spar` tool, use the same Settings category and choose the folder that holds `study-lib.json`, `nodes/` and `quizzes/` (not the tool's source code). The import only reads those files, keeps the due dates, intervals and sources it can parse, and importing again does not overwrite existing progress.
- Clearing finished task cards keeps the sources and questions they produced. Audio usage records and keys are not part of library backups.

## Interface language

The interface starts in Chinese when your browser's first preferred language is Chinese, and in English otherwise. Switch it with **Language** at the bottom of the sidebar; StudyHub remembers your choice. Buttons, errors, background progress, notifications, messages handed to the chat and new AI explanations follow it.

Switching does not translate what you saved: sources, file names, questions, notes and provider replies stay in their original language. New questions use the interface language unless you choose another in the **Language** field of **Create deck**. To read English under a Chinese question while you practise, click **EN** on the practice toolbar ([details](docs/translate-en.md)). Audio transcripts keep their own source and translation languages.

## Choose components

The complete package installs seven components. DSH's own plugin manager lists them as **StudyHub** (the main package), **StudyHub · Core**, **StudyHub · Materials**, **StudyHub · Question bank**, **StudyHub · Question generation**, **StudyHub · Practice & review** and **StudyHub · Audio**. Turn each one on or off there. Saved data is kept while a component is off.

- **Create deck** needs Materials, Question bank and Question generation. Practice, **Mistakes & weak points**, **Mock exam** and **Statistics** need Question bank and Practice & review.
- A component that is off hides its pages or says that it is turned off.
- If several installed packages provide the same component, turn all of them off to switch it off.
- The release page also has each component as a separate package.

Details and safe source deletion: [customise components](docs/install.md#customise-components). Command-line installs: [install from the command line](docs/install.md#install-from-the-command-line).

## Development

StudyHub is an ES-module DSH plugin built on Cordis, with a React interface bundled by esbuild. Its seven components work together through public plugin APIs; see [architecture](docs/architecture.md). The package is named `@ericwang1358/dsh-daily-flashcard`; the product name is StudyHub.

```sh
npm install --legacy-peer-deps
npm run verify         # lint, tests and build
npm run test:fast      # the tests without browser, ffmpeg and program-starting files, for quick iteration
npm run dev            # preview at http://127.0.0.1:4178 (after a build)
npm run build:demo     # static demo in output/static-demo-site/dist
npm run release:pack   # release packages and SHA256SUMS-<version>.txt in output/release-<version>
```

- `npm run dev` needs `npm run build` (or `npm run verify`) first, because it serves `dist/`. It uses a throwaway library in `output/preview-library` and keeps global study files in `output/preview-home`, never in `~/.dsh`. Add `-- --library=<dir>` to open another library, and set `STUDY_FAKE_MODEL=1` for a deterministic fake model.
- `npm run release:pack` does not build; run `npm run verify` first.
- `npm test` (and so `npm run verify` and CI) always runs every test file, starting the longest first from the durations of the last run (cached in `node_modules/.cache/studyhub-tests/`; a machine with no timings of its own, such as a CI runner, orders by `tests/test-weights.json`). Full runs on one machine take turns through a lock file in `~/.cache/studyhub-tests/`: a second run prints one line and waits (at most 20 minutes, then it goes ahead with fewer workers); set `STUDY_TEST_NO_LOCK=1` to skip the queue. `npm test -- tests/<file>.test.mjs` runs just those files without queueing.
- `npm run test:fast` skips the files named in `tests/slow-tests.json`: those that launch a browser, run ffmpeg or start another program. `tests/slow-tests-list.test.mjs` fails when a new test file does one of these and is not listed, so the fast tier stays fast; run `npm run verify` before a pull request.
- The host supplies the DSH SDKs `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` (optional peers, `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3`). Tests that need a missing SDK report an explicit skip.
- CI runs on Node 22, on Ubuntu and Windows, for every pull request: lint and the build once (Ubuntu), and the tests cut into shards of about equal weight (3 on Ubuntu, 5 on Windows), each shard on its own machine, with one `verify` check that is green only when lint and every shard are. # dsh-composer-plus — Composer Plus for DeepSeek Harness [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-composer-plus)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-composer-plus) [![test](https://github.com/furkancak1r/dsh-composer-plus/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/furkancak1r/dsh-composer-plus/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) **English** · [中文](README.zh.md) · [Türkçe](README.tr.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md) · [Français](README.fr.md) · [Deutsch](README.de.md) · [Русский](README.ru.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [한국어](README.ko.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](README.id.md) · [Tiếng Việt](README.vi.md) · [हिन्दी](README.hi.md) Codex-style quality-of-life features for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) desktop and web UI: a Changes panel, swipe-card feature ideas, sidebar search in message text, turn rollback with file restore, chat deletion to the Trash, the project name under the composer, project status in the sidebar, input history, a plan-mode shortcut, one-click Continue, resume running chats after a restart, queue drag-and-drop, session deeplinks, chat export as Markdown, per-chat Auto Review grants, background notifications, iPhone access with the Tether app and automatic updates. **In one line:** a single DeepSeek Harness plugin (npm `dsh-composer-plus`, shown as **Composer Plus** in Settings → Plugins) that adds a git Changes panel, Tinder-style feature idea cards, sidebar search that also finds words in messages, ↶ turn rollback (chat only, or chat and files), Delete chat, the project name under the composer, ↑/↓ input history, a Shift+Tab `/plan` toggle, one-click ▶ Continue, Resume after restart, drag-and-drop queue reordering, Copy session link, Export as Markdown, Auto Review “Allow for this chat”, background notifications, iPhone access (Mobile connect, Tether app), 11 extra interface languages and automatic updates.

Unofficial community plugin. The update check (GitHub releases and the npm registry) makes network calls; switch off **Automatic updates** to stop them at startup. **Turkish skill pack** (on by default) downloads the turkish-anti-ai-skill from GitHub and checks it for a newer version once a day, only while **Application language** is Türkçe; switch it off in **Settings → Composer Plus** to stop these calls. **Feature ideas** calls your chat's own model only when you click **Suggest features**. **Next message prediction** (on by default) calls the model chosen in Settings (dsh's default unless you pick another) once after each finished turn, without a click. Switch it off in **Settings → Composer Plus** to stop these calls. **Complete while typing** (off by default) calls its chosen model (by default the prediction's) at each pause while you type, after you switch it on. **Improve prompt** calls a model only when you click its magic wand. **Task board** calls the new chat's model once for the tags of each task that you start on the board. With its **AI summary** setting (the default is **Fast (no AI)**), it also calls a running chat's model for a short progress note while you look at that task's progress on the board or in Tether. **Goal check** (on by default) calls a model once each time the agent marks a `/goal` complete in an automatic round. **Mobile connect** (off by default) accepts iPhone connections from your local network or tailnet only after you switch it on. ## Install **Desktop app:** Settings → Plugins → **Add plugin** → enter `dsh-composer-plus` → **Enable now**. You can also paste `https://github.com/furkancak1r/dsh-composer-plus` instead of the npm name. **Web / CLI profile:** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-composer-plus ``` Then restart dsh. (The CLI can't install into the desktop profile; the app manages it.) > dsh's pnpm skips versions younger than 24 hours. Right after a release, add the version: `dsh-composer-plus@1.23.0`. ## Features | Feature | How to use it | Screenshot | |---|---|---| | **Changes panel** | Right sidebar → `+` → **Changes**. The page opens on **Tree**: a branch map of the chat's repository. Three cards count the branches: all of them, the merged ones and the ones that wait to merge. Click a card to show only those branches; click it again to show all. Each branch is a box with its last commit: green when the main branch has its work, orange when not, blue for the main branch. An arrow goes from each branch to the branch that took it (✅ **Merged**) or to the branch that it started from (⏳ **Waiting**, dashed). Click a box to see the branch's commits, then click a commit to see its files and their diffs. Click **Merged** to see the files of the merge commit, or **Waiting** to see the files that the branch brings into its target. A remote branch shows only when no local branch has the same name. In the mode menu, pick **Uncommitted**, **Unstaged**, **Staged** or **Branch** to see changed files with `+/-` counts; click a file for its diff. **Last Turn** opens dsh's own review of the latest turn. **This chat** lists only the files that the open chat's file tools (write, edit) wrote, in all its turns, and their total diff since its first message. The **␣** button hides whitespace changes (`git diff -w`): lines that changed only in indentation or line endings do not show. A file's **…** menu → **Chats that changed this file** lists the chats of the same repository whose write or edit tools changed that file, newest first, with the request that did it; a click opens that chat at that request. | | | **Feature ideas** | Right sidebar → `+` → **Feature ideas** → **Suggest features**. The chat's own model reads a short summary of the chat's project (top-level files, the README and manifest heads, an outline of the rest of the README, the titles of recent commits) and suggests up to 8 features, shown as a stack of cards in dsh's UI language. Swipe a card right (or click **✓**, or press `→`; the card flies off to its side in each case) to start a new chat in the same project: it starts in plan mode with the idea as the request, so nothing changes before you approve the plan. To skip the plan, click **▶ Build now** (or press `↑`; the card flies up): the new chat starts at once with the idea as an ordinary request, and the model makes the change and runs its checks (approvals apply as usual). Swipe left (or **✕**, or `←`) to skip; **Undo** (or `Z`) brings a skipped card back. Click **↓** (or press `↓`) to save a good idea for later: it goes to the project's **Later** list, which every chat in the same project folder shows (also after a restart). **Later (N)** opens the list; **Plan** starts the same plan-mode chat for the idea and **Build now** the chat without a plan, both take it off the list; **Plan all (N)** starts one plan-mode chat for every idea in the list, so shared parts are planned once; **Remove from the list** deletes it. **Copy as checklist** copies the whole list to the clipboard as a Markdown checklist (`- [ ] Title — Summary`, one line per idea) for an issue tracker or a TODO file; it makes no network call. **Open GitHub issue** on an idea opens an issue with its title and summary (and why it matters) in the GitHub repository of the project, with your own GitHub CLI (`gh`) login; the link **Issue #N** then shows next to the idea and opens the issue. **More ideas** adds cards. To get ideas about one area only, type a short **focus topic** in the field next to **Suggest features** (at most 80 characters; `Enter` also suggests), or click one of the fixed topics under it: **Performance**, **Accessibility**, **Tests**, **Security**, **Usability** or **Documentation** (click it again to clear it). The model then suggests only features about that topic; an empty field means any feature. Ideas are not suggested twice in a project: every suggested idea (skipped, saved or started) goes to the project's **History**, the model is told not to suggest those again, and a repeated title is dropped. **History** lists them with **Started** or **Suggested**; **Forget** (or **Forget all**) lets one come again; an idea that is still in the Later list stays out of the suggestions until you remove it there. The model runs only when you click. | | | **Content search** | dsh's own sidebar search (the magnifier next to **Workspaces**; `Cmd+K` in the desktop app, `Cmd+Alt+K` in a browser) also finds chats by the words in your messages and in the replies, not only by title, and shows the matching text under the chat. dsh already has this search, but ships it switched off; this feature switches it on with a search index file on your computer. The index is made at the first search after a start (about 15 s for 250 chats, see Limits) and is kept for the next starts. On by default; a change applies after you restart dsh. | | | **Turn rollback** | Hover one of your messages and click **↶** (next to Copy). **Chat only** takes that message and everything after it (replies, tool calls) out of the chat and out of the model's context, and puts the message back in the composer: change it and send it again. **Chat and files** first lists the project files that changed since that message, then also puts them back as they were, including changes made by commands (`bash`), not only by dsh's edit tools. A running turn stops first. The chat log is never rewritten: one hidden marker hides the withdrawn part, the same way dsh's own `/compact` hides old messages. When [dsh-rewind-plugin](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-rewind-plugin) is installed, it does this job and Composer Plus shows no second button. After a rollback, a **Redo** bar shows above the composer: it starts a new chat from just before the rollback (the same messages and context) and, with **Chat and files**, puts the files back; a file that you changed after the rollback is listed and kept, unless you tick the box that overwrites it. | | | **Delete chat** | Sidebar → a chat's **…** menu (or right-click) → **Delete…** → **Delete**. dsh itself can only archive. The chat stops (its turn, jobs, subagents and schedules, like dsh's own archive) and its saved history, with its subagent chats, moves to the macOS Trash (on other systems: `$DSH_HOME/trash`). To get it back, put the folder back and restart dsh: it shows in the sidebar's **Archived only** view. | | | **Project name in the composer** | The row under the composer (turns, tokens, cache hit, context) starts with the chat's project name, so you always see which project a chat works in. It is dsh's own project title, or the folder name when the project has no title. Hover it to see the full folder path. Click it to find the chat in the sidebar, in the list or project view: the sidebar and the project open (also a collapsed project and its **Show N more sessions**), the list scrolls to the chat and the chat blinks for 5 seconds. | | | **Input history** | In an empty composer, press `↑` / `↓` to walk through messages you sent, like a terminal. | | | **Shift+Tab plan mode** | `Shift+Tab` adds `/plan ` to the start of the draft (press again to remove it). If the chat is already in plan mode, `Shift+Tab` leaves it. | | | **Keep composer focus** | After you send a `/` command or skill, the cursor stays in the composer, and you can type again at once. This also works for keyboard macros that type a command and press `Enter`. dsh makes the composer read-only while it resolves the command, and the browser then removes the focus. This feature puts the focus back, unless a menu, a dialog or another field has it. | | | **Fit question card to window** | When the agent asks you a question, the question and its answers scroll together in the card, and **Skip** and **Submit** stay in view at the bottom. The card uses the height of the window (less 200 px for the chat header and a strip of the chat), so it grows and shrinks with the window. Without this feature, dsh keeps the card at 60% of the window (at most 520 px) and only the answers scroll: a long question can push its own end, the answers and the buttons out of the card. | | | **Fit chat header to window** | In a narrow window, the buttons in dsh's chat header (the mode, subagents, background jobs, Open in, the branch pill and the grants chip) no longer cover each other. The chat title keeps at least 120 px; the buttons that do not fit move to a second line at the right, and each one stays clickable. When everything fits on one line (a wide window), the header is exactly dsh's. Without this feature, dsh shrinks only the title: with a subagent and background jobs, its buttons slide over each other in a narrow chat column. The branch pill (**Branch per chat**) and the grants chip (**Allow for this chat**) also fit the header when this switch is off. | | | **Remember window size** | dsh's desktop app opens its window at 1280 × 820 at each start. With this feature, it opens with the size and place that the window had when you last used it. The size is saved each time you resize or move the window, and it comes back when the plugin loads at the next start. A full-screen or minimized window is not saved; a place on a display that is not connected now comes back on the main display. Only in the desktop app: a browser tab cannot change the size of its window. | | | **One-click Continue** | After a stopped, failed or cut-off turn, an empty composer shows **▶**. One click resumes from the existing conversation without writing in the input or adding a visible chat message (the model receives a short hidden “continue from where it stopped” note, because some providers, such as Claude, reject a request that ends on an assistant reply). Messages that wait in the queue stay there: ▶ continues only the stopped task, then the queue runs. A completed turn keeps the regular Send button. | | | **Resume after restart** | Off by default: switch it on in **Settings → Composer Plus**. If you quit dsh (or it closes) while a chat is working, that chat continues by itself when you open dsh again, with the same hidden note as One-click Continue. If a goal round (`/goal`) was running, the goal goes on with its next round (dsh pauses goals at every start until you resume them). Chats that you stopped, that finished or that failed do not continue. dsh itself has no setting for this: it only marks such a turn as interrupted. | | | **Queue drag-and-drop** | Queued messages get a grip (⠿). Drag to reorder, or focus the grip and press `↑` / `↓`. `Esc` cancels. | | | **Edit queued message in place** | Double-click a queued message, or click its Edit button (**Edit queued message**). An editor opens in the row: change the text, remove an image or a file with its ✕, or add new ones with the paperclip (**Add images or files**) or paste an image. `Enter` saves, `Esc` cancels, `Shift+Enter` adds a line. The message keeps its place in the queue, and the images and files that you keep stay as they are. While the editor is open, the queue cannot be reordered. In Tether: queued message menu → Edit. | | | **Send after Stop goes first** | On by default. Stop a chat while messages wait in its queue, then send a new message: it runs at once, alone. The queued messages keep their order and run after it, one per turn. Without this, dsh adds the new message at the end of the queue and runs the first queued message instead, so the new one runs last. A message that you send while the chat works still waits at the end of the queue. | | | **Copy session link** | Right-click a chat in the sidebar → **Copy session link**. Paste the `dsh-session:…` link into another chat to attach that chat as read-only context. dsh 0.2.1 has its own **Copy Session ID**, which copies only the plain id; this item comes right after it. | | | **Copy message link** | Hover a message and click **🔗** (in its action row; for an answer, next to the time). The link is the session link plus the message number: `dsh-session:…#42`. Paste it in a message and send it: on dsh 0.2.1 and later the link shows as a chip, and a click opens that chat, scrolls to the message and highlights it for 2 seconds. Like a session link, it also attaches that chat as read-only context. | | | **Export chat as Markdown** | Right-click a chat in the sidebar (or open its **…** menu) → **Export as Markdown…**. A dialog shows how many messages the chat has; **Copy to clipboard** copies the chat as Markdown, **Save .md file** saves it as `.md` through the browser's download (dsh desktop: your Downloads folder or a save dialog, as your system is set). The file has the chat title, the project name and the date, then one `## You` or `## Assistant` section per message. Code blocks stay as they are; a code block that a message leaves open is closed. | | | **Copy project path** | Right-click a project in the sidebar → **Copy path** copies the full path of its folder. | | | **Project search in a new chat** | New chat → the project button above the composer. The projects show in A–Z order, with a **Search projects** box on top. Type part of a name (case and accents do not matter) and press `Enter` to pick the first match. **No matching project** shows when nothing matches. dsh's saved project order in the sidebar does not change. | | | **Default workspace for New session** | Settings → Composer Plus → **Default workspace for New session** → **Open New session in**: choose a project, or **General folder (default-workspace)** (the default: dsh's own folder `Documents/deepseek-harness/default-workspace`, made at the first use). Then **New session** at the top of the sidebar (and its shortcut) always opens there, also while another project's chat is open. The `+` next to a project still opens that project, and the project button above the composer of the new chat still changes the project. | | | **Find in chat** | Press `Cmd+F` on a Mac (`Ctrl+F` on Windows and Linux) in a chat: a find box opens over it. Type a word: every match in the messages and replies on screen is highlighted, the current one in a stronger color, and the box shows **n / total**. `Enter` or `↓` goes to the next match and `Shift+Enter` or `↑` to the previous one (also the arrow buttons); the chat scrolls the match to the middle. Case, accents and the Turkish dotless ı do not matter. `Esc` closes the box and puts the cursor back where it was. It follows the chat while a reply streams in. | | | **Branch per chat** | On the New chat screen, the branch button (branch icon) between the project button and the mode button shows **New branch** by default. Type the first message and send it. To stay on the current branch, choose “Current branch (main)” in the same button. The first message can carry images and files. In plan mode the new chat starts in plan mode too: send the message as `/plan ` (Shift+Tab), or put the New chat in plan mode first. The AI names the branch (`feat/…`, `fix/…`) from that message, Composer Plus makes a git worktree for it in `/.worktrees/`, copies the ignored files that `.worktreeinclude` lists (for example `.env` and `node_modules/`) and opens a new chat there with your message. The open chat's header shows ⑂ branch · N changes · ↑ ↓ (or **not pushed**); click it to open **Changes**. The same menu lists the open worktrees: pick one to start a chat in it. To see the branch folders inside their project in the sidebar, choose dsh's **View options** → **Workspace tree**. | | | **Branches in the workspace tree** | Settings → Composer Plus → **Branches in the workspace tree** (off by default). Each branch that has a worktree folder in `/.worktrees/` then shows as a project inside its project; choose dsh's **View options** → **Workspace Tree** to see it nested. A branch whose folder is deleted leaves the list, and dsh shows its chats under **Ungrouped**. When the agent of a chat in the project folder creates a branch and switches to it (`git switch -c`, `git checkout -b`) while the folder has no uncommitted changes, the project folder goes back to its branch, the branch gets its own folder, and the chat moves into it: a copy opens in the branch project and goes on with the task, and the old chat is archived. The list is checked at start, every 30 seconds, after each turn and when you come back to the window. | | | **Next message prediction** | On by default; switch it off in **Settings → Composer Plus**. When the agent finishes a turn (not a stopped or failed one), the empty composer shows a guess of your next message in grey, with a **Tab to accept** hint. `Tab` puts the text in the composer, but does not send it. `Esc` hides it for that turn. Typing also hides it, and a new turn replaces it. The **Model** menu under the switch lists dsh's own models (the same list as dsh's model menu). **dsh default** is selected by default and follows dsh's default model. Each finished turn costs one short model call. In Tether, the guess shows above the empty composer: tap it to put it in the field. | | | **Complete while typing** | Off by default; switch it on in **Settings → Composer Plus**. While you type, grey text right after the cursor shows how your message may go on. `Tab` adds it to the message, but does not send it. `Esc` hides it. It suggests only your own next words: never an answer to you, and no made-up error texts or names. When the message looks complete or the model is not sure, nothing shows. Typing the next letters of the grey text keeps it, with no new model call. It has its own **Model** menu under its switch. Its first entry, **Same as Next message prediction**, uses the model of **Next message prediction** (the default); pick another model to use a different one for each feature, for example a faster model for completions. It makes one model call at each pause while you type, so it uses many more tokens than the prediction: pick a fast, low-cost model. It does not run for a slash command, a message with a file chip, or when the cursor is not at the end. In Tether, the rest shows above the field while you type: tap it to add it. | | | **Improve prompt** | Type a rough request, then click the magic wand (**Improve prompt**) next to the model menu. One model call rewrites it as a clearer prompt: the goal first, short numbered steps when there are several parts, and the check to run. It reads this chat (rolled-back messages left out), the project's README, AGENTS.md and manifest, the changed files and the files whose names match your words, and keeps your language. It never makes up file names. The new text replaces your draft but is not sent: read it, edit it, then press `Enter`. `Cmd/Ctrl+Z` brings your text back in one step, and so does the button (**Undo improvement**). If you type while it works, your new text stays. `Esc` or a second click cancels. It has its own **Model** menu in Settings (default: **Same as the chat's model**). On a `/goal ` message it rewrites only the objective, as a completion condition that **Goal check** can verify: the outputs, the checks that must pass, the evidence to show in the chat, a part that cannot be done marked as unresolved, and a stop when the same blocker stays. The `/goal` command stays. Not for other slash commands, a `/goal` control word (`clear`, `pause`, `resume`) or a message with a file chip. In Tether, the wand is next to the field. | | | **Goal check** | Start a goal with `/goal`. When the agent marks the goal complete in an automatic round, the goal closes only after two checks. First, the project's test command runs in the chat's folder, under the chat's sandbox mode. The command is your own one or the one found in `package.json`, `Makefile`, `Cargo.toml`, `go.mod` or pytest. When the agent's own newest step was a passing run of that test, it does not run again. Then one independent model call, with no tools, reads the goal, this chat, `git status` and the test result. The model answers with an evidence table: each part of the goal is verified, incorrect or unresolved, with the evidence and the fix; the goal closes only when every part is verified. If a check fails, the goal stays active and the agent reads each open part with its evidence and fix, then the next round goes on. A row under the goal bar (**Goal check**) shows the test, the last result and how many parts were verified (hover it for the table). **Edit** sets your own test command and a time or token limit; over the limit the goal

# DSH PLCdev Workbench

DSH 中的 PLC＋HMI 工程开发工作台。通过 DeepSeek Harness 原生插件、对话工具和团队接口，连接本机 OpenPLC、FUXA 及受支持的 OIP 工程。

**0.5.0 · Windows 开发预览。** 这是插件和本地工程服务源码，不包含上游安装包。维护者同机验收已有结果，新用户全新电脑安装尚未验收。许可证为 GPL-3.0-only；第三方材料保留原许可。

## 已有能力

- 工程资源、保存版本、任务、候选和运行实例视图；对话显式关联工程。
- PLC／HMI／OIP 专业成员分别提交产物，Lead 组装候选；人工审阅后保留新 UUID 或撤销。
- 用户工程声明 BOOL／INT／REAL 变量与操作，生成可编辑 FUXA 原生画面。
- 本机编译、显式运行／停止、Runtime 归属锁、版本失效、编译诊断与工具身份检查。
- 保存重开、同机环境恢复，以及停止后工程移动与工具归属迁移。

默认不调用模型、不准备或运行 PLC。模型操作需使用者配置凭据并按本次用途和材料授权，仓库不包含凭据或历史授权。

## 发布范围

本仓库只发布插件、配套工程服务、安装与接口文档及自动化测试。**不包含案例工程、PLC 工艺程序、HMI 画面或 OIP 场景。** 默认工程清单为空，请先登记自己的工程，再启动 DSH 工作台。测试中的最小内存／临时目录夹具不构成演示工程。

## 开始

先读 [安装说明](docs/INSTALL.md)。源码检查不需要模型、Runtime 或 OIP：

```powershell
npm ci
npm run build
npm test
python -B -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_project_interface.py
python -B -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_plcdev_environment.py
python -B -X utf8 tools/verify_source_release.py .
```

实际编译运行需要另行配置本机工具链。部分候选路径仍依赖定制 OpenPLC CLI 与源码依赖，缺失时拒绝操作，不能将源码测试视为完整安装通过。

[开发状态](docs/STATUS.md) · [架构](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) · [隐私与发布范围](docs/PRIVACY.md) · [贡献](CONTRIBUTING.md)。

跨机、长期后台可靠性、实体硬件、实时性和课堂验收未执行；本项目和软件停止逻辑不得用作人员安全功能。

## 许可

本项目原创代码按 GPL-3.0-only 授权，见根 LICENSE。[许可准备状态](LICENSE-CHOICE.md)、[第三方说明](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。不附带上游安装包，不代表其官方项目。

# DSH PLCdev plugin 0.5.0

See the [repository README](../../README.md), [installation](../../docs/INSTALL.md) and [development status](../../docs/STATUS.md).

# DSH PLCdev Workbench

DSH 中的 PLC＋HMI 工程开发工作台。通过 DeepSeek Harness 原生插件、对话工具和团队接口，连接本机 OpenPLC、FUXA 及受支持的 OIP 工程。

**0.5.0 · Windows 开发预览。** 这是插件和本地工程服务源码，不包含上游安装包。维护者同机验收已有结果，新用户全新电脑安装尚未验收。许可证为 GPL-3.0-only；第三方材料保留原许可。

## 已有能力

- 工程资源、保存版本、任务、候选和运行实例视图；对话显式关联工程。
- PLC／HMI／OIP 专业成员分别提交产物，Lead 组装候选；人工审阅后保留新 UUID 或撤销。
- 用户工程声明 BOOL／INT／REAL 变量与操作，生成可编辑 FUXA 原生画面。
- 本机编译、显式运行／停止、Runtime 归属锁、版本失效、编译诊断与工具身份检查。
- 保存重开、同机环境恢复，以及停止后工程移动与工具归属迁移。

默认不调用模型、不准备或运行 PLC。模型操作需使用者配置凭据并按本次用途和材料授权，仓库不包含凭据或历史授权。

## 发布范围

本仓库只发布插件、配套工程服务、安装与接口文档及自动化测试。**不包含案例工程、PLC 工艺程序、HMI 画面或 OIP 场景。** 默认工程清单为空，请先登记自己的工程，再启动 DSH 工作台。测试中的最小内存／临时目录夹具不构成演示工程。

## 开始

先读 [安装说明](docs/INSTALL.md)。源码检查不需要模型、Runtime 或 OIP：

```powershell
npm ci
npm run build
npm test
python -B -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_project_interface.py
python -B -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_plcdev_environment.py
python -B -X utf8 tools/verify_source_release.py .
```

实际编译运行需要另行配置本机工具链。部分候选路径仍依赖定制 OpenPLC CLI 与源码依赖，缺失时拒绝操作，不能将源码测试视为完整安装通过。

[开发状态](docs/STATUS.md) · [架构](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) · [隐私与发布范围](docs/PRIVACY.md) · [贡献](CONTRIBUTING.md)。

跨机、长期后台可靠性、实体硬件、实时性和课堂验收未执行；本项目和软件停止逻辑不得用作人员安全功能。

## 许可

# Inline Diff · 内联差异

中文（默认）| [English](README.en.md)

> **原创声明（重要）**：本项目是**完全原创**的作品，与 [JanEickholt/dsh-inline-diff](https://github.com/JanEickholt/dsh-inline-diff) **以及任何其他同名插件、仓库或项目没有任何关系**。本项目没有参考、复制或移植上述项目；两者的实现方式、模块划分、代码组织与最终渲染效果完全不同。部分功能相似（对话内联差异展示）纯属**雷同巧合**——本项目是在完成实现之后搜索同类插件时，才发现存在同名/相似项目。本项目**不是**任何其他项目的衍生作品、复刻作品或分支。

DeepSeek Harness 插件：为每次 `edit` / `write` / `str_replace_editor` 调用在对话中就地渲染内联差异卡片，自动识别文件语言（57 种）并做避开红绿的语法高亮，并提供左右对照、行内字符级高亮、移动块与被动行号说明、Read 行范围展示；命令、搜索、网页与通用工具调用还可切换为默认展开 IN/OUT 的「展开风格」，命令与工具卡片的输入/输出状态按段独立着色。**1.3.0 起界面与文档提供完整中英双语，并可在设置页独立切换语言（默认中文）。**

- **作者**：[Him666233](https://github.com/Him666233)
- **仓库**：[Him666233/dsh-inline-diff](https://github.com/Him666233/dsh-inline-diff)
- **License**：MIT
- **npm**：`@him666233/dsh-inline-diff`
- **当前版本**：1.3.0

> 设置项中的「展开风格 / Expanded」指展开式、平板式、类现代编码代理的透明输出效果；项目不包含任何第三方产品品牌字样。

## 兼容性

- **DSH 版本范围（`engines.dsh`）**：`>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0`
- **实测版本**：`0.2.2-rc.1`
- 不在 `engines.dsh` 范围内时，DSH 加载器会拒绝加载本插件，不会静默运行未验证版本
- 桌面端与 Web UI 若使用不同 profile，需要分别安装
- 不 shadow `conversation.chat.node` 的 tool-call 条目（官方 Tool 层拥有该条目并声明 `tool.call.toolview` 子槽，重复声明会抛错），只通过 keyed `tool.call.toolview` 注册接管已登记的工具行；未登记工具沿用官方通用行
- 与启动动画类插件互不接管 slot；动画关键帧使用独立命名空间（`dsh-inline-diff-*`），Read 范围观察器只响应 Read 行相关 DOM 变更，避免抢占启动动画的主线程
- 与第三方主题共存：keyed `tool.call.toolview` 使用 priority `-100`，避免与同样注册工具视图的主题插件（如 claude-style 在 `-1` 注册）发生重复 key 冲突；卡片头部带 `aria-haspopup="false"` 豁免并只响应真实用户手势，避免主题在折叠动画结束时重放合成点击、把「放大 / 轨迹 / 文件路径」的点击变成折叠卡片

## 安装

在 DSH 中从 npm 安装（推荐）：

```bash
dsh plugin add @him666233/dsh-inline-diff
```

也可以在 DSH Web UI 的「插件 → 添加插件」里直接输入包名安装。桌面端与 Web UI 若使用不同 profile，需要分别安装；插件加载后刷新或重启 DSH。npm 包名同时写在本包的 `cordis.patch.yml`（bundle 插件的模块名）与 `client.js`（浏览器模块 id）里，请勿只改其中一个。

其他安装方式（旧方式继续可用）：

- **本地目录 / 离线安装**：把本目录（`plugin/`）交给 DSH「插件 → 添加插件」（输入绝对路径），或解压 Release 中的 `dsh-inline-diff-<版本>-plugin.zip` 后选择解压出的 `plugin/` 目录；
- **手动 link（开发调试）**：见下方；
- **升级**：`dsh plugin add @him666233/dsh-inline-diff@<版本>`，或在插件页卸载后重装；**卸载**：`dsh plugin remove @him666233/dsh-inline-diff`（或插件页卸载）。同一个 profile 不要同时保留 link 版与 npm 版。

本地开发或离线安装：把本目录（`plugin/`）作为本地插件安装，或手动 link：

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>
pnpm add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-inline-diff/plugin
```

然后在 profile 的 `package.json` 中加入：

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@him666233/dsh-inline-diff": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-inline-diff/plugin"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@him666233/dsh-inline-diff"]
    }
  }
}
```

## 功能

- edit / write / str_replace_editor 逐次内联差异，精确旧/新行号；每个修改点的行号列上方带「旧 / 新」图例（与行号列严格对齐；新建文件等只有一侧行号的修改点只显示对应一侧图例），删除行旧行号染红、增加行新行号染绿并加粗；
- 紧凑行号栏与更清晰的卡片边框：内容内缩、代码起点更靠左，新增/删除色条仍通栏到边缘；
- 行内字符级高亮，只有真正变化的片段标深红/深绿；同一处替换中共享的空白与标点并入改动区，连成连续高亮带，孤立的空白/标点差异不会被误标；
- 移动块标注「移至/移自 旧/新 Lx–Ly」（单行移动按显示宽度判定，≥12 格才标注）；被动行号位移说明 `旧 Lx–Ly → 新 Lm–Ln · 行号顺延 ±N`；
- 左右对照弹窗与全文对照（依赖 Host 内存快照）；变更块模式按修改点分组、横条吸顶，历史回放等说明横幅与「修改前/修改后」栏固定在标题下方，滚动条只属于对比内容区域；
- 固定文件/修改点表头；Read 行折叠时在文件名旁显示实际行范围（多段用 ` · ` 分隔，最多 4 段后省略），展开后保留 DSH 原生展示；
- 自动识别文件语言（57 种，按扩展名、特殊文件名与 shebang 首行），在卡片头部与放大弹窗显示语言徽章（短代码 / 全名 / 隐藏；「隐藏」隐藏全部徽章；徽章可见时未知语言可显示虚线徽章；纯文本显示「纯文本」标记）；
- 逐语言语法高亮：内联卡片与左右对照弹窗的代码行统一着色；配色限定在蓝→紫区间（色相 180°–285°）并刻意避开红/绿/橙/黄/品红，避免与新增/删除标记混淆；每个前景色在官方深色/浅色代码底色上对比度 ≥ 4.5:1；关闭高亮、未知语言或纯文本时回退默认前景色（跟随浅色/深色外观）；
- 语法高亮四项设置：开启/关闭、语言标识（短代码/全名/隐藏）、未知语言（显示/不显示）、字体强调（颜色+字体样式/仅颜色：关键词等加粗、注释斜体）；设置页内可展开查看支持的 57 种语言；
- grep / glob / web_search / web_fetch 与普通工具调用共用展开风格：类别图标、关键词/路径/URL 摘要、匹配数/文件数/来源数/HTTP 状态徽标、默认展开 IN/OUT；
- 内联差异卡片与所有展开风格工具行使用统一的「轨迹」胶囊按钮；
- 命令执行与工具调用卡片的左侧色条按 IN/OUT 分段独立显示状态：IN 准备/等待输出=主题色（脉动）、输入侧完成=绿、输入侧失败=红；OUT 执行中=主题色（脉动，含「执行中…」占位）、输出成功=绿、执行失败/非零退出=红、用户中止=警告色；失败按错误码归因到输入侧或输出侧（缺少错误码时按原始参数是否合法 JSON 回退判定），输入侧失败时 OUT 标为「跳过」；输入侧失败时 IN 代码红字、输出侧失败时 OUT 代码红字，正常文字跟随内部配色与明暗外观；
- 文件修改、命令执行、其它工具调用三类卡片都使用「外壳 + 内部」双色结构；外壳跟随当前主题（含第三方主题）——派生颜色在 `body` 层解析，官方原版主题（token 在 `body`）与皮肤主题（token 在 `:root`）都能正确跟随，切换后不会残留上一个主题的色调；内部使用官方明暗外观的代码块底色与对应字色；三类卡片可分别配置外壳/内部配色（外壳：自动 / 浅色 / 深色；内部：自动 / 浅色 / 深色 / 与外壳一致）；
- 读取宿主实际明暗外观（浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统），卡片与设置窗口自动使用可读的底色和字色，第三方主题切浅色时也不会浅底浅字；弹窗与卡片均为不透明表面，不会透出壁纸；
- 四项独立展示选项：文件卡片、命令执行行、其它工具调用、过程折叠；设置弹窗标题栏固定、内容独立滚动，滚动条按区域贴边或内缩。

## 设置

侧边栏底部「差异样式」或 DSH 设置页「内联差异」：

**界面语言（1.3.0 新增）**：

| 设置项 | 可选项 |
| --- | --- |
| 界面语言 / Language | 中文（默认） / English / 跟随 DSH |

切换立即生效、无需刷新，不会改动 DSH 全局语言；文档语言：中文默认（本文件），英文见 [README.en.md](README.en.md)。设置页顶部同时展示一条醒目的原创声明：本项目为完全原创作品，与任何同名/相似插件（包括 [JanEickholt/dsh-inline-diff](https://github.com/JanEickholt/dsh-inline-diff)）没有任何关系。

四项展示风格：

| 设置项 | 展开风格 / 不折叠 | DSH 原生 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 文件修改卡片 | 本插件的内联差异卡片 | 官方文件修改行 |
| 命令执行行 | 默认展开 IN/OUT 的扁平命令行 | 官方 bash / pwsh / win_bash 行 |
| 其它工具调用 | 普通/详情/搜索/网页类工具默认展开 IN/OUT | 官方卡片 |
| 过程折叠 | 写入 DSH verbose 偏好 | 保留用户已有偏好 |

开启「其它工具调用 → 展开风格」时，若「过程折叠」仍为 DSH 原生，插件会自动把它切到「不折叠」，否则已完成的工具行会被 DSH 折叠组遮住。

语法高亮与语言徽章（独立于上表）：

| 设置项 | 可选项 |
| --- | --- |
| 语法高亮 | 开启 / 关闭 |
| 语言标识 | 短代码 / 全名 / 隐藏 |
| 未知语言 | 显示“未知语言” / 不显示 |
| 字体强调 | 颜色 + 字体样式 / 仅颜色 |

设置保存在 localStorage（`dsh-inline-diff.settings.v4`）；旧 v3 / v2 值自动迁移并删除旧键。

## 数据与限制

插件没有网络请求或遥测，客户端不使用 `innerHTML` / `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` / `eval`。Host 只保留显示所需的修改前后文本到内存快照（LRU：最多 240 条、每侧上限 4MB，并限制总量 64MB），不落盘；Host 只读 API 受 DSH 浏览器信任边界（`connection` 准入，无该服务时回退本机 loopback 围栏）保护，并有请求体 1MB、仅 JSON、10 秒读取超时、15 秒文件读超时与 8 并发上限。超大文件与超大单行在浏览器侧有物化预算（20 万行 / 单行 100 万字符），超限自动降级为差异块并提示原因，不会冻结页面。Host 只为 `edit` / `write` 保存快照，`str_replace_editor` 按工具元数据中的修改块展示并尽量定位行号，卡片与放大弹窗用「不保存执行快照」的专用说明（不是历史回放措辞）；应用重启后的历史回放同样会在放大弹窗内说明。极端情况下按「快照 → 当前文件读取 → 工具元数据差异块 → 明确说明」逐级回退；界面语言、设置存储、语法高亮同样有中文 / 默认值兜底，最终才显示可读的错误说明而不是静默失败。历史回放的行号按当前文件重新定位；若文件此后又被改动导致无法唯一定位，会显示「行号待定」并在弹窗说明只展示修改块。同一张卡片展示的是该次编辑的执行快照，不会随文件后续改动刷新；完整的显示行为说明（快照语义、刷新规则、行号图例、弹窗层级与滚动、性能提示）见仓库 [docs/display-behavior.md](https://github.com/Him666233/dsh-inline-diff/blob/main/docs/display-behavior.md)。

完整说明、内部架构与已知限制见仓库根目录 [README](https://github.com/Him666233/dsh-inline-diff#readme)。

## 截图

> 以下截图在**关闭第三方主题、官方原版外观**下生成（深色为主，另附浅色外观），示例内容仅用于展示插件行为，不包含第三方主题或桌宠素材；文件卡片为默认的「展开风格」，命令/工具行截图展示开启对应「展开风格」后的效果。截图流程：先关闭正在使用的第三方主题 → 切换界面语言 / 明暗外观 → 分中文、英文各截一套 → 再恢复原主题与外观。中文截图位于 [`docs/`](docs/)，英文截图位于 [`docs/en/`](docs/en/)，文件名一一对应。实际外壳颜色会跟随当前主题与明暗外观变化。

### 内联差异卡片

## 功能

- **逐次内联差异**：`edit` / `write` / `str_replace_editor` 每次调用单独一张卡片，不等待整轮结束。
- **精确行号与「旧 / 新」图例**：旧文件行号、新文件行号双栏显示；每个修改点的横条下方有一行与行号列对齐的「旧 / 新」图例（有精确行号时显示），删除行的旧行号、增加行的新行号分别用红/绿系轻微染色并加粗。只有一侧行号的修改点（新建文件或纯删除）只显示实际存在的那一侧图例，例如新建文件只显示「新」。多修改点各有独立表头，写明 `旧 Lx–Ly → 新 Lm–Ln` 与 `+/−` 统计。
- **行内字符级高亮**：替换行只把真正变化的 token 标深红/深绿，避免整行染色；同一处替换中两侧共享的空白与标点会并入改动区，连成一条连续高亮带，不会切成零散词块（真正共享的单词仍留白）。孤立的空白/标点差异不会被误标成改动。
- **移动识别**：完全相同的连续代码块纯粹移动时，删除侧标「移至 新 Lx–Ly」、新增侧标「移自 旧 Lx–Ly」，多行移动给出完整目标范围；边界空行不影响识别。单行移动按显示宽度判定（CJK/全角按 2 格计，≥12 格才标注），多行移动最多识别 120 行。
- **被动行号位移**：未改区段显示「N 行未修改」、旧→新行号范围与「行号顺延 ±N」，用于说明插入/删除/移动造成的被动换行。
- **左右对照**：变更块模式按修改点分组；全文对照模式对整份修改前/后文件逐行对齐，超过 4000 行时截断并提示。
- **固定表头与说明横幅**：内联卡片和放大弹窗里的文件/修改点横条滚动时吸顶；放大弹窗的说明横幅（历史回放、行号待定、全文对照不可用等）与「修改前/修改后」栏固定在标题下方，滚动条只属于对比内容区域，不会盖住它们。
- **文件语言自动识别**：按文件路径识别 57 种语言与标记格式；识别顺序为「复合扩展名 → 特殊文件名 → 普通扩展名 → 无扩展名脚本的 shebang 首行」。`.d.ts` / `.min.js` 等复合扩展名，`Dockerfile`（含 `Dockerfile.dev`）/ `Makefile` / `CMakeLists.txt` / `nginx.conf` / `Jenkinsfile` / `Cargo.toml` / `.env` / `.editorconfig` / `Gemfile` / `.bashrc` 等特殊文件名，以及 `#!/usr/bin/env node` 等脚本首行都会参与识别；`.txt` / `.log` / `LICENSE` / `.gitignore` / `go.mod` 等显式文本文件标记为纯文本并跳过高亮。
- **语言徽章**：卡片头部文件路径旁与放大弹窗副标题处显示中性小徽章，可设为短代码 / 全名 / 隐藏（「隐藏」隐藏全部徽章，含纯文本与未知语言）；徽章可见时，识别不到语言按「未知语言」设置显示虚线徽章或完全不显示，纯文本文件显示「纯文本」标记。
- **语法高亮**：内联卡片与左右对照弹窗（变更块与全文对照）中的所有代码行按语言着色；配色被约束在蓝→紫区间（色相 180°–285°），**红、绿、橙、黄、品红及其相近色一律不参与高亮**——红绿只用于新增/删除语义，两类颜色不会混淆。每个前景色在官方深色/浅色代码底色上的对比度 ≥ 4.5:1，在增删行与行内改动底色上仍可读。关闭高亮、未知语言与纯文本时回退默认前景色，浅色/深色外观下都保证可读。
- **字体强调**：开启时关键词、类型、函数名与标签加粗，注释斜体，链接下划线；关闭后只保留颜色区分。
- **紧凑行号栏**：行号栏收窄、内容与边框留白，代码正文起点更靠左；新增/删除行的整行底色与左侧色条仍通栏延伸到卡片/弹窗边缘。
- **读取范围外显**：Read 行折叠时显示 `L x – L y`（单行 `L x`、未知结尾 `L x 起`，多范围用 ` · ` 分隔，最多 4 段后以 `…` 省略）；展开时自动隐藏，不覆盖 DSH 原生展示。
- **四项展示选项**：文件修改卡片、命令执行行、其它工具调用可选「展开风格 / DSH 原生」；过程折叠可选「不折叠 / DSH 原生」。
- **命令执行行**：`bash` / `pwsh` / `win_bash` 使用终端图标、等宽标题与类终端布局，头部显示状态与非零退出码；IN/OUT 各自独立滚动（IN 限高更矮），滚动条贴卡片右边缘。
- **搜索与网页工具行**：`grep` / `glob` / `web_search` / `web_fetch` 也纳入「其它工具调用」的展开风格，显示类别图标、关键词/路径/URL 摘要、匹配数/文件数/来源数/HTTP 状态徽标，以及默认展开的 IN/OUT。
- **工具行差异化**：命令行使用终端图标、等宽标题和绿色强调；搜索类工具使用放大镜图标，网页类工具使用地球图标；通用工具调用带「工具调用」标签。所有展开风格工具行与内联差异卡片共用同一款「轨迹」胶囊按钮。
- **IN/OUT 分段状态**：命令执行卡片与其它工具调用卡片的左侧色条按「输入 / 输出」两段独立显示状态——IN 段：准备参数 / 参数已提交等待输出=主题色（脉动）、输入侧完成=绿色、输入侧失败=红色；OUT 段：执行中=主题色（脉动，含「执行中…」占位）、输出成功=绿色、执行失败 / 非零退出码 / 被信号中止=红色、用户中止=警告色。错误会按 `INVALID_ARGS` / `UNKNOWN_TOOL` / `ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH`（输入侧）与其余执行期错误（输出侧）分别归因，缺少错误码时若原始参数不是合法 JSON 对象也归为输入侧；输入输出互不干扰，输入侧失败时 OUT 段标为「跳过」并保持中性色。
- **分段文字配色**：输入侧失败时 IN 区代码为红字，输出侧失败时 OUT 区代码为红字；正常内容使用跟随内部配色与浅色/深色外观的默认前景色，浅色内部配色下不会出现浅底浅字。运行/准备中的分段色条按状态做明暗呼吸（脉动）；标签与分隔线也使用内部配色 token。
- **壳 / 内双色层（三类卡片统一支持）**：文件修改卡片、命令执行卡片、其它工具调用卡片都使用同一套「外壳 + 内部」结构。外壳、标题条、文件条与设置弹窗使用当前主题自身的外壳色（第三方主题会呈现它自己的色调）；派生颜色在 `body` 层解析，因此官方主题（token 定义在 `body`）与皮肤主题（token 定义在 `:root`）都能正确跟随，切换官方/原版外观不会残留上一个主题的色调。内部差异行、命令执行与工具 IO 内容使用 DSH 官方外观的代码块底色（深色近黑偏灰、浅色近白），并配对应的明暗前景色。命令执行卡片不再出现整卡绿色蒙层；状态由头部状态点/标签、非零退出码与 IN/OUT 分段色条共同表达；失败文本只出现在对应的 IN / OUT 段内，卡片在 IO 面板处结束，不会在面板下方再追加重复错误行或额外外壳。
- **每类卡片独立配色**：设置里文件修改卡片、命令执行行、其它工具调用各自拥有「外壳配色 / 内部配色」选项——外壳可选自动（主题+外观）/ 浅色 / 深色，内部可选自动（官方外观）/ 浅色 / 深色 / 与外壳一致（即统一底色，不再拼色），三类互不影响。
- **外观自适应（浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统）**：插件读取宿主实际解析出的明暗外观（`color-scheme`）：深色外观下外壳呈主题的深色色调、内部为官方深灰代码区；浅色外观下外壳变为主题的浅色/近白、内部变为官方浅色代码区，字色同步转为深色，避免浅底浅字或灰蒙蒙。
- **不透明表面**：第三方主题的卡片/弹层 token 常常是半透明的；插件在主题色之下垫了一层不透明底色，保证卡片、差异弹窗和设置窗口都可读，不会透出壁纸。设置弹窗的弹层表面取自主题**分层** token（`bg-layer-2`）而不是遮罩用的 `bg-overlay`——官方深色主题下前者是 `#2c2c2e` 深灰、后者是中间灰，用后者会把整块面板冲成发白的灰色。
- **外观细节对齐官方**：卡片使用宿主圆角 token，IN/OUT 竖条为 2.5px 左描边并沿卡片底部圆角收尾，两段之间只保留一根细分隔线；放大弹窗与设置弹窗自身裁剪圆角，滚动条按区域分别贴边或内缩。
- **大文件 / 历史回放降级**：超出预算时退回工具元数据差异块并明确提示；历史回放无法全文对照或无法定位行号时，放大弹窗内说明原因并置灰「全文对照」。
- **主题安全与配色安全**：外壳、文字与边框默认取自宿主主题 token（`--dsw-alias-*`）；语法高亮的前景色使用插件自带的受限调色板——蓝→紫、避开红绿、按深色/浅色分别校准对比度，其余颜色不写死；跟随 DSH 原生主题、第三方主题和明暗模式。配色安全由单元测试断言，任何引入红/绿高亮色的改动都会让测试失败。

## 兼容性

| 环境 | 支持情况 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH 桌面端（Desktop profile） | ✅ 已验证 |
| DSH Web UI（Web profile） | ✅ 代码兼容；需在该 profile 单独安装本插件 |
| 浏览器 / Electron 内嵌 WebView | ✅ 客户端使用标准 Web platform |
| 第三方主题 / 桌宠 / 皮肤 | ✅ 颜色跟随主题 token；已适配会拦截点击重放折叠的主题（如 claude-style）：卡片头部带 `aria-haspopup` 豁免、只响应真实用户手势，主题与桌宠属于外部插件，不影响本插件安装 |
| 启动动画类插件（自定义开场动画等） | ✅ 互不接管 slot；动画关键帧与样式使用插件命名空间（`dsh-inline-diff-*`）；Read 范围观察器只响应 Read 行相关变更 |

**DSH 版本范围（`engines.dsh`）**：`>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0`。当前版本在 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.1`（desktop profile）实测通过。

插件在 `plugin/package.json` 声明了 `engines.dsh`；DSH 插件加载器会校验该范围，**不在范围内时拒绝自动加载**，避免把未验证的宿主版本当成可用环境。插件清单同时声明 `dsh.client.platform: web`，Host 端只使用通用的 `webServer`、`tools/result` 与 Node.js 文件读取能力，不依赖 Electron 或桌面专属 API。

> 注意：DSH 插件按 **profile** 独立安装。桌面端与 Web UI 端若使用不同 profile，需要分别在对应 profile 中安装一次；本插件不会自动跨 profile 同步。DSH 升级到 `0.3.0` 或更高版本前，请等待本插件发布新的兼容版本。

## 安装

### 方式一：从 npm 安装（推荐）

> npm 包自 **1.3.0** 起提供，包名 `@him666233/dsh-inline-diff`。

```bash
dsh plugin add @him666233/dsh-inline-diff
```

也可以在 DSH Web UI 的「插件 → 添加插件」里直接输入包名安装（等价入口）。命令会把包装进当前 profile 的 `node_modules`，并自动把该包登记到 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`；DSH 校验 `engines.dsh` 与 bundle patch 通过后加载本插件。

- 桌面端与 Web UI 若使用不同 profile，请分别在各自 profile 中安装一次（`dsh plugin --profile <name> add @him666233/dsh-inline-diff`）；
- 安装后刷新页面或重启 DSH 生效；首次安装需要能访问 npm 源（默认 npm 官方源，DSH 在源不可用时回退 npmmirror）。

### 方式二：本地目录 / 离线安装

1. 下载本仓库或 Release 中的插件包并解压；
2. 打开 DSH 插件管理页 →「添加插件」，输入解压后 `plugin/` 目录的绝对路径（也接受本地压缩包）；
3. 刷新或重启 DSH。

插件包目录 `plugin/` 自带 `package.json`、`client.js`、`index.js`、`cordis.patch.yml`、locale 和 icon，可直接被 DSH 作为本地 bundle 加载。

### 方式三：手动 link 安装（开发调试）

把 `<repo>/plugin` 链接到目标 profile：

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>
pnpm add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-inline-diff/plugin
```

然后在同一 profile 的 `package.json` 中加入：

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@him666233/dsh-inline-diff": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-inline-diff/plugin"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@him666233/dsh-inline-diff"]
    }
  }
}
```

重启 DSH 后生效。桌面端和 Web UI 若使用不同 profile，请分别在各自 profile 中执行。

### 方式四：从 GitHub Release 安装（离线包）

1. 打开 [Releases](https://github.com/Him666233/dsh-inline-diff/releases) 下载当前版本的 `dsh-inline-diff-<版本>-plugin.zip`（插件包）或 `dsh-inline-diff-<版本>.zip`（完整源码包）；
2. 解压后按「方式二」把 `plugin/` 目录的绝对路径交给「添加插件」；
3. 校验下载文件：`SHA256SUMS.txt` 中的哈希应与 Release 页面一致（Windows 可用 `certutil -hashfile <文件> SHA256` 核对）。

> Release 附件（zip、`SHA256SUMS.txt`、发行说明）是发布资产，不进入源码仓库；仓库里的 `release/` 目录只是维护者本地的打包产物目录（已在 `.gitignore` 中忽略）。

### 升级与卸载

- **升级（npm 安装的版本）**：`dsh plugin add @him666233/dsh-inline-diff@<版本>`；或在插件页卸载后重新安装最新版。第三方组合包不提供原地升级按钮。
- **卸载**：`dsh plugin remove @him666233/dsh-inline-diff`，或在插件页点击「卸载」（需确认）。
- **本地 link / Release 安装的版本**：替换 `plugin/` 目录后刷新或重启；卸载时在 profile 的 `package.json` 中移除依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中的条目。
- 同一个 profile 中不要同时保留 link 版与 npm 版，否则会重复注册同一批 slot（表现为卡片重复或报重复 key）。

### 界面语言与文档语言

- **界面语言**：1.3.0 起可在插件设置页选择「中文（默认）/ English / 跟随 DSH」，切换立即生效、无需刷新；默认中文，不会改动 DSH 全局语言设置。
- **文档语言**：中文为主文档（本文件），英文文档见 [README.en.md](README.en.md)；npm 包内同时提供 `README.en.md` 与 `README.md`。

### 从源码构建

```bash
npm install
npm run build      # -> plugin/client.js + plugin/cordis.patch.yml（包名从 plugin/package.json 读取）
npm run check      # 语法 / JSON 校验，并校验已提交的 client.js、cordis.patch.yml 与源码/包名一致
npm test           # 差异引擎、卡片模型、语言识别、高亮配色、工具状态、read range、i18n 与安全回归单元测试（共 124 项）
```

需要 Node.js 20+，构建期依赖 `esbuild` 与 `highlight.js`（语法模块会随 `client.js` 一起打包）。插件运行时无额外依赖，只使用 React 与宿主提供的 Web 服务。

## 使用

### 内联卡片

在对话中定位到 `编辑` / `写入` / `替换编辑` 卡片：

- 点击卡片头部：展开或折叠逐行差异；
- 点击「放大」按钮或底部「左右对照」链接：打开左右对照弹窗；
- 点击右上角「轨迹」胶囊按钮（内联卡片、命令执行行与其它工具行共用）：跳转到对应轨迹位置；
- 点击标题中的文件路径：在宿主文件面板中打开该文件（宿主提供该能力时）；
- 行号列上方的「旧 / 新」图例标明两列行号的归属：删除行的旧行号用红系染色、增加行的新行号用绿系染色，行号错位时也能分辨哪一列属于修改前、哪一列属于修改后；
- 卡片展示的是**该次编辑的执行快照**，不会随文件后续改动自动刷新；放大弹窗的「全文对照」同样是这份快照。数据来源、刷新规则与弹窗层级详见 [显示行为说明](docs/display-behavior.md)。

内联卡片内容区最高 360px，超过后卡片内部滚动；折叠状态下差异区最多展示 42 行（按修改点顺序分配行预算），其余行通过「放大」查看。

### 命令与工具行（展开风格）

把「命令执行行」和/或「其它工具调用」设为「展开风格」后：

- 命令执行行以终端样式展示 IN/OUT 两段：IN 是命令文本（参数异常时回退为原始参数），OUT 是输出文本，两段各自独立滚动、独立状态色条；头部状态点、非零退出码与状态标签共同表达结果；
- 其它工具调用（普通、详情、搜索与网页类）默认展开 IN/OUT，并保留折叠按钮；标题使用中文工具名（如 `grep` = 搜索文件内容、`glob` = 搜索文件、`web_search` = 网页搜索、`web_fetch` = 抓取网页）；
- 搜索/网页行摘要显示搜索关键词与路径、文件名模式与路径、搜索词或抓取 URL；已结束调用显示匹配数、命中文件数、来源数或 HTTP 状态徽标；
- 输入侧失败（参数/派发问题）时 IN 色条变红，OUT 段标为「跳过」并展示错误摘要；输出侧失败（执行报错、非零退出码、信号中止）时 OUT 色条变红；用户中止显示警告色；
- 切换回「DSH 原生」会释放本插件的注册，恢复官方搜索/网页富结果卡片与官方命令行。

### 读取行范围

Read 工具行折叠时，范围标签位于文件名右侧；多段不连续读取用 ` · ` 分隔，超过 4 段后以 `…` 省略。展开该行后标签自动隐藏，完全显示 DSH 原生 Read 卡片内容。调用尚未结束时按 `offset` / `limit` 参数预估范围；结束后以工具结果中的实际行号为准。

## 内部实现

### Host 端

- 监听 `tools/result`，对成功的 `edit` / `write` 截取 `{ path, before, after, operation }`，按「会话 + 调用 ID」保存为**内存**快照（LRU：最多 240 条、每侧文本上限 4MB，并额外限制**总量 64MB**；任一预算超限时从最旧条目淘汰；超大写入不保存快照，卡片退化为差异块模式）；
- 提供**只读** API，所有路径（含 `/ping`、404、405）先经过浏览器信任边界校验：
  - 准入优先复用 DSH `connection` 服务的 `admit(req)`（官方 Host / Origin / 跨站围栏 + HttpOnly、SameSite=Strict 的浏览器会话 Cookie）；
  - 无 `connection` 服务的嵌入式 profile 回退本地围栏：`Host` 必须是 loopback 或监听器绑定地址、`Origin` 必须同 authority、拒绝 `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`；任何异常都**不 fail-open**；
  - `POST /dsh-inline-diff/api/snapshot`：按 `sessionId + callId` 返回快照；
  - `POST /dsh-inline-diff/api/read`：在请求方给定的根目录内读取文件（realpath 两层 containment；单文件上限 2MB；15 秒读超时；最多 8 个并发读取，超限返回 429/504；二进制返回 `binary`，并剥离 UTF-8 BOM）；
  - `GET /dsh-inline-diff/api/ping`：健康检查（返回当前快照条数），同样受准入保护（浏览器 profile 需要会话 Cookie）；
- `POST` 请求体上限 1MB、仅接受 `application/json`、10 秒读取超时（超限返回 413 / 415 / 408）；响应统一带 `nosniff` / `no-store` / `referrer-policy` / `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy` 头；错误使用语义化状态码与固定文案，**不回显**文件系统错误、绝对路径或堆栈；
- 快照只存在内存、不落盘；应用重启后历史卡片退化为“修改块 + 当前文件定位行号”的展示，因此「全文对照」不可用。

### Client 端

- 通过 `ctx.slots` 以 keyed `tool.call.toolview` 接管 `edit` / `write` / `str_replace_editor` 的文件卡片、`bash` / `pwsh` / `win_bash` 的命令行、以及普通/详情/搜索/网页类工具行；**不 shadow** `conversation.chat.node` 的 tool-call 条目——dsh ≥0.2.2-rc.1 的官方 Tool 层（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-tool`）拥有该条目并声明 `tool.call.toolview` 子槽，重复声明会抛 `slot "tool.call.toolview" is already declared`，因此插件只做 keyed 注册，由官方 tool-call 树按工具名分发；未注册的工具沿用官方通用行；
- 展示风格变化时释放并重建这组注册：切回 DSH 原生后官方富结果卡片原样恢复；
- 轨迹跳转统一为带文字的「轨迹」胶囊按钮，内联差异卡片与所有展开风格工具行位置一致；
- 纯浏览器侧实现 LCS 对齐（单侧 4000 行 / 250 万格预算，超限退化为前后缀+替换块的粗对齐）、上下文 ±3 行的 hunk 分组、行内 token diff（单行 4000 字符、16 万格、整段 200 万格预算）、移动块配对（2 行以上或单行显示宽度 ≥12 格，最多 120 行，容忍边界空行）、被动位移 gap、超大文件预算回退；
- 语言识别与高亮：`languages.js` 在模块加载期构建扩展名/文件名 Map（O(1) 查询）；`highlight.js` 用 highlight.js 语法把可用全文的每一侧各分词一次，再把高亮 HTML 解析回逐行 token 区间并按行号索引（历史回放没有完整全文时按修改块本地分词），结果以 WeakMap 缓存在 diff 上；单侧超过 200k 字符或 4000 行、单行超过 2000 字符时自动放弃高亮并回退默认前景色；
- IN/OUT 分段状态由 `tool-status.js` 的纯函数推导（输入侧错误码、参数合法性回退、非零退出码与中止标记），渲染层按状态给分段色条与文字着色；状态变化以描边颜色明暗呼吸表达脉动；
- 配色安全由 `syntax-styles.js` 的单一调色板生成 CSS，并由 `tests/syntax-palette.test.mjs` 断言色相窗口（180°–285°）、WCAG 对比度与红绿增删底色上的可读性，任何引入红/绿高亮的改动都会让测试失败；
- 明暗外观通过监听根元素的 `color-scheme` 同步到 `data-dsh-inline-diff-appearance`，再结合每张卡片的 `data-shell-tone` / `data-inner-tone` 选择外壳与内部配色；
- Read 范围使用页面级 `MutationObserver` 挂载到官方 Read 行文件名后，只响应 Read 行相关 DOM 变更、首帧后再扫描，不依赖某一条内部渲染路径；
- 全屏弹窗与设置弹窗通过 React Portal 挂到 `document.body`，避免被第三方浮动层遮挡；点击遮罩或按 Esc 关闭。

### 多级回退与容错

每类功能都按「主路径 → 回退 → 显示降级 → 明确说明」设计，极端情况下宁可降级展示也不崩溃：

| 场景 | 主路径 | 回退 1 | 回退 2（最终） |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 修改前全文 | Host 内存执行快照 | `/read` 读取当前文件补齐行号 | 工具结果 `meta.diffs` 差异块 + 「行号待定 / 不保存执行快照」说明 |
| 全文对照 | 快照全文精确对齐 | 超大文件粗对齐（截断到 4000 行） | 页签置灰 + 弹窗内原因说明 |
| 超大输入 | 完整 diff（20 万行物化预算内） | 差异块 / 仅统计 + 「文件过大」降级提示 | 不渲染逐行内容，页面不冻结 |
| 语法高亮 | 逐语言 highlight.js 分词 | 超预算 / 未知语言 / 纯文本 → 默认前景色 | 语言徽章与语言识别仍生效 |
| 高亮 HTML 解析 | 逐行 token 区间 | 纯文本逐行重建（硬校验） | 放弃高亮，按纯文本展示 |
| 界面语言 | 设置的语言字典 | 中文 `zh` 字典 | 直接显示 key 本身（不抛错） |
| 设置读取 | localStorage 存档 | 内存默认值 | 存档损坏 / 超长 → 丢弃并回退默认值 |
| 语言识别 | 扩展名 / 特殊文件名 / shebang | 纯文本标记 | 不做高亮 |
| Host API 准入 | DSH `connection.admit` | 本地 loopback / 绑定地址围栏 | 403 拒绝，客户端 api 返回 null，卡片降级显示 |
| 工具视图注册 | keyed `tool.call.toolview` 接管 | 注册失败时释放并恢复官方行 | 官方通用行（不抛错中断整组注册） |

> 上表对应实现分散在各模块注释中；新增功能时请沿用同样的回退层级，并在最终回退处给出可读的原因说明，而不是静默失败或抛错。

### 数据与隐私

- 无网络请求、无遥测、无外部服务；不读取 DSH 会话外文件；
- Host 只读 API 有浏览器信任边界与输入/超时/并发上限（见上文 Host 端）；客户端无 `innerHTML` / `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` / `eval`，高亮 HTML 只被解析为**纯文本 token**；
- 快照有条数与总字节双预算，diff 物化有行数/单行上限，超限时降级展示而不是卡死；
- 只有显示所需的修改前后文本在 Host 内存中短暂保留；默认不写磁盘；
- 设置（含界面语言）只写入浏览器 localStorage；不包含文件内容；
- 颜色全部由宿主主题 token 派生，插件不附带壁纸或人物素材。

## 已知限制

- **全文对照依赖快照**：应用重启后的历史回放无法还原修改前全文，页签置灰并在放大弹窗显示原因。
- **`str_replace_editor` 走无快照降级路径**：Host 只为 `edit` / `write` 保存执行快照；`str_replace_editor` 卡片展示工具结果中的修改块并尽量按当前文件定位行号，「全文对照」不可用。该工具不产生执行快照，卡片与放大弹窗用「不保存执行快照」的专用说明，而不是历史回放措辞（历史回放措辞只用于 `edit` / `write` 快照丢失的情况）。
- **全文对照是执行快照**：同一张卡片始终展示当次编辑的修改前/后全文，不会自动刷新成文件最新版本；要查看最新内容，请打开最新一次编辑的卡片。数据来源与刷新规则见 [显示行为说明](docs/display-behavior.md)。
- **大文件全文对照滚动**：行数较多时快速滚动可能出现短暂的渲染闪烁；内容来自静态快照，不受影响（详见 [显示行为说明](docs/display-behavior.md)）。
- **历史回放行号**：快照丢失后会按当前文件重新定位修改块；若该文件随后又被改动导致无法唯一定位，行号会标记为「行号待定」，放大弹窗会说明只能展示修改块。删除型修改块没有足够的上下文锚点时也可能无法定位。
- **超大文件**：任一侧 > 4000 行或对齐预算（250 万格）超限时降级为差异块模式，关闭移动识别；有工具元数据差异块时「全文对照」不可用，仅有粗对齐结果时全文对照会截断到 4000 行。
- **超大输入的物化预算（1.3.0 新增）**：浏览器侧在拆分逐行对象之前先测量文本预算；任一侧超过 20 万行或单行超过 100 万字符时不再物化逐行内容，只保留准确行数与增删统计并显示「文件过大」降级提示（避免 4MB 级输入生成数百万行对象导致页面冻结/OOM）。
- **移动识别**：只识别完全相同的连续行块；移动同时伴随内容修改的块按普通增删显示；单行移动需显示宽度 ≥12 格，多行移动超过 120 行不标注。粗对齐模式（超大文件）下关闭移动识别。
- **接管的工具**：文件修改卡片仅支持 DSH 原生 `edit` / `write` / `str_replace_editor`；`apply_patch` 与手工写入保持 DSH 原生展示，不会生成内联差异卡片。
- **配色设置的作用范围**：文件/命令/工具三类卡片的「外壳 / 内部配色」只作用于对应的工具卡片；放大弹窗与设置弹窗跟随宿主当前外观（浅色 / 深色）与主题外壳色，不套用单张卡片的配色选项。
- **语法高亮为词法级**：高亮只依赖语言语法（highlight.js grammar），不依赖语言服务；TOML 使用 INI 语法、JSONC 使用 JSON 语法、Vue / Svelte / Astro 使用 HTML/XML 语法做近似高亮；历史回放没有完整全文时，跨行结构（块注释、模板字符串等）按修改块局部推断，可能比全文模式略保守；行内 token 高亮超出单行/整段预算时该行回退为纯色。
- **高亮预算**：任一侧超过 200k 字符或 4000 行、或单行超过 2000 字符时不高亮，回退默认前景色；语言徽章与语言识别仍然生效。
- **语言标识**：「语言标识 = 隐藏」隐藏全部语言徽章（含纯文本标记与未知语言徽章），「未知语言」选项只在徽章可见时生效；语言识别与语法高亮仍照常工作。
- **富结果卡片**：读取、待办、提问、图片等富结果卡片不纳入展开风格，保持 DSH 原生交互。
- **搜索/网页行交互**：展开风格下搜索/网页调用以 IN/OUT 原文展示；官方卡片里的「点击匹配文件打开」「点击 URL 打开新标签页」等交互只保留在「DSH 原生」模式。
- **展开风格的工具覆盖范围**：命令执行、通用、详情、搜索与网页工具行通过 `tool.call.toolview` 的 keyed 注册接管，只对插件登记过的工具名生效；未登记的工具在 dsh ≥0.2.2-rc.1 下沿用官方通用行（插件不再覆盖整棵 tool-call 树，避免与官方 Tool 层重复声明子槽）。
- **跨 profile**：插件按 profile 安装，不自动同步。
- **界面语言只作用于本插件**：1.3.0 的语言设置只影响本插件自己的界面文案，不修改 DSH 全局语言，也不影响其它插件；选择「跟随 DSH」时随 DSH 全局语言切换（无法识别 host 语言或缺少对应字典时按中文兜底）。
- **文档与截图为中英两套**：中文为默认主文档（`README.md`、`docs/*.md`），英文为对照文档（`README.en.md`、`docs/*.en.md`）；截图分别放在 `docs/` 与 `docs/en/`，文件名一一对应。

## 开发与贡献

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm run check
npm test
```

- 修改 `src/client/` 后需要重新执行 `npm run build`，安装的是 `plugin/` 中构建后的 `client.js`；`npm run check` 会校验已提交的 `client.js`、`cordis.patch.yml` 与源码、包名一致；
- 提交前请确保 `npm run check` 与 `npm test` 通过；测试覆盖差异对齐、卡片模型、语言识别、highlight.js token 提取、语法高亮配色安全约束、IN/OUT 失败归因、read range、行号图例单侧适配（`gutterSides`）、i18n 语言解析/回退与安全回归；
- 新增界面文案必须同时写入 `src/client/locales.js` 的 `zh` 与 `en` 字典（两边键集合保持一致），默认语言为中文；新增/修改代码写详细中文注释，并说明失败时的回退路径；
- 项目身份集中维护在 [`src/client/project.js`](src/client/project.js)；仓库改名时同步更新该文件、`package.json` 的 `homepage` / `repository` / `bugs` 及 README 链接即可；
- 文档：中文为主（`README.md`、`docs/*.md`），英文为对照（`README.en.md`、`docs/*.en.md`）；截图中文放 `docs/`、英文放 `docs/en/`，文件名一一对应；
- 发布流程：
  - npm：见 [docs/publish.md](docs/publish.md)，`node build.mjs` → `node build.mjs --check` → `npm test` → `cd plugin && npm publish`；换 npm 包名用 `node scripts/set-package-name.mjs <新包名>`（同步 manifest、`cordis.patch.yml`、`client.js` 模块 id 与 README）；
  - 发行版：`node scripts/build-release.mjs` 生成 `release/` 下两个 zip 与 `SHA256SUMS.txt`（含版本/包名/构建产物一致性校验，旧版本自动归档到 `release/archive/`）；
  - GitHub：源码只提交仓库内文件；`release/` 下的两个 zip、`SHA256SUMS.txt` 与发行说明作为 GitHub Release 附件上传，不进入源码历史。

## 更新日志

当前版本：**1.3.0**（2026-11-08）。版本日期索引：

| 1.2.6 | 2026-11-07 | 官方主题外壳配色、命令失败卡片底部多余外壳、行号图例对齐与单侧适配、徽章隐藏语义等修复 |
