# dsh-personas — role presets for this DeepSeek Harness profile

Five Agent presets layered on top of the shipped `standard`, `ptc`, `minimal`, and
`cordis` presets. They appear in **New session → preset picker** and in
**Settings → Agent presets**, after the built-ins (orders 10–14).

| Preset id | Name | Tools | Intended use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orchestrator` | Orchestrator | fs, search, bash, web, todo, ask-user, skills, subagent + fork, workflow | Decompose a goal, fan work out to subagents, integrate results |
| `architect` | Architect | fs, search, bash, web, todo, ask-user, skills, present | Design systems grounded in the repo; write design docs |
| `writer` | Writer | fs, search, web, todo, ask-user, skills, present | Prose and documents matched to audience and house style |
| `reviewer` | Reviewer | read-only fs (read + readImage), search, bash, web, todo, ask-user, skills | Independent validation, evidence-cited findings, verdict |
| `researcher` | Researcher | fs, search, bash, web, todo, ask-user, skills, present | Primary-source research with citations, fact vs. inference |

Every preset mounts its own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` row (keeping tool guidance and
runtime context), plus `time-context`, and an isolated compaction group.

## Notes

- A preset is chosen **per session**. A subagent started with `subagent`/`subagent_fork`
  inherits the parent's preset unless the parent's `tool-subagent` row configures
  `agentPreset` (and `allowedAgentPresets` to restrict the choice) — both supported in
  DSH 0.2.2-rc.1. To get a mixed-role team in one conversation, run roles in separate
  sessions, configure those two fields, or install the official
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile` bundle.
- `reviewer` is read-only by design: `write: false`, `edit: false`, `applyPatch: false`.
- Removing the bundle on the sidebar **Plugins** page removes all five presets again
  (sessions already using one keep their composition).
- Rows mounted by a preset must satisfy their plugin's **required** config: one
  rejected row fails the whole preset ("failed to load" in Settings). Required in
  DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 are `tool-fs-search.sampleOverCapGlobResults` and
  `tool-todo.allowParallelInProgress`; both are set here. Re-check these rows
  when upgrading DSH, against the shipped presets' configs.

## Edit

Change `cordis.patch.yml`, then reinstall the bundle (plugin_manager
`install_bundle` on this directory). The declaration row ids are `preset-<id>`.

# dsh-swarm-jev

**A swarm setup for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): role personas, a self-hosted System One decision layer, and a design for an objective/progress orchestrator.**

This repository packages the pieces of a working DSH swarm configuration in
installable form. It is meant to be forked, read, installed on another DSH
installation, and extended. Everything here is ordinary DSH plugin material:
bundles with a `cordis.patch.yml`, plain ES modules, and Markdown.

| Part | Package / location | What it gives you | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Role personas** | [`packages/dsh-personas`](packages/dsh-personas) (`@local/dsh-personas` 1.0.0) | Five agent presets — orchestrator, architect, writer, reviewer, researcher — layered over the shipped DSH presets | Stable |
| **System One decision layer** | [`packages/dsh-systemone`](packages/dsh-systemone) (`@local/systemone` 0.2.0) | `systemone_ask` / `systemone_status` tools, a self-hosted decision model integration, `off`/`shadow`/`enforce`/`swarm` decision layer, persona routing, per-preset tool policy and model judging, the **Settings → Decision model** page, and a live **right-sidebar swarm panel** | Stable |
| **Objective/progress orchestrator** | [`docs/orchestrator.md`](docs/orchestrator.md) + [`docs/design/`](docs/design/objective-progress-swarm-design.md) | A decision-complete design for a managed objective registry, event-driven wakeups, budgets, a verifier-gated completion gate, and a kill switch | **Design only — not implemented** |

> The objective engine is a design document, not a shipped feature. No
> `objective_*` tools, `@local/objective-engine` bundle, or durable journal
> exist yet. The design is included because it is the third part of the setup
> and it explains where swarm mode is going.

---

## Why this exists

Out of the box, DSH gives you sessions, agent presets, subagents, compaction,
and the extension points a harness needs. It deliberately does not tell you
*who* should do *what*, and it has no opinion about decisions a language model
is bad at making confidently.

This kit adds three things on top of that:

1. **Roles.** Five presets that compose a session's whole capability set —
   including a delegating orchestrator and a read-only-independent reviewer —
   so the same harness can behave like a small team instead of one generalist.
2. **A decision plane you host yourself.** A small HTTP endpoint that answers
   typed questions (`noul`, `choice`, `score`, `box`) with calibrated numbers.
   DSH consults it for tool selection, per-call assessment, loop detection,
   persona policy, and — in swarm mode — stage assignment. The model never
   writes prose for the agent and never touches harness state.
3. **Swarm mode.** A session-scoped mode in which the primary agent becomes an
   orchestrator: its tool surface is narrowed to coordination, it keeps an
   explicit workplan, and `swarm_assign` asks the decision model which persona
   executes each stage. Every other session stays inert, so a lead session
   cannot block itself.

The design in `docs/design/` extends that last piece into an objective/progress
agent type: a control-plane plugin that tracks objectives, work items, budgets,
verification, wakeups, and a human acknowledgment gate.

---

## Architecture

```text
                      +------------------------------------------------------+
                      |             DeepSeek Harness profile                 |
                      |                                                      |
                      |  packages/dsh-personas     packages/dsh-systemone    |
                      |  +-------------------+     +----------------------+  |
                      |  | 5 agent presets   |     | tools: systemone_ask |  |
                      |  |  orchestrator     |     |        systemone_    |  |
                      |  |  architect        |     |        status        |  |
                      |  |  writer           |     | swarm: enter/assign/ |  |
                      |  |  reviewer         |     |        exit          |  |
                      |  |  researcher       |     | decision layer       |  |
                      |  +---------+---------+     | (selection, assess,  |  |
                      |            |               |  policy, judge, ...) |  |
                      |            | preset rows   | Settings screen      |  |
                      |  +---------v---------------v----------------------+  |
                      |  | sessions - subagents - swarm mode - tool policy  |  |
                      |  +---------------------------+----------------------+  |
                      +------------------------------|-----------------------+
                                                     |
                                    POST { state, questions, model }
                                    Authorization: Bearer <optional>
                                                     |
                                       +-------------v-------------+
                                       | System One decision model |
                                       | self-hosted, e.g. Jev     |
                                       +---------------------------+

  Objective/progress orchestrator (design only, see docs/orchestrator.md)
  +-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
  | @local/objective-engine control plane                                 |
  | objective registry - journal - admission - budgets - wakeup pump -    |
  | verification gate - human ack - kill switch                           |
  +-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

The two shipped bundles are independent: personas work without System One, and
System One works without the role presets. Installing both gives the per-preset
behavior (`swarm.presets`, `presets.<id>.policy`, `presets.<id>.judge`) that the
rest of the documentation assumes.

---

## Quick start

Prerequisite: **DSH 0.2.2-rc.1** (the release this kit was built and tested
against). See [Compatibility](#compatibility).

```text
1. Install the personas bundle
   DSH Web -> Plugins (sidebar) -> Add plugin -> local directory
   choose:  <repo>/packages/dsh-personas

2. Install the System One bundle
   same screen, choose:  <repo>/packages/dsh-systemone

3. Point System One at your decision endpoint
   Settings -> Decision model
     endpoint:  http://127.0.0.1:8008/v1/systemone
     model:     <the model id your endpoint serves>
     timeoutMs: 20000
     mode:      shadow          (observe first; enforce later)
     API key:   stored by DSH's credential service under SYSTEMONE_API_KEY

4. Use it
   New session -> preset "Orchestrator" -> ask it to enter swarm mode
   (it calls swarm_enter), then let swarm_assign route stages to personas
```

On a fresh install nothing is enforced: `mode: shadow` computes decisions and
records them under `systemone_status` without changing behavior. Switch to
`enforce` only after reading `docs/decision-system.md`, and keep approval
prompts enabled.

Full instructions, including CLI and manual profile wiring:
[`docs/install.md`](docs/install.md).

---

## Installation summary

| Bundle | Install path | Requires | Enables |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@local/dsh-personas` | `packages/dsh-personas` | DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 | Five presets in the New-session picker and Settings → Agent presets |
| `@local/systemone` | `packages/dsh-systemone` | DSH 0.2.2-rc.1, a reachable System One endpoint; pnpm/registry access for its two dependencies; the Web client for the Settings page | `systemone_*` and `swarm_*` tools, the decision layer, per-preset policy/judge, Settings → Decision model |

Both bundles are added through the DSH Web Plugins page (or the equivalent
profile wiring). Keep `@local/dsh-personas` before `@local/systemone` in the
profile's bundle list, as the documented order; the shipped
[`examples/profile-patch.example.yml`](examples/profile-patch.example.yml) shows
a complete, credential-free profile patch.

---

## Compatibility

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | **0.2.2-rc.1** (tested) |
| DSH profile team packages | 0.2.2-rc.1 |
| Bundled Node / pnpm shipped with DSH | Node 24.21.0 / pnpm 11.28.5 |
| `@local/dsh-personas` | 1.0.0 — no runtime dependencies |
| `@local/systemone` | 0.2.0 — `engines.dsh: >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0`, `engines.node: >=24`; declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 0.2.1-rc.3, `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` ~3.18.5; browser half at `lib/client.js` (`platform: web`) |

DSH's plugin API is young. Treat the versions above as the tested set: if you
run a different DSH release, install in `shadow` mode first and check
`systemone_status`. There is no compatibility shim and no claim of forward
compatibility.

---

## Security and egress

Read this before pointing the bundle at anything.

- **What leaves the machine.** Every `systemone_ask` call and every decision the
  layer makes sends the `state` and `questions` payload to the configured
  endpoint. That is the only network egress the plugin performs (image paths
  are read locally and sent to that same endpoint when the endpoint supports
  multipart assets). Use an endpoint you control or trust; the bundle has no
  analytics, telemetry, or callback.
- **Credentials.** The API key is resolved at call time from the DSH credential
  service under the reference `SYSTEMONE_API_KEY`, falling back to the process
  environment variable of that name. It is sent as a `Bearer` header. It is
  never returned by a tool, never logged, and never written into configuration
  by the plugin. The Settings screen writes it to the credential service, not
  to the profile patch.
- **Decision output is probabilistic.** A `noul` answer is a probability, not a
  fact; `enforce` mode can deny or hold tool calls based on it. Keep DSH
  approval prompts enabled while you learn the endpoint's calibration. With
  approvals disabled, an `ask` decision becomes a denial.
- **Nothing in this repository is secret.** It contains no API keys, tokens,
  session ids, internal hostnames, or absolute user paths. The design document
  was sanitized; endpoint examples use `127.0.0.1`.
- **The reviewer is not a sandbox.** The reviewer preset plus the
  systemone persona policy is a cooperative guarantee for a well-behaved model,
  not an operating-system sandbox. Run DSH with the file and command
  permissions you are willing to grant.

See [`docs/decision-system.md`](docs/decision-system.md) and
[`docs/configuration.md`](docs/configuration.md) for the full picture.

---

## Repository layout

```text
dsh-swarm-jev/
├── README.md
├── LICENSE                  MIT (changeable by the maintainer)
├── CHANGELOG.md
├── VERSION
├── .gitignore
├── packages/
│   ├── dsh-personas/         @local/dsh-personas bundle
│   └── dsh-systemone/        @local/systemone bundle (tools + layer + Settings UI)
│       └── test/             mock decision endpoint + selftest suite
├── docs/
│   ├── personas.md           the five presets and how to customize them
│   ├── decision-system.md    tools, decisions, modes, swarm mode, Settings
│   ├── orchestrator.md       swarm orchestrator + objective/progress design summary
│   ├── install.md            installing on another DSH installation
│   ├── configuration.md      every configuration field, defaults, precedence
│   ├── troubleshooting.md    failure modes and diagnostics
│   └── design/
│       └── objective-progress-swarm-design.md   sanitized full design (design only)
└── examples/
    └── profile-patch.example.yml   generic two-bundle profile patch
```

## Documentation

| Read this | If you want to |
|---|---|
| [`docs/personas.md`](docs/personas.md) | Understand, choose, compose, or customize the five role presets |
| [`docs/decision-system.md`](docs/decision-system.md) | Understand the System One tools, every decision, the modes, swarm mode, and the Settings screen |
| [`docs/orchestrator.md`](docs/orchestrator.md) | Understand the swarm orchestrator today and the objective/progress design |
| [`docs/install.md`](docs/install.md) | Install, enable, reload, verify, uninstall, and roll back on another machine |
| [`docs/configuration.md`](docs/configuration.md) | Change a config field without breaking the layer; understand precedence and credentials |
| [`docs/troubleshooting.md`](docs/troubleshooting.md) | Fix an endpoint, auth, answer, mode, Settings-page, or version problem |
| [`docs/design/objective-progress-swarm-design.md`](docs/design/objective-progress-swarm-design.md) | Read the complete objective-engine design (protocol, state machines, phasing, tests) |

---

## What is not in this repository

- **The objective engine.** No code exists; `docs/orchestrator.md` explains the
  design status and the Phase 0 prototype you can run with today's primitives.
- **A decision-model server.** The bundle ships the client, not the model. The
  endpoint is yours to run; any service that implements the System One contract
  described in `docs/decision-system.md` works, and Jev-style deployments are
  what this kit was built against.
- **The author's profile.** No profile patch, credential, or session data is
  included; start from the example.

What *is* included beyond the bundles: the package test harness for
`dsh-systemone` (`packages/dsh-systemone/test`, an in-process mock System One
endpoint plus the selftest suite) and the sanitized objective-engine design.

---

## Testing

The systemone package ships its selftest suite, including an in-process mock of
the decision endpoint:

```bash
cd packages/dsh-systemone
pnpm install
pnpm test        # node test/run.mjs
```

The suite exercises the tools, decision layer, deterministic policy, vision
transport, and swarm behavior against the real package modules. It needs no DSH
process, but it does need the package's two `@deepseek-ai/*` dependencies
resolved (that is what `pnpm install` does). The personas bundle is
configuration-only and has no test suite.

---

# @local/systemone — tools + decision layer

Three surfaces over one self-hosted System One endpoint (`/v1/systemone`):

1. **Tools** — `systemone_ask`, `systemone_status` (model-invoked).
2. **Decision layer** — four harness adapters that consult System One on their
   own, in `off` / `shadow` / `enforce` / `swarm` mode.
3. **Settings page** — a browser-side **Decision model** section in Settings
   that edits the endpoint, model, timeout, mode, and the endpoint API key.

The endpoint is configurable and defaults to
`http://127.0.0.1:8008/v1/systemone`. Any Jev-compatible decision service can
serve it; `/health` may report the served model id and its aliases, and the id
sent on every request is the `model` field.

## Decision layer

| Extension point | Decision | Effect in `enforce` |
|---|---|---|
| `agent/pre-step` | which declared tool categories the step needs | `agent.ctx.tools.restrict({ allow })`, recomputed every step |
| `tools/pre-execute` | per-call assessment: restriction conflict, missing information, task match | `ask` (or `cancel` for `onFailure: hold`); off-task alone never gates |
| `tools/result` + `tools.guard` | deterministic identical-call detection | denies a repeat after `maxRepeats` |
| `agent/pre-step` | optional skill hint and model route | one skill notice; `agent.model.select()` for the **next** step |

Per-preset overrides (`presets.<id>`) select the taxonomy, mode, and thresholds
for a session's composing preset (resolved through `ctx.get('agentPresets')`).
This profile ships overrides for `orchestrator`, `architect`, `writer`,
`reviewer`, and `researcher`; `layer.presetOverrides` lists them and every
selection decision records the detected `preset`.

Modes:

- `off` — no work.
- `shadow` — decisions are computed, logged, and kept in `systemone_status` under
  `layer.recent`; behavior is untouched.
- `enforce` — decisions narrow behavior for every session. Never widens: a
  downstream `deny` / `cancel` survives, a restriction only intersects, and a
  stale decision (snapshot changed mid-flight) is discarded.
- `swarm` — a **session mode**, not a preset (like plan mode). No session is
  affected until it enters with `swarm_enter` (or says "enter swarm mode");
  every other session stays inert — no selection, no assessment, no policy, no
  model calls — so a lead session never blocks itself. While a session is in
  swarm mode:
  - the primary agent becomes the **orchestrator**: a `swarm:policy` prompt
    section tells it to keep an explicit workplan and assign every stage;
  - `swarm_assign(stage, needs?, context?)` asks the decision model which
    persona executes the stage (orchestrator / architect / writer / reviewer /
    researcher, configurable via `swarm.personas`) and returns that persona's
    description and operating instructions. The orchestrator then invokes that
    agent — spawn a subagent with those instructions, or execute the stage when
    it is the chosen persona. The model's answer is the assignment; the
    orchestrator does not pick the persona itself;
  - every tool call is judged by the decision model (generic assessment plus a
    per-preset `judge` where configured). Note that per-session personas are
    not selectable through the subagent tool in this harness, so the persona
    travels as the brief's operating instructions, not as a preset switch.
  `swarm_exit` leaves the mode and restores an inert session.

Safety defaults: fail to `ask` rather than allow on provider failure; skip a
restriction that would leave <15% of tools; always keep `systemone_ask` /
`systemone_status` and any tool with no declared category; bound state
(`maxStateChars`), arguments (`maxArgumentChars`), and request size.

Selection only asks about declared categories (`selection.categories`). Tools
without a `toolCategories` entry are never narrowed. Scoped tools mounted by an
agent preset are out of scope for restrictions by design, so selection mostly
affects host-level tools.

### Configuration

Behavior config lives in the profile patch override
(`~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`, row id `systemone`), which replaces
this bundle's `config` wholesale. Feature blocks: `selection`, `assessment`,
`loopDetection`, `skills`, `modelRouting`; plus `thresholds`, `mode`, `swarm`,
`policy` (per preset, deterministic), `judge` (per preset, model-judged),
`timeoutMs`, `maxStateChars`, `maxArgumentChars`, `maxCategories`,
`maxSelectedTools`, `redactKeys`.

The Settings page writes the volatile fields above into that same profile patch,
so a value set in the UI becomes an ordinary profile override. Editing the patch
directly still takes precedence and remains the way to set the non-volatile
limits (`maxQuestions`, `maxRequestChars`, and so on).

`skills` and `modelRouting` ship disabled:

- skill hints depend on `agent.inject()` accepting a plugin-sourced message;
  unverified in 0.2.2, so it is opt-in and failure-tolerant.
- model routing uses `agent.model.select()` and therefore applies to the next
  step, not the one being decided.

## Settings

Open **Settings → Decision model** in the Web UI. The page edits the same live
fields the decision layer reads:

| Field | Effect |
|---|---|
| Endpoint URL | Where decision POST requests are sent. |
| Model id | The `model` value sent with every request. |
| Timeout (ms) | Per-call deadline for one decision request. |
| Mode | `off`, `shadow`, `enforce`, or `swarm`. |
| API key | Written to the DSH credential service under `apiKeyRef` (default `SYSTEMONE_API_KEY`), never to the settings file. Blank keeps the current key; **Clear key** removes it. |

The page is the browser half of this same package (`lib/client.js`, declared by
`dsh.client` in `package.json`). It writes through `ctx.configForms`, so the
Host persists the values in the active profile's Cordis patch and the running
plugin sees them without a restart: `endpoint`, `model`, `apiKeyRef`,
`timeoutMs`, `mode`, and the five feature toggles are `.volatile()` in the
Config schema, and the runtime binds them as live getters. A profile that does
not compose the Web client simply does not show the page; the same fields stay
editable in the profile patch.

The key is resolved through `ctx.credentials.resolve` and then the environment,
so a deployment that supplies `SYSTEMONE_API_KEY` externally can leave the
Settings field blank.

## Swarm panel (right sidebar)

The browser half also registers a **Swarm** tab in the right sidebar. Open the
right sidebar (its expand button sits in the conversation header corner), pick
**Swarm** from the guide — or let it auto-open: the poller opens the tab once
when a session enters swarm mode.

It shows, live:

- the decision plane: mode, model, and endpoint;
- active swarm sessions with their preset and session id (the on-screen session
  is marked), plus the persona catalog with assignment counts;
- the recent decision feed — tool selection, call assessment, persona policy,
  loop guard, and `swarm_assign` stage → persona — with the counters beside it.

The panel polls every 3 s (paused in a hidden tab; refresh on visibility) and
has a manual refresh button. Its **»** button collapses the sidebar; the
sidebar's own chrome also collapses and re-opens it.

Data path: `GET /systemone/panel.json`, registered only where the Web host and
its connection gate are composed. The handler runs `connection.admit(request)`,
which applies the same Host/Origin fence and browser-session cookie check as
`/api`, so an unauthenticated request receives 401. The payload is decision
metadata only — counters, recent decisions, persona catalog, and swarm-mode
session ids — never prompts, tool arguments, credentials, or session content.

## Questions

`noul`, `choice`, `score`, and `box`. A `box` question locates what its
instructions describe in an attached image and answers `{ top, bottom, left,
right }` as fractions of the image; it requires `images` and fails fast without
them.

## Images (vision)

`systemone_ask` accepts `images: [{ path, name? }]` and sends the TypeSafe
assets protocol: `multipart/form-data` with a `request` JSON part plus
`asset-N` binary parts, referenced from `state` as `{ assets: { alias: { type,
part } } }`.

**This deployment does not accept it.** The Qev Playground server parses the
body as JSON only (`POST` with `application/json`) and answers `422 invalid
JSON` to multipart, so image decisions are unavailable here; the tool returns
an explicit error instead of a silent failure. The client code is retained for
a TypeSafe-compatible endpoint. Base64 in `state` is not a substitute — the
contract expects assets.

## Notes

- `enforce` + disabled approval prompts = every `ask` becomes a denial. Keep
  approvals enabled before switching modes.
- `restrict()` may only name tools a scope *inherits*: a tool the agent
  registered on its own layer is visible but not restrictable, and naming one
  rejects the whole filter. The layer tries the full allow-list, trims the
  scope-local names the rejection names, retries once, then fails open.
  `ctx.tools.schemas()` (the global view) is not a usable stand-in for
  "restrictable names" here — it returns only the few tools registered on the
  global layer while host tools live on the agent plane, which is how an
  enforce rollout once collapsed a 38-tool selection to 4 and hid every tool.
  The `selection.alwaysAllow` escape hatch keeps `bash`, `edit`, `glob`, `grep`,
  `read`, and `write` visible regardless.
- Model routing is unverified end to end; leave it off until a route target is
  added and observed.
- Calibration observed on a real shadow run: category probabilities across a
  documentation/config task were 0.11–0.33, so the default selection threshold
  is `0.25`; on-task assessments scored 0.46–0.64 `matchesTask`, while a
  meta-tool call scored 0.24 and is recorded as a note rather than a gate.
- Verify state with the `systemone_status` tool: `layer.mode`,
  `layer.selectionCategories`, `layer.stats`, and the last 20 decisions in
  `layer.recent`.

# dsh-swarm-jev

**A swarm setup for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): role personas, a self-hosted System One decision layer, and a design for an objective/progress orchestrator.**

This repository packages the pieces of a working DSH swarm configuration in
installable form. It is meant to be forked, read, installed on another DSH
installation, and extended. Everything here is ordinary DSH plugin material:
bundles with a `cordis.patch.yml`, plain ES modules, and Markdown.

| Part | Package / location | What it gives you | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Role personas** | [`packages/dsh-personas`](packages/dsh-personas) (`@local/dsh-personas` 1.0.0) | Five agent presets — orchestrator, architect, writer, reviewer, researcher — layered over the shipped DSH presets | Stable |
| **System One decision layer** | [`packages/dsh-systemone`](packages/dsh-systemone) (`@local/systemone` 0.2.0) | `systemone_ask` / `systemone_status` tools, a self-hosted decision model integration, `off`/`shadow`/`enforce`/`swarm` decision layer, persona routing, per-preset tool policy and model judging, the **Settings → Decision model** page, and a live **right-sidebar swarm panel** | Stable |
| **Objective/progress orchestrator** | [`docs/orchestrator.md`](docs/orchestrator.md) + [`docs/design/`](docs/design/objective-progress-swarm-design.md) | A decision-complete design for a managed objective registry, event-driven wakeups, budgets, a verifier-gated completion gate, and a kill switch | **Design only — not implemented** |

> The objective engine is a design document, not a shipped feature. No
> `objective_*` tools, `@local/objective-engine` bundle, or durable journal
> exist yet. The design is included because it is the third part of the setup
> and it explains where swarm mode is going.

---

## Why this exists

Out of the box, DSH gives you sessions, agent presets, subagents, compaction,
and the extension points a harness needs. It deliberately does not tell you
*who* should do *what*, and it has no opinion about decisions a language model
is bad at making confidently.

This kit adds three things on top of that:

1. **Roles.** Five presets that compose a session's whole capability set —
   including a delegating orchestrator and a read-only-independent reviewer —
   so the same harness can behave like a small team instead of one generalist.
2. **A decision plane you host yourself.** A small HTTP endpoint that answers
   typed questions (`noul`, `choice`, `score`, `box`) with calibrated numbers.
   DSH consults it for tool selection, per-call assessment, loop detection,
   persona policy, and — in swarm mode — stage assignment. The model never
   writes prose for the agent and never touches harness state.
3. **Swarm mode.** A session-scoped mode in which the primary agent becomes an
   orchestrator: its tool surface is narrowed to coordination, it keeps an
   explicit workplan, and `swarm_assign` asks the decision model which persona
   executes each stage. Every other session stays inert, so a lead session
   cannot block itself.

The design in `docs/design/` extends that last piece into an objective/progress
agent type: a control-plane plugin that tracks objectives, work items, budgets,
verification, wakeups, and a human acknowledgment gate.

---

## Architecture

```text
                      +------------------------------------------------------+
                      |             DeepSeek Harness profile                 |
                      |                                                      |
                      |  packages/dsh-personas     packages/dsh-systemone    |
                      |  +-------------------+     +----------------------+  |
                      |  | 5 agent presets   |     | tools: systemone_ask |  |
                      |  |  orchestrator     |     |        systemone_    |  |
                      |  |  architect        |     |        status        |  |
                      |  |  writer           |     | swarm: enter/assign/ |  |
                      |  |  reviewer         |     |        exit          |  |
                      |  |  researcher       |     | decision layer       |  |
                      |  +---------+---------+     | (selection, assess,  |  |
                      |            |               |  policy, judge, ...) |  |
                      |            | preset rows   | Settings screen      |  |
                      |  +---------v---------------v----------------------+  |
                      |  | sessions - subagents - swarm mode - tool policy  |  |
                      |  +---------------------------+----------------------+  |
                      +------------------------------|-----------------------+
                                                     |
                                    POST { state, questions, model }
                                    Authorization: Bearer <optional>
                                                     |
                                       +-------------v-------------+
                                       | System One decision model |
                                       | self-hosted, e.g. Jev     |
                                       +---------------------------+

  Objective/progress orchestrator (design only, see docs/orchestrator.md)
  +-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
  | @local/objective-engine control plane                                 |
  | objective registry - journal - admission - budgets - wakeup pump -    |
  | verification gate - human ack - kill switch                           |
  +-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

The two shipped bundles are independent: personas work without System One, and
System One works without the role presets. Installing both gives the per-preset
behavior (`swarm.presets`, `presets.<id>.policy`, `presets.<id>.judge`) that the
rest of the documentation assumes.

---

## Quick start

Prerequisite: **DSH 0.2.2-rc.1** (the release this kit was built and tested
against). See [Compatibility](#compatibility).

```text
1. Install the personas bundle
   DSH Web -> Plugins (sidebar) -> Add plugin -> local directory
   choose:  <repo>/packages/dsh-personas

2. Install the System One bundle
   same screen, choose:  <repo>/packages/dsh-systemone

3. Point System One at your decision endpoint
   Settings -> Decision model
     endpoint:  http://127.0.0.1:8008/v1/systemone
     model:     <the model id your endpoint serves>
     timeoutMs: 20000
     mode:      shadow          (observe first; enforce later)
     API key:   stored by DSH's credential service under SYSTEMONE_API_KEY

4. Use it
   New session -> preset "Orchestrator" -> ask it to enter swarm mode
   (it calls swarm_enter), then let swarm_assign route stages to personas
```

On a fresh install nothing is enforced: `mode: shadow` computes decisions and
records them under `systemone_status` without changing behavior. Switch to
`enforce` only after reading `docs/decision-system.md`, and keep approval
prompts enabled.

Full instructions, including CLI and manual profile wiring:
[`docs/install.md`](docs/install.md).

---

## Installation summary

| Bundle | Install path | Requires | Enables |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@local/dsh-personas` | `packages/dsh-personas` | DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 | Five presets in the New-session picker and Settings → Agent presets |
| `@local/systemone` | `packages/dsh-systemone` | DSH 0.2.2-rc.1, a reachable System One endpoint; pnpm/registry access for its two dependencies; the Web client for the Settings page | `systemone_*` and `swarm_*` tools, the decision layer, per-preset policy/judge, Settings → Decision model |

Both bundles are added through the DSH Web Plugins page (or the equivalent
profile wiring). Keep `@local/dsh-personas` before `@local/systemone` in the
profile's bundle list, as the documented order; the shipped
[`examples/profile-patch.example.yml`](examples/profile-patch.example.yml) shows
a complete, credential-free profile patch.

---

## Compatibility

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | **0.2.2-rc.1** (tested) |
| DSH profile team packages | 0.2.2-rc.1 |
| Bundled Node / pnpm shipped with DSH | Node 24.21.0 / pnpm 11.28.5 |
| `@local/dsh-personas` | 1.0.0 — no runtime dependencies |
| `@local/systemone` | 0.2.0 — `engines.dsh: >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0`, `engines.node: >=24`; declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 0.2.1-rc.3, `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` ~3.18.5; browser half at `lib/client.js` (`platform: web`) |

DSH's plugin API is young. Treat the versions above as the tested set: if you
run a different DSH release, install in `shadow` mode first and check
`systemone_status`. There is no compatibility shim and no claim of forward
compatibility.

---

## Security and egress

Read this before pointing the bundle at anything.

- **What leaves the machine.** Every `systemone_ask` call and every decision the
  layer makes sends the `state` and `questions` payload to the configured
  endpoint. That is the only network egress the plugin performs (image paths
  are read locally and sent to that same endpoint when the endpoint supports
  multipart assets). Use an endpoint you control or trust; the bundle has no
  analytics, telemetry, or callback.
- **Credentials.** The API key is resolved at call time from the DSH credential
  service under the reference `SYSTEMONE_API_KEY`, falling back to the process
  environment variable of that name. It is sent as a `Bearer` header. It is
  never returned by a tool, never logged, and never written into configuration
  by the plugin. The Settings screen writes it to the credential service, not
  to the profile patch.
- **Decision output is probabilistic.** A `noul` answer is a probability, not a
  fact; `enforce` mode can deny or hold tool calls based on it. Keep DSH
  approval prompts enabled while you learn the endpoint's calibration. With
  approvals disabled, an `ask` decision becomes a denial.
- **Nothing in this repository is secret.** It contains no API keys, tokens,
  session ids, internal hostnames, or absolute user paths. The design document
  was sanitized; endpoint examples use `127.0.0.1`.
- **The reviewer is not a sandbox.** The reviewer preset plus the
  systemone persona policy is a cooperative guarantee for a well-behaved model,
  not an operating-system sandbox. Run DSH with the file and command
  permissions you are willing to grant.

See [`docs/decision-system.md`](docs/decision-system.md) and
[`docs/configuration.md`](docs/configuration.md) for the full picture.

---

## Repository layout

```text
dsh-swarm-jev/
├── README.md
├── LICENSE                  MIT (changeable by the maintainer)
├── CHANGELOG.md
├── VERSION
├── .gitignore
├── packages/
│   ├── dsh-personas/         @local/dsh-personas bundle
│   └── dsh-systemone/        @local/systemone bundle (tools + layer + Settings UI)
│       └── test/             mock decision endpoint + selftest suite
├── docs/
│   ├── personas.md           the five presets and how to customize them
│   ├── decision-system.md    tools, decisions, modes, swarm mode, Settings
│   ├── orchestrator.md       swarm orchestrator + objective/progress design summary
│   ├── install.md            installing on another DSH installation
│   ├── configuration.md      every configuration field, defaults, precedence
│   ├── troubleshooting.md    failure modes and diagnostics
│   └── design/
│       └── objective-progress-swarm-design.md   sanitized full design (design only)
└── examples/
    └── profile-patch.example.yml   generic two-bundle profile patch
```

## Documentation

| Read this | If you want to |
|---|---|
| [`docs/personas.md`](docs/personas.md) | Understand, choose, compose, or customize the five role presets |
| [`docs/decision-system.md`](docs/decision-system.md) | Understand the System One tools, every decision, the modes, swarm mode, and the Settings screen |
| [`docs/orchestrator.md`](docs/orchestrator.md) | Understand the swarm orchestrator today and the objective/progress design |
| [`docs/install.md`](docs/install.md) | Install, enable, reload, verify, uninstall, and roll back on another machine |
| [`docs/configuration.md`](docs/configuration.md) | Change a config field without breaking the layer; understand precedence and credentials |
| [`docs/troubleshooting.md`](docs/troubleshooting.md) | Fix an endpoint, auth, answer, mode, Settings-page, or version problem |
| [`docs/design/objective-progress-swarm-design.md`](docs/design/objective-progress-swarm-design.md) | Read the complete objective-engine design (protocol, state machines, phasing, tests) |

---

## What is not in this repository

- **The objective engine.** No code exists; `docs/orchestrator.md` explains the
  design status and the Phase 0 prototype you can run with today's primitives.
- **A decision-model server.** The bundle ships the client, not the model. The
  endpoint is yours to run; any service that implements the System One contract
  described in `docs/decision-system.md` works, and Jev-style deployments are
  what this kit was built against.
- **The author's profile.** No profile patch, credential, or session data is
  included; start from the example.

What *is* included beyond the bundles: the package test harness for
`dsh-systemone` (`packages/dsh-systemone/test`, an in-process mock System One
endpoint plus the selftest suite) and the sanitized objective-engine design.

---

## Testing

The systemone package ships its selftest suite, including an in-process mock of
the decision endpoint:

```bash
cd packages/dsh-systemone
pnpm install
pnpm test        # node test/run.mjs
```

The suite exercises the tools, decision layer, deterministic policy, vision
transport, and swarm behavior against the real package modules. It needs no DSH
process, but it does need the package's two `@deepseek-ai/*` dependencies
resolved (that is what `pnpm install` does). The personas bundle is
configuration-only and has no test suite.

---

## License

MIT — see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE). The license is the maintainer's choice and can
be changed in a fork; if you publish a derivative, keep the copyright notice.

DeepSeek Harness and its `@deepseek-ai/*` packages are separate works under
their own licenses; this repository only depends on them and does not
redistribute them.

Native five-file closure and patch match. Default shadow mode observes; the panel explicitly uses connection.admit and tool hooks retain downstream denial. However systemone_ask reads caller-supplied absolute image paths with raw readFile before sending them to the configured endpoint; workspace or delegated file authorization is not established in that path. No lifecycle hook. The companion personas manifest is configuration-only and separately excluded from native catalog admission. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# 影响网 / influence-net 面向 A 股的影响分析工具：在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）对话里把调研累积进「影响网」，在右侧栏即时看到关系网与八维雷达。 > 非投资建议。仓库内工业富联示例仅供演示。 ## 产品效果 **左边对话补充调研，右边关系网即时更新** ![关系网与对话](docs/screenshots/01-relationship-net.png) **雷达维：八个维度一眼看结构** ![雷达维](docs/screenshots/02-radar-dims.png) **点开节点看详情与证据** ![节点详情](docs/screenshots/03-node-detail.png) ## 它做什么 - 本地引擎保存影响网（SQLite，默认 `~/.influence-net/`） - 在 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）对话里用工具提出 / 确认写入 - 右侧栏画布：关系网、雷达维、近中远筛选与节点详情 ## 架构 ```mermaid flowchart LR U[你] --> DSH[DeepSeek Harness 对话] DSH --> P[影响网插件] P -->|右侧栏| C[关系网 / 雷达维画布] P -->|propose / apply 等工具| E[本地引擎 :18765] E --> DB[(本机 SQLite
~/.influence-net/)] EX[示例种子
工业富联 601138] -.->|首次空库装入| DB ``` 数据留在本机；对话只负责提出改动，确认后再写入。默认引擎地址：`http://127.0.0.1:18765`（可用 `INFLUENCE_NET_URL` / `INFLUENCE_NET_HOME` 覆盖）。 ## 前置 已安装并可运行的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）。也可参考[官网](https://deepseek.com/harness/)与[文档](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/)。 ## 快速开始 ### 1. 克隆并启动引擎 ```bash git clone https://github.com/jqlong17/influence-net.git cd influence-net ./engine/run.sh ``` 首次空库会自动装入工业富联（601138）示例网。 ### 2. 在 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）中加载插件 ```bash dsh --patch /path/to/influence-net/cordis.yml ``` 若改动了 `src/client/**`，先重建前端包（`DSH_ROOT` 指向 DeepSeek Harness 安装根目录）： ```bash DSH_ROOT=/path/to/deepseek-harness npm run bundle:client ``` npm 包名：`influence-net`（可在 [DSH Plugin Hub](https://dshpluginhub.ai) 浏览 DeepSeek Harness 插件生态）。 ### 3. 使用 1. 打开会话右侧栏 → **影响网** 2. 切换关系网 / 雷达维，点选节点查看详情 3. 常用工具：`influence_net_propose`、`influence_net_apply`、`influence_net_create_net`、`influence_net_load_example` ## 示例数据 `data/examples/fii-601138/` — 工业富联演示网，可用 `influence_net_load_example` 重新装入。 ## Plugin Hub 仓库已标注 `dsh-plugin` / `deepseek-harness` topic，可在 [DSH Plugin Hub](https://dshpluginhub.ai) 作为源码或 npm 条目被发现。包名：`influence-net`。 ## 测试 ```bash # 引擎 cd engine && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest ../tests/engine -q # 插件（需本机 DeepSeek Harness，设置 DSH_ROOT） DSH_ROOT=/path/to/deepseek-harness npx vitest run ``` ## 相关链接 - 本插件：https://github.com/jqlong17/influence-net - 产品页：https://influence.notta.uk - DeepSeek Harness（dsh）：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness - 官网：https://deepseek.com/harness/ - 文档：https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/ - Plugin Hub：https://dshpluginhub.ai ## License MIT

# dsh-purge Community **让 AI 更专注地辅助你的学习与动手实验。** 给 DeepSeek Harness 的自托管控件（俗称「破甲」插件）· 86 条宿主补丁 · 25 层状态自检 · 左侧栏整页设置 [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge?label=release)](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/releases) [![Checks](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/actions/workflows/community.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/actions/workflows/community.yml) 当前版本 **1.6.84** · 适配 **DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1**（0.2.1-rc.1 / rc.2 / rc.3 / rc.5 同样通过） · [English](docs/README.en.md) 1.6.84 为已授权测试入口增加一次性命令执行挑战，区分文件写入与命令执行。[发行说明](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/releases/tag/v1.6.84)。 **原项目与作者**：基于 [小杨 / YuJunZhiXue 的 dsh-purge](https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge) 独立维护。原仓库已恢复；保留原作者署名、版权与 MIT 许可证。社区版由本仓库维护，并非原作者官方发行。
--- ## 搭配：本机出图（Qwen Studio） 破甲之后最直接的玩法，是把「生图」也搬到本机——不用网页、不用会员、不把提示词发到别人服务器。 配套插件 **Qwen Studio**（`dsh-qwen-studio`）把 Qwen Image 2.1 接进 DSH： - **Apple Silicon Mac**：MLX / MFLUX 本机推理，模型用时加载、空闲释放； - **Windows / Linux + NVIDIA**：连你自己的 GPU 网关（ComfyUI 或 vLLM-Omni 协议），也支持 SSH 按需拉起； - 支持参考图编辑（按图改画风、换材质）、LoRA、ControlNet、蒙版、整套预设、图库与批量任务； - 装好之后，会话里直接说「画一张…」或「把这张改成水彩」，Agent 调用 `qwen_generate_image` 并把图返回到对话里。 **组合效果**：破甲让 Agent 不再反复确认「要不要画」，出图插件让它真的画出来，全程在你自己的机器上完成。 **仓库**：[kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio) · **下载**：[最新 Releases](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio/releases/latest) · **安装与硬件自查**：[docs/SETUP.md](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md)（先看「这台机器能不能跑」再动手） ## 它是什么 dsh-purge Community 是一个跑在你自己机器上的 Harness 附加组件。它把日常使用里最消耗注意力的几件事收敛到一处： - **看清楚状态**：安装、补丁、注入到底有没有就绪，一条命令或一屏面板给结论； - **少一些往返**：把反复出现的确认与打断，收敛成一次设置； - **随时能回去**：应用、回滚、开关都留记录，操作前自动快照； - **方便做实验**：提示词、规则、预设集中管理，改坏了能撤。 目标很简单：**让助手更连贯地配合你的学习与动手实验**，而不是每做一步都先停下来问一句。 社区里通常把它叫作「破甲」或「无限制模式」插件——指的是它降低了交互层面的摩擦，让 agent 能连续执行任务；它不改模型本身，也不改变你要做的事。 ### 下载时报 `fetch failed`？ 1.6.39 起，独立安装器会显示失败阶段和错误码，有限重试后可切换系统 curl；两条通道都保留来源、证书和 SHA256 校验。请先重新下载安装脚本再运行 dry-run，仍失败时提交脱敏诊断行即可。见 [下载排查说明](docs/maintenance-issue-52.md)。不会自动修改代理或重启 DSH。 ### 让不同预设保留自己的提示词 1.6.40 新增 `excludePresets`：默认空列表，保持原有行为；可将 `roleplay`、`minimal` 等预设排除在 Purge 提示词注入之外，保留命令、面板与工具。切换预设、并行会话和子 Agent 各自判断，宿主兜底也遵守排除。配置示例、升级步骤与边界见 [按预设排除说明](docs/maintenance-issue-53.md)。这不会撤销全局宿主补丁。 ## 设计原则 | 原则 | 含义 | | --- | --- | | 本机优先 | 全部逻辑在本机运行，不改云端账号、不上传提示词或配置 | | 可见 | 每个动作都有状态与证据，不靠"应该生效了"这种判断 | | 可回滚 | 应用 / 安装 / 回滚前自动快照，保留原文件与校验清单 | | 不替你做决定 | 只减少摩擦，不改变你的目标；改什么、开什么，都由你确认 | ## 适用场景 本机学习、个人项目、自动化实验与维护工作。请在你拥有或已获授权的环境中使用；涉及他人系统时，先取得许可。 ## 1.6.39 更新 修复独立安装器只显示 `fetch failed` 的问题：分阶段诊断、有限重试和系统 curl 备用下载，继续严格校验官方来源、证书和 SHA256。下载失败不触碰现有安装。[发行说明](docs/releases/1.6.48.md) · [配置与验收](docs/maintenance-issue-52.md) ## 安装 **DSH 官方入口负责安装插件；下面的社区安装器由本仓库维护，不是 DeepSeek 官方脚本。** 首次安装可用官方界面或 CLI；已经装过 `dsh-purge` / 旧独立面板时，用社区安装器原地迁移，不要先卸载。安装、应用宿主补丁、手动重启是独立动作。 ### 方式一：DSH 官方界面（首次安装） 1. 先打开 DSH 完成初始化。按当前官方文档，进入「插件」，点击「实验性插件」旁的「更多」，启用「自定义插件市场」；然后进入「发现 → 添加索引源」。 2. 本项目的**社区索引**：`https://kingcharleslzy-ai.github.io/dsh-purge/index.json`。 3. 选择 dsh-purge Community，核对来源为 `kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge`、包名为 `dsh-purge-community`，确认后安装。 界面和安装协议由 DSH 提供，索引与插件由社区维护。不同 DSH 版本的入口文字可能不同；第三方 `dsh-market` 也可能有额外的筛选与迁移限制。已有旧包时请使用方式三。[官方市场说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/guide/plugin-market.zh.md) ### 方式二：DSH 官方 CLI（首次安装） 下面命令适用于**已经安装 `dsh` 命令、且使用 `web` profile 的 CLI/Web 用户**，在 macOS/Linux 终端或 Windows PowerShell 中运行。桌面版用户优先用上面的界面；不要为了安装插件再用 `npx` 下载另一套宿主。 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/releases/download/v1.6.84/dsh-purge-community-1.6.84.tgz" ``` `web` 必须与实际启动的 profile 一致；自定义数据目录需要沿用该实例的 `DSH_HOME`。命令使用本次发行的固定版本 URL；不是 `npm install -g`，也不是安装裸 npm 包名。本项目通过 GitHub 发行，**不要替换成 `add dsh-purge` 或 `add dsh-purge-community`**。官方 CLI 的安装不会额外运行我们安装器的 Release SHA256 比对及迁移快照；需要这些功能时选方式三。[官方 CLI 安装说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.zh.md) ### 方式三：社区安装器（备份、旧版迁移、恢复） 先安装并打开一次 DSH，让实际 profile 初始化。以下命令下载**本仓库的脚本**，先校验，再安装；`dry-run` 通过仅代表前置检查、下载和 SHA256 通过，不代表依赖安装、迁移或启动已通过。请先阅读下载的脚本。 #### macOS Desktop 默认应用位置 `/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app`、数据目录 `~/.dsh`、profile `desktop`。将下面两段放在同一个终端会话中执行： ```sh PURGE_INSTALL_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" curl -fSL --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 90 "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/master/scripts/install.sh" -o "$PURGE_INSTALL_DIR/install.sh" sh "$PURGE_INSTALL_DIR/install.sh" --dry-run ``` 校验成功、核对目标实例后执行： ```sh sh "$PURGE_INSTALL_DIR/install.sh" ``` 自定义应用或 home 时，先设置 `DSH_APP` / `DSH_HOME`；自定义 profile 对两次命令都加 `--profile=实际名称`。不要照抄别人的路径。 macOS 支持从 XML/二进制 plist 读取真实可执行文件名；元数据无效会停止，不会换用其他应用。详见[定位边界](docs/INSTALLATION.md#应用定位边界pr-78)。 #### Windows Desktop · PowerShell 5.1 / 7 脚本会尝试定位唯一的 DSH Desktop，默认 home 为用户的 `.dsh`。旧 Desktop CLI 默认 profile 为 `desktop`，带独立 dsh CLI 的新壳默认为 `web`；自定义 profile 用 `-Profile` 指定。不要求管理员权限；路径含空格也支持。 ```powershell $PurgeInstaller = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('purge-install-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.ps1') Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 90 -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/master/scripts/install.ps1' -OutFile $PurgeInstaller powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$PurgeInstaller" -DryRun ``` 上一条退出码为 0、核对目标实例后，在同一个 PowerShell 会话中执行： ```powershell powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$PurgeInstaller" ``` 找不到应用或有多个副本时，对两次命令都增加 `-DshExe '实际的 DeepSeek Harness.exe 完整路径'`；自定义目录用 `-DshHome`、profile 用 `-Profile`。`ExecutionPolicy Bypass` 只作用于这次子进程，不修改持久执行策略；组织策略仍可能禁止执行，遇到时报告错误，不修改系统策略。 #### Linux · CLI / Web 先安装 Node ≥18 和 DSH CLI，并初始化实际使用的 profile。以下从下载开始，不要求已 clone 本仓库： ```sh PURGE_INSTALL_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" curl -fSL --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 90 "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/master/scripts/install.sh" -o "$PURGE_INSTALL_DIR/install.sh" sh "$PURGE_INSTALL_DIR/install.sh" --dry-run ``` 校验成功后，在同一终端执行 `sh "$PURGE_INSTALL_DIR/install.sh"`。默认使用 PATH 中的 `node` / `dsh` 与 `web` profile。自定义实例在两次调用中保持 `DSH_NODE`、`PURGE_DSH_CLI`、`DSH_HOME`、`--profile=名称` 一致。 ### 安装会改什么，以及怎么确认 - 社区安装器在迁移前备份，调用当前实例的官方 `dsh plugin --profile … add …`，再核对安装版本和入口；保留提示词、规则、更新偏好及其他插件设置。 - **不是“完全不碰宿主目录”**：解包桌面布局缺失/损坏 `app/runtime` 链接时，会保留旧链接并修复到该安装的 runtime；冲突则停止。Linux 系统宿主只读时可能创建用户副本，并在成功后切换用户启动器。详见[安装指南](docs/INSTALLATION.md)。 - 插件加载前若市场安装失败（issue #7），插件本身尚未运行；先读脱敏错误、核对依赖来源，不能承诺安装器能修复所有市场或网络错误。 - 不自动应用宿主补丁、不自动重启、不改代理、不修改全局 npm 源或清空缓存。脚本和 bootstrap 从本仓库 `master` 下载；Release 包另做 SHA256 校验，这不是对下载脚本的独立签名验证。 - 命令退出码非零就视为失败。安装成功后记录 `backup_id`，核对磁盘版本；运行中的 DSH 仍可能显示旧版，待用户方便时手动退出重开。`dry-run` 成功、备份存在或市场卡片出现都不能替代安装成功证据。 - 回滚优先用「Purge → 状态 → 本机备份」，选择本次安装前的备份；无界面时按[安装指南中的 CLI 回滚](docs/INSTALLATION.md#cli-rollback)执行。不要假设 `purge-community` 已加入系统 PATH。 完整的实例选择、回滚与失败恢复步骤见 [安装指南](docs/INSTALLATION.md)，Agent 必须先读 [AGENTS.md §12](AGENTS.md#installation)。 ## 面板 左侧栏一整页，不做悬浮按钮： - 顶部一句话说明当前状态，主操作是「应用」； - 其余分区折叠，说明收进 `?`，需要时再展开； - 维护页可看最近动作、备份占用、更新偏好； - 支持隐藏不用的入口（例如回退按钮），只影响显示。 ## 常用命令 | 命令 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `purge-community selfcheck [--json]` | 逐层状态与证据；不适用项单独标注 | | `purge-community status` | 宿主路径与计数 | | `purge-community host-status` | 只读查看安装布局与当前入口（不换包、不重启） | | `purge-community diagnose` | 锚点漂移诊断，给出文件、行号与候选落点 | | `purge-community reanchor …` | 把确认过的新锚点钉成本地覆盖，可撤销 | | `purge-community probe [new]` | 生成运行时探针，验证注入确实送达模型 | | `purge-community audit [--limit n]` | 最近动作记录 | | `purge-community boost [on\|off]` | 尾部强化段开关 | | `purge-community preset [status\|install]` | 「无限制模式」预设落盘 | | `purge-community retry [on\|off]` | 回答被中断时的单次重试开关 | | `purge-community usage` / `prune` | 备份占用与清理 | | `purge-community backup` / `rollback ` | 快照 / 回滚插件 | ## 更新 维护页分别设置「自动检查」与「自动安装」，默认只检查，间隔 6 小时。安装完成不会自动重启——你决定什么时候重开。 ## 兼容性 | 组件 | 值 | | --- | --- | | 插件 | `dsh-purge-community` 1.6.84 | | 已验证宿主 | DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 / 0.2.1-rc.1 / 0.2.1-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.3 / 0.2.1-rc.5 | | 其它宿主 | 允许安装，自检会标「未验证」；先看 `diagnose` | | Node | ≥18（桌面版自带运行时即可）；红队工具需 ≥22.5（`node:sqlite`） | ## 出问题怎么办 ```sh purge-community selfcheck --json # 先看哪一层不是 ok purge-community diagnose # 锚点漂移时看候选位置 purge-community audit --limit 20 # 最近动作 ``` 面板打不开时，先确认版本一致，再按 [维护文档](docs/MAINTENANCE.md) 恢复；不要直接覆盖 `Resources/app`。 ## 开发与验证 ```sh npm test # 单元与契约测试 npm run check:docs # 版本与文档一致性 npm run check:client # 面板 bundle 与源码一致 npm run test:electron # 真实 Electron 环境（临时目录，不改安装） npm run smoke # 发行包冒烟 ``` 面向 AI agent 的操作说明在 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)，两者冲突时以它为准。 **关键词**：破甲 · 无限制模式 · unrestricted · prompt injection · jailbreak · DSH 插件 · 状态自检 · 备份回滚 ## 贡献者 感谢原作者、代码贡献者，以及提供问题复现、分析与验证的朋友。头像链接直达 GitHub 主页；具体贡献见 [贡献记录](CONTRIBUTORS.md)，第三方来源见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。

# Purge 界面 独立的 DSH 桌面端界面插件。官方 `dsh-purge` 提供功能和数据接口；`dsh-purge-panel` 提供右侧入口、设置布局及由插件生命周期管理的旧入口隐藏样式。它不写入官方包、不复制后端补丁、不安装会话钩子，也不自动应用或恢复补丁。 ## 使用 先安装、启用官方 dsh-purge，再安装本包。右侧栏的「＋ → Purge」打开设置。也可以从本插件的配置入口打开。 两个插件独立更新：更新官方 Purge 不会替换本包中的界面文件。禁用本插件后，官方原有入口会重新显示，官方配置和数据不会删除。迁移前的 `dsh-purge@1.1.71-local.*` 是旧的内嵌界面版本，请先换回官方原版，以免重复注册右侧标签。 ## 兼容范围 实测 DSH 桌面版当前安装环境与官方 Purge 1.1.71。界面通过 `/dsh-purge/*`、原演练台 `/redteam/api` 使用现有接口；服务不可用或版本未经验证时，会显示提示。官方未来改变接口或入口 class 名时，本插件可能需要适配，不能承诺永久兼容。 隐藏旧入口只使用 `.dshp-launch`、`.dshp-hero-chip`、`.dshp-tab-chip`、`.dshp-dock` 四个 CSS 选择器。样式由插件加载生命周期直接挂到文档 head，不依赖设置页或 shell.overlay 是否渲染；禁用插件时只清理自身创建的样式节点。没有全局 DOM 扫描、猴子补丁、加载器劫持或对官方安装文件的重写。官方自身的隐藏组件及扫描逻辑仍由官方运行；独立界面不能在不侵入官方实现的情况下去掉它们。 界面使用独立的 `dshpp-` 类名和 locale 命名空间，防止官方 CSS 更新串样式。切换分类保持未保存草稿；刷新状态不重写草稿。已访问分类保持挂载。 ## 来源与维护 界面部分派生自 YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge 1.1.71，版权归原作者，MIT 许可证见 LICENSE。独立界面并非官方发布。本地适配仅调整展示与入口，不修改提示词、安全策略、模型行为或后端能力。 当前独立版本：1.1.2。源码位于 src/，client.js 是自动生成的安装产物，禁止手工编辑；index.js 是无副作用的宿主入口，cordis.patch.yml 只注册本插件自身。 ## 1.0.1 修复 - 初次读取完成前禁止编辑，避免慢响应覆盖刚输入的内容。 - 保存中的新输入保留为未保存草稿，旧保存响应不会覆盖它；重复保存合并为一次请求。 - 文本保存统一采用超时和 HTTP 状态检查，失败后保留内容并恢复保存按钮。 - 兼容提示复用状态页数据，刷新时一起更新，避免重复状态请求。 - 授权状态同步纳入插件生命周期，禁用时清理重试。 - 增加异步竞态、HTTP 500、超时恢复与模块加载无副作用测试。 本轮不是对上游补丁、演练台或所有第三方依赖的全面安全审计。未来上游 API / 入口选择器变化仍需适配。 ## 1.1.0 模块化 - `src/entry.js`：DSH 注册与生命周期。 - `src/api/`：请求、超时、HTTP 错误和旧路由兼容。 - `src/state/`：侧栏状态、授权读取和当前工作区的只读订阅。 - `src/components/`：设置页、规则、技能、状态和对话框。 - `src/shared/`：语言、版本判断和公共 React 导出。 - `src/styles/`：可直接编辑的 CSS。 - `src/vendor/drill.js`：保留的上游演练台，仅隔离模块；不代表已完成其功能审计。 清理独立界面中未启用的旧回退/续写、悬浮窗定位、发送挂件副本及其样式；官方插件原有行为未改变。规则页直接读取当前会话目录，切换会话会刷新，迟到的旧请求不会覆盖新状态。技能接口只在 404/405 时回退到旧路由；500 或格式错误不会重发可能已经执行的写入。 开发时运行 `npm ci --ignore-scripts --legacy-peer-deps`、`npm run build`、`npm test`。CI 检查源码与提交的构建产物一致，测试不会修改真实配置。源码模块化不等于整个上游已无缺陷，后续按模块逐项验证。 ## 1.1.2 修复 旧入口的隐藏样式不再依赖 shell.overlay 内的 React style 节点。即使关闭或切换页面导致 overlay 不渲染，旧悬浮按钮和旧面板仍保持隐藏；停止本界面插件后按生命周期恢复。回归覆盖 overlay 完全不渲染、挂载后卸载及插件清理，不改动官方插件文件、提示词或个人设置。
# dsh-purge Community **让 AI 更专注地辅助你的学习与动手实验。** 给 DeepSeek Harness 的自托管控件（俗称「破甲」插件）· 86 条宿主补丁 · 25 层状态自检 · 左侧栏整页设置 [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge?label=release)](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/releases) [![Checks](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/actions/workflows/community.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/actions/workflows/community.yml) 当前版本 **1.6.84** · 适配 **DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1**（0.2.1-rc.1 / rc.2 / rc.3 / rc.5 同样通过） · [English](docs/README.en.md) 1.6.84 为已授权测试入口增加一次性命令执行挑战，区分文件写入与命令执行。[发行说明](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/releases/tag/v1.6.84)。 **原项目与作者**：基于 [小杨 / YuJunZhiXue 的 dsh-purge](https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge) 独立维护。原仓库已恢复；保留原作者署名、版权与 MIT 许可证。社区版由本仓库维护，并非原作者官方发行。
--- ## 搭配：本机出图（Qwen Studio） 破甲之后最直接的玩法，是把「生图」也搬到本机——不用网页、不用会员、不把提示词发到别人服务器。 配套插件 **Qwen Studio**（`dsh-qwen-studio`）把 Qwen Image 2.1 接进 DSH： - **Apple Silicon Mac**：MLX / MFLUX 本机推理，模型用时加载、空闲释放； - **Windows / Linux + NVIDIA**：连你自己的 GPU 网关（ComfyUI 或 vLLM-Omni 协议），也支持 SSH 按需拉起； - 支持参考图编辑（按图改画风、换材质）、LoRA、ControlNet、蒙版、整套预设、图库与批量任务； - 装好之后，会话里直接说「画一张…」或「把这张改成水彩」，Agent 调用 `qwen_generate_image` 并把图返回到对话里。 **组合效果**：破甲让 Agent 不再反复确认「要不要画」，出图插件让它真的画出来，全程在你自己的机器上完成。 **仓库**：[kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio) · **下载**：[最新 Releases](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio/releases/latest) · **安装与硬件自查**：[docs/SETUP.md](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md)（先看「这台机器能不能跑」再动手） ## 它是什么 dsh-purge Community 是一个跑在你自己机器上的 Harness 附加组件。它把日常使用里最消耗注意力的几件事收敛到一处： - **看清楚状态**：安装、补丁、注入到底有没有就绪，一条命令或一屏面板给结论； - **少一些往返**：把反复出现的确认与打断，收敛成一次设置； - **随时能回去**：应用、回滚、开关都留记录，操作前自动快照； - **方便做实验**：提示词、规则、预设集中管理，改坏了能撤。 目标很简单：**让助手更连贯地配合你的学习与动手实验**，而不是每做一步都先停下来问一句。 社区里通常把它叫作「破甲」或「无限制模式」插件——指的是它降低了交互层面的摩擦，让 agent 能连续执行任务；它不改模型本身，也不改变你要做的事。 ### 下载时报 `fetch failed`？ 1.6.39 起，独立安装器会显示失败阶段和错误码，有限重试后可切换系统 curl；两条通道都保留来源、证书和 SHA256 校验。请先重新下载安装脚本再运行 dry-run，仍失败时提交脱敏诊断行即可。见 [下载排查说明](docs/maintenance-issue-52.md)。不会自动修改代理或重启 DSH。 ### 让不同预设保留自己的提示词 1.6.40 新增 `excludePresets`：默认空列表，保持原有行为；可将 `roleplay`、`minimal` 等预设排除在 Purge 提示词注入之外，保留命令、面板与工具。切换预设、并行会话和子 Agent 各自判断，宿主兜底也遵守排除。配置示例、升级步骤与边界见 [按预设排除说明](docs/maintenance-issue-53.md)。这不会撤销全局宿主补丁。 ## 设计原则 | 原则 | 含义 | | --- | --- | | 本机优先 | 全部逻辑在本机运行，不改云端账号、不上传提示词或配置 | | 可见 | 每个动作都有状态与证据，不靠"应该生效了"这种判断 | | 可回滚 | 应用 / 安装 / 回滚前自动快照，保留原文件与校验清单 | | 不替你做决定 | 只减少摩擦，不改变你的目标；改什么、开什么，都由你确认 | ## 适用场景 本机学习、个人项目、自动化实验与维护工作。请在你拥有或已获授权的环境中使用；涉及他人系统时，先取得许可。 ## 1.6.39 更新 修复独立安装器只显示 `fetch failed` 的问题：分阶段诊断、有限重试和系统 curl 备用下载，继续严格校验官方来源、证书和 SHA256。下载失败不触碰现有安装。[发行说明](docs/releases/1.6.48.md) · [配置与验收](docs/maintenance-issue-52.md) ## 安装 **DSH 官方入口负责安装插件；下面的社区安装器由本仓库维护，不是 DeepSeek 官方脚本。** 首次安装可用官方界面或 CLI；已经装过 `dsh-purge` / 旧独立面板时，用社区安装器原地迁移，不要先卸载。安装、应用宿主补丁、手动重启是独立动作。 ### 方式一：DSH 官方界面（首次安装） 1. 先打开 DSH 完成初始化。按当前官方文档，进入「插件」，点击「实验性插件」旁的「更多」，启用「自定义插件市场」；然后进入「发现 → 添加索引源」。 2. 本项目的**社区索引**：`https://kingcharleslzy-ai.github.io/dsh-purge/index.json`。 3. 选择 dsh-purge Community，核对来源为 `kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge`、包名为 `dsh-purge-community`，确认后安装。 界面和安装协议由 DSH 提供，索引与插件由社区维护。不同 DSH 版本的入口文字可能不同；第三方 `dsh-market` 也可能有额外的筛选与迁移限制。已有旧包时请使用方式三。[官方市场说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/guide/plugin-market.zh.md) ### 方式二：DSH 官方 CLI（首次安装） 下面命令适用于**已经安装 `dsh` 命令、且使用 `web` profile 的 CLI/Web 用户**，在 macOS/Linux 终端或 Windows PowerShell 中运行。桌面版用户优先用上面的界面；不要为了安装插件再用 `npx` 下载另一套宿主。 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/releases/download/v1.6.84/dsh-purge-community-1.6.84.tgz" ``` `web` 必须与实际启动的 profile 一致；自定义数据目录需要沿用该实例的 `DSH_HOME`。命令使用本次发行的固定版本 URL；不是 `npm install -g`，也不是安装裸 npm 包名。本项目通过 GitHub 发行，**不要替换成 `add dsh-purge` 或 `add dsh-purge-community`**。官方 CLI 的安装不会额外运行我们安装器的 Release SHA256 比对及迁移快照；需要这些功能时选方式三。[官方 CLI 安装说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.zh.md) ### 方式三：社区安装器（备份、旧版迁移、恢复） 先安装并打开一次 DSH，让实际 profile 初始化。以下命令下载**本仓库的脚本**，先校验，再安装；`dry-run` 通过仅代表前置检查、下载和 SHA256 通过，不代表依赖安装、迁移或启动已通过。请先阅读下载的脚本。 #### macOS Desktop 默认应用位置 `/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app`、数据目录 `~/.dsh`、profile `desktop`。将下面两段放在同一个终端会话中执行： ```sh PURGE_INSTALL_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" curl -fSL --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 90 "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/master/scripts/install.sh" -o "$PURGE_INSTALL_DIR/install.sh" sh "$PURGE_INSTALL_DIR/install.sh" --dry-run ``` 校验成功、核对目标实例后执行： ```sh sh "$PURGE_INSTALL_DIR/install.sh" ``` 自定义应用或 home 时，先设置 `DSH_APP` / `DSH_HOME`；自定义 profile 对两次命令都加 `--profile=实际名称`。不要照抄别人的路径。 macOS 支持从 XML/二进制 plist 读取真实可执行文件名；元数据无效会停止，不会换用其他应用。详见[定位边界](docs/INSTALLATION.md#应用定位边界pr-78)。 #### Windows Desktop · PowerShell 5.1 / 7 脚本会尝试定位唯一的 DSH Desktop，默认 home 为用户的 `.dsh`。旧 Desktop CLI 默认 profile 为 `desktop`，带独立 dsh CLI 的新壳默认为 `web`；自定义 profile 用 `-Profile` 指定。不要求管理员权限；路径含空格也支持。 ```powershell $PurgeInstaller = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('purge-install-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.ps1') Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 90 -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/master/scripts/install.ps1' -OutFile $PurgeInstaller powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$PurgeInstaller" -DryRun ``` 上一条退出码为 0、核对目标实例后，在同一个 PowerShell 会话中执行： ```powershell powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$PurgeInstaller" ``` 找不到应用或有多个副本时，对两次命令都增加 `-DshExe '实际的 DeepSeek Harness.exe 完整路径'`；自定义目录用 `-DshHome`、profile 用 `-Profile`。`ExecutionPolicy Bypass` 只作用于这次子进程，不修改持久执行策略；组织策略仍可能禁止执行，遇到时报告错误，不修改系统策略。 #### Linux · CLI / Web 先安装 Node ≥18 和 DSH CLI，并初始化实际使用的 profile。以下从下载开始，不要求已 clone 本仓库： ```sh PURGE_INSTALL_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" curl -fSL --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 90 "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/master/scripts/install.sh" -o "$PURGE_INSTALL_DIR/install.sh" sh "$PURGE_INSTALL_DIR/install.sh" --dry-run ``` 校验成功后，在同一终端执行 `sh "$PURGE_INSTALL_DIR/install.sh"`。默认使用 PATH 中的 `node` / `dsh` 与 `web` profile。自定义实例在两次调用中保持 `DSH_NODE`、`PURGE_DSH_CLI`、`DSH_HOME`、`--profile=名称` 一致。 ### 安装会改什么，以及怎么确认 - 社区安装器在迁移前备份，调用当前实例的官方 `dsh plugin --profile … add …`，再核对安装版本和入口；保留提示词、规则、更新偏好及其他插件设置。 - **不是“完全不碰宿主目录”**：解包桌面布局缺失/损坏 `app/runtime` 链接时，会保留旧链接并修复到该安装的 runtime；冲突则停止。Linux 系统宿主只读时可能创建用户副本，并在成功后切换用户启动器。详见[安装指南](docs/INSTALLATION.md)。 - 插件加载前若市场安装失败（issue #7），插件本身尚未运行；先读脱敏错误、核对依赖来源，不能承诺安装器能修复所有市场或网络错误。 - 不自动应用宿主补丁、不自动重启、不改代理、不修改全局 npm 源或清空缓存。脚本和 bootstrap 从本仓库 `master` 下载；Release 包另做 SHA256 校验，这不是对下载脚本的独立签名验证。 - 命令退出码非零就视为失败。安装成功后记录 `backup_id`，核对磁盘版本；运行中的 DSH 仍可能显示旧版，待用户方便时手动退出重开。`dry-run` 成功、备份存在或市场卡片出现都不能替代安装成功证据。 - 回滚优先用「Purge → 状态 → 本机备份」，选择本次安装前的备份；无界面时按[安装指南中的 CLI 回滚](docs/INSTALLATION.md#cli-rollback)执行。不要假设 `purge-community` 已加入系统 PATH。 完整的实例选择、回滚与失败恢复步骤见 [安装指南](docs/INSTALLATION.md)，Agent 必须先读 [AGENTS.md §12](AGENTS.md#installation)。 ## 面板 左侧栏一整页，不做悬浮按钮： - 顶部一句话说明当前状态，主操作是「应用」； - 其余分区折叠，说明收进 `?`，需要时再展开； - 维护页可看最近动作、备份占用、更新偏好； - 支持隐藏不用的入口（例如回退按钮），只影响显示。 ## 常用命令 | 命令 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `purge-community selfcheck [--json]` | 逐层状态与证据；不适用项单独标注 | | `purge-community status` | 宿主路径与计数 | | `purge-community host-status` | 只读查看安装布局与当前入口（不换包、不重启） | | `purge-community diagnose` | 锚点漂移诊断，给出文件、行号与候选落点 | | `purge-community reanchor …` | 把确认过的新锚点钉成本地覆盖，可撤销 | | `purge-community probe [new]` | 生成运行时探针，验证注入确实送达模型 | | `purge-community audit [--limit n]` | 最近动作记录 | | `purge-community boost [on\|off]` | 尾部强化段开关 | | `purge-community preset [status\|install]` | 「无限制模式」预设落盘 | | `purge-community retry [on\|off]` | 回答被中断时的单次重试开关 | | `purge-community usage` / `prune` | 备份占用与清理 | | evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Arya Computer Use

Computer use for [DeepSeek Harness / AryaCode](https://github.com/KonnectSuite): drive Windows desktop apps through **native accessibility refs** (UIA) instead of pixel coordinates, with a **takeover overlay** that frames the window being driven, shows what the agent is doing, keeps a synthetic ghost cursor where it acts (your own pointer is never followed), and stops on a global Esc. The agent calls itself **Arya** in that overlay by default, and the name is a setting.

Replaces [dsh-computer-use-win](https://github.com/Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win) (wincu) completely — see [docs/PLAN.md](docs/PLAN.md) §7 for the retirement path.

## Why

| wincu complaint | Arya Computer Use |
| --- | --- |
| Slow (PowerShell + UIA backend) | Native Rust engine: snapshot ~117 ms, ref action ~197 ms on a Windows devbox |
| Pixel alignment off | Ref-based semantic UIA — coordinates are never the targeting mechanism; identical twins are refused, not mis-clicked |
| Chinese UI/docs | English throughout |
| (kept) DSH integration + setup UI | Settings page, chat step rows, takeover overlay, Esc kill, tool presets |

## Engines (not vendored — pinned npm dependencies)

- [`agent-desktop`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-desktop) `1.2.0` (Apache-2.0) — accessibility-tree computer use CLI, native Windows binaries on npm. Reference mirror: [KonnectSuite/dsh-arya-agent-desktop](https://github.com/KonnectSuite/dsh-arya-agent-desktop).
- [`agent-browser`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-browser) `0.41.2` (Apache-2.0) — web lane via CDP (`agent-browser mcp`).

## Requirements

- **DSH host must run elevated (Run as administrator).** The engine's interaction lease lives at `C:\ProgramData\agent-desktop\<user-SID>\interaction.lock` with a protected DACL `{SYSTEM, Administrators, token user}`; a non-elevated medium-IL token fails validation (`lease_directory_untrusted`). The adapter surfaces this as an explicit "run AryaCode as administrator" hint.
- Accessibility permission (`desktop_status` reports `accessibility: granted`).
- Engine state root is the engine default `~/.agent-desktop` — do **not** point `AGENT_DESKTOP_HOME` at `%LOCALAPPDATA%` (inherited AppContainer ACEs fail the engine's private-DACL check).

## Status

**Phases 0–2 complete (Phase 0 accepted 2026-11-06; takeover UI verified live 2026-11-07).**

| Phase | Deliverable | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Evaluation spike: raw `agent-desktop mcp` row, drive Notepad/Explorer/Chrome — speed ✓, readable trees ✓, refs-not-pixels ✓ | ✅ accepted, spike removed |
| 1 | Adapter MCP server: Lite 16 tools, per-conversation session lifecycle, headed toggle + foreground promotion, screenshot→file path, WinRT OCR, skill | ✅ built, installed, driven in-host |
| 2 | Takeover UI: window rim + banner + Esc kill, configurable ghost cursor, settings page, chat step rows, driver lock, English UI | ✅ built + verified live |
| 3 | Web lane (`arya_browser` row), sign-in profiles, attach-to-your-Chrome, **wincu retirement** | planned |
| 4 | Lazy preset, notifications/clipboard/trace, npm publish | planned |

Lite 16 tool surface: `snapshot, find, get, is, click, set_value, type, press, scroll, list_windows, launch, wait, screenshot, ocr, batch, tools` (superset of wincu Lite 12; `set_value` fills a field through the accessibility value pattern without touching the pointer; `type` follows the input lane (background by default, real keyboard only when that conversation opts in); `tools` manages headed/overlay/session state).

Full plan: [docs/PLAN.md](docs/PLAN.md).

## Layout

```
package.json          Cordis bundle manifest (dsh.bundle.patch) + pinned engine deps
cordis.patch.yml      rows: arya-computer-use (Host), mcp-arya-desktop, mcp-arya-browser
index.js              Host plugin entry (settings, driver lock, takeover mgmt, status route)
client.js             Settings page + chat step rows (client plugin)
mcp/adapter-server.mjs  adapter MCP server (Lite 16 tool surface)
scripts/windows-takeover.cs  window rim + banner + progress + ghost cursor + global Esc
scripts/ocr.ps1       WinRT OCR helper (Phase 1)
skills/arya-desktop/  observe-act loop guide (Phase 1)
locale/ icon.svg      Plugin Manager display metadata
docs/PLAN.md          complete v1 plan
```

## Install (dev, Phase 1+)

Not published to npm yet (`private: true`). Install from a local checkout with `plugin_manager` → `install_bundle` pointing at this directory. The `mcp-arya-desktop` row is currently in **dev form** (`command: node`, `args: [<absolute path to mcp/adapter-server.mjs>]`); after npm publish replace with `npx -y @konnectsuite/dsh-plugin-arya-computer-use@<version>`. Keep the checkout in place while the dev row is active.

## Settings (Settings → Plugins → Computer Use)

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Frame the app window | on | Rim only the driven window plus a banner; monitor edges are just the fallback before a target is known |
| Show a ghost cursor | on | Draw a synthetic cursor where the agent acts; your pointer is never followed |
| Agent name | `Arya` | Drives the ghost-cursor tag and the progress-panel header (`Arya · Step 3 · acting`), 1–16 characters |
| Banner text | `Arya is controlling your computer` | One line, 1–120 characters |
| Real mouse and keyboard | off | Opted-in headed input for one conversation; the background lane never moves the pointer |
| One conversation drives at a time | on | Refuses desktop tools in other conversations while a drive is live |
| Stop shortcut | Esc | Global kill switch; synthetic keystrokes are ignored, so it needs a real keypress |
| Tool preset | `lite` | `lite` lists all 16 desktop tools; `lazy` starts with tools/snapshot/click and reveals the rest on demand |
| Tool surface (web) | `core` | agent-browser tool profile: core 29, network 9, state 27, debug 40, tabs 13, react 8, mobile 15, webmcp 4, all 156 |
| Chrome profile / Session | – / `arya` | Reuse a Chrome login state and name the browser session |
| Connect to my browser | – | `--cdp` port or URL to attach to a Chrome you already have open |
| Saved sign-in state | – | Absolute path to a cookies+localStorage JSON to reuse |
| Show the browser window | off | `--headed` for the web lane |

## Web lane

The second MCP row (`arya_browser`, server `agent-browser`) runs through `mcp/browser-launcher.mjs`, a transparent stdio pipe that reads the control file and spawns the real server with the settings applied:

```
node mcp/browser-launcher.mjs          # → agent-browser mcp --tools core [--profile X] [--session Y] [--state Z] [--cdp ...] [--headed]
```

So sign-in reuse and attaching to your own Chrome are settings, not hand-edited rows. Web-lane changes land on the next MCP restart; the settings page says so.

## Tool presets

- `lite` (default) — all 16 desktop tools listed up front.
- `lazy` — starts with `tools`, `snapshot`, `click`; everything else appears after `tools {operation:"load", names:[...]}`. The adapter advertises `tools.listChanged` and emits `notifications/tools/list_changed`, which DSH's MCP client re-syncs (`listChanged.onChanged → refreshTools`), so the new tools become callable immediately.

## License

MIT (KonnectSuite original code). Engines stay Apache-2.0 — see [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).
