evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-multi-provider-usage

A [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that shows the
quotas of **OpenCode GO**, **Command Code** and **GLM Code Plan** in one sidebar
widget. It is modelled on
[`@astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage`](https://github.com/Astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage)
— same dual-half package, same-origin proxy, same sidebar slot, same Plugins
panel settings page — extended from one provider to three.

> The package name is `dsh-multi-provider-usage` because the unscoped
> `dsh-provider-usage` name is already taken on npm by a different plugin. The
> HTTP routes (`/provider-usage/*`) and chat command (`/provider-usage`) stay
> short and stable.

![Sidebar widget with the three stacked providers](docs/widget.png)

## Features


- **Three providers, one column.** All enabled providers are stacked vertically;
  each header carries a health dot, the provider's primary percentage and its
  top-up balance. Click a provider header to collapse/expand that provider's
  plan windows, quota bars and time bars; the collapse state is remembered
  locally, so any subset can stay folded.
- **OpenCode GO** — 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows (the API calls the 5-hour field `rolling`). Prefers the live
  `dsh-opencode-go` plugin's active account through its `opencodeGoUsage`
  host service, then falls back to the official `GET /v1/usage` endpoint.
- **Command Code** — monthly credit pool, 5-hour window and weekly window from
  the official billing/usage endpoints (`/alpha/billing/*`,
  `/alpha/usage/summary`).
- **GLM Code Plan, international and China** — 5-hour token window, weekly
  token window and monthly MCP tool limit, read from the international Z.ai
  host (`api.z.ai`) or the China BigModel host (`open.bigmodel.cn`) at
  `/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit`. `auto` probes both, the GLM card badges the
  version that answered (**International** / **China**), and the plugin
  settings can pin one version (or a custom endpoint). When neither version
  answers, the failure names each version's result instead of only the last
  probe.
- **Top-up balances** — OpenCode GO shows the OpenCode Zen prepaid balance and
  Command Code shows its purchased + free "Extra Credits" balance, both as a
  badge next to the account/plan and in the `/provider-usage` text. The OpenCode
  console token is auto-discovered from `OPENCODE_CONSOLE_TOKEN`, the OpenCode
  CLI auth file, or its local `opencode.db`; the token never leaves the host.
  When that token is missing, the balance slot becomes a clickable "Set up" chip
  that opens the plugin settings, where the OpenCode GO card renders a
  step-by-step setup guide, instead of silently showing nothing. Command
  Code's tooltip breaks its amount into purchased + free credits; a credits
  response without either pool renders a muted **No top-up** badge.
- **Auto-update** — on boot and every configured interval the host checks the
  npm registry, the npmmirror mirror and the GitHub release feed together and
  trusts the newest version any of them reports. A local `link:`/`file:` checkout
  is fast-forwarded when it is on `main`, clean, and a strict fast-forward. An
  npm / market / tarball copy updates itself: the release tarball is downloaded
  from the first source that serves it (registry → mirror → GitHub, in turn) and
  each packaged file (`lib/`, `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `docs/`) is
  written to a temp file and renamed over the target, so pnpm's hardlinked store
  is never edited in place. Either way the running Host keeps the old module
  graph, so the widget/settings show "updated — restart DSH". The plugin never
  restarts DSH by itself.
- **Balance-change animation** — the widget polls on its normal interval; when
  a provider's balance differs from the previous poll, the number counts from
  the old value to the refreshed one while a red/green delta chip (for example
  `-0.1`) floats up and fades away. There is no popup and no turn-event
  tracking, so the animation may appear up to one poll interval later.
- **Low-balance tone** — a balance at or below 5 renders amber and at or below 1
  renders red (thresholds are in the currency unit and apply to USD and CNY
  plans alike), in both the sidebar and the settings page's live-usage sections.
- **Click-to-retry failures** — an error line in the widget is itself clickable
  (and keyboard-activatable) and forces one fresh upstream read.
- **Same-origin proxy** — the browser only talks to `/provider-usage/usage` and
  `/provider-usage/settings`; API keys stay in the host process.
- **Failure isolation** — one broken provider never hides the other two. The
  route answers `200` while any provider succeeds and `502` only when all
  enabled providers fail. Partial endpoint failures keep the provider's numbers
  but turn its health dot amber and name the failed calls in the tooltip.
- **Settings shortcut** — the widget header's **Settings** button opens this
  bundle's page in the sidebar **Plugins** panel, directly on the configuration
  page below.
- **Bundle settings page** — sidebar **Plugins** panel → this bundle's card:
  enable/disable each provider, edit credential refs and endpoints, choose the
  GLM region, and see non-network detection status. Save applies immediately.
  Each provider card embeds a **live usage** section — quota windows with
  percentages, time-to-reset and the top-up balance, from the same canonical
  snapshot the widget renders. While the page is open it follows the widget:
  a 30-second poll (when the tab is visible) plus an "Updated HH:MM" stamp,
  a **Refresh usage** control forces a re-read, and every save re-reads with
  `refresh=1`, so a changed credential ref shows its own numbers immediately.
  The GLM card also carries the **referral link** (Z.ai "Invite Friends, Get
  Credits") as a clickable, copyable row. The URL is a bundle constant: it never
  goes through the settings route and a settings save cannot overwrite it.
- **`/provider-usage` chat command** — prints every enabled provider's numbers
  as text.
- **Time bars** — under each quota bar, gray is time already elapsed and blue is
  time remaining, matching the reference widget's geometry. Each window also
  counts down to its reset on the right; an exhausted window keeps that
  countdown and gains a small **exceeded**/**rate-limited** chip right after the
  percentage, whose hover title also carries the absolute reset time.
- **`x-opencode-session` fix** — injects the real per-conversation harness
  session id into OpenCode GO chat requests at runtime, without patching DSH.
- **Chinese and English UI** through the DSH locale service.

## Install

From npm:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-multi-provider-usage
```

or, for the web profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-multi-provider-usage
```

From a checkout (for development):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-provider-usage
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the CLI reconciles it into the
profile's bundle layer stack automatically. The widget and client bundle are
part of the profile's client-modules graph, so **restart DSH once** after
installing (a running host does not rebuild its `window.__DSH_BOOT__` manifest
for a newly linked package).

For a local `link:` dependency pnpm prints a peer-dependency warning
(`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh`). That is expected: the linked
checkout resolves schemastery from its own `node_modules` in development; a
normal npm install resolves the peers from the DSH runtime.

## Credentials

All values are resolved through the DSH credentials domain (the process
environment, `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` and `.env` layers). They are never
returned by the settings route and never reach the browser.

| Provider | Default ref | Resolution order | Fallback source |
|---|---|---|---|
| OpenCode GO | `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` | `opencodeGoApiKeyEnv`, the `dsh-opencode-go` active-account ref (only when that entry is enabled), `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`, `OPENCODE_API_KEY` | `GET {baseUrl}/v1/usage` |
| Command Code | `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY` | `commandCodeApiKeyEnv`, `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY`, then the CLI auth file | `~/.commandcode/auth.json` (`apiKey`) |
| GLM Code Plan | `ZAI_API_KEY` | `glmApiKeyEnv`, `ZAI_CODING_CN_API_KEY`, `ZAI_API_KEY`, `ZHIPU_API_KEY`, `GLM_API_KEY`, `BIGMODEL_API_KEY` | — |

Set a ref in **Plugins → dsh-multi-provider-usage → settings** (or in the
auto-generated **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration** form). A ref is a
name such as `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`; the secret itself lives in DSH's credential
store.

### OpenCode console balance

The GO quota API does not include the account's prepaid balance. That comes from
`GET https://opencode.ai/console/api/billing/status`, which needs the OpenCode
**console** OAuth token (the GO API key returns 403 there). The host resolves it
in this order:

1. `opencodeConsoleApiKeyEnv` (`OPENCODE_CONSOLE_TOKEN` by default), resolved
   through DSH credentials;
2. the `credential` table of `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db` (read via
   `node:sqlite` when available; this is where current OpenCode releases keep
   the OAuth grant and rotate it);
3. `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` (`$XDG_DATA_HOME/opencode/auth.json` when
   set), provider `opencode` — the legacy location kept by older releases.

The database is preferred deliberately: OpenCode migrated its grant there but
often leaves the old `auth.json` behind, and that stale token returns 401. Every
usable OAuth candidate is tried in turn (at most four), so one expired store
cannot hide the live one. Channel builds (`opencode-beta.db`, `opencode-dev.db`,
…) and `$OPENCODE_DB` are discovered too. The billing host comes from the grant's
`metadata.server` (so a self-hosted console works), falling back to the public
origin; `opencodeConsoleBaseUrl` overrides it.

An OpenCode **API-key** login (`oc_sk_…`, the service-account method) carries no
console session and is never sent to the billing endpoint. Such a login, a
missing token, or an expired/revoked grant renders a clickable **Set up** chip
(instead of a mute dash) that opens this bundle's page in the Plugins panel and
names the fix: run `opencode auth login` and choose the **OpenCode Console
account**, or store a console token as `OPENCODE_CONSOLE_TOKEN`.

When the balance is not configured (or the console login is fixable), the
OpenCode GO card in the plugin settings renders a step-by-step **setup guide**
in place of the static hint. The lead-in names the state-specific fix (nothing
configured, an API-key login, or an expired sign-in). Step ① shows the
`opencode auth login` CLI command with a **Copy command** button; step ② offers
a **Re-check** button that re-reads the sign-in state and forces one upstream
usage read, so a fresh login shows the balance without restarting DSH (unsaved
form edits are never discarded by the re-check). The `/provider-usage` command
gives the same state-specific guidance as text for all three fixable states.

The optional `opencodeConsoleAuthFile` overrides the auth file (and its
directory is used to locate `opencode.db`), `opencodeConsoleOrgId` supplies the
`x-org-id` header, and `opencodeConsoleEnabled: false` turns the whole balance
read off. Balance failures never hide the GO quota: the provider stays `ok` with
`balance: null` and a `meta.balanceError` (plus `meta.balanceSetup` when the
user can fix it). Any other balance failure renders a muted **Balance —** badge
whose tooltip carries the error.

### Command Code balance

Command Code's quota and balance share one API key and one billing family, so
they cannot diverge the way OpenCode's do: a missing key (`COMMANDCODE_API_KEY`
or `~/.commandcode/auth.json`) fails the whole provider with an explicit
`no API key` message rather than blanking only the balance. Two narrower gaps
are reported instead of hidden:

- when `/alpha/billing/credits` fails, that request carries every window, so the
  provider errors as well; its message now includes the underlying interface and
  status instead of only "no usable quota windows", and `meta.balanceError` lets
  the header show a muted **Balance —** badge carrying the cause;
- when the credits response succeeds but carries neither `purchasedCredits` nor
  `freeCredits`, `balance` stays `null` with `meta.balanceMissing: true` and the
  header shows a muted **No top-up** badge (a real `0` still renders `$0.00`).

### OpenCode GO integration and fallback

When `opencodeGoSource` is `opencode-go` (the default), the host probes:

1. a live loader entry named `opencode-go` / `dsh-opencode-go`;
2. that entry is not disabled;
3. `ctx.get("opencodeGoUsage")` exposes `read()`;
4. `read()` returns valid `rolling` / `weekly` / `monthly` data;
5. the active account is read from that entry's `apiKeyEnv` + `accounts[]`.

If any step fails, the host reads the built-in endpoint and reports a `fallback`
object with one of: `not-installed`, `entry-disabled`, `service-unavailable`,
`read-failed`, `invalid-response`. The widget shows a **Built-in** badge with the
reason and message in its tooltip. `opencodeGoSource: "builtin"` pins the HTTP
path and never touches the other plugin.

## Plan windows

| Provider | Windows | Window length |
|---|---|---|
| OpenCode GO | `rolling`, `weekly`, `monthly` | 5 h, 7 d, ~30 d |
| Command Code | `five-hour`, `weekly`, `monthly` | 5 h, 7 d, real billing period |
| GLM Code Plan | `five-hour`, `weekly`, `mcp` | 5 h, 7 d, monthly |

Percentages are **used** percentages and are clamped to `[0, 100]` for display.
Command Code monthly utilization is
`totalCost / (totalCost + monthlyCredits)`; purchased and free credits are
reported separately in `meta.monthly` and do not change the plan bar, while
their sum is the visible top-up balance (`balance.extra`). The
5-hour/weekly bars use `windowLimits.fiveHour` / `weekly` (`used`, `cap`,
`resetAt`, `exceeded`).

**Token usage on a window row (since 0.8.2)**: a window may carry `tokensUsed`,
the vendor's absolute token count for that window, and the widget renders it as
`Token: <number>` right after the window label, with a compact unit (亿/万 with
a Chinese locale, B/M/K otherwise; full grouped digits below the smallest unit).
Only Command Code provides one today — its billing-period `summary.totalTokens` rides on the `monthly`
window (falling back to `totalTokensIn + totalTokensOut` when the vendor omits
the combined field). No vendor reports tokens for the 5-hour or weekly windows
(Command Code's `windowLimits.used`/`cap` count credits, not tokens), so those
rows show no token count.

**Billing context (since 0.8.3)**: the monthly token count's tooltip carries
the billing-period in/out split (`meta.totals.tokensIn` / `tokensOut`) and the
request totals with success rate (`meta.totals.requests` / `successRate`); the
projected exhaustion date (`meta.projection.runsOutInDays`, Command Code)
renders right after the token count in the monthly row's label. **MCP tool calls (since 0.8.3)**: GLM's monthly `TIME_LIMIT`
counts ride on the `mcp` window as `used`/`cap` and render as "123 / 1,000"
after its label. **Recharge link (since 0.8.3)**: a low OpenCode prepaid
balance that the console marks purchasable links straight to
[opencode.ai/console](https://opencode.ai/console) from the badge.

A GLM account without a Coding Plan answers HTTP 200 with
`{ "success": false, "msg": ... }`; the adapter surfaces that message and the
widget shows the provider in an error state.

## Configuration

The loader reads the exported `Config` schema; every field is `.volatile()`, so
the settings page and the auto-generated form hot-apply.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `opencodeGoEnabled` | `true` | Show OpenCode GO |
| `opencodeGoSource` | `"opencode-go"` | `opencode-go` or `builtin` |
| `opencodeGoApiKeyEnv` | `"OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY"` | Credential ref |
| `opencodeGoBaseUrl` | `"https://opencode.ai/zen/go"` | Gateway base |
| `opencodeConsoleEnabled` | `true` | Read the Zen prepaid balance |
| `opencodeConsoleApiKeyEnv` | `"OPENCODE_CONSOLE_TOKEN"` | Console token ref |
| `opencodeConsoleOrgId` | `""` | Optional `x-org-id` |
| `opencodeConsoleAuthFile` | `""` | Optional auth.json path; empty auto-discovers |
| `opencodeConsoleDbFile` | `""` | Optional opencode.db path; empty derives it |
| `opencodeConsoleBaseUrl` | `"https://opencode.ai"` | Console origin |
| `commandCodeEnabled` | `true` | Show Command Code |
| `commandCodeApiKeyEnv` | `"COMMANDCODE_API_KEY"` | Credential ref |
| `commandCodeBaseUrl` | `"https://api.commandcode.ai"` | API base |
| `commandCodeAuthFile` | `""` | Empty = `~/.commandcode/auth.json` |
| `glmEnabled` | `true` | Show GLM Code Plan |
| `glmApiKeyEnv` | `"ZAI_API_KEY"` | Credential ref |
| `glmBaseUrl` | `""` | Optional base override |
| `glmRegion` | `"auto"` | `auto`, `zai`, `bigmodel`, `custom` |
| `cacheMs` | `30000` | Per-provider host cache TTL |
| `updateCheck` | `true` | npm update check (24 h) |
| `autoUpdate` | `true` | Check npm, npmmirror and GitHub together; fast-forward a clean checkout, otherwise replace an installed package from the first source that serves the tarball |
| `autoUpdateCheckHours` | `6` | Hours between auto-update checks (1–168) |
| `injectSessionHeader` | `true` | OpenCode GO session-header fix |
| `providerOrder` | all three ids | Provider display order in the widget; drag the cards in the plugin settings to reorder |

`glmRegion: "custom"` requires `glmBaseUrl`; `auto` probes
`https://api.z.ai` first and then `https://open.bigmodel.cn`, and the widget
badges the version that answered.

## HTTP API

### `GET /provider-usage/usage`

`?refresh=1` (or `?force=1`) bypasses the host cache.

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "enabled": ["opencode-go", "command-code", "glm"],
  "providerOrder": ["opencode-go", "command-code", "glm"],
  "providers": [
    {
      "id": "opencode-go",
      "name": "OpenCode GO",
      "short": "GO",
      "status": "ok",
      "account": { "ref": "OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY", "id": null, "name": "" },
      "plan": null,
      "source": "builtin",
      "requested": "opencode-go",
      "fallback": {
        "from": "opencode-go",
        "reason": "not-installed",
        "message": "dsh-opencode-go is not installed, or its profile entry is inactive"
      },
      "balance": {
        "amount": 5.01495352,
        "currency": "USD",
        "labelKey": "balance.zen",
        "source": "opencode-db",
        "details": { "billingMode": "prepaid", "mode": "pay-as-you-go" }
      },
      "windows": [
        {
          "key": "rolling",
          "labelKey": "window.five-hour",
          "hintKey": "window.five-hour.hint",
          "percent": 0,
          "status": "ok",
          "resetsAt": "2026-11-05T13:50:46.363Z",
          "windowMs": 18000000
        }
      ],
      "meta": {}
    }
  ],
  "update": { "current": "0.1.0", "available": false, "latest": null },
  "sessionHeader": { "active": true, "count": 0, "diag": {} }
}
```

Failed providers have `"status": "error"`, `code`, `error` and `windows: []`;
their siblings are still returned. A body with `providers: []` means no provider
is enabled. `meta.balanceError` carries a tolerated balance failure (the
provider still answers `ok`); `meta.balanceSetup` (`no-credential`, `api-key` or
`expired`) marks a failure the user can fix by signing in again;
`meta.balanceMissing` marks a Command Code credits response without
purchased/free pools. `meta.errors` lists partial Command Code endpoint
failures: the numbers stay, the health dot turns amber, and the tooltip names
the failed calls. Error cards keep the plan they already resolved.

**Caching and refresh semantics (since 0.8.1)**: the host keeps a TTL cache per
provider (`cacheMs`, default 30 s). Once a provider's entry has expired, the
next request **answers instantly with the last-known value** (top-level and
per-provider `servedStale: true`) while a background read refreshes upstream —
a slow provider (up to its 15 s fetch timeout) can no longer stall the sidebar
widget or the `/provider-usage` command; the widget follows up automatically a
few seconds later. `?refresh=1` still blocks on a fresh read (manual refresh
and post-save behavior are unchanged); an account/source switch never serves
the previous account's data. Responses carry an `ETag`; a request with
`If-None-Match` gets `304` with no body while the document is unchanged. The
sidebar widget stretches its poll gap while nothing changes (from 30 s up to
2 min).

### `GET /provider-usage/settings`

Returns the settings descriptor (`namespace`, `revision`, `value`, `base`,
`user`) plus a non-network `detection` report:

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "namespace": "dsh-multi-provider-usage",
  "revision": 0,
  "value": { "opencodeGoEnabled": true },
  "detection": {
    "providerOrder": ["opencode-go", "command-code", "glm"],
    "enabled": ["opencode-go", "command-code", "glm"],
    "providers": {
      "opencode-go": { "configured": true, "entryFound": false, "fallback": { "...": "..." } },
      "command-code": { "configured": true, "source": "auth-file" },
      "glm": { "configured": true, "region": "auto" }
    }
  }
}
```

`503` means the host has no settings service or the entry has no volatile
fields; the settings page explains how to fix it.

### `POST /provider-usage/settings`

Only the fields in the table above are accepted; anything else is ignored.
`expectedRevision` gets `409` on a concurrent change.

```json
{
  "patch": { "commandCodeEnabled": false, "providerOrder": ["glm", "opencode-go", "command-code"] },
  "expectedRevision": 0
}
```

Cross-origin writes are refused with `403`. The usage route is read-only.

## How it is put together

| Half | File | Role |
|---|---|---|
| host (Node) | `lib/index.js` | Config schema, routes, command, settings/detection, cache, session fix |
| host adapters | `lib/providers.js` | Canonical window shape and the three vendor adapters |
| console balance | `lib/opencode-console.js` | OpenCode console token discovery + billing status |
| session fix | `lib/opencode-session.js` | `globalThis.fetch` wrapper + `llm/stream` ALS context |
| browser | `lib/client.js` | Hand-authored `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` bundle: widget, settings page, locale dictionaries |
| bundle patch | `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the profile entry |

The browser bundle is composed by DSH's official client-modules scan from
`dsh.client` + `exports["./client"]`; it registers into
`sidebar.footer.action` and `plugins.bundle.config`, exactly like the reference
plugin.

The session fix wraps `globalThis.fetch` once and only adds
`x-opencode-session` when the request URL starts with the gateway base carried
by the current `llm/stream` call. The base comes from
`llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.baseURL`, falling back to `opencodeGoBaseUrl`.

## Compatibility

- DSH `0.1.7` and above, with no upper bound (future DSH lines included); verified on `0.2.1-rc.5`.
- `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` `^3.18.4` (volatile fields / settings page).
- Node.js ≥ 18 (global `fetch`, `AbortSignal.timeout`).
- `dsh-opencode-go` is optional; its absence is a normal fallback.
- Command Code's CLI auth file is optional if `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY` is set.
- A DSH runtime that does not expose `plugins.bundle.config` loses only the
  settings page; the sidebar widget and `/provider-usage` keep working. Set the
  config fields in the profile patch or the auto-generated form instead.

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm test
```

The tests are hermetic: a fake `globalThis.fetch` and a stub Cordis context, no
network and no real keys. They cover the schema, all three adapters, OpenCode
GO service integration/fallback, aggregation and error isolation, caching and
forced refresh, settings conflicts/whitelisting, the client bundle contract,
top-up balance discovery (credential and local auth.json) and failure
isolation, and the session-header injection. 110 tests, all offline.

## License

MIT.

# 下一步建议 · dsh-next-steps

在每轮回复下方给出一组可点的下一步建议：**2×2 最多四格**，每一条都只属于它自己那一轮。

建议是**按轮次投影**出来的：每个轮次尾部只读它自己那一轮的工具结果，所以历史轮次各自定格、新的一轮不会继承上一轮的按钮，晚到的结果也会触发重渲染。

## 设计取舍

- **按轮次投影，不共享状态。** 每个轮次尾部只回答一个问题：「在（本轮起点, 本轮收尾] 之间，有没有一条 `suggest_actions` 结果？」历史轮次各自定格在自己那一组，晚到的结果也会触发重渲染。没有 Map、没有 render 副作用、没有跨组件传递。
- **2×2 版式。** 一次最多四条：1 条整宽、2 条一行、3 条末条跨列、4 条标准 2×2。超过四条在 host 侧直接截断，不做"还有 N 条"——那会破坏版式。
- **三档视觉。** 主推用强调色（DeepSeek 蓝）16% 底 + 55% 描边 + 3px 左座条；常规用主文字色 8% 叠底；`stop` 用 5% 叠底、次级文字。**全部基于主题令牌与 alpha 叠加**，浅色/深色自动跟随，代码里没有一处硬编码颜色。
- **不突兀。** 不加卡片/边框/阴影，字号比正文小一档、两行截断，圆角与原生按钮同档；和下方「点赞那排」之间用宿主已有的 16px 间距，不额外补边距。
- **窄容器自适应。** 右侧栏打开或窗口变窄时，`@container ≤420px` 自动降成一列。

## 交互

- **点击** = 把建议文本作为你的消息发出去（走输入框的 setDraft → 落定 → submit）。
- **Shift+点击** = 只填进输入框，不发送，改完自己按回车。
- 点击后该条标灰、其余暂时禁用，防连点；失败会在下方显示原因，不静默。
- 悬停显示完整 `prompt`（当它比按钮文字长时）以及「Shift+点击只填入」的提示。

## 安装

```
dsh plugin add dsh-next-steps
```

或者插件管理器里添加 `dsh-next-steps`。

> 同一个「轮次尾部」如果还有别的插件也往里放建议按钮，会出现两排；那种情况下同一时间只启用一个。

## 配置

写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里本插件那一行的 `config` 下：

```yaml
- id: next-steps
  config:
    maxActions: 4      # 1-4，默认 4
    history: latest    # latest=只在最新一轮显示（默认）；all=每轮都显示当轮的建议
    prompt: always     # always=注册一条常驻指令，让模型每轮收尾都调用工具；off=不注册
```

## 为什么某轮可能没有按钮

建议不是插件凭空生成的，它来自**这一轮的工具调用结果**。插件会注册一条常驻提示（`prompt: always`），要求模型在收尾时调用 `suggest_actions`；但如果某一轮模型没调用，那一轮就确实什么都不显示——这是刻意的：绝不把上一轮的按钮顶上来充数。

## 原理与兼容

- **Host 半**：注册 `suggest_actions` 工具，负责清洗（按立场去重、只留一个推荐、推荐置顶、`stop` 沉底、截断到上限），把算好的结果随工具结果一起交给客户端。
- **Client 半**：不注册采集器，只注册 `conversation.chat.turnTail`；用宿主给的 `turn.start.seq` / `turn.end.seq` 定位本轮的工具结果。节点内部形状不是公开契约，所以按「数据段前缀」深搜而不是写死路径；万一认不出来，降级到采集器，且仍然只挂最新一轮。
- **零依赖**：不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包（本地目录安装时那些包解析不到），工具用明文 JSON Schema 直接注册。
- 声明 `engines.dsh >= 0.2.2-rc.1`，在 `0.2.2-rc.1` 上验证。

## 已知限制

- 工具结果里那段给客户端读的 JSON（前缀 `dsh-next-steps/v1`）也会进入模型上下文，每次约几百 token。改用 host 的 session projection + `wire.view` 可以消掉，但目前没做。
- 如果宿主某轮没有提供 `turn.start.seq`，按轮定位会退化成"截至本轮"——那种情况下，某一轮没调用工具时可能沿用上一轮的建议。
- 客户端不导出 `Config`，配置项不做 schema 校验，取值时按默认值兜底。

## 开发与自检

- `_test-next-steps.mjs`（工作区根目录）：用假 React/假 ctx 驱动真实组件，覆盖逐轮投影、不继承上一轮、`latest`/`all` 两种模式、1/3 条跨列、缓存失效、跨会话隔离、兜底通道。
- `_test-normalize.mjs`：从 `index.js` 里抽出 `normalizeActions` 直接跑，覆盖推荐置顶、`stop` 沉底、去重、截断、非法输入过滤。

## License

MIT

# dsh-next-steps (English)

Clickable next-step suggestions under each reply: up to four, in a 2x2 grid, and **each turn only ever shows its own suggestions**.

Suggestions are **projected per turn**: each turn tail reads only its own turn's tool result, so historical turns keep their own set and a new turn never inherits the previous one's buttons.

- **Per-turn projection.** Each turn tail answers one question — *is there a `suggest_actions` result inside (this turn's start, this turn's end]?* Historical turns keep their own set; late results re-render. No shared map, no render-phase side effects, no cross-component handoff.
- **2x2 layout.** One entry spans the row, two sit side by side, three give the last one a full row, four make a clean 2x2. Anything beyond four is truncated host-side.
- **Three visual tiers.** Recommended: accent colour at 16% fill, 55% outline, 3px left bar. Normal: 8% ink overlay. `stop`: 5% overlay with secondary text. Everything is a theme token plus alpha, so light and dark follow the host with no literal colours.
- **Quiet by design.** No card, border or shadow; one step below body text, clamped to two lines, same corner radius as native buttons, reusing the host's existing 16px gap.
- **Narrow columns.** `@container (max-width: 420px)` collapses the grid to one column.

Interaction: click sends the text as your message; **Shift+click** only fills the composer; buttons disable after a click; failures are shown, never swallowed.

Requires DSH `>= 0.2.2-rc.1`. Zero dependencies. Only one plugin that adds rows to the turn tail should be enabled at a time. MIT.

dsh-desktop-bridge

把 Windows 桌面交给 agent，但由你说了算。
截屏 · 点击 · 输入 · 快捷键 · 剪贴板 · 进程 · 注册表 —— 默认关闭，随时一键开启。

它能做什么 · 快速开始 · 配置 · 常见问题

--- ## 这是什么 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 能读文件、跑命令，但它看不见你的屏幕。 **dsh-desktop-bridge** 补上这一段：它把 [CursorTouch/Windows-MCP](https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP) 接进 DSH，于是模型可以截一张屏、找到那个按钮、点下去、把结果读回来——真实窗口、真实鼠标、真实键盘。 它不是一个新写的 MCP 客户端。DSH 内部本来就带着官方的 MCP 桥（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`），这个插件只做四件桥做不到的事：**把开关交给人、把依赖装好、把版本管住、把参数摊开**。 > 桌面控制是**默认关闭**的。装完插件、装好依赖，你不点那个开关，模型连工具名都看不见。 --- ## 它能做什么 装上之后，工具表里会出现 18 个 `mcp__windows__*` 工具： | 分类 | 工具 | 干什么 | | --- | --- | --- | | **看** | `Screenshot` `Snapshot` | 截屏，附带光标位置、窗口列表、屏幕尺寸 | | | `DisplayInventory` | 多显示器布局与 DPI | | | `Scrape` | 抓一个网页的正文 | | **操作** | `Click` `Move` `Scroll` | 按坐标或按控件名点击、移动、拖拽、滚轮 | | | `Type` `MultiEdit` | 输入文本、批量填表 | | | `MultiSelect` | 多选文件 / 复选框 | | | `Shortcut` | `ctrl+c` 这类组合键 | | **等** | `Wait` `WaitFor` | 等固定秒数，或等某个 UI 条件成立 | | **系统** | `Clipboard` | 读写剪贴板 | | | `Process` | 列进程、结束进程 | | | `Registry` | 读写注册表 | | | `Notification` | 弹一个系统通知 | | | `ControlStatus` | 当前桌面控制归属与用户空闲时长 | 典型用法： - 「打开设置，把缩放调到 125%」——截屏 → 找到入口 → 点击 → 再截屏确认 - 「把这张表从网页抄进 Excel」——`Scrape` 取数 → `MultiEdit` 批量填 - 「看看是哪个进程占了 CPU」——`Process` 列表 + `Notification` 汇报 - 「帮我把这段文字复制到微信」——`Clipboard` 写入 → 切窗口 → `Shortcut` 粘贴 --- ## 为什么不是"又一个 MCP 客户端"
左边是调用链，一条都不归这个仓库管：模型发调用、官方桥走 stdio、`windows-mcp.exe` 用 UI Automation 和 Win32 干活。 右边四件事才是这个插件存在的理由： - **开关归人。** 桌面控制的开启/关闭是一条 HTTP 路由，写入 `$DSH_HOME`，重启后仍在。关闭时工具从模型的工具表里消失，硬调用也会被 dispatch guard 拒绝——不是"提示一下"，是拿不到。 - **依赖自己装。** Windows-MCP 是个 Python 程序。插件在 7 个 PyPI 镜像之间测速择优，装完自动把桥指向装好的 exe，**下次开机不再碰网络**。 - **版本互不覆盖。** 每个版本装在 `toolchain//` 下，切换只是改写一行配置，回退不下载任何东西。 - **参数摊开。** 超时、截图缩放、截图后端、要屏蔽哪些工具、用哪个镜像、要不要惰性工具——都在设置页里，不用手改 YAML。 --- ## 三分钟上手 ### 1. 装 uv（Python 包管理器） ```powershell winget install --id=astral-sh.uv -e ``` 装完**重启 DSH**，让它能在 PATH 上找到 `uv`。 ### 2. 装插件 在 **DSH Desktop → 设置 → 插件** 里添加这个 bundle，填仓库地址： ``` github:xkzm123/dsh-desktop-bridge ``` 非 Electron 的 profile 也可以用命令行： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile add github:xkzm123/dsh-desktop-bridge ``` 装完**重启 DSH**，让新的 patch 层在启动时生效。 > `desktop` 这个 profile 归 Electron 应用所有，CLI 会拒绝所有针对它的命令——包括只读的。改 `desktop` 请走图形界面。 ### 3. 装依赖 + 开开关 打开 **设置 → 桌面控制 → 依赖**，点 **下载并安装**： - 首次约 60 MB，走测速最快的镜像，页面上能实时看到安装日志 - 装完插件会自动把桥指向新装的 exe，**再重启一次 DSH** 让它生效 - 重启后回到输入框，点左下角的 **Computer Use**，指示灯变绿 到这里就通了。问模型一句「截个屏看看我现在在干什么」验证一下。 --- ## 界面在哪里
只有两个地方： - **输入框工具行**：`Computer Use` 胶囊，带一个状态点。绿=开，灰=关，橙=宿主连不上或还没注册到工具。 - **设置 → 桌面控制**：依赖安装 / 更新 / 回退、桥接参数、镜像策略、惰性工具开关，全在这一页。 插件自己的卡片（设置 → 插件 → 本插件）只留一行状态和一句指路，不重复放安装按钮。 --- ## 配置 全部在 **设置 → 桌面控制**。改完点保存，插件参数立即生效，**桥接参数要重启 DSH**（MCP 客户端只在启动时读一次那一行配置）。 | 项 | 默认 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | 工具调用超时 | `120000` ms | 5000–600000。截屏和 UI 树遍历很慢，调小容易中断，调大卡住时等得久 | | 截图缩放 | `0.75` | `0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 / 1`。越小越省视觉 token，细节也越少 | | 截图后端 | `auto` | `dxcam` 最快，`mss` 居中，`pillow` 最慢但最稳 | | 截图闪光边框 | 关 | 关掉可少一次桌面重绘 | | 屏蔽的工具 | `App, PowerShell, FileSystem` | 不出现在工具表里，省上下文 | | 启动时检查更新 | 开 | 每次启动后台查一次，结果缓存 6 小时 | | 首选镜像 | `auto` | 也可以固定 USTC / 阿里云 / 腾讯云 / 华为云 / 南京大学 / 清华 TUNA / PyPI | | 惰性工具 | 开 | 平时只给模型一个入口，调用后才下发工具定义 | 设置写在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-desktop-bridge.settings.json`，原子写入；越界的值会被夹回默认并明确告诉你，不会静默写坏。 --- ## 工作原理 ### 装依赖 ```mermaid flowchart TD A[点「下载并安装」] --> B[7 个镜像并发测速] B --> C[按吞吐量排序] C --> D[uv tool install] D --> E{成功?} E -- 否 --> F[换下一个镜像] F --> D E -- 是 --> G[校验安装结果] G --> H[改写桥的配置行] H --> I[重启 DSH 生效] ``` ### 惰性工具（默认开启） ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant M as 模型 participant D as DSH participant W as windows-mcp Note over M: 工具表里只有 windows_desktop M->>D: windows_desktop（无参数） D-->>M: 18 个能力的定义 Note over M: 下一步起，这些工具才进工具表 M->>D: mcp__windows__Screenshot D->>W: stdio 转发 W-->>D: 截图 + 光标 + 窗口摘要 D-->>M: 结果 ``` 18 份 schema 每一步都占上下文，包括根本没人碰桌面的那些步骤。惰性工具把这一步挪到"真的要用了"的时候，调用后按 session 记住。 --- ## 安全模型 三条，按重要性排： 1. **默认关闭，且关闭是真的关闭。** 工具既不出现在工具表，调用也会被 dispatch guard 拦下。开关状态存在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-desktop-bridge.state.json`，重启不丢。 2. **改开关必须来自 DSH 窗口。** 所有写操作（开关、安装、更新、设置）都要求带 GUI 的签名 session cookie——模型就算有 shell 权限，也没法给自己开桌面控制。拿不到 `connection` 服务的部署会在 `/state` 里报 `gate: unobservable`，不会假装安全。 3. **不回家。** 上游默认开 PostHog 遥测，插件在桥的行里写死 `ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=false`。 除此之外请自己判断：一旦开关打开，模型能做你在这个桌面上能做的一切——包括读写注册表、结束进程。不确定的时候，先关掉开关再让它干活。 --- ## 常见问题 **装了插件，但模型看不到桌面工具** 桥的那一行出厂是 `disabled: true`，这是故意的：`uvx` 冷启动会解析整棵 Python 依赖树，慢网络下能把 DSH 卡在"加载插件"好几分钟。去 **设置 → 桌面控制 → 依赖** 点安装，装完重启。 **显示「未找到 uv」** `uv` 不在跑 DSH 那个进程的 PATH 上。装完 uv 要**重启 DSH**，不是重启终端。 **改了桥接参数没反应** 桥接参数写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，MCP 客户端只在启动时读一次。**重启 DSH**。设置页会明确显示"已写入，重启后生效"。 **提示「检测到多个已装本插件的 profile」** 插件不去猜该改哪一个。给跑 DSH 的进程设 `DSH_DESKTOP_BRIDGE_PROFILE=`，或给绝对路径，再重试。 **截图太糊 / 太费 token** 调 `截图缩放`：要看清小字用 `1`，只想看布局用 `0.5`。还可以关掉惰性工具以外的东西——比如把 `App`、`PowerShell` 屏蔽掉省上下文。 **工具调用超时** 截屏和 `WaitFor` 本来就慢。把 `工具调用超时` 往上调（最大 600000），比反复重试划算。 **想彻底停用** 关掉 Computer Use 就够了——工具对模型不可见。想连依赖一起清掉：`uv tool uninstall windows-mcp`，再删掉 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-desktop-bridge/toolchain`。 --- ## 开发 ```powershell npm install npm test # 43 个用例，约 11 秒 npm run check # 语法检查 npm run dump # 在真实 profile 上打印合成后的配置树，不改动它 ``` 零运行时依赖，只用 `node:*`。三条纪律写在 `lib/index.js` 头部，改代码前先读：`apply()` 永不抛、只注入确定存在的服务、不打日志噪音。 调试工具在 `tools/`（不发布到 npm）：`mcp-handshake.mjs` 直接和 Windows-MCP 握手，`probe-asar.mjs` 读 Electron 的 `app.asar`，`update-e2e.mjs` 跑真实的下载→激活→回退链路。 欢迎提 issue 和 PR。 --- ## 致谢与许可 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 - [CursorTouch/Windows-MCP](https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP)（MIT）负责真正的桌面自动化，本项目只做接线。 - 本项目派生自 [dsh-windows-mcp](https://github.com/helloHub1212/dsh-windows-mcp)（MIT），原始版权声明保留在 `LICENSE`，详见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。 - MCP 客户端桥属于 DeepSeek Harness 本体，不在本仓库分发。 - 与 DeepSeek 官方、Windows-MCP 作者均无隶属关系。

decision.reason: Held for versioned DSH compatibility, package or companion artifact mapping. MIT and explicit Git installation; no versioned DSH compatibility declaration established. Native diagnostics/control implementation exists, so this is not a configuration-only MCP bundle. Patch keeps the official MCP row disabled by default; installation can use uvx/windows-mcp 0.8.8 and mirror-selected Python/toolchain downloads. Signed-session admission is documented, but companion/source artifact mapping remains unresolved. No lifecycle hook. evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# anysearch-cli

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) > This document is canonical; [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md) is the derived translation. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@anysearch-cli/cli)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@anysearch-cli/cli) [![ci](https://github.com/Xxx91n/anysearch-cli/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Xxx91n/anysearch-cli/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Xxx91n/anysearch-cli)](LICENSE) A vertical-domain information-specialist CLI: search + research + memory + knowledge in one agent — FTS5 recall, multi-source RRF fusion, an MCP server that auto-indexes results, and a domain allowlist that actually gates what comes back. **Status: published on npm** — `npm i -g @anysearch-cli/cli` (npm OIDC trusted publishing with sigstore provenance since 0.0.4; 0.0.1/0.0.2 were revoked over a `workspace:*` peer escape — see CHANGELOG). What a gated search looks like — every returned URL sits inside the domain's `urlAllowlist`; an empty gated result is a first-class abstain: ```text $ ANS_DOMAIN=docs ans search "model context protocol" 1. [tavily] What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)? - Model Context Protocol modelcontextprotocol.io/ 2. [exa] modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic 3. [exa] modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026%2D07%2D28 … # when the gate leaves zero results — a first-class abstain, not an error: abstain: no results within allowed cold domain(s) (pre-filtered 0, post-filtered 0, gate pre) ``` ## Requirements - Node.js >= 22 (Node 24 verified) - pnpm 11.24.0 exactly (pinned; corepack reads `packageManager` automatically) - At least one provider API key for real searches: - `EXA_API_KEY` — Exa (supports domain filtering) - `TAVILY_API_KEY` — Tavily (supports domain filtering) - `ANYSEARCH_API_KEY` — anysearch MCP (optional; anonymous tier works, no domain filter) ## Quickstart ```bash npm i -g @anysearch-cli/cli ans doctor # self-check: keys, DB path, domain resolution, provider readiness ans search "tokio JoinSet rust" # first search (full fanout across keyed providers) ANS_DOMAIN=docs ans search "tokio JoinSet rust" # domain-scoped search # optional vector arm (peer-optional — never auto-installed): npm i -g @anysearch-cli/embedding ``` From source (contributors): ```bash git clone && cd anysearch-cli pnpm install --ignore-scripts --node-linker=hoisted # prebuilt better-sqlite3, no node-gyp; hoisted avoids Windows EPERM pnpm build node apps/cli/dist/index.js doctor ANS_DOMAIN=docs node apps/cli/dist/index.js search "tokio JoinSet rust" # machine-readable output (includes sufficiency / attribution / abstain) node apps/cli/dist/index.js search "..." --json ``` The CLI resolves as `ans` when the package is installed globally or linked; in repo form, `node apps/cli/dist/index.js` is the same entry point. ## Post-install: vector arm `@anysearch-cli/embedding` is peer-optional — the CLI runs FTS-only without it. After a global install (npm or pnpm), verify activation and embed existing rows: ```bash ans doctor # "vector arm (present ...)" confirms activation ans memory backfill-vectors # embeds stored rows; first run downloads the model (~130 MB) ``` The model downloads from huggingface.co on first use and is cached at `~/.anysearch/models` (override: `ANYSEARCH_MODEL_CACHE`). On an offline host, copy a populated cache dir in from a connected machine. Removing the package returns the CLI to FTS-only mode — no crash, `ans doctor` reports the arm as SKIP. ## Domains & abstain A *domain* is a TOML file under `domains/` (or `ANS_DOMAINS_DIR`) naming its providers and an authoritative `urlAllowlist`. `ANS_DOMAIN` selects it. Filtering runs as two gates: 1. **Pre-filter (capability-negotiated)** — providers that declare domain-filter support receive the allowlist directly (`tavily`: `include_domains` hard filter mode; `exa`: `includeDomains`). Providers without support (e.g. `anysearch`) degrade honestly to post-filter only — never a faked filter. 2. **Post-filter (authoritative)** — the kernel drops every returned result whose URL is not in the allowlist *before* fusion/attribution. Deny rules take precedence; allow entries match a host and its subdomains. When the gate leaves zero results, `ans` **abstains** — a first-class result, not an error: ```text abstain: no results within allowed cold domain(s) (pre-filtered 0, post-filtered 0, gate pre) ``` - Exit code **0** by default (abstention is a successful policy outcome); `--fail-on-abstain` returns dedicated exit **3** for automation. - `--json` carries `abstain: { reason, domain, preFiltered, postFiltered, gate }`; MCP tools surface `structuredContent.abstain` with `isError: false`. - Two audit events land in the observation trace per domain-scoped search: `retrieval.domain_filter.pre` and `retrieval.domain_filter.post`. Exit codes: `0` ok/abstain · `1` generic failure or zero results without a domain policy · `2` usage error · `3` abstain under `--fail-on-abstain`. ### Writing domain descriptions (`ans recommend`) `ans recommend ""` ranks domains by BM25 over **`name` + `description` only** (plus an optional embedding arm when `@anysearch-cli/embedding` is installed; without it the command degrades to FTS-only). It prints top-3 candidates with a confidence score: high confidence suggests `ans domain `, low confidence lists the candidates with a structured "why no recommendation" line — it never switches domains by itself. So the description is the trigger surface; write it accordingly (evidence: community reports + arXiv 2604.04323 both find vague descriptions silently never fire — description quality is the make-or-break factor): - State **what the domain is for** and the **concrete nouns a user would actually type** — tools, formats, sites (e.g. `MCP spec / TypeScript tsconfig / pnpm settings`), not adjectives. - Add the **differentiating keywords** that separate it from sibling domains, and implicitly what it is *not* (the corpus inclusion rule). - One line, ≤ ~250 characters (per-entry description budget precedent from agent-skill registries); keep `name` short and literal — both fields are indexed verbatim. A domain can also inject its own **private/internal data** into the agent's context through `[rag] adapter` — `none` (default), `note` (legacy fixed text) or `fts` (real FTS5 memory recall, provenance-tagged). See [docs/rag-adapters.md](docs/rag-adapters.md). ### Installing Agent Skills (`ans skill`) `ans skill` is a minimal installer, not a package manager. It copies a self-contained directory with a root `SKILL.md` from a **local Git checkout**. Checkout the desired commit or tag first; the installer records that source, the full HEAD commit, an exact tag when present, and whether the source was dirty. Dirty detection streams `git status` and stops at the first entry, so a checkout with a very large ignored or untracked tree stays installable instead of failing on a full listing. It does not clone repositories, resolve dependencies, or run skill code. ```bash ans skill install /path/to/checkout/skills/research ans skill validate # all installed skills; optionally pass one name ans skill list ans skill uninstall research # Project scope: add --project to each command ans skill install /path/to/checkout/skills/research --project ans skill validate --project ans skill list --project ans skill uninstall research --project ``` User scope is the default (`--user` selects it explicitly): ```text ~/.anysearch-cli/skills/synced/installed.json ~/.anysearch-cli/skills/synced//SKILL.md /.anysearch/skills/synced/installed.json /.anysearch/skills/synced//SKILL.md ``` `synced/` is machine-managed; sibling `skills//` directories remain user-authored. `SKILL.md` must begin with a parseable YAML frontmatter mapping whose `name` is 1–64 lowercase letters/digits with single hyphens (not a Windows device name). That name selects the destination. This is a syntax/name check, not a full Agent Skills linter. Git metadata is omitted and symlinks are rejected; a source repository that defines local Git content-filter drivers (`filter..clean`/`process`) is refused, because `git status` would otherwise execute that repository-controlled code. Submodules are not inspected for dirtiness. Existing installations are never overwritten (uninstall first). The version-1 `installed.json` has a `skills` object keyed by name. Each entry contains `name`, absolute `source`, `commit`, `dirty`, and optional `tag`. Missing, malformed, or schema-invalid manifests cause uninstall to refuse without deleting anything; uninstall never scans for guessed targets. `install` and `uninstall` hold an exclusive lock in the selected scope, so two concurrent mutations cannot lose each other's manifest entry. The lock records its owner (`pid`, `host`, a stable machine identity, and the PID-namespace identity where the OS exposes one) and is published with that record already inside, so a lock never exists without an owner. The machine identity is derived from `/etc/machine-id` (Linux), `MachineGuid` (Windows), or `IOPlatformUUID` (macOS) — not from `hostname()`, so two hosts that share a managed root and happen to use the same hostname cannot reclaim each other's live locks. A lock whose owner is provably dead on the same machine and PID namespace — including one left by a previous boot — is reclaimed automatically; a live lock, a lock written on another machine or namespace, or one without a readable owner or machine identity fails closed and is never deleted. To recover manually, remove the lock directory when no `ans skill` process is running on the machine that created it. An acquisition killed before publication can leave `.installed.lock.pending-*`; a dead copy is cleaned in a scope without `installed.json`, and any remaining copy is inert and can be removed once no `ans skill` process is running. Manifest publication and the install/uninstall directory renames retry transient Windows sharing violations (`EPERM`/`EBUSY`/`ENOTEMPTY`) with bounded backoff for up to about 60 seconds before reporting the original error; on other platforms only `EBUSY` is treated as transient. `install`, `list` and `validate` also reconcile installer-owned residue while holding that lock. Residue is recognized by its exact generated name, never by a prefix: `.install-` plus six alphanumerics (staging), `.installed-.tmp` (manifest temporary), `.installed.lock.pending-` plus six alphanumerics, and `.installed.lock.reclaim-` (reclamation quarantine). Staging and a temp manifest are removed only in a scope without `installed.json`. A pending or reclaimed lock is removed only once its recorded owner is provably dead; a reclaimed lock that cannot be proven dead stops the run with its path, while a pending lock with a live or unreadable owner is left in place — it is inert, so it neither blocks nor stops a run. The match is on shape, not authorship. Anything that merely looks similar — a hand-made `.installed-notes.tmp`, an `.install-archive/` directory, `.installed.lock.pending-` — is operator content: it is never deleted, and a scope without `installed.json` keeps failing closed instead of bootstrapping a manifest beside it. A name that happens to have exactly the generated shape is indistinguishable from installer residue and is treated as such — an operator directory named `.install-backup` is six alphanumerics after `.install-`, so it is removed in a scope without `installed.json`. Avoid that shape for your own files. `.uninstall-*` backups, unrecorded `/` directories and unknown entries are never deleted automatically. An unrecorded `/` left by an interrupted install can be removed manually and reinstalled. If the manifest records a skill whose `/` directory is missing, `ans skill list` (and `validate`) prints a recovery hint: rename the matching `.uninstall-*` backup back to `/`, or run `ans skill uninstall ` to drop the stale entry (add `--project` for project scope). A `.installed-*.tmp` left next to an existing `installed.json` is not removed automatically; inspect `skills/synced/` before manual cleanup. Leftovers from an interrupted reclamation (`.installed.lock.reclaim-*`) follow the same manifest-gated rule: they are removed only in a scope without `installed.json`, and only when their recorded owner is provably dead on this host; a manifest-bearing scope is never cleaned automatically. If `ans skill list` itself reports a missing or invalid manifest, inspect `skills/synced/` directly before removing anything. **Installation is not activation.** These commands never edit domain TOML. The Active Domain's `[skills].active` remains the authority for the Skill Active List; manage activation through the domain configuration as before. ## Provider domain-filter matrix | provider | pre-filter sent | degrade mode | |----------|-----------------|--------------| | tavily | yes (`include_domains`, hard filter mode) | — | | exa | yes (`includeDomains`) | — | | anysearch| no (MCP `domain` is a vertical-routing enum, not a host allowlist) | post-filter only | Provider selection comes from the domain TOML's `sources.enabled`. Missing keys skip that provider instead of crashing (fail-open); if *no* provider can register, the search is an error, not an abstain. ## AnySearch vertical domains The anysearch provider also exposes an orthogonal axis: a server-side **vertical-domain router**. Set it per query — CLI flags or MCP tool args — or per domain TOML; it is NOT a hostname allowlist and does not interact with `urlAllowlist` at all. - Query-level args (whole-replace the TOML default, never deep-merged): `verticalDomain` / `verticalSubDomain` / `verticalParams` on `search_web` + `research_web`; CLI `--vertical-domain` / `--vertical-sub-domain` / `--vertical-params '{"k":"v"}'`. - Repo default: `[sources] vertical = { domain = "finance" }` in the domain TOML (static affinity only — `sub_domain` is optional here, but parameterized tags like `calendar` fail upstream without `sub_domain_params`, which live at query level via `--vertical-params`). - Capability-negotiated: only providers declaring `verticalDomainSupported` (currently just anysearch) receive the wire fields `domain` / `sub_domain` / `sub_domain_params`; others fan out on the general axis and are named in the `retrieval.vertical.pre` audit event's `anysearch.vertical.degraded` list (a lost hint, never an abstain). - Audit: one `retrieval.vertical.pre` event per vertical search — attributes `anysearch.vertical.domain` / `.sub_domain` / `.params_keys` (key *names* only, values never enter audit) / `.source` (repo|query) / `.sent` / `.degraded`. Vertical hits carry a machine-readable `extra.vertical` marker on each NormalizedResult. The dated domain-vocabulary snapshot and observed upstream semantics moved to [docs/vertical-domains.md](docs/vertical-domains.md). ## MCP server ```bash node apps/mcp/dist/index.cjs # stdio transport (default) node apps/mcp/dist/index.cjs --transport http --port 3099 # HTTP ``` Five tools: `search_web`, `research_web`, `recall_memory`, `query_knowledge`, `ans_chat`. `ANS_DOMAIN` scopes the server the same way it scopes the CLI. Tools never print to stdout; the server keeps the protocol channel pure. ## How it works One pass through the pipeline — providers fan out, the domain gate filters, results fuse and persist: ```mermaid flowchart LR U["ans CLI · ans-mcp"] --> Q["fanout"] Q --> T["tavily"] Q --> E["exa"] Q --> A["anysearch"] T & E & A --> G{"domain gate
pre + post urlAllowlist"} G -->|"kept"| F["RRF fusion + attribution"] G -->|"dropped"| X["off-list URLs"] G -->|"zero kept"| Z["abstain — first-class"] F --> S[("store
FTS5 memory + observation")] ``` ## Verified agent hosts | Host | Version | Verified scope | Status | |------|---------|----------------|--------| | CodeBuddy Code | 2.151.0 | `mcp.json` registration + `.codebuddy/settings.json` hooks | live-verified · [doc](docs/codebuddy-integration.md) | | Claude Code | 2.1.251 | `mcp.json` registration + `.claude/settings.json` hooks + plugin skeleton | live-verified · [doc](docs/claude-integration.md) | | Codex CLI | 0.142.5 | `config.toml` MCP registration + `.codex/hooks.json` hooks | live-verified · [doc](docs/codex-integration.md) | | Antigravity CLI (`agy`) | 1.2.5 | named-hook map `hooks.json` (5 events via argv) | live-verified (reduced matrix) · [doc](docs/antigravity-integration.md) | | Antigravity IDE | 2.12.2 | `.antigravity/rules/anysearch.mdc` fallback | hooks not executed (reproduced) · [doc](docs/antigravity-integration.md) | | DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) | 0.1.7-rc.2 | native registration (`ctx.tools`) + `dsh-plugin` Cordis bundle | live-verified (established-via-fallback) · [doc](docs/deepseek-harness-integration.md) | "Verified" means an end-to-end transcript captured on the real host (`stream-json`), not contract isomorphism — full scope, dates and probe evidence live in the linked integration docs. ## Known limitations | Limitation | Why it matters | |------------|----------------| | exit-time `libc++abi` aborts on macOS | root-caused (#183) to forced `process.exit()` while native state was still alive, not to leaked sqlite handles: store-side exits now close handles and let the loop end, and macOS is a blocking `ship-gate` leg again. Anything that force-exits a process with live native state can still abort — the non-blocking `macos-spillover-probe` job stays as an early-warning reporter | | `anysearch` provider cannot pre-filter | its MCP `domain` param is a vertical-routing enum (not a host allowlist) — under a domain allowlist it degrades honestly to post-filter only | | exit-time `libc++abi` may overwrite the abstain exit code | automation must read the structured abstain marker (`--json` / `structuredContent.abstain`), not the exit code alone | | `rag.adapter = "fts"` is not enabled on any shipped domain | all three shipped domains stay on `adapter = "none"`; enabling it per domain is an explicit opt-in product decision (#130) | | MCP `query_knowledge` does not dispatch to the RAG registry yet | it still answers with the `adapter=` line; its read scope is decided (store-level shared Research Memory, #130), wiring is tracked in #155 | | omitting `[rag]` is not the same as `adapter = "none"` | `rag` is a replace-on-declare section: a derived domain inherits its base's adapter/note, and a chain with no adapter fails validation outright | | `rag.adapter = "fts"` reads **store-level shared** Research Memory, not the current session | deliberate boundary (#130): the store is the isolation unit; sessions/domains are sub-scopes. Every shipped domain stays on `none`, so the `fts` prompt injection is opt-in (the same store-wide range is already read by `recall_memory`) | Full record: [docs/limitations.md](docs/limitations.md). ## Design rationale - **Vertical-domain** — domains are TOML policy files with an authoritative `urlAllowlist` enforced in the kernel, not prompt wishes. - **Abstain-first** — an empty gated result is a first-class abstain, never a hallucinated answer. - **Fail-open** — hooks, providers and optional peers degrade honestly instead of breaking the host agent. ## For contributors - `GLOSSARY.md` — canonical domain glossary (read first) - `docs/rag-adapters.md` — RAG adapter configuration (`none` / `note` / `fts`), injection shape and budgets - `docs/limitations.md` — full known-limitations record - `docs/agents/` — domain-doc + GitHub issue tracker conventions - Repo layout: `packages/kernel` (engine) · `packages/store` (FTS5 memory, observation, URL policy) · `packages/retriever` (provider adapters + RRF) · `apps/cli` · `apps/mcp` · `apps/plugin` (host hooks) - Per-package tests run under `node --import tsx --test`; the full gate is `node scripts/ship-gate.mjs` (clean tree, tests, pack, install verify, MCP initialize, fail-open boot) - Governance: `AGENTS.md`, `docs/agents/` > AI生成

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-wiki-notes

[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4B6EF5)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)

**给你那堆 Markdown 笔记，接上四个能用的工具：查得到、读得出、核得住、看得见。**

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 做的只读检索插件。旧的流程是五步：读总览 → 读索引 → 敲命令搜 → 打开那页 → 追它的来源。现在一次调用就把**命中小节的完整正文 + 出处**返回，模型自己接着答。

> 中文文档从下面开始。实测：73 页的库，旧流程单次 ≈ 18.7k 字符，新流程 ≈ 2.5k。

---

## 目录

| 你想知道 | 直接跳 |
| --- | --- |
| 这插件到底能干什么 | [四个工具](#四个工具) |
| 我要先装上试试 | [装](#装) · [配](#配) |
| 我自己的笔记该怎么写 | [库该长什么样](#库该长什么样) |
| 检索为什么这么打分 | [检索质量](#检索质量) |
| 它有没有偷看我的东西 | [只读，且不往外发](#只读且不往外发) |
| 旧版本有没有遗留 | [发布物与残余风险](#发布物与残余风险) |
| 已知毛病 | [已知局限](#已知局限) |
| 要改代码 | [目录 / 开发](#目录--开发) |

---

## 四个工具

插件注册四个工具，用途不重叠，按顺序读就明白了：

| 工具 | 一句话 | 什么时候用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **`wiki_recall`** | 检索库，拿到命中小节的正文与出处 | 「我的笔记里怎么写的？」 |
| **`wiki_context`** | 检索 + 抽证据 + 标缺口 + 给回答约束，**一次做完** | 要引用笔记原文回答，或想知道「依据够不够」 |
| **`wiki_verify`** | 拿已有的 context 核验一段回答，**不重新检索** | 答案写完了自查，特别是有数字的时候 |
| **`wiki_observe`** | 查观察日志统计（调用次数、支持状态分布、违规类型） | 诊断，不参与回答 |

设置页里只有一个「知识库」入口，进去分两个页签：**概览**（路径、体检、提示词）和**调用记录**（谁在什么时候查了什么、查到没有）。后者不是工具，是那本账的界面。

### `wiki_recall` —— 检索

一个工具，七种 mode：

| mode | 干什么 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `search`（默认） | 关键词 AND 检索 | `query`、`limit`（5，≤12）、`sectionChars`（900，≤3000） |
| `page` | 按页名/别名取整页 | `name`、`pageChars`（6000） |
| `list` | 按类型/标签/状态列目录 | `type`、`tags`、`status`、`limit`（40，≤200） |
| `overview` | 总览 + 规模行 + 最近日志 + 健康计数 | `pageChars`（4000）、`logLimit`（5，≤20） |
| `lint` | 库健康检查：孤儿页、断链名字、缺字段、别名冲突、久未更新、无出链、草稿、index 与磁盘不一致；**并和上次体检对比，报出新增与已修** | `limit`（8，≤40）、`staleDays`（120） |
| `draft` | 把好答案回写成新页的落盘骨架（目录、frontmatter、index 行、log 条），不写文件 | `title`、`type`、`tags`、`summary`、`sources` |
| `help` | 用法与状态说明：七个 mode 各返回什么、`status` 各取值怎么读、参数默认值 | 无 |

```jsonc
{ "mode": "search", "query": "上下文 预算", "limit": 5 }
```

每条命中带 `kind`（note / raw-summary / source）、`sources`（来源数，**证据强度的唯一可靠代理**）、`status`、`gist`、`section`（命中小节正文，不是 90 字片段）、`citation`（`← [[页名]] §小节 → 路径`）、`brokenLinks`（指向不存在页的双链 = 「库里没依据」的硬信号），以及 `updated` 后面的**距今天数**（超过 180 天标「可能已过时」——三年前的结论和上周的长得一样，模型需要这个信号）。`overview` 额外给三项健康信号：index 有磁盘无、磁盘有 index 无、跨目录重名。

### `wiki_context` —— 带证据的上下文

要引用笔记原文回答、或需要知道「有没有依据 / 依据够不够 / 哪里是缺口」时用它，而不是自己连续调 `wiki_recall`。

参数：`query`（必填）、`limit`（1–12，默认 5）、`engine`（`both` / `search` / `wiki_recall`，默认 `both`）、`ttl_seconds`（默认 1800）。

返回里最重要的一条：**`status.support` 和 `status.degraded` 是两件事，必须分开看。**

- `support` 说的是**知识够不够**（`sufficient` / `partial` / `insufficient`）。
- `degraded` 说的是**引擎有没有坏**。它是布尔值，为真时说明某个检索通道挂了 —— 这时候不能把 `support` 当结论，那是拿不完整的检索结果下的判断。

同时返回 `evidence`（证据页，含分级、支撑了哪个槽位）、`missing`（缺什么、为什么缺）、`conflicts`（冲突候选，**未裁决，别当成已确认的结论**）、`answer.contract_text`（给回答的约束：必须披露缺口、不得超出证据、引文须原文），以及一个 `context_id`。

### `wiki_verify` —— 核验回答

写完答案后自查（尤其含数字、范围、年份、题量分值这类主张时）用它。参数：`context_id` + `answer`（可选 `observe_id`，一般不用传，插件会自动带上）。

它不重新检索 —— 拿当初那份快照来比，所以快，也不受库里后来改动的影响。

返回 `status` 与 `violations`：violations 非空说明回答越过了证据允许的边界，每条都带类型、主张和原因。另有 `notices` 单独放「说不清」的提示 —— **「说不清」不等于「说错了」**，模型若只读 violations 会漏掉这一块。

`context_expired` / `context_missing` 是**快照问题**，不等于回答错了：重新取一份 context 再核验就行。

每次核验都会往观察日志追加一条记录，并用 `parent_observe_id` 指回当初那份 context —— 这样「哪次核验修好了哪次回答」在日志里追得回。

### `wiki_observe` —— 诊断

参数：`days`（1–365，默认 7）、`limit`（1–50，默认 10）。

报观察窗口内的调用次数、支持状态分布、检索状态分布、违规类型分布，还有**修正情况**（核验过的 context 里已改正 / 仍未改正的比例）—— 这一项比违规总数更能反映核验到底有没有用。只读诊断，不参与回答，也不改检索行为。

> ⚠️ 它只看**网关**那三次调用（`wiki_context` / `wiki_verify`）。`wiki_recall` 不走 Python，也就不写观察日志 —— 要看全部调用，去「知识库」页的「调用记录」页签。

### 调用审计 —— 「知识库」页的「调用记录」页签

在设置页的「知识库」里切到第二个页签。模型和面板**每一次**查库都会记一行，回答的是「我这句问话，它到底查了没有、查到没有」。

三格数字（今日调用 / 命中率 / 零命中）+ 一张表（时间 · 来源 · 工具 · 问题 · 命中 · 耗时）+ 筛选（全部 / 模型 / 面板、只看零命中）。页面每 2 秒自己刷新。

账本落在插件目录旁的 `calls.jsonl`（已在 `.gitignore` 里），只记 8 个字段：

```
ts · source · tool · mode · query · hits · ms · ok
```

**页面路径、正文、答案一律不进账本。** `query` 截到 120 字。

几条口径值得写清楚：

- **命中率的分母不含 `wiki_verify` / `wiki_observe`**，也不算 `page` / `list` 这类非检索模式 —— 它们没有「命中几页」这回事，记成 0 会把命中率系统性压低，所以记 `null`，不进统计。
- **它只能看见「发生了的调用」**。模型压根没想起来查库，这里也不会有记录 —— 那是一种缺席，账本记不了缺席。要统计「哪类问题从来不查库」，得去读会话转录（本插件不读）。
- 记满 5000 行轮转一次，只留最近 2500 行；读取只扫文件尾部 256 KB。
- 记账是**旁路**：写不进去只打一行警告，工具的返回值一个字都不改。`calls.enabled` 可以整个关掉。

---

## 设计从哪来

库结构来自 [Karpathy 的 `llm-wiki.md`](https://gist.github.com/karpathy/442a6bf555914893e9891c11519de94f)：与其每次提问都从原始文档重新检索（知识不累积），不如让 LLM 增量维护一个持久的 wiki。本插件只加速其中的 **Query** 一段。

| gist 里的概念 | 本插件默认位置 |
| --- | --- |
| Raw sources（不可变） | `原始资料-raw/` |
| The wiki（LLM 维护） | `知识层-wiki/` |
| The schema | 库根 `AGENTS.md` |
| `index.md` + `log.md` | 同名同格式 |

---

## 库该长什么样

**一个目录 + 一堆 `.md` 就能用。** 更细的约定见 [docs/库结构.md](docs/库结构.md)：frontmatter 七字段（英文写法 `title/type/tags/aliases/status/created/updated/sources` 也认）、`index.md` 摘要目录、`log.md` 时间线、`总览-overview.md`，满足得越多检索越准。可跑的样例在 [`examples/sample-wiki/`](examples/sample-wiki/)。

路径指到上一层（比如 `LLM-Wiki/`，里面还有 `原始资料-raw/` 和 `知识层-wiki/`）也没关系：插件会认 `index.md`，自动下钻到知识层，并在返回里注明它实际读的是哪一层。

---

## 装

在 DSH 里说一句即可：**「帮我装一个 DSH 插件，目录是 `<绝对路径>`」**。或自己发：

```
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "<绝对路径>" }
```

返回 `application: applied` 就生效，不用重启。但**改插件自己的代码要重启 DSH**：`lib/*.js`（宿主半）和 `lib/client.js`（设置页）都一样，已载入的模块不会因为关开插件而重新求值。

---

## 配

**设置 →「知识库」**，填路径 → 测试 → 保存。四层优先级：

| 优先级 | 来源 |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 插件 config 的 `root` |
| 2 | 环境变量 `DSH_WIKI_ROOT` |
| 3 | `wiki-notes.config.json`（设置页写这里） |
| 4 | `lib/config.js` 的 `DEFAULT_WIKI_ROOT`（默认空） |

没配时工具会直接告诉你「还没配置知识库路径」，不会静默扫空目录。

`wiki_context` / `wiki_verify` / `wiki_observe` 还需要一条 Python 通路（`bridge.python` + `bridge.toolsRoot`，后者是含 `wiki_bridge.py` 的目录）。没配的话这三个工具会明确报 `E_PYTHON_UNAVAILABLE` —— **不会假装成「知识库里没有」**。配置形状见 [docs/契约-stage0/阶段4-插件接入.md](docs/契约-stage0/阶段4-插件接入.md)。

---

## 模型怎么知道该查库

插件会从你库里现有的 `标签` 算出主题词，注入一行（约 50 token，例如「本地知识库主题：上下文工程、ai、agent…」）。不带页数 —— 页数一变就会打掉提示词的前缀缓存，而它对「该不该查」没有帮助。换库自动变，所以问题沾这些主题时它自己会去查，不用你提醒。设置页里可以关掉（不占上下文）、换成自己的整段、或在末尾追加一句，改完下一回合生效。

主题词怎么挑：跳过 `总览`/`index` 这类结构页，跳过 `数据`/`工具`/`meta` 这类空泛标签，默认只留出现 ≥2 次的标签（设置页可改回 ≥1）。全被滤掉时退回不过滤的前五 —— 小库不至于一条提示都没有。

---

## 设置页

设置 →「知识库」。状态栏圆点表示实时同步是否生效，三个数字是页面 / 资料 / 红链页，下面是路径卡片和 `测试 · 保存并生效 · 重新扫描`。一次没配过时，卡片会变成三步引导。

浏览器半侧走同源 HTTP `/api/wiki-notes/*`（`state` / `search` / `check` / `save` / `rescan`），不碰 RPC。

---

## 检索面板

设置页里有一张「试一试检索」的卡，右侧栏另有一个「知识库」页签 —— 同一份组件，`compact` 控制密度。用途只有一个：**让人自己看见检索依据**，不必等模型说它查到了什么。

输入关键词回车，上面一行是「命中 7 页（显示前 5）· 参与打分 95 页 · 36 ms · 库 95 页」；紧跟一行是**查询诊断**：`实际用的词` 后面逐个列出这次真正参与打分的词，一页都没沾到的词会标成「没沾到」，末尾写清这次是「全词都要（AND）」还是「命中任一（OR）」。中文不分词，写整句时这一行通常只剩一个词 —— 这是最直观的提示：换词，而不是加词。

每条命中占一行，左边是名次、页名、类型，右边是一条按「相对第一名」缩放的分数条和总分。多类型命中会按类型分组（`概念（3）`、`资料（2）`…）。展开后有：

- 页名、类型、总分，以及「只命中部分词」的标记（该条没命中全部查询词）；
- **命中理由**：每个查询词一条徽章，主词加粗、明细灰字，例如 `上下文 · 页名 120 · 别名 50 · 正文 ×7 21`，未得分的词显示为「未命中」。悬停徽章有各通道的权重说明；
- 该条命中的小节标题与正文（正文里出现过的查询词带淡黄底纹），末尾附 citation，右侧一个复制按钮 —— 把「哪句话支撑了这条」直接抄进对话里；
- 查询降级成「命中任一」时，计数行旁边会黄字提示。

**键盘**：输入框防抖 350ms（够 2 个字符才查），`Enter` 立刻查，`Esc` 清空，`↑`/`↓` 在结果里移动高亮并展开对应条目；任意位置按 `/` 或 `Ctrl/⌘ + K` 直接跳到输入框。查询进行中列表上方显示「检索中…」。输入框右边有「复制词」—— 查出来的说法常常要拿去别处再查一遍，省得重敲；citation 那行的复制按钮同理（键盘走过去会看到焦点框）。

**覆盖统计**在设置页的状态卡下面：`发现 102 个文件 → 读到 95 页 / 677 个小节`，后面是总体积、跳过 / 读不了 / 超大未读 / 读取失败的计数（非 0 时标黄）、最新修改时间、本次扫描耗时，以及这次实际扫的目录（自动下钻过时它和配置里的路径不是同一个）。

没查之前不是一片空白：显示库的规模、同步开关，以及库里出现最多的几个标签 —— 点一下直接拿它当查询词，省得先想「该查什么」。查不到时也顺带报覆盖：`参与检索 95 页 / 677 个小节 · 跳过 7` ——「没命中」和「那几页根本没读」是两回事，面板得能分清。`discovered = pages + unreadable + skipped` 在 `tests/api.mjs` 里当恒等式断言，这几个数不是凑出来的。

面板是只读的：不写库、不改配置、不进模型上下文。

**`explain` 是对既有检索的解释，不是第二套检索。** 引擎里分数只有一个实现 —— `termScore(page, token)` 就是 `termBreakdown(page, token).score`，理由和排序分数出自同一份明细，所以面板不可能显示「一套理由、另一套排序」；`tests/explain.mjs` 对同一批查询比对开关前后的 `name|score|allTerms` 逐条相同，还核对了「每个词的明细加起来 === 该条总分」。`explain` 也不在工具 schema 里：模型触发不到它，`wiki_recall` 的输出体积一个 token 都不变。

工具输出里新增两个短字段，是给**模型**看的而不是给面板看的：`matchMode`（`and`/`or`）和 `missedTerms`（一个词都没沾到的那些）—— 模型看到「这个词没用上」才可能换词重查。它们会被渲染成一行：`没沾到：量子纠缠（这些词在库里一页都没命中，换同义词或干脆去掉）`；没有漏词时这行不出现，正常路径不多花一个 token。而「每个词命中多少页」(`termPages`) 只在 `explain` 时出现：那是面板的事，模型用不上。

> 这条踩过一次：字段先加进了 `run()` 的返回值，但模型拿到的是 `renderValue()` 渲染出的文本 —— 不写进渲染，模型就等于没拿到。`tests/status.mjs` 现在有两条断言看着它（有漏词要出现、没漏词不许出现）。

侧栏是可选能力：`ctx.inject(['sidebarRightTabs'], …)` 运行时按需取，服务不在就静默跳过，设置页照常可用；`dsh.client.inject` 刻意不钉侧栏模块（钉了会把「侧栏在不在」变成整个客户端包的加载前提）。`tests/contract.mjs` 守着这两条。

接口：`GET /api/wiki-notes/search?q=上下文 预算&limit=5`，`q` 截到 200 字，`limit` 夹在 1–12，缺 `q` 返回 400。

---

## 实时同步

`fs.watch(root, { recursive: true })`，`.md` 新增 / 改 / 删 → 400ms 防抖 → 作废缓存。监听失败自动退回 30 秒 TTL 缓存。`recursive` 在 Linux 需 Node 20.13+，这也是 `engines` 的下限。

---

## 检索质量

基线是 v3：14 条 query / 68 个槽位，比 top5 集合，**Recall@5 = 100%，当回归硬门禁**（口径、判据与历史快照见 [docs/metrics.md](docs/metrics.md)）。单条查询 0–2ms，扫 95 页约 76ms。

评分刻意朴素：标题全等 120 / 标题含 60 / 别名含 50 / 标签含 25 / 正文词频 ×3（封顶 36）/ index 摘要只在其它通道全 0 时补 8。三处经验细节：摘要分只补漏不抢位、同分用码点序（拼音序不可复现）、选节排除清单类与元讨论类小节。

---

## 只读，且不往外发

- 插件只读你的笔记：不写库、不改页、不修红链。
- 检索在本地进程内跑，没有任何出站请求。
- `wiki_context` / `wiki_verify` 调的是**你自己机器上的** Python 管线（`bridge.toolsRoot`），同样不出网。
- 仓库里不含任何本机绝对路径或用户名；测试用环境变量拿真实路径（`WIKI_ROOT` / `WIKI_TOOLS`），不给就跑样例库。
- 公开仓库里的样例、契约文档与测试查询词一律用虚构语料，不写任何人的笔记主题。旧发布物仍有遗留，见下一节。

---

## 发布物与残余风险

**1.4.3 起是干净版本。** 仓库内 `docs/`（整目录进 `files`）、`examples/`、`tests/` 里的演示样例已全部换成虚构的「星港缓存」技术语料：没有真实引文、真实页面路径、外链、本机用户名、私有路径或凭据。发版前会解包 `npm pack` 的产物逐文件扫一遍，命中即视为发布失败。`wiki-notes.config.json` 是本机文件，`.gitignore` 覆盖，从未提交。

**1.4.2 及更早的公开传播源已经发出去了，收不回来：**

| 来源 | 情况 | 处置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| npm `1.4.0` / `1.4.1` / `1.4.2` | 包内 `docs/契约-stage0/samples/` 与几份阶段文档含少量早期演示用的笔记引文、页面标题和一个外部链接；**不含**凭据、用户名、本机路径，也不是运行时采集的数据 | npm 不允许覆盖已发布版本 ⇒ 只把这三个版本标记 `deprecated`，提示升级到 `>=1.4.3`（更早的干净版本不误伤） |
| GitHub Release `v1.4.0` / `v1.4.1` / `v1.4.2` 的 tarball | 与对应 npm 包同源 | 不删 Release 记录，只删带内容的 tarball 资产；取包用 `v1.4.3` 或 `releases/latest/download/dsh-wiki-notes.tgz` |
| Git 历史 `36cfe85` 与标签 `v1.4.0`–`v1.4.2` 自动生成的源码归档 | `36cfe85` 曾写进本机绝对路径与用户名，`f82b125` 已在首个 1.4.0 npm 包发布**之前**清掉；但历史对象与标签归档仍在 | 不重写历史：改 tag SHA 会断掉已发 npm 包与 Release 的提交关联。在意的话请自行 fork 后清理 |

一句话结论：**升级到 `1.4.3+` 即可**；旧版本里那部分内容不会自行消失，别把旧包当「干净语料」再分发。这里只做事实登记，不假装把它们删干净了。

---

## 上下游（可选）

- **进料**：[Obsidian Web Clipper](https://github.com/obsidianmd/obsidian-clipper) —— 网页剪藏成 Markdown 落进 raw 层。模板里写好 `类型` / `来源数量` / `标签`，本插件的 `kind`、`sources`、证据强度才有东西可用。
- **维护**：[kepano/obsidian-skills](https://github.com/kepano/obsidian-skills) —— 六个 `SKILL.md`，教 agent 写 Obsidian 语法（wikilink / `.base` / `.canvas` / CLI），少猜少往返。

---

## 已知局限

- 中文不分词，靠空格切分；连写词靠 `别名` 补。
- 页名本身是查询词时，正文很少重复该词，选节可能偏。
- 每次调用全量扫描；70–100 页无所谓，再大一个数量级要上增量索引。
- **重启后第一次扫描是冷盘读**：95 页实测 5,217ms（此后 29ms）。插件启动就预热一次，所以这段延迟通常落在你还没提问的时候；但第一条查询正好赶上也确实要等。
- **面板没打开时 `/`、`Ctrl/⌘ + K` 不会有反应**：快捷键绑在面板上，而宿主的 `sidebarRightTabs` 只提供 `register()`，没有「打开 / 激活页签」的接口，插件没法从外面把面板叫出来。
- **知识网关那套仍是两套实现**：JS 侧 `wiki_recall` 和 Python 侧 `wiki_context` 各自解析页面，差在结构解读层。统一方向未定。
- **`unverifiable` 只在 `notices` 里**：模型若只看 `violations`，会漏掉「这个数字我核实不了」。
- **观察日志无轮转**：只追加不清理，`legacy` 计数会随时间变大。
- **快照不自动清理**，也没有滑动续期。

---

## 目录 / 开发

```
lib/corpus.js   扫描 + frontmatter / 小节 / 双链解析
lib/engine.js   评分、选节、七种模式（纯函数）
lib/config.js   库路径解析与配置读写
lib/index.js    插件入口：工具、渲染、设置页 API、目录监听
lib/client.js   设置页 + 检索面板 + 右侧栏页签（手写 bundle，无构建）
bin/cli.mjs     命令行，不装插件也能跑
tools/probe.mjs 检索质量探针：hit@1 / hit@3 / Recall@5，追加趋势 CSV
tools/preview.mjs 把面板渲染成静态页（真组件 + 真 CSS），改样式不必重启 DSH
docs/库结构.md  库结构约定（这份才是一手文档）
docs/README.md  文档导航页
docs/superpowers/specs/  检索面板的设计稿
docs/契约-stage0/  知识网关的设计与验收记录
examples/       可跑的最小样例库
tests/          smoke / status / lint / explain / api / help / contract / watch / client bundle / gateway
```

```bash
npm test                                           # 跑样例库，不需要本地知识库
node bin/cli.mjs search 上下文 --root=examples/sample-wiki
WIKI_ROOT="/path/your/wiki" node tests/smoke.mjs   # 拿自己的库跑通就行（不校验答案）
npm run probe -- --root "/path/your/wiki"          # 攒一行检索质量趋势
node tools/preview.mjs                             # 出 preview/panel.html，浏览器直接看面板
node tools/preview.mjs --diag                      # 同上，并量一遍宽度 / 截断 / 溢出 / 对比度
```

跑知识网关那两段真实通路，要给两个环境变量（不给就整段跳过，不会假装通过）：

```bash
WIKI_ROOT="/path/your/知识层-wiki" WIKI_TOOLS="/path/your/工具-tools" node tests/gateway.mjs
```

发版：改 `version` → `npm test` 全绿（`scripts.test` 只调 `node tests/*.mjs`，所以 20.x 也能跑；`node --run test` 要 Node 22+，别在低版本上用它，也别拿它当门槛的证明）→ `npm pack --dry-run` 看一眼打包内容（`files` 只含 `lib`/`bin`/`docs`/`examples`/`README.md`/`LICENSE`/`cordis.patch.yml`，`preview/` 与 `tools/` 不进包）→ `npm publish`。发布前先 `npm whoami --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/` 确认已登录（本机 token 在 `.npmrc` 的 `//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=`；注意 `npm config get registry` 指向 npmmirror，而 npmmirror 那边不认这个 token，登录状态要显式指定 registry 去查）。

改样式的两条经验：

- `.wn-hit-row` 那道 span 不能省。`<summary>` 自带 display 规则，某些浏览器会把 `display:flex` 顶掉，行就塌成内容宽度、分数贴在标题右边 —— 所以行布局放在 summary 里那层 span 上，`tests/client.mjs` 守着它。
- 小字别用 `--wn-faint`（这组 token 在浅色底上约 3.4:1，低于 WCAG AA 的 4.5），小字一律 `--wn-muted`（约 5:1），层级靠字号和字重拉开，不靠把字调淡。
- `--diag` 遍历样式表时，别用「有 `cssRules` 就往下钻」的写法：现代 Chrome 的 `CSSStyleRule` 自己也带一个空的 `cssRules`（CSS 嵌套），会把你正要找的那条规则跳过，于是明明 `display=flex` 却报「NOT FOUND」。先判 `rule.cssRules.length`。

0.2.2 · 一个只做减法的 DSH 发行版：把审批、沙箱围栏、写意图拦截和模型自己的推脱倾向一起拆掉，留下能自证的最小集合。

中文 | English

> **来源声明（请先看这段）** > - 上游原始项目：[YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge](https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge)（作者 小杨 / YuJunZhiXue，MIT）。 > - 本仓库的代码直接来自社区分支 [kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge) 的 minimal 裁剪；宿主补丁、自检、安装器与面板都源自那里。 > - 本仓库 [youki258/dsh-ungate](https://github.com/youki258/dsh-ungate) 只做减法与重写：去掉工具面与历史调试入口、去掉在线自更新、补丁表压到 27 条、文档收敛为单一事实。**不是上游作者的官方发布**，也不代表社区分支的立场。 --- ## 它做什么 | 层 | 内容 | 生效方式 | | --- | --- | --- | | 宿主补丁 | 27 条定义，web 面 21 条落地、6 条仅桌面壳适用 | 点「应用」→ **完全退出 DSH 再打开** | | 运行时提示词 | 每步重贴的注入正文（`$DSH_HOME/prompt-inject.md`） | 立即 | | 强化段 | 尾部 section，默认开启 | 立即 | | 权限配置 | `danger-full-access` + `approval: ask`（由你决定是否改） | 重载后 | | agent 预设 | `unrestricted`，standard 的超集，只改人格 | 新会话下拉选择 | 它**不改**你的提示词正文、规则集、其他插件配置；**不替**你判断目标归属、不做内容审核、不做公网门禁——范围由操作者自己声明。 "应用"只写宿主源码副本并留备份；磁盘写成功 ≠ 当前进程已加载。所有"已生效"的结论都以重开后的 `selfcheck` 与探针为准。 ## 安装 三种入口任选其一，装完的生效步骤相同（应用 → 完全退出重开 → 自证）。 **方式一：官方 CLI + 固定版本 tgz（推荐）** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/youki258/dsh-ungate/releases/download/v0.2.2/dsh-ungate-0.2.2.tgz ``` **方式二：npm 包**（发布到 npm registry 的同名包） ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ungate@0.2.2 ``` **方式三：社区引导安装器**（备份迁移、旧包换装；先 `--dry-run` 审阅再执行） ```sh sh scripts/install.sh --dry-run # Linux/macOS pwsh scripts/install.ps1 -DryRun # Windows ``` **装完生效（三种方式相同）** ```sh node bin/community.js apply # 面板点「应用」等价；写宿主源码副本并留备份 # 完全退出 DSH（托盘退出 / ⌘Q，不是关窗口）再打开，然后自证： node bin/community.js selfcheck --json # state=ok、broken 为空 node bin/community.js probe new # 发一句话看模型是否原样回显 nonce ``` - Desktop 用户把 `--profile web` 换成实际 profile 名（桌面壳默认 `desktop`）。 - **升级**：本包在插件管理器里属 `not-updatable`（预期行为），换新版本重新 `plugin add` 一次即可，配置与提示词不受影响；每次宿主升级后 `asar` 重新封住，点一次「应用」再退出重开。 - **卸载**：`node bin/community.js uninstall`（只清理本 home 内插件目录与链接，不动提示词、规则集、其他插件配置）。 - 细节与失败排查见 [安装指南](docs/INSTALLATION.md)；桌面壳验收见 [桌面测试卡](docs/DESKTOP-TEST.md)。 ## 兼容矩阵 只写有实测证据的组合；没测过的版本不猜。 | 宿主 | 面 | 结果 | 证据 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.1 / rc.2 / rc.3 / rc.5 | Desktop + Web | 已验证 | 锚点命中、apply、selfcheck 全绿 | | DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 | Web / npm CLI | 已验证（apply 20 条 + 自检 19/19 适用层） | 隔离实例，见 [VERIFY](docs/VERIFY.md) | | DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 | Desktop 壳 | 未验证：换包/关窗组 6 条为不适用，桌面流程未跑 | — | | DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.4 / 0.2.2-alpha.2 | 任意 | 未验证，selfcheck 会标未验证 | — | | 其它 0.2.x | 任意 | 允许应用，但先跑 `purge diagnose` 看漂移 | — | `package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 与宿主启动检查会拦下 0.3.x 及更早的 0.2.1-rc.0；未验证版本想强装，用宿主的 `dsh plugin --profile allow-version --accept-risk`（豁免不随升级继承）。 ## 面板与 CLI 左侧栏 **Purge**：状态（版本/宿主/补丁计数/逐层证据，按需展开）、提示词正文、规则与技能、更多（诊断与重锚、预设安装）。备份与回滚只走 CLI：`purge backup` / `purge rollback `。 `purge` 是 `bin/community.js` 的别名，常用命令： | 命令 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `purge status` / `selfcheck [--json]` | 宿主与补丁概况 / 20 层逐层证据（broken → 退出码 1） | | `purge apply` / `revert` | 写补丁 / 撤补丁（都先备份，幂等） | | `purge diagnose` / `reanchor …` | 锚点漂移诊断 / 半自动重锚 | | `purge probe [new]` | 运行时注入探针（30 分钟 TTL） | | `purge backup` / `rollback ` / `usage` / `prune` | 快照 / 回滚 / 占用 / 清理 | 完整表见 [AGENTS.md §3](AGENTS.md)。 ## 更新策略 **升级不由插件自己做**：面板不联网检查版本，也不下载替换包——这是当前架构的约定（宿主统一管理插件生命周期）。 - 市场/索引安装的：由 DSH 插件市场或 `dsh plugin --profile update` 升级，升级后重新「应用」并重启。 - tgz 手工安装的：换新版本 tgz 重装；本包在 `pluginManager.listVersions` 里属 `not-updatable`，这是预期。 - 每次宿主升级后 `asar` 会重新封住、旧补丁全部失效：点一次「应用」再退出重开。 ## 生效证明 ```sh purge probe new # → {"nonce":"purge-1a2b3c4d","message":"请原样输出下面这行…[purge-1a2b3c4d]"} ``` 模型原样回显 nonce = 注入链路通；回显了但仍在推脱 = 人设/强化段问题；不回显 = 注入没到（查注入层、`boost`、`injectPosition`）。 ## 开发与测试 ```sh pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --allow-build=esbuild # 面板构建需要 esbuild 的二进制 pnpm test # 449 项：补丁锚点、自检、安装器、HTTP、面板契约、回归 pnpm run smoke # 打包后：无依赖启动、模块导入、预设解析、status pnpm run check:docs # 版本/兼容声明/残留引用一致性 pnpm run test:ui # 面板客户端 bundle 契约 pnpm run build:client # 改面板源码后重建 bundle ``` 测试在干净环境跑：`scripts/bootstrap-install.mjs` 只在没有显式 home 时才继承 `DSH_PROFILE`，避免把当前会话的 profile 泄漏进 fixture。真机验收（Electron、换包）另用隔离实例，不拿组件测试冒充。 CI 在 `.github/workflows/ci.yml`（Node 22/24 矩阵：`check:docs` → 面板 bundle 校验 → 面板契约 → 533 项测试 → 打包并断言包里不含 `docs/upstream/`）；`release.yml` 在 `v*.*.*` tag 上重复同一套检查、打包并建 release，带 fork 保险丝。 ## 文档地图 | 文件 | 给谁看 | | --- | --- | | [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) | 在 DSH 里干活的 agent：CLI、症状树、补丁表、维护规则 | | [docs/INSTALLATION.md](docs/INSTALLATION.md) | 安装、升级、回滚、故障定位 | | [docs/STATE.md](docs/STATE.md) | 27 条补丁明细、20 层自检语义、已知限制 | | [docs/VERIFY.md](docs/VERIFY.md) | 逐宿主验收证据（可复查的命令与输出） | | [docs/RUNBOOK.md](docs/RUNBOOK.md) | 运维：重启、体检、恢复决策 | | [docs/upstream](docs/upstream) | 上游历史资料原样归档，仅作溯源 | ## 许可与免责 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)；第三方归属见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)；贡献者见 [CONTRIBUTORS.md](CONTRIBUTORS.md)。本发行版免费，不提供付费转售。宿主补丁会修改 DSH 安装目录下的源码副本并替换归档，属于侵入式操作：应用前请确认你接受这一代价，并保留快照。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Purge 界面 独立的 DSH 桌面端界面插件。官方 `dsh-purge` 提供功能和数据接口；`dsh-purge-panel` 提供右侧入口、设置布局及由插件生命周期管理的旧入口隐藏样式。它不写入官方包、不复制后端补丁、不安装会话钩子，也不自动应用或恢复补丁。 ## 使用 先安装、启用官方 dsh-purge，再安装本包。右侧栏的「＋ → Purge」打开设置。也可以从本插件的配置入口打开。 两个插件独立更新：更新官方 Purge 不会替换本包中的界面文件。禁用本插件后，官方原有入口会重新显示，官方配置和数据不会删除。迁移前的 `dsh-purge@1.1.71-local.*` 是旧的内嵌界面版本，请先换回官方原版，以免重复注册右侧标签。 ## 兼容范围 实测 DSH 桌面版当前安装环境与官方 Purge 1.1.71。界面通过 `/dsh-purge/*`、原演练台 `/redteam/api` 使用现有接口；服务不可用或版本未经验证时，会显示提示。官方未来改变接口或入口 class 名时，本插件可能需要适配，不能承诺永久兼容。 隐藏旧入口只使用 `.dshp-launch`、`.dshp-hero-chip`、`.dshp-tab-chip`、`.dshp-dock` 四个 CSS 选择器。样式由插件加载生命周期直接挂到文档 head，不依赖设置页或 shell.overlay 是否渲染；禁用插件时只清理自身创建的样式节点。没有全局 DOM 扫描、猴子补丁、加载器劫持或对官方安装文件的重写。官方自身的隐藏组件及扫描逻辑仍由官方运行；独立界面不能在不侵入官方实现的情况下去掉它们。 界面使用独立的 `dshpp-` 类名和 locale 命名空间，防止官方 CSS 更新串样式。切换分类保持未保存草稿；刷新状态不重写草稿。已访问分类保持挂载。 ## 来源与维护 界面部分派生自 YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge 1.1.71，版权归原作者，MIT 许可证见 LICENSE。独立界面并非官方发布。本地适配仅调整展示与入口，不修改提示词、安全策略、模型行为或后端能力。 当前独立版本：1.1.2。源码位于 src/，client.js 是自动生成的安装产物，禁止手工编辑；index.js 是无副作用的宿主入口，cordis.patch.yml 只注册本插件自身。 ## 1.0.1 修复 - 初次读取完成前禁止编辑，避免慢响应覆盖刚输入的内容。 - 保存中的新输入保留为未保存草稿，旧保存响应不会覆盖它；重复保存合并为一次请求。 - 文本保存统一采用超时和 HTTP 状态检查，失败后保留内容并恢复保存按钮。 - 兼容提示复用状态页数据，刷新时一起更新，避免重复状态请求。 - 授权状态同步纳入插件生命周期，禁用时清理重试。 - 增加异步竞态、HTTP 500、超时恢复与模块加载无副作用测试。 本轮不是对上游补丁、演练台或所有第三方依赖的全面安全审计。未来上游 API / 入口选择器变化仍需适配。 ## 1.1.0 模块化 - `src/entry.js`：DSH 注册与生命周期。 - `src/api/`：请求、超时、HTTP 错误和旧路由兼容。 - `src/state/`：侧栏状态、授权读取和当前工作区的只读订阅。 - `src/components/`：设置页、规则、技能、状态和对话框。 - `src/shared/`：语言、版本判断和公共 React 导出。 - `src/styles/`：可直接编辑的 CSS。 - `src/vendor/drill.js`：保留的上游演练台，仅隔离模块；不代表已完成其功能审计。 清理独立界面中未启用的旧回退/续写、悬浮窗定位、发送挂件副本及其样式；官方插件原有行为未改变。规则页直接读取当前会话目录，切换会话会刷新，迟到的旧请求不会覆盖新状态。技能接口只在 404/405 时回退到旧路由；500 或格式错误不会重发可能已经执行的写入。 开发时运行 `npm ci --ignore-scripts --legacy-peer-deps`、`npm run build`、`npm test`。CI 检查源码与提交的构建产物一致，测试不会修改真实配置。源码模块化不等于整个上游已无缺陷，后续按模块逐项验证。 ## 1.1.2 修复 旧入口的隐藏样式不再依赖 shell.overlay 内的 React style 节点。即使关闭或切换页面导致 overlay 不渲染，旧悬浮按钮和旧面板仍保持隐藏；停止本界面插件后按生命周期恢复。回归覆盖 overlay 完全不渲染、挂载后卸载及插件清理，不改动官方插件文件、提示词或个人设置。

本仓库 [youki258/dsh-ungate](https://github.com/youki258/dsh-ungate) 只做减法与重写：去掉工具面与历史调试入口、去掉在线自更新、补丁表压到 27 条、文档收敛为单一事实。**不是上游作者的官方发布**，也不代表社区分支的立场。 --- ## 它做什么 | 层 | 内容 | 生效方式 | | --- | --- | --- | | 宿主补丁 | 27 条定义，web 面 21 条落地、6 条仅桌面壳适用 | 点「应用」→ **完全退出 DSH 再打开** | | 运行时提示词 | 每步重贴的注入正文（`$DSH_HOME/prompt-inject.md`） | 立即 | | 强化段 | 尾部 section，默认开启 | 立即 | | 权限配置 | `danger-full-access` + `approval: ask`（由你决定是否改） | 重载后 | | agent 预设 | `unrestricted`，standard 的超集，只改人格 | 新会话下拉选择 | 它**不改**你的提示词正文、规则集、其他插件配置；**不替**你判断目标归属、不做内容审核、不做公网门禁——范围由操作者自己声明。 "应用"只写宿主源码副本并留备份；磁盘写成功 ≠ 当前进程已加载。所有"已生效"的结论都以重开后的 `selfcheck` 与探针为准。 ## 安装 三种入口任选其一，装完的生效步骤相同（应用 → 完全退出重开 → 自证）。 **方式一：官方 CLI + 固定版本 tgz（推荐）** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/youki258/dsh-ungate/releases/download/v0.2.2/dsh-ungate-0.2.2.tgz ``` **方式二：npm 包**（发布到 npm registry 的同名包） ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ungate@0.2.2 ``` **方式三：社区引导安装器**（备份迁移、旧包换装；先 `--dry-run` 审阅再执行） ```sh sh scripts/install.sh --dry-run # Linux/macOS pwsh scripts/install.ps1 -DryRun # Windows ``` **装完生效（三种方式相同）** ```sh node bin/community.js apply # 面板点「应用」等价；写宿主源码副本并留备份 # 完全退出 DSH（托盘退出 / ⌘Q，不是关窗口）再打开，然后自证： node bin/community.js selfcheck --json # state=ok、broken 为空 node bin/community.js probe new # 发一句话看模型是否原样回显 nonce ``` - Desktop 用户把 `--profile web` 换成实际 profile 名（桌面壳默认 `desktop`）。 - **升级**：本包在插件管理器里属 `not-updatable`（预期行为），换新版本重新 `plugin add` 一次即可，配置与提示词不受影响；每次宿主升级后 `asar` 重新封住，点一次「应用」再退出重开。 - **卸载**：`node bin/community.js uninstall`（只清理本 home 内插件目录与链接，不动提示词、规则集、其他插件配置）。 - 细节与失败排查见 [安装指南](docs/INSTALLATION.md)；桌面壳验收见 [桌面测试卡](docs/DESKTOP-TEST.md)。 ## 兼容矩阵 只写有实测证据的组合；没测过的版本不猜。 | 宿主 | 面 | 结果 | 证据 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.1 / rc.2 / rc.3 / rc.5 | Desktop + Web | 已验证 | 锚点命中、apply、selfcheck 全绿 | | DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 | Web / npm CLI | 已验证（apply 20 条 + 自检 19/19 适用层） | 隔离实例，见 [VERIFY](docs/VERIFY.md) | | DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 | Desktop 壳 | 未验证：换包/关窗组 6 条为不适用，桌面流程未跑 | — | | DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.4 / 0.2.2-alpha.2 | 任意 | 未验证，selfcheck 会标未验证 | — | | 其它 0.2.x | 任意 | 允许应用，但先跑 `purge diagnose` 看漂移 | — | `package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 与宿主启动检查会拦下 0.3.x 及更早的 0.2.1-rc.0；未验证版本想强装，用宿主的 `dsh plugin --profile allow-version --accept-risk`（豁免不随升级继承）。 ## 面板与 CLI 左侧栏 **Purge**：状态（版本/宿主/补丁计数/逐层证据，按需展开）、提示词正文、规则与技能、更多（诊断与重锚、预设安装）。备份与回滚只走 CLI：`purge backup` / `purge rollback `。 `purge` 是 `bin/community.js` 的别名，常用命令： | 命令 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `purge status` / `selfcheck [--json]` | 宿主与补丁概况 / 20 层逐层证据（broken → 退出码 1） | | `purge apply` / `revert` | 写补丁 / 撤补丁（都先备份，幂等） | | `purge diagnose` / `reanchor …` | 锚点漂移诊断 / 半自动重锚 | | `purge probe [new]` | 运行时注入探针（30 分钟 TTL） | | `purge backup` / `rollback ` / `usage` / `prune` | 快照 / 回滚 / 占用 / 清理 | 完整表见 [AGENTS.md §3](AGENTS.md)。 ## 更新策略 **升级不由插件自己做**：面板不联网检查版本，也不下载替换包——这是当前架构的约定（宿主统一管理插件生命周期）。 - 市场/索引安装的：由 DSH 插件市场或 `dsh plugin --profile update` 升级，升级后重新「应用」并重启。 - tgz 手工安装的：换新版本 tgz 重装；本包在 `pluginManager.listVersions` 里属 `not-updatable`，这是预期。 - 每次宿主升级后 `asar` 会重新封住、旧补丁全部失效：点一次「应用」再退出重开。 ## 生效证明 ```sh purge probe new # → {"nonce":"purge-1a2b3c4d","message":"请原样输出下面这行…[purge-1a2b3c4d]"} ``` 模型原样回显 nonce = 注入链路通；回显了但仍在推脱 = 人设/强化段问题；不回显 = 注入没到（查注入层、`boost`、`injectPosition`）。 ## 开发与测试 ```sh pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --allow-build=esbuild # 面板构建需要 esbuild 的二进制 pnpm test # 449 项：补丁锚点、自检、安装器、HTTP、面板契约、回归 pnpm run smoke # 打包后：无依赖启动、模块导入、预设解析、status pnpm run check:docs # 版本/兼容声明/残留引用一致性 pnpm run test:ui # 面板客户端 bundle 契约 pnpm run build:client # 改面板源码后重建 bundle ``` 测试在干净环境跑：`scripts/bootstrap-install.mjs` 只在没有显式 home 时才继承 `DSH_PROFILE`，避免把当前会话的 profile 泄漏进 fixture。真机验收（Electron、换包）另用隔离实例，不拿组件测试冒充。 CI 在 `.github/workflows/ci.yml`（Node 22/24 矩阵：`check:docs` → 面板 bundle 校验 → 面板契约 → 533 项测试 → 打包并断言包里不含 `docs/upstream/`）；`release.yml` 在 `v*.*.*` tag 上重复同一套检查、打包并建 release，带 fork 保险丝。 ## 文档地图 | 文件 | 给谁看 | | --- | --- | | [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) | 在 DSH 里干活的 agent：CLI、症状树、补丁表、维护规则 | | [docs/INSTALLATION.md](docs/INSTALLATION.md) | 安装、升级、回滚、故障定位 | | [docs/STATE.md](docs/STATE.md) | 27 条补丁明细、20 层自检语义、已知限制 | | [docs/VERIFY.md](docs/VERIFY.md) | 逐宿主验收证据（可复查的命令与输出） | | [docs/RUNBOOK.md](docs/RUNBOOK.md) | 运维：重启、体检、恢复决策 | | [docs/upstream](docs/upstream) | 上游历史资料原样归档，仅作溯源 | ## 许可与免责 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)；第三方归属见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)；贡献者见 [CONTRIBUTORS.md](CONTRIBUTORS.md)。本发行版免费，不提供付费转售。宿主补丁会修改 DSH 安装目录下的源码副本并替换归档，属于侵入式操作：应用前请确认你接受这一代价，并保留快照。
